tei:div.tei:p: byaḥ/bka'agu/ //shā chi/hā sbya 7717shā 0'aḥcuXng060jib jing 505533 7 bci kho zhugaX 50 yokhog

༄7/ /snyan dgon sprul sku gsung rab mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum legs bshad nor sna'i snang ba bzhugs/mgo log khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang gis 'tshol sdud dag sgrig byas/si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /
tsho ———4)rwasnos khe (sne cho khangardo

dkar chagabastod 31gas phyogs bsdus/ (1)dpal ldan bla ma dam par bstod pa/ (3)ston pa thub pa'i dbang por bstod pa/ (5)rgyan drug mchog gnyis la bstod pa/ (11)o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po pad+ma sam+bha wa la bstod pa/ (14)rje btsun tsong kha par bstod smon/ (32)gsang chen snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa la bstod pa/ (37)ri bo dge ldan pa'i rang lugs dri med rtogs brjod/ (43)drang nges rnam 'byed la bstod pa/ (48)gzungs kyi rnam bshad la bstod pa/ (57)rje btsun sgro la ma la bstod pa/ (59)rgya yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bstod pa/ (63)grub chen dpal rga lo ba la bstod pa/ (66)chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa la bstod pa/ (68)yab rje tsong kha pa la bstod pa/ (72)rje btsun bla ma dam pa la bstod pa/ (77)gsang bdag mi 'gyur rdo rje'i bstod pa/ (86)1

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/sgrolabastod 'ga' zhig (91)sa chen bsod nams rtse mo la bstod pa/ (96)sa chen kun dga' snying po la bstod pa/ (99)spyod 'jug la bstod pa/ (103)spyan ras gzigs kyi gsol 'debs/ (107)mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus/ (117)zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ (157)dge sgrub sdig spang gi gtam thos pa don ldan/ (281)zlos gar gyi skor tsho/ — (287)zlos gar gyi bstan bcos lha yi sil snyan/ (289)dge bar skul ba'i gtam/ (295)blo gsal khu byug gi rtogs brjod/ (311)chab shog gi skor tsho/ (343)rgya'i hwa shang rdo rje bdud 'joms la springs pa'i zhu yig (344)lha ldan du rje btsun 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros la phul ba/ (349)sgra tshad zung du 'brel bar dpyad pa'i sa bon rigs pa'i 'khor lo/ (377)bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ (391)2
da nga

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/tshog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la bstod pa don zab gsal byed dbang po rdo rje'i phreng ba/khog /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bka' drin mtshungs med de yi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrib gnyis zhi ba'i dbyings nyid gzigs/ /mi shigs ting 'dzin ri bzhin brjid/ /zhi bsil khrims kyi gzi byin 'dzin/ /rig 'dzin 'di ni snying gi dpyid/ /phul byung lung kun gzungs su bzung / /gzhung lugs bcud 'dus thugs su chud/ /bdud thul sku gsum lhun grub tu/ /klu sgrub lugs mtshungs zung 'jug grub/ /theg chen bshes gnyen 'dren byed dpe/ /brjed med bsten te sems bskyed de/ /mkhyen brtse bde chen ye shes brnyes / /bde gshegs khyed bzhed dpe med dge /nyon mongs stobs gnon sdom brtson khyod/ /'gro don spyod mchog yongs rdzogs mtshon/ /'gro mgon dkon mchog ngo bo dngos/ /kho bo drongs mdzod slob dpon mchog /dpal ldan rgyal ba thams cad dang / /rab mnyam bla ma dam pa la/ /bya dka' snyan dngags rgyan dag las/ /dad pas bsngags nas phyag 'tshal na/ /da nas gnas skabs thams cad la/ /bla ma dam par 'phrad pa dang / /dga' ldan bstan dang mjal ba 3

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/—dang / /bslab pa rnams la rab gnas 'tshal/ /mya ngan 'das la rab dad nas/ /bsam pa dag pas pham lhag bcas/ /bya ba ngan pa dang bral nas/ /tshangs spyod gtsang mas 'da' bar 'tshal bsam gtan mtha' dang bral ba rab brtan pas/ /snang ba dgag tsam ma lags dpyad pa na/ /zab yangs mkha' ltar mnyam la mnyam bzhag nas / /gang snang bag chags bslad pa spang bar 'tshal/ /dpyad pas mkha' la skra shad snang 'dra yang / /ma brtags nyams dga' tsam la dkar nag las/ /'ja' ltar bkra bas spang blang la mkhas nas/ /rang gzhan 'tshang rgya bar yang yang yang 'tshal/ /ces dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la zlos gar dang bya dka'i sgo nas bstod pa don zab gsal byed dbang po rdo rje'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal bo de nyid kyi bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba rig byed kyi lung gis/ 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros tshangs sras snyems pa'i sde ru 'bod pa'i ban+de dharma sā ras zhing dam pa la dmigs pa'i phan yon chen po sdud pa'i slad du bsgrigs pa dge legs 'phel/ /4

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/dze /ston pa thub pa'i dbang por bstod cing smon lam du bya ba dad pa'i me tog g.yo ba'i dri bsung /na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ /rab yangs mi mjed snod kyi pad+ma gling bzhi'i 'dab ma bye ba brgyas/ /nye bar bkra ba'i zhing mchog 'dir ni skal ldan lha mi'i bung ba'i khyu/ /bye ba khrag khrig grangs kyis mi mtshon dam chos sbrang rtsi'i mgron chen por/ /rgyu med par yang byams pas 'bod pa'i ston pa mtshungs med khyod nyid mchod/ /'khor los bsgyur ba rtsibs kyi mu khyud dang / /de sras stong sogs theg mchog rigs skyes rnams/ /ting 'dzin rnam par 'phrul bas yongs snang ba'i / /bzang bo'i zhing rnams yongs su bzung ba'i mod/ /mgon khyod snyigs ma lnga bdos ches mnar ba'i/ /rtsod ldan nyam thag gdul bya yongs gzigs te/ /thugs rje chen pos dus mthar 'tshang rgya ba'i//smon lam chen pos 'gran zla bral gyur pa/ /ji ltar me tog sna tshogs phan tshun du/ /'gran pa lta bu'i skyed mos tshal rnams na/ /kun nas mdzes pa pad+ma dkar bo ni/ /lta na sdug pas ches cher bsngags pa ltar / /rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba'i mdun sa na/ /rlabs chen spyod la 'jug pa'i rgyal sras dang / /dpa' chen snying stobs rdzogs pa'i 5

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/skyes mchog khyod/ /bde gshegs kun gyis mgrin gcig bstod par gyur / /de lta lags na mgon khyod kyis/ /bya dka'i spyod pas nyer bsgrub pa'i/ /bstan pa rin chen mchog 'di dang / /bsod nams chen pos yongs mjal te/ /ston pa mtshungs pa med pa khyod/ /bdag cag mgon du thob lags na/ /sems yod su zhig snying nas ni/ /rjes su dran te bstod mi bgyid/ /mgon khyod sku ni gser gyi mchod sdong gis/ /thun mtshams sprin gyi bla gos 'dzin pa ltar/ /dag cing gsal la mdzes pa'i ngur smrig gi /rnam gsum chos gos sor bzhis ma reg gsol/ /gang la mnga' ba skyes bu khyu mchog tu/ /mtshon pa'i mtshan nyid yal ga rdzogs pa'i rtser/ /nang gi yon tan ngom pa'i dpe byad grangs/ /bcu phrag brgyad kyi me tog mdzes par rgod/ /'dom gang 'od kyis khor yug yongs 'khyud pa'i/ /thub dbang zhal gyi pad+mo 'dzum pa'i zer/ /mnar med nas bzung srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar/ /lan re 'phros pas srid zhi'i rgyad pa 'joms/ /'dod khams bdag pos bdud sde bye ba'i dpung / /sbran te rgol ba byams pas yongs mnan te/ /sa chen dpang du gsol ba'i phyag rgya la/ /sa yi lha mos legs so'i skyes chen phul/ /chos dbyings spros pas dben pa'i gzigs mo la/ /ro gcig zhugs pa'i mnyam bzhag phyag stangs kyis/ /6

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/chos rnams kun gyi snying po'i de bzhin nyid/ /zhi bsil bdud rtsi khyod nyid kho nas bzhes/ /rtsibs stong rnam bkra'i 'khor los legs mtshon pa'i/ /bkra shis zhabs zung gang du bkod pa der/ /'dab mdzes me tog rgod pa'i zhabs gnyis ni/ /pad zla'i gdan la skyil mo krung gis rol/ /mgon khyod gsung gi dkyil 'khor ni/ /rnam par rtog pas mi bskyod bzhin/ /lhun grub ba spu'i khung res kyang / /tshangs dbyangs gdangs kyis dam chos ston/ /gang zhig bzhed pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha klu mi dang mi 'am ci/ /dri za la sogs skal ldan 'khor / /lcags kyus drangs bzhin 'dus pa yi/ /gdul bya'i rigs dang mos ngo bzhin/ /dpag med sgra skad sna tshogs kyis/ /gang la gang gis 'dul ba'i chos/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med sogs/ /snyan zhing 'jebs par 'doms mdzad phyir/ /don du mi 'gyur ma mchis pa'i/ /gsung mchog rnam pa thams cad pa/ /lha yi rnga bzhin khyod la mnga'/ /khyod thugs spros pa med pa'i rdzing bu la/ /kun rtog 'khrud pa'i khrus kyis brel bzhin du/ /spros pas dub pa'i rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba la/ /byams brtse'i sman gyis byug pa ring bsten pas/ /da lta gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i g.ya' tsam yang / /yongs dag rab dkar stobs bcu'i glang bo che/ gzugs sku rin chen rgyan gyis nyer spras te//7

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/lhun grub 'phrin las 'khor lo'i 'gros kyis brjid/ /e ma zag med dbyings su spros pa'i rdul/ /gcig tsam mi gzigs nam mkha' lta bu'i thugs/ /ji snyed spros pa'i rnam pa ma 'dres par/ /so sor gzigs pa'i ngo bor skyes pa ni/ /mi 'gal 'gal ba lta bu'i ye shes kyis / /kun khyab khyab bdag chen po khyod kyi skus/ /kun gzigs gzigs pa'i ye shes de kho na/ /ma dag dag pa'i gdul byar sku ru snang / /de slad ba spu'i khung bu gcig gis kyang / /mtha' yas shes bya gzigs shing 'doms pa dang / /ye shes skad cig gcig kyang mtshan dang dpe'i/ /sgyu ma'i lang tshor rdzogs pa khyod 'ba' zhig /de slad phyogs bcu'i zhing du mngon shes lngas/ /sa chen rdul snyed bskal bar btsal na yang / /nyes zad yon tan rdzogs pa khyod las gzhan/ /ma rnyed mi rnyed rnyed par mi 'gyur bas/ /bdag ni deng nas srid pa'i phyi mtha'i bar/ /skye dang skye ba rnams su bde gshegs khyod/ /nor bu'i cod pan lta bur gces spras kyis/ /spyi bo'i rgyan du 'bral med 'dzin par shog /gang tshe yan lag mchog gis nyer btud de/ /thub dbang zhabs kyi pad+ma 'dzin pa'i tshe/ /de yi 'gro 'dul 'phrin las 'bum gyi gtso/ /gsung mchog chos sgo dpag med thos par shog /thos pa'i mod la blo gros 'khrul ba'i rnyog /tshangs dbyangs gsung gi 8

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/ke ta kus bgrungs te/ /shes bya'i snang tshul 'dab stong 'dzum pa dang / /lhan cig gnas lugs sbrang rtsi myong bar shog /chos kyi dbyings su chos can 'khor 'das kyis/ /bzang ngan spyod pa'i rdzun phug rdib pa yi/ /'od gsal sems kyi ltad mo brgyas brel te/ /kun rtog srid pa'i g.yang sa chod par shog /med pa ma yin las tshul bsam yas kyis/ /bris pa'i rnam smin ri mo ches bkra zhing / /yod do zhes kyang rab rib can bzhin du/ /gtad so med pa'i chos sku mthong bar shog /bzang ngan rkyen gyis ma bcos rang byung bab/ /blos byas stong ba tsam du mi 'khrul bar/ /'khor 'das chos rnams zhen med ro gcig rgyas/ /btab ste 'khor ba'i lam chen 'gags par shog /rang nyid zhi bar chas tsam ma yin par/ /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes rol ba che/ /'khor 'das kun la khyab pa'i 'phrin las kyis/ /mkha' khyab rgyal ba kun dang dgongs mnyam shog /de srid du yang skye ba'i me tog phreng / /tshul khrims sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyis legs gtams te/ /rgyal ba mnyes pa'i mchod sprin du gyur nas/ /yon tan dri bsung cir yang 'phro bar shog /thog med nas goms nyes brgya'i gzhi gcig pu/ /rang nyid gces par 'dzin pa'i phung byed bdud/ /byams dang snying rje'i rigs sngags kyis btul te/ /theg mchog bgrod pa kho nas 'gro 9

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bar shog /mdor na ji srid byang chub bar de srid/ /theg pa mchog gi chos dang chos smra ba/ /srog la thug kyang yal bar mi 'dor bar/ /snying stobs chen pos rtag tu 'dzin par shog /ces ston pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po la bstod cing smon lam du bya ba dad pa'i me tog g.yo ba'i dri bsung zhes bya ba 'di ni/rtsod bral gyi grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rig 'dzin 'ja' lus rdo rje'i thugs zin gyi sras kyi thu bo mdo shul 'jigs med 'od zer gyi sprul ba'i sku pad+ma dkar bo'i gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs te/rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs mi yi sha tshugs su phebs pa'i rje btsun bla ma/ 7 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros dpal bzang bo'i bka' drin gyis gzhung lugs du ma la dpyod pa'i sgo thob pa/ blo bzang mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtshos gus pas bstod tshigs su bsgrigs pa dge legs 'phel/ / 10

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/༄ga /rgyan drug mchog gnyis la bstod pa/na mo gu ru mañdzu sto ṣā ya swa ra swa sbyi/ gzod nas nyes pa'i rnam dag sems kyi mkhar/ /mkhyen brtse'i chu 'dzin phung bos rab gtams pas/ /bgrang yas lus can dga' ba'i chos kyi char/ /'bebs mdzad shākya seṅge de la 'dud/ /de sras rgyal ba rang gi gsung gsang gis/ /yod med mthar 'dzin gzhig la lung bstan bzhin/ /zab bshad bdud rtsi'i 'od kyi mgrin pa can/ /dngos med smra ba'i zla ba klu yi dbang / /de yi zab don legs bshad ga bur zer/ /snying dbus kun+dha'i ze'u 'brur smin pa las/ /ma khol lta grub dbang med 'dor ba yi/ /yum don dri bsung ster ba'i 'phags pa lha/ /rgya chen brtson pas ma pham sgrub pa las/ /sbas don gsal byed lnga phrag chos kyi skyes/ /theg mchog bstan pa'i gsos su 'dzin mkhas pa'i/ /'od byed sar gnas 'phags pa thogs med zhabs/ /chos mngon rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' gzigs pa'i spyan/ /gang la mnga' bas kun mkhyen gnyis pa zhes/ /grags pa sa gsum skye dgu'i rna rgyan du/ /gdags mdzad yon tan phung bo dbyig gi gnyen/ /sbyang ba'i yon tan bcu gnyis khyim gyi gzhir/ /rtag tu gnas bzhin 'chad rtsod 11

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rtsom pa'i 'od/ /smra ngan khron pa skem la chas pa yi/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs kyi glang bo'i zhabs/ /rigs pa'i seṅge'i lus stobs rab brtas nas/ /rtag chad phyogs lhung mu stegs gnyis 'thung 'bum/ /yang dag lam du bkri ba'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba chos kyi grags/ /bstan rtsa tshul khrims bsil khang dam pa'i gzhir / /'dul ba rgya mtsho'i legs bshad zla ba'i zer/ /thub bstan kun nas mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig tu/ /byed po rnam sad sras po mchog gnyis zhabs/ /de ltar lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyis/ /'dzam gling mdzes ba'i rgyan du yongs gyur pa'i/ /ma smad shākya'i sras po khyed rnams la/ /snying nas gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam dag bstan pa'i nyi mar mjal ba'i dus/ /'dzin 'dod yid kyi me tog ldem gyur pas/ /'gal rkyen sprin gyi yol ba mi 'jug cing / /lung rtogs 'od zer snying la gsal bar shog /rgya chen thos pa'i g.yu ral rab rgyas shing / /bsam pa'i lus stobs rab tu rdzogs gyur te/ /mi rtog sgom pa'i gangs can la gnas pa'i/ /thub bstan 'dzin la dpa' ba'i mthu thob shog /rnam gsum sde snod 'chad pa'i sbrang rtsi'i mgrin / /lung rigs gad rgyangs sgrogs la mi 'jigs shing / /legs bshad rtsom pa'i dri bsung 'bum 'gyed pas/ /thub bstan gsal 12

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/ba'i sgron mer bdag 'gyur shog /rnam dag bstan la spyod pa rnam dkar tshogs/ /mkha' mnyam skye dgu srid zhi las bsgral nas/ /bla med byang chub snying por 'god pa'i ched/ /ji ltar smon bzhin 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces rgyan drug mchog gnyis la bstod pa nyung bsdus 'di ni/ sa gsum 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba'i gangs can bstan pa'i sgron me chos kyi rje/ 'jam dpal snying bo'i lugs bzang gser gyi cod pan spyi bor 'dregs pa ban chung 'jam dpal dgyes pa zhes bya bas/ gnas mchog dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil ba'i ri ngos nas lhag bsam dag pas bris pa'o/ /

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/༄gi /yo rgyan chos kyi rgyal po pad+ma sam+bha wa la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/༄sto /dpal ldan chos dbyings nam mkha'i ngos la nyes pa'i chu 'dzin dag pa'i khams/ /kun gzigs mkhyen brtse nyi zla'i snang ba zung 'brel 'char nub med pa'i mdangs/ /'ja' lus sdo rje'i sku ru mngon bzhengs rang snang longs sku'i rgyal srid dang / /lhan cig sgyu 'phrul dra bas rnam rol rgyal dbang mtsho skyes rdo rjer 'dud/ /gang gi sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las kyi/ /bla med gsang bas mkha' dbyings la 'khyud cing / khyad par bsil ljongs bsod nams rgyan gyur pa'i/ /rnam thar bka' drin gzhal du med pa'i tshul/ /rgya mtsho che las snyim pa'i chu bzhin du/ /dad gus me tog gsar ba'i rtser bkod de/ /bstod tshig dri bzang blo ldan bung ba'i yid/ /'gug pa'i mchod pa'i sprin 'dis rnam par mchod/ /mgon po khyod kyi sku yi gsang ba mi shigs 'od lnga'i rang mdangs zer/ /kun rtog sprin gyi sgrib byed zad pa'i 'od gsal rang snang ye shes sku/ /'pho ba chen po'i rgyal srid mchog la rtag tu g.yo ba med bzhugs pas/ /skye gnas rnam bzhis bsdus pa min na khyod sku ji ltar brdzus te skyes/ /rdo rje'i 14

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/tshig don rtogs dka' tshul bzhi'i rgyan/ /ma rtogs nying 'khrul byis pa'i blo gros kyis/ /mkha' dbyings rdul dmar rum du nyin byed gzi//gsal ba min ltar khyod kyi gsang ba bslad/ /khams drug 'dus pa'i mi gtsang gong bu dang / /dwangs pa'i rdul du grub pa'i lus spangs shing —/ /gzugs snang nye bar bkag pa'i snyoms 'jug gis/ /re zhig chags bral mdzad pa'ang ma yin te/ /bag la nyal gyi tshang tshing 'khrigs pa yi/ /kun rtog sems su grub pa'i phra ba'i lus/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong dang bdag med pa'i/ khyad par 'dzin pa'i sgyu ma ring du spangs/ /'gro 'ong la sogs kun rtog spros pa'i cha mi dmigs mkha' dbyings gzhal med khang nyid du/ /rnam thar bsam mi khyab pas rol ba yi/ /ye shes sku yi gsang ba rgya mtsho'i rdul/ /grangs med bskal bar bdag nyid che rnams kyis/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtshos bgrangs na yang / /grangs su mtshon min dpe zla rnyed min na/ /byis blos 'jal 'dod ngal ba kho nar zad/ /'on kyang dwangs pa'i yid kyi rdzing bu ru/ /khyod sku'i gzugs brnyan gsal bar bkod pa yi/ /dad pa'i legs byas mchog thun grub pa'i nor/ /'gug pa'i lcags gyur nges slad ri mor byed/ /'og min zhing du rang snang longs spyod rdzogs/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos 15

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bzhin / /phyogs bcur khyod sprul longs sku'i ston 'khor zhing / lnga ldan snang ba mi 'gog lhun grub rgyan/ /'gro drug khams la thugs rjes rnam bkod pa'i/ /'gro 'dul sprul sku thub pa drug nyid kyang / /ji srid gdul bya'i skye bo ma zad pa/ /de srid rgyun mi chad pa'i rnam 'phrul ngom/ /de ltar sku gsum gsang ba bsam yas las/ /skal ldan mos ngor ngo mtshar rdo rje'i sku/ /skye 'chi bral ba'i go 'phang brnyes pa'i tshul/ /brda thabs kyis mtshon brdzus skyes sprul sku ni/ /yid 'phrog nges 'byung blo yi pad sdong rtser/ /dri med byang chub sems gnyis nyi zla la/ /bcu drug dga' ba'i bgrang bya rdzogs pa yi/ /bde stong dkar la dmar mdangs chags pa'i sku/ /ston dus mkha' la zla ba shar ba bzhin/ /dag pa'i rig 'dzin 'khor gyi rgyu skar nang / /gsal rdzogs mtshan dang dpe byad rab 'bar bzhin/ /lham me lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs pa yi/ /chos nyid ro gcig zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ni / /tshar gcod rjes 'dzin 'phrin las kun mdzad pa'i/ /rab 'byams zhi khro'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i brdar/ /khro 'dzum nyams kyis shin tu sgeg cing 'bar/ /gnag snum dri zhim ral ba'i lcang lo yis /sku stod sil bur khebs pa'i mdzes sdug can/ /dbu la rigs lnga'i dbang rtags rab rdzogs pa'i/ /'dab ldan mnyen zhu rdo rje'i tog 16

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/can la/ /chos nyid mkha' dbyings rtsal chen gyis gcod pa'i/ /theg mchog a ti mtshon pa'i bya rgyal sgro/ /'od lnga lhun grub dar snas bcings pa ni/ /zung 'jug rgyal srid mchog la dbang bsgyur brda/ /phyag g.yas thabs kyis mkha' la gsor ba yi/ /sku lnga lhun grub rdo rje rtse lnga bas/ /gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i gdon la bsdigs tsam gyis/ /snang srid dregs pa mtha' dag zil gyis gnon/ /g.yon pa shes rab mnyam bzhag phyag rgya yis/ /bde stong bhan+dhar gtsang me'i rtog spangs pa'i / /ye shes bdud rtsi lnga ldan tshe bum mchog /skye 'chi bgres rgyad bral ba'i rtags su bsnams/ /phyi ru nyan thos spyod pa skyong ba yi/ /gser mdog me tog ris bkra chos gos dang / /nang du gsang don rtogs pas myos pa yi/ /chos dbyings nam mkha'i mdangs 'dzin phod ka che/ /chags pa'i skyon bral bde chen pho nya'i lam/ /bsten pa'i brtul zhugs mtshon pa'i gsang gos dkar/ /phyi nang gnyis med gzhan phan theg pa che'i/ /zab ber 'dong ma rnams ni sku la gsol / /e yig mi 'gyur bde ba 'dren pa'i dpyid/ /sbas tshul kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor bsten pa yis/ /waṃ yig rnam kun mchog ldan stong ba dang //mnyam sbyor chos sku'i ston par zhal gyis bzhes/ /tshogs gnyis zab yangs 'o mtsho 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /'od lnga sku ru smin pa'i 'ja' tshon 17

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/zer / /dwangs ma'i kha dog lnga ldan zlum 'khrigs nang / /chos kyi rgyal po rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ /mtshan dpe'i sku mchog mchog tu mdzes pa'i ba spu'i khung res res mos ma yin par/ /dus gsum shes bya bya byed dang bcas mkhyen cing gsal ston ston pa khyod kyi sku/ /mtshan brgyad rnam rol rol ba mi zad srid pa'i mthar yang yang yang 'phrul ba yis/ /mngon mtho nges legs legs pa'i lam la lus can rab bkod bkod pa bsam mi khyab/ /de ltar khyod sku yid la legs bsgoms te/ /cung zad bstod pa'i dge legs 'od dkar gzis/ /las nyon 'khrul ba'i mun pa sangs gyur te/ /pad+ma 'od du khyod drung dbugs dbyung nas/ sprul ba'i zhal bzang mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar ba'i / /mthong grol sku mchog nor bu'i cod pan che/ /mngon sum mig gi bdud rtsir gyur ma thag /rab tu dga' ba'i sa mchog non gyur cig /o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba las sku la bstod pa'i skabs te dang po'o/ / ༄7/ /dbyings dang ye shes mnyam par sbyor ba yi/ /bde chen byang chub sems kyi rdo rje'i sku/ /grub pa'i slob dpon gzugs su rnam rol ba'i/ /pad+ma'i cod pan tshe rabs phreng ba'i rgyan/ /mi shigs rlung 18

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/gi rang mdangs rdo rje gsum gyi mdangs su nyer bkug pas/ /tha mal brjod pa'i rang bzhin brjod med chos kyi 'khor lor thim pa las/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan brjod med brjod pa'i rdo rje'i gsung dbyangs ni/ /tshangs dbyangs yan lag drug cus nyer mdzes skal bzang rna ba'i bdud rtsi che/ /byang chub chen pos mngon du mdzad nas ni / /legs par gsung bas yang dag blang ba dang / /phyogs re ma yin thugs rje chen po yis/ /sems can kun gyi dbang du mdzad pa dang —/ /re 'ga' tsam min dus gsum thams cad du/ /rgyun mi chad par 'jug pa nyid dang ni/ /chos la ser snas dpe mkhyud med pa yis / /dgongs don rab tu ldan pa nyid kyi gsung / /rang rang so so'i khams dang bsam pa dang / /'tsham par rab tu dbye ba nyid dang ni/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag lnga dang ldan pa yis/ /snyan la 'jebs pas khyad par 'phags pa'i rten/ /gsung gcig nyid kyis 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang / /'jig rten kun tu go bar mdzad pa nyid / /mtha' gnyis rnam par bsal ba'i don gyis ni/ /ji snyed gsungs pa dbu mar gdags pa'i ngang / /gdul bya dbang po smin pa'i dus nyid du/ /grol byed zab mo'i chos sgo 'byed pa dang / /gsung gi gdangs rer yan lag drug cu yi/ /yon tan yongs su 19

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'dzin pa nyid kyis na/ /legs par gsung ba'i khyad par rnam pa bcus / /legs par gsungs pa'i yon tan ldan pa yi/ /mgon po khyod gsung thos grol rin chen sgrom/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi nor bus gtams/ /de lta na yang skal bzang skye bo rnams/ /byang chub chen por bde blag 'jug pa'i thabs/ /theg mchog gser gyi them skas rnam pa dgu'i/ /man ngag chos kyi nying khu'i rgyal thabs kyis/ /bsil ljongs bsod nams skal ba sbom po ru/ /mdzad pa'i tshul 'dis yid rab 'phrog gyur te/ /khyod gsung snying la bcags pa'i rig 'dzin tshogs/ /grub gnyis dga' ston dpal gyis myos 'di rmad / /bden bzhi'i blang dor nyan thos theg pa dang / /rgyal ba'i gsung gi gces mdzod rten 'brel chos/ /rang rgyal theg pas thog mar nges 'byung blo/ /bslab gsum thar 'dod spyi yi btsas su gdams / /de nas theg pa chen po'i 'jug sgo mchog /byang chub sems dang spyod pa phyin drug gi /byang sems theg pas skal bzang mtha' dag gi /lam chen pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung shing btsugs/ /khyad par mthar thug 'bras ba'i bdag nyid kyis/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i myur lam 'dod pa la/ /dam tshig sgrub dang grub pa rnam gsum gyis/ /grub pa brgyad gyi gter kha khyod kyis phyes/ /sku gsung 20

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/thugs kyi rang bzhin lam byed pa'i/ /rnal 'byor gsum gyis rigs can rnam pa gsum/ /gsang ba mchog gi gnas su bkri ba yi/ /zla med rdo rje'i slob dpon khyod 'ba' zhig /rjod byed rnam pa kun ldan tshangs dbyangs gcig la 'gro ba so so'i sgra skad dang / /brjod bya rnam pa kun ldan dgongs don gcig la rang rang khams dang mthun pa'i chos/ /rab rdzogs rnam pa kun ldan gsung dbyangs gcig gi mi zad yon tan nor bu'i gter/ /mkhyen pa'i rnam pa kun ldan grangs med gcig gis gzhal kyang 'jal bar mi nus na/ /bdag 'dras brjod pa lta ci dran pa yang / /snying la 'jigs pa ster ba'i gnas yin mod/ /dad pa'i spu long g.yo ba'i mos gus kyis/ /rnam dpyod sor mos gsung gsang rnga chen bskul/ /de ltar khyod gsung cung zad bstod pa yis/ /sku gsum 'og min khang bzang nyams dga' bar/ /'khrid pa'i rdo rje'i gsung gi them skas cher/ /'jug pa'i blo gros lus rtsal rdzogs gyur te/ /khyod gsung rna bar lan gcig lhung ba'i mod/ /rim dgu'i theg pa'i rtogs rigs ga bur sman/ /bcud dril bde chen byang chub sems mchog gis/ /tshe 'dir sa bcu'i go 'phang gnon gyur cig /o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa / rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba las/ gsung la 21

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bstod pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o/ /༄gi /spros bral dbyings su mngon par byang chub pa'i/ /shin tu rmad byung rdo rje theg pa'i rtse/ /zung 'jug grub pa'i nor bus mngon 'phags pa/ /kun bzang pad+ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len/ /khyod thugs kun tu rtog pa'i rlabs kyis bskyod pa'i nyes brgya'i chu srin tshogs / /yongs su 'khrigs pas gtams pa'i bdag lta'i rgya mtsho zab la rngam gnag pa/ /gsang chen chos kyi bdud rtsi'i phabs kyis bran te 'od gsal dwangs pa'i klung / /gcig tu mdzad pa'i spros med rigs pa'i rgya mtsho mkha' dbyings snod du 'khyil/ /de tshe 'gro drug khams la rjes chags pa'i/ /thugs rje zhags pas khyod thugs rab bsdams pas/ /zhi ba phyogs rer lhung ba'i chad pa'i mtha'/ /khyod la rnam pa kun tu yod ma yin/ /mtshar sdug snang ba'i ltad mo'i dngos dgu'i gzugs/ /khyod thugs me long ngos su legs bkod kyang / /dmigs pa'i dug gis nges legs lam gyi srog /gcod pa'i srid pa'i zug rngu rnam par spangs/ /gang shar rtog pa'i btsan dug mi bzad pa/ /rtog med rig stong zhal du la bzlas pas/ /'od gsal rig pa'i rang mdangs cher rgyas te/ /ye shes lus kyi rtsal chen rdzogs par gyur/ /de tshe dge sdig spros pa'i na bun cha/ /spros med dbyings 22

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/su sangs pa'i chos sku'i bzhin/ /so so rang rig spyan gyis gzigs pa ni / /stong chen rab rib bral ba'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /de ltar dbyings kyi lhums su zhugs pa yi/ /spros med phyal ba chen po'i ye shes ni/ /bzhugs gzigs thabs kyis gcun pa'i rkyen snang gi /theg mchog sbrel zhi'i ltad mo khyod kyis gzigs/ /rig pa'i rang snang mi zad sku yi rgyan/ /cir yang 'char ba'i lam mchog snang ba bzhi/ /gsang chen thabs la mkhas pas mig 'phrul ltar/ /khyod sku kun bzang thog ma'i ston par bzhengs/ /de tshe sems snang spros pa'i rgyu ba zad pa'i chos zad chos sku'i zhing / /rgyal kun dgongs pa gcig pa'i bsti gnas mchog gyur de bzhin nyid dbyings che/ /'khrul ba'i ming yang stor ba'i mthar thug skyel so bla na med pa'i gnas/ /der ni de yi rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin slar mi ldang bar gshegs/ /ye shes skad cig gcig gis shes bya'i khyon/ /mtha' dag mngon sum bcal ba'i gzigs pa yang / /rnam par mi rtog zab mo'i blo gros dang / /de tshe bdag nyid gcig tu skyes 'di rmad/ /sgra dang rtog pa'i tha snyad rgyun chad cing / /shes dang shes bya'i snang ba nub pa'i sgos/ /chos kyi dbyings su chu la chu bzhag bzhin/ /ro gcig zhugs pa'i ye shes khyod kyis brnyes/ /bden gnyis cig char gsal bar snang ba yi/ /lkog 23

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gyur bag la nyal gyi rdul phyis pas/ /chos can mtha' dag sgrib med 'char ba yi/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes khyod kyis brnyes/ /bdag dang gzhan du mthong ba'i phyogs ris blo/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das pa'i 'dus byas cha/ /rnam par spangs pa'i mnyam nyid yon tan gter/ /ye shes gzigs pa dag pa khyod kyis brnyes/ /shes bya'i chos re'i rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid/ /sna tshogs tha snyad rjes 'gro ku sha'i rtse/ /ma nor ma 'dres so sor rtogs pa yis/ /ye shes zad mi shes par rang dbang bsgyur/ /nyam thag 'gro ba'i khams bzhin 'jug pa yi/ /lhun grub 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i bya ba che/ /legs par grub pa'i bdag rkyen mchog gyur pa'i/ /ye shes phan bde'i 'byung gnas mngon du mdzad / /chos kun kun nas mkhyen pa'i lus gcig la/ /stobs bcu'i lang tsho rdzogs pa'i she mong gis/ /sa gsum 'gro ba 'dul ba'i khur theg pa'i/ /don gnyis grub pa'i mchod sdong bla med khyod/ /spros bral dbyings la zag med bde ba'i ros/ /shin tu myos kyang zhi ba phyogs gcig pa'i/ /mya ngan 'das la nam yang mi gzhol ba/ /e ma ngo mtshar 'di 'dra gang gis brnyes/ /sdug bsngal brgya phrag du mas gtses pa yi/ /'gro drug sems dpa'i las snang gzigs pa'i thugs/ /kun tu thugs rje chen po'i gzhan dbang du/ /gyur 'dis dbyed du 24

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/spyos pa ma lags sam/ —/grangs med bskal bar snying rje'i sbrang rtsi yis / /yang yang btab pa'i khyod thugs dpag bsam ljon/ /lus can kun gyi gsos su ches mngar ba'i/ /phun tshogs ro brgyas 'di ltar dud pa lags/ /de slad bde gshegs zhing gi rdul snyed kyis/ /thugs bskyed mdzad pa'i yul las 'gongs pa yi/ /snyigs ma lnga bdo'i 'gro ba mi 'dor ba'i/ /grub pa'i slob dpon mchog la skyabs su mchi/ /khyod thugs gsang ba bsam mi khyab pa la/ /dwangs pa'i yid kyis cha tsam bstod pa yis/ /mkhyen brtse ye shes nyi ma stong gi 'od / /snying dbus pad+ma'i bcud du yongs shar te/ /'khrul ba'i sems kyi rang mtshang brdol gyur nas/ /'khrul med gnyug mar btsan sa legs zin pas/ /shin tu rnal 'byor zab mo'i gsang lam nas / /bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa thob shog /o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba las thugs la bstod pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o/ /༄7/ /chos sku'i dgongs pa rgyal kun ro mnyam bzhin/ /longs sku rigs lnga'i rang mdangs lhun grub pa'i/ /sprul sku 'gro 'dul thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul che/ /sku gsum yon tan dbang phyug mtsho skyes rje / /snying rje chen po'i phabs kyis bran pa'i 'od gsal sbrang chang bla 25

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/na med/ /theg mchog 'chi med btung bas myos pa'i mgon po khyod kyi yon tan gter/ /mkha' dbyings snod du shong ba min pa'i gsang ba mchog gi nor bu'i mdzod/ /lus can yongs kyi bgo skal nyid du byams pa'i thugs kyis bsgrub lags te/ /'on kyang phyogs 'dzin phyogs re'i blo mig gis/ /ma rtogs 'khrul bas 'khrul bar 'phyan pa rnams / /dpal ldan yon tan yon por mthong gyur te/ /kye ma bsod nams bsod nams min pas brlag /'gro drug 'gro ba so so'i skal ba dang / legs 'tsham legs pa'i yon tan sbyin pa yis/ /mgon khyod mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen du/ /yongs gyur yongs kyi bshes gnyen chen po khyod/ /mi rtog bzhin du phan bde'i gter gyur pa'i / /yon tan 'doms la dpag bsam ljon pa dang / /'dod 'jo'i ba dang gter bum bzang bo dang / /bsam 'phel nor bu'i tshogs rnams shin tu rmad/ khyad par snang srid che btsan dregs pa'i tshogs / /khyod thugs dgongs pa gtad pa tsam nyid las/ /drag po'i rlung gis bskyod pa'i shing bal bzhin/ /zil gnon rdo rje'i brtul zhugs 'di kho nas/ /rgyal kun dgongs pa gcig pa'i ye shes byin/ /khyod kyi gsang ba'i bcud du thob pa yis/ /mkha' mnyam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i spyi gzugs su/ /gyur pa'i tshul 'di mkha' la nyi shar bzhin/ /26

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/rgya mtsho bzhin du gsang ba ches zab cing / /lhun po bzhin du yon tan gtos che la/ /sa chen 'di bzhin 'gro ba'i rten gyur pa'i/ /ngo mtshar 'di bzhin sus mthong 'tshengs par nges/ /nyi ma bzhin du mkhyen pa'i 'od kyis mdzes/ /zla ba lta bur thugs rje'i bsil zer 'gyed / /skar tshogs la 'gran nus pa'i grangs kyis brjid/ /yon tan kun tshogs rig 'dzin bla ma'i zhabs/ /dad pa'i pad+mo'i ze'u 'brur rnam bkod de/ /cung zad bsngags pa'i tshig gi dri bzang dang / /skyabs gcig dgyes pa'i mchod sprin nyid gyur te/ /'dzum ldan spyan gyis gzigs pa skyong gyur cig /o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba las yon tan la bstod pa'i skabs te bzhi ba'o/ / ༄ga /gang zhig rgya mtsho'i rdul las ches lhag pa'i/ /'phrin las mi zad ngo mtshar bye ba brgya/ /skad cig re bzhin 'gro khams la 'jug pa'i/ /gu ru'i zhabs pad snying dbus ze'u 'bru'i rgyan/ /thogs reg spangs pa'i nam mkha'i sgeg mo'i bzhin ras la ni rjes chags pa'i/ /bzang bo'i 'phrin las phra rab rdul ni 'phags pa lags kyang ji ltar bgrang / /'on kyang gangs ri'i rwa bas bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir chos kyi snang ba 'bum/ /legs par brdal ba'i bka' 27

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/drin gcig pu stong gsum snod du ji ltar shong / /snga 'gyur zab gsang chos kyi rgya mtsho che/ /gangs can thub bstan klung brgya 'bab pa'i gzhi/ /'dren mdzad zhi ba'i zhabs dang pad ma'i rgyan/ /brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang po khyod 'ba' zhig /o rgyan yul sogs grub pa'i gnas mchog nas/ /skal ldan bsod nams skal ba chos kyi gter / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod byin rlabs gter/ /drangs pa'i theg mchog bstan 'di khyod kyi drin/ /thub bstan dus kyis rnyog pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /lha yi bla ma'i thugs bskyed gru bo ches/ /drangs pa'i phul byung nor bu ke ta ka /khyod nyid byams brtse'i zol gyis byon pa lags/ /bgrang bya sum brgya'i khur gyis yongs dub par//phyi gtsang nang gtsang dge sbyong pad+ma'i tshal/ /bsil ljongs thub bstan ldum ra mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /khyod kyi thugs rje'i phyag gis bzos pa lags/ /slar yang dam chos nyin mor byed pa'i 'od/ /log rtog sprin gyis nye bar bsgribs pa'i tshe/ /rigs tshul drag po'i rlung gis mthar bskrad de/ /legs bshad 'od stong 'byin pa'i grags pa'i dpal / /thub bstan chos kyi sgron me zla med pa/ /'khrul ba'i mun sel dge ba'i drod sbyin pa'i/ /srid 'dir rgyal ba'i nyi ma gnyis pa de'ang / /khyod kyis gser mdog cod pan bcings par zad/ /de yi 28

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/legs bshad legs spyad chos kyi gter/ /yongs rdzogs thub bstan thub pa'i ring lugs mchog /mchog dman kun la kun nas sman pa'i sman/ /khyod kyi thugs bcud thugs bskyed dpal las grub/ /gangs can thub dbang bstan pa'i chos kyi tshigs/ /rnam gsum skal ldan bye ba rol ba'i gnas/ /rlabs chen thugs bskyed dpung bas nyer btegs te/ /dar zhing rgyas pa'i tshul 'di khyod kyi drin/ /bye brag 'gro khams kun tu dge ba yi/ /mos ngor zab gsang chos kyi gru char rgyun/ /'bebs pa'i gter 'byin grub pa'i rig 'dzin sprin/ /bsod nams mkha' la dus dang dus su snang / /skal ngan dus kyi rlung dmar drag po yis/ /sdug bsngal rdul gyi 'tshub ma ldang ba yang / /gnon pa'i 'phrin las char ba skabs skabs su/ /gtong ba'i klu dbang khyod drin su yis gzhal/ /bod khams bde skyid myu gu 'khrungs pa'i gzhi/ /bsod nams sa bon smin pa'i byin rlabs char/ /khyod kyi ye shes mkha' dbyings kho na nas/ /rjes chags bsil ba'i rlung gis rnam par 'grem/ /de slad mngon par mtho dang nges legs kyi/ /bdud rtsis ljongs 'dir tshims pa yod do cog /pad+ma'i mchog sbyin mkhyen brtse'i bum pa las/ /byung ba'i 'phrin las rgyun la spyod par nges / /de ltar kha ba can 'di la ltos te/ /rags pa'i 'phrin las 29

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/cung zad brjod pa 'dis/ /gzhal bar dka' ba'i bka' drin dran gyur te/ /mos gus dbyar gyi chu gter ltar 'phel shog /dwangs pa'i rlung gis ba spu'i 'khri shing tshogs/ /rnam par bskyod pa'i rgyud la byin rlabs char/ /phabs te nyams dang rtogs pa'i me tog 'bum/ /cig char bzhad pa'i dga' ston myong gyur cig /o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba las/ 'phrin las la bstod pa'i skabs te lnga ba'o/ /de ltar rgyal ba kun gyi gdung 'tshob pa'i/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i spyi gzugs slob dpon che/ /pad+ma'i sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las kyi / /ngo mtshar gsang ba cung zad brjod pa 'dis/ /tshe rabs kun tu pad+mas rjes bzung ste/ /gsang chen chos kyi bdud rtsir longs spyad nas / /theg mchog rigs sad sa lam rim bgrod de/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog /'di nas pha rol skyas chen 'degs pa'i tshe'ang / /pad+ma 'od du pad+ma'i zhabs drung du/ /skyes te rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang / /lhan cig zab gsang chos la rol bar shog /'jig rten 'dir yang ris med bstan pa'i char/ /skal ldan yid kyi 'dzin mar babs pa las/ /lung rtogs chos kyi chu gter cher 'khyil nas/ /bsod nams dbyar gyi dga' ston mthong gyur 30

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/cig /ces o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bla ma 'gro 'dul gyis lha rdzas dar dmar ser gyi maṇ+ḍal bcas bskul ngor/ rje btsun chos kyi rgyal bo7mkha' klong yangs pa rtsal gyi zhal snga nas sogs dam pa du ma'i zhabs pad spyi bos len pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i gzugs brnyan / 7gangs can gyi mgon po pad dkar 'chang ba bcu gsum pa chen po'i bka' lung gis san 'o rul thu zhes ming gi cod pan byin pa/ kun bzang bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhes bya bas bris pa dge legs 'phel/ /

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/༄/ /rje btsun tsong kha pa la bstod cing smon lam du bya ba yid 'phrog bung ba'i rtsed 'jo/gang gis rgyal ba'i mdun sar thugs bskyed bzhin/ /gang du dam chos thang mar brdal ba yis/ /gang tshe rgyal rnams dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal gyis/ /gang la legs so sbyin pa de la gus/ /srid pa gsum na rnam par rol ba'i blo bzang rgyal ba'i myu gu 'bum/ /skye dgu'i gsos su snying rje'i brlan gyis rnam par bstar ba'i tshogs kyi nang / /zab mo'i gtam la khyad du 'phags pa'i grags pa'i ro mngar g.yur za ba/ /yab gcig mkhyen pa'i gter chen de ko ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gar du gyur/ /mthon mthing ral ba'i zur phud lnga la rin chen prog zhu'i phras mdzes pa'i/ /mtshams sprin zhal gyi zla ba'i rtsed 'jo skal bzang dkar bo'i phyogs dag tu/ /legs gsung ga bur 'dzag pa'i dpyid de bsod nams mi dman gzhan du ni/ /gur kum tshos kyis btsos pa'i paṇa zhus rten 'brel gtam gyi sgo brgya phyes/ /lnga rig mkhyen pa'i blo gros bzang bo'i legs bshad yal ga re re yang / /dri med lung dang rigs pa'i me tog cir yang mdzes pa'i nags tshal nang / /ma 'phrog spobs pas rnam par bskrun pa'i zab don nor bu'i 32

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/chun 'phyang gis/ /mngon mtho'i grags pa cir yang 'bar ba'i dpag bsam ljon pa khyod gcig pu/ /thub dbang zhal gyi pad+mo las 'ongs dam chos dga' ston bye ba'i bcud/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung sbrang rtsi'i snying po yum don ro brgya ches mngar ba/ /rnam par btung la mchog sbyin bum pa 'phags pa'i yul du klu yi dbang / kha ba can na mgon po khyod de de dag sangs rgyas gnyis par grags/ /gang tshe khyod kyis rgyal ba'i yum mchog dpal ldan klu dbang de nyid kyi/ /rigs tshul shing rtas mgron du bos bzhin legs bshad khyod la nyer drangs te/ /mang thos bye ba'i snying gi yol gor rab dga' bdud rtsi 'bum bkod pa/ /de tshe rgyal sras bgrang yas tshogs kyang 'dir 'dus dam chos ro 'di myong / /btags yod 'khri shing gsar ba'i rtse mor 'khor 'das shes bya'i 'bras bu brgya/ /ming tsam kho nas rnam par bcings te rgol ngan sor mos mi shigs pa'i/ /chos kyi longs spyod 'di la spyad de theg gsum skye dang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /zag med lus stobs cir yang rgyas nas lam lnga'i 'gros kyis rtsen par gyur / /chos rnams rnam bdun rigs pa'i srang gis zhib mor bcal na nam du yang / /yang dag rdzas kyi dngos po'i ljid ni cha tsam dmigs pa ma yin na/ /kun byang blang dor gang du 'char ba btags 33

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/yod me long 'di 'di zhes/ /mkhyen pa'i spyan stong rnam bkra'i tshogs kyang dga' ba'i rkang bro 'khrab pa mang / /bdag las ma skyes gzhan gyis ma bskyed gnyis dang rgyu med kyang min par/ /sna tshogs shes bya'i 'ja' tshon bkra ba'i ltad mo 'di la bltas pa na/ /ming rkyang 'phrul gyis bzos pa kho na sus kyang bsnyon du med lags pas/ /gtam 'di gang gi zhal na mchis de thub dbang chos kyi sras su nges/ /de slad ljongs 'dir zab mo'i tshul de blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa ru/ /grags pa'i ba dan dkar bos rnam mdzes mkhas mchog gdong lnga 'dis bsgrags te/ /dbus 'gyur chos kyi zhing sa der yang zla ba'i cod pan ltar gyur pa/ /grags pa'i mu khyud dkar bos rnam mdzes mkhas mchog gdong lnga de yis so/ /thub pa'i zhal chab bdag med ro ldan nyon mongs skom pa'i gdung sel du/ /gus pas bsten pa'i mkhas mang tshogs kyis 'bad pa brgyas btsal chos kyi nor/ /kun gyi rtser son grub mtha'i gsang 'dir blo gros mig bzang 'bum 'gyed pa'i/ /zab don gser gyi thur ma bsnams pa'i grags pa don ldan 'tsho byed khyodaske/ /sa gsum 'gro ba gnyis snang khang bar ma rig mun pas yongs mnar te/ /chos mchog brten nas btags pa'i gzugs la blta ba'i skabs dang bral ba rnams/ /rnam grol gling du 'khrid pa'i sa 34

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/mkhan drang srong chen po'i lam mtshon pa'i/ /zab mo'i gtam gyi 'od stong spro ba'i nyin byed gcig pur bdag gis nges/ /de slad srid pa 'di tsam ma zad tshe rabs phreng ba thams cad du/ /gser ri'i drung na rin chen lhun po'i gzi byin mngon par ngom pa bzhin/ /thub pa'i lugs bzang smra ba'i khrod na dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam gyis/ /mngon par mtho ba'i yab rje'i rang lugs rtag tu mjal te 'dzin par shog khyad par rigs lam 'od dkar 'dzags pas mthar 'dzin tsha ba'i gdung sel ba/ /nges don dbu ma'i blo gros mchog gi zla ba dkar bo'i ngos dag tu/ /btags yod ri bong mtshan mas rnam mdzes zhi ba'i dga' ston chen po 'dis/ /'jig lta'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i shis pa 'jig rten gsum du bsgrub gyur cig /de skad smra ba yab gcig 'jam pa'i dpal/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i rol bar shar ba'i lha/ /dri med blo gros sgo brgya 'byed pa'i mgon/ /gang gis bskyangs pa'i chos kyi myu gu des/ /'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po'i rang lugs bzhin/ /zab mo'i gtam gyi dga' ston myong ba'i tshe/ /brten nas btags pa'i blo gros 'phel gyur te/ /yab rje'i lugs la smon lam 'di ltar btab/ /ces 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po 7 tsong kha pa'i zhabs la 35

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bstod cing smon lam du bya ba yid 'phrog bung ba'i rtsed 'jo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ ru dam o rgyan bstan 'dzin gling gi yang dben/ gangs ri mngon par mtho ba'i zhol/ dpal kyi g.yu mtsho 'khyil ba'i 'gram/me tog rtswa sman shing gi ra ba 'khrigs pa'i tshal nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la slob par smon pa'i skabs/ brten nas btags pa'i rten 'brel gyi tshul gyi yab rje'i rang lugs la blo gros kyi na tshod gsar ba thob pa'i tshe ji ltar smon pa de ltar slar yang rnam rgyal dge ldan gyi gtsug lag gi nye 'khor rang shag dkon mchog gsum gyi lha khang du yi ger bris pa de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /dge'o/ /

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/༄/ /gsang chen snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa la bstod pa log rtog mun sel dad pa'i gzi brgya 'bar ba'i nyi ma/rgyal kun thugs kyi gsang ba zab mo'i bcud/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan grub rigs bye ba'i lam/ /mdo sngags rgya mtsho bsrubs pa'i nying khu mchog /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i lugs bzang rgyal gyur cig /'jam dbyangs ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i zol/ /gsang 'dzin bdag po grub pa'i brdzu/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang sa skyong tshul/ /lugs bzang chu bo 'dren pa'i gnyen/ /de slad chos kyi khungs btsun la / /rmad byung thugs bskyed mthu grub pas/ /byin rlabs 'od brgya 'bar ba yis/ /skal ldan snying gi mun pa sel/ /'phags yul chos kyi pad+mo la/ /o ṭi ya na sogs kyi rgyan/ /mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /zung 'brel lugs bzang ro mngar bo/ /grub pa'i rig 'dzin phreng ba yis/ /nyams su myong bzhin 'dzam gling 'di'i/ /thub dbang bstan pa'i bcud chen por/ /e ma 'phel 'grib med par gnas/ /theg gsum chos kyi chu gter che/ /sgrib gnyis tsha gdung bsil byed du/ /rim dgu'i hub kyis btung ba'i tshul/ /yongs rdzogs thub bstan 'di 'dra dkon/ /chos kyi mthar thug don dam 37

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/sems / /rim 'jug rtsol bas mngon byed la/ /theg mchog bstan pa'i stegs bu brgyad/ /skal ldan bsod nams dpal du bdog /rnam bzhi'i bden pa'i 'jug ldog dang / /thub dbang bstan pa'i gces nor che/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i lam/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i gzigs mor grub/ /don gnyis khur du 'degs bzod pa'i/ /rgyal sras bye ba'i lam po che'i/ /'jug ngogs rin chen sems kyi dbyig /'dzin pa lugs 'di rgyal po'i mdzod/ /de slad gzhan phan spyod pa'i zong / /ngo mtshar thang mar brdal ba'i skyes/ /chos kyi tshong 'dus chen po yang / /theg mchog rgyal srid 'di la che/ /zhi sgo gnyis su med pa'i lam/ /bdag med gtam gyi rnga bo che/ /rnam gsum rigs pas brdungs ba yang / /bla na med pa'i rgyal thabs lags/ /rgyu yi theg pa'i 'od dkar gzis/ /snang min zab gsal rtogs pa'i gzugs/ /gsal byed 'bras bstan nyin mor byed/ /lugs bzang nam mkha'i rgyan du rdzogs/ /dka' thub dang ni gtsang sbra yi/ /bya dang rnal 'byor cha mnyam spyod/ /rnal 'byor gtso bor 'dod pa yi/ /theg gsum theg mchog 'di'i 'bab stegs/ /rnam bzhi'i rgyud kyi bla med lam / /rnal 'byor gsum gyis nyer mtshon te/ /sngags spyod skal ldan bye ba'i tshogs/ /'og min bgrod la bstan 'di grub/ /snang phyogs 38

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/thabs la gtsor bzung nas/ /rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i lam bgrod de/ /tshe 'dir grub pa'i rtser gshegs pa'i/ /ma hā bka' srol 'di yi spyi/ /de la tan+d+ra bco brgyad dang / /sgrub sde chen po rnam brgyad sogs/ /gsang chen chos kyi klung brgya yis/ /grub gnyis rin chen bye ma 'dren / /de bzhin 'dzam gling grub pa'i khyus/ /don gnyis sgrub pa'i rig sngags kun/ /'di la bcud du rdzogs pas na/ /chos kyi gter 'di gzhal bar dka'/ /skye 'chi bar do'i lcags kyi khams/ /gsang chen chos kyi gser 'gyur rtsis/ /sku gsum rin chen dang po ru/ /bsgyur ba'i thabs mkhas 'di na che/ /grub pa'i gnas mchog ji snyed na / /brtul zhugs gar gyis rol ba yis/ /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyang thams cad 'dis/ /myos te bde chen rol mos 'da'/ /skal ldan khyad par 'jug pa'i sgo/ /rim rtsol bral ba'i 'od gsal lam/ /dbyings ye mnyam sbyor a nu yis/ /shes rab bde ba'i nyams brgya 'byin / /de phyir dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yi/ /bde chen thugs la gab pa'i sgos/ /phyag mtshan nyid du bzhes pa las/ /rtog ge'i srang na snang rung min/ /'on kyang bsod nams mi dman zhing / /mos ldan dam pa'i 'gro ba la/ /nor bu ji bzhin byin rlabs dang / /rang gi skal bas cung zad rnyed/ /des na theg pa mchog 'di nyid/ /babs 39

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/so gsum gyis snang ba'i tshul/ /ngo mtshar chos kyi rgya mtsho'i rlabs/ /byis pa'i skye bo su yis bzod/ /mdo dang sgyu 'phrul sems phyogs sogs / /rgyud lung man ngag chos kyi mdzod/ /rnam pa gsum du phye ba ni / /lugs bzang 'di las gzhan du gang / /'gro 'dul dus babs 'phrin las slad/ /pad mas phyag rgyas btab pa yi/ /mi zad chos kyi gter 'dis kyang / /mi mnyam che ba'i khyad par 'don/ /bde chen rtogs pas rtsen pa yi/ /rig 'dzin tshogs kyi bgo skal du/ /chos kyi chu gter ches 'phyur te/ /lugs 'dis gsang ba'i sgo brgya 'dzin/ /spros med sems kyi rdo rje la/ /spros pa med par 'jug rnams kyi/ /'jug ngogs mchog ni lugs 'di nyid/ /gang gis rab tu phye ba'i sgo//de phyir bstan pa'i nyin byed 'di/ /rdo rje'i grwa zur ma nyams pa/ /mthon po'i mkha' dbyings la brgyud de/ /'phags blo go la kho na'i rgyan / /de lta na yang rig 'dzin tshogs/ /theg pa mchog gi rgyal thabs su/ /gsang bstan dbyar gyi rnga gsang 'di/ /bdud sde'i mgo bo 'gem slad brdungs/ /grub brgya'i thugs gsang rin chen sgrom/ /ngo mtshar chos kyi gzi 'od brgyas/ /chos 'dod skal ldan bye ba'i tshogs / /dngos brgyud grub pa mchog la dkri/ /gzhi rig gdod nas dag pa'i char/ /rtsol med bzhag thabs kyis bsnun te/ /kun rtog 40

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/gcod pa'i 'od gsal lam/ /myur lam kun gyi mthar thug nyid/ /rig gdangs lhun grub g.yo ba'i cha/ /bzhugs gzigs thabs kyi ye shes skur/ /mngon du byed pa'i gsang chen 'phrul/ /ngo mtshar las kyang ngo mtshar gnas/ /gsang ba mchog gi bden gnyis kyi/ /chos kyi rnga chen 'di brdungs tshe/ /zung 'jug gtam gyi rol mo phal/ /gud du blo ldan su zhig thos/ /rtsol med thabs kyi che ba yis/ /bstan 'di khyad par 'phags pa'i dbyangs/ /nyams myong rgyud du legs bkug ste / /blo chen sor mos brdungs pa'i sgras/ /mu med phyogs dang dus rnams su/ /skal bzang rig 'dzin tshogs dgyes te/ /rdo rje'i glu dang lhan cig par/ /gsang chen theg dgu'i rtse mor btegs/ /e ma'o zab yangs chos kyi mtsho/ /'dod dgu'i nor bu'i g.yur za ba/ /skal bzang klu tshogs kun gyi gnas/ /'di la sems shes su mi dad/ /ji srid lugs bzang chu gter 'di/ /bsod nams 'dzin mar 'khyil de srid/ /gangs can bstan pa'i klung brgya yang / /mi nyams 'bab pa'i gsos sman te/ /de phyir sras bcas rgyal kun gyis/ /'gro la dgongs pa'i byin rlabs dang / /rtag tu dpa' bo ḍāk+ki yis/ /bstan 'dir spyan ras kyis btsa' ba'i/ /bden pa'i gzi 'od stong 'bar te / /sgro skur 'dam gyis ma sbags par/ /'jig rten bsod nams 41

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rgyan gcig tu/ /bdag nyid kho nas 'dzin gyur cig /ces gsang chen snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa rin po che la rang bzhin brjod pa'i sgo nas cung zad bstod pa log rtog mun sel dad pa'i gzi brgya 'bar ba'i nyi ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal dbang pad+ma saṃ bha wa dang dbyer med pa'i rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po/ mkha' klong yangs pa rtsal gyi zhal snga nas dang / grub dbang gter chen rin po che 7 o rgyan las rab gling pa'i zhabs sogs pad+ma'i rig sngags 'chang ba'i mchog gzigs kyi rdo rje slob dpon las gsang ba mchog gi chos kyi bka' drin mang du thob pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i gzugs brnyan theg pa mchog gi spros med kyi dkyil 'khor chen por smin pa'i lung gis/kun bzang bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhes 'bod pas rnam rgyal dge ldan du bsgrigs pa 'dis kyang bstan pa'i snying po 'dri nyid sgro skur dang bral te phyogs dus kun tu rgyas par gyur cig /dge legs 'phel/ /42

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/sto /mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i rang lugs dri ma med pa gser gyi me tog lta bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa kun tu dga' byed me tog 'khri shing /tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho las 'khrungs shing / /lnga ldan ye shes 'dab mas mdzes/ /mu med zhing gi rgyan gyur pa'i/ /dri med rgyal ba'i me tog mchod/ /dpal ldan yon tan phung bo mnyam med thub dbang dbang po'i tog ces pa'i/ /grags pa'i 'brug sgras khor yug kun tu zhi bsil 'phrin las char 'bebs tshe/ /zab cing gsang ba'i chos kyis rnga chen phyogs bcu'i zhing du brdungs pa yi/ /smon lam rlung gis cir yang bskul ba'i thugs bskyed chu yi gter 'di bskyil/ /dri bral shel dkar phreng ba lta bu'i brgyud pa gnyis ldan chos kyi slad/ /dri bral shel dkar phreng ba'i me tog maṇ+ḍal tshom bur yongs bstar nas//thub dbang chos kyi mchod pas lung bstan chos dung dkar bo'i skyes kyi phul/ /dge ba ldan pa'i ri la sbas pas bstan 'di'i mtshan gyi cod pan byin/ /kun nas mi bzod chad pa'i gcong rong rnam par bsal ba'i khyon yangs su/ /rab tu brtan pa'i rtag lta'i brag ri yongs su bsnyil te khod snyom par/ /zhi ba'i ting 'dzin me tog gzhon 43

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/nu mi rgod mi zhum snyoms par bdal/ /drang srong chen pos rjes su gnang ba'i tshangs spyod mchog ldan skyed tshal lags/ /'dzam gling mun pa'i go skabs 'gog pa'i zhing 'di'i rgyan mchog nyi zla zung / /rab yangs mkha' la zlos gar rtse ba'i 'od kyi thur mas rnam phyes pa'i / /sngon med me tog gzhon nu'i 'khri shing gzhan phan sman kyi sdong bo che/ /gangs ri'i ngogs na dud pa'i grags pas phyogs bcu'i lus can mgron du 'bod/ /dngos grub sbrang rtsi'i dog pas gtams pa'i gsang chen chos kyi me tog che/ /rdo rje'i 'dab ma bzhi yis nyer mdzes zung 'jug ze'u 'bru'i dga' ston can/ /rgyud rgyal gnyis kyi rgya mtsho las 'khrungs grub pa'i drang srong 'bum gyi nor/ /u dam wa ra las kyang lhag pa'i me tog mchog gis ches cher mdzes/ /yan lag dgu ldan gsung rab zhal bzang bden gnyis rwa dang 'grogs pa yi/ /lha mchog de yis spyan ras kyis btsa' rnam 'byed blo gros 'bum bdal zhing / /'gal rkyen bgegs kyis nam yang mi brdzi sngon med dge ba'i me tog 'di/ /kun nas bsten pa'i bh+ra ma ra ru smon lam rlung gis bskyod par gyur/ /de lta'i mnyam med me tog ni/ /gser ri'i dbus na lhun po bzhin/ /thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /yid 'phrog dga' ba brgya ldan pa/ /'di ni mngon par bsten pa 44

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/yis / /bden gnyis zab mo'i gnas lugs la/ /mi mnyam blo gros phra mo'i dbyig /thob ste chos kyi rjes 'brang 'gyur/ /brtson pa'i rlung gi stobs bzhin du/ /mthong ba'i chos la grub pa mchog /mngon du byed dang de'i 'og tu/ /srid zhi'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol 'gro/ /bde gshegs seng ge'i nga ros seng ge'i sgras/ /bdag med chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe/ /phyag gi mchod sdong mthong ba tsam gyis kyang / /rnam grol mchog byin 'di yi phan yon yin/ /de ltar ngo mtshar phun tshogs gsum ldan pas/ /gang dang mi mnyam thub dbang bstan pa'i bcud/ /'di nyid kho nas 'di nas byang chub bar/ /legs par 'tsho zhing gzhan yang sgrol gyur cig /ces mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i rang lugs dri ma med pa gser gyi me tog lta bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa kun tu dga' byed me tog 'khri shing zhes bya ba 'di ni snon gyi zla ba'i dus me tog ser bos khyab pa'i skyed mos tshal yid du 'ong ba la dmigs te dkon mchog mchod pa'i smon lam gyis dad pa'i khams gso ba'i tshe 'jam dbyangs bla ma bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa de nyid kyi rang lugs dri ma med pa gser gyi me tog lta bu rjes su dran te yid kyi bung ba dad pa'i shugs kyis rnam par bskyod pa bzhin du yi ge'i lam du 'jam 45

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros tshangs sras snyems pa'i sdes phab pa dge legs 'phel/ /༄7/ /ka nas ka ltar dag gtsang dga' ldan pa/ kha ba can na rgyal bstan rtsa lag la/ /ga nas brtags kyang 'gal ba ma snang bas/ /nga rang 'tshang rgya bar yang dad phyag 'tshal/ /ca dang ca la dbyangs(grumatha' sbyar ba mang / /cha byad gang yang ran la dag pa dka'/ /ja dang chang la dga' bas spyad mkhan yang / /nya la sum ltar 'gal ba mang snyam spangs/ /ta thā ga ta mkha' ltar dpag dka' yang / /tha mal ba la lag par bzhag pa la/ /da ltar tsam las 'gyangs bral gsang sngags kyang / /na maḥdaga' ldan pa la snang bas dad/ /pa sangs dkar yang nam mkha' snang dka' ltar/ /phar tshad bshad pa gang la'ang nyams zhan pas/ /ba lang bdag 'dra mkhas par drangs dka' snyam/ /ma brtags dpyad pa mkhan rnams rgyab la bzhag /tsa la lang bsdad gang 'dra bya bar yang / /tsha grang ngal spangs sbyangs ldan bsam gtan la/ /dza yas yang yang bshad pas mtha' bcad pas / /wa ltar bdag cag dad pas brgyal ba lags/ /zhwa la mtshal kha spangs pa tsam dang gzhan/ /za thabs rkyang bas dga' ldan par btags pa/ /'a la dbyangs(2)sbyar da mthas brgyan pa las/ /ya 46

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/mtshan bral ba 'ga' la cang ma dad/ /rwa ba gangs can pa la gang dar bstan/ /la lar ma zad tshang ba dga' ldan bstan/ /sham+bha la na'ang mkhas rnams 'chad skad gtam/ /sar gnas 'phags pa 'gas bshad ha cang mtshar/ /ha shang gang zag bzang ngan brtag dka' yang / /lta ba rgyal bstan rnam dag dang 'gal ba/ /a ma zab lam bsam par 'chad mkhan rnams/ /yang yang dpyad na 'ja' ltar yal bar snang / /ma brtags nyams dga' tsam la snang grags rnams / /'thad pas thabs la mkhas pa ma btang na'ang / /gang yang btsal na ma snang ba tsam pa/ /zab zab gnad la ma skrag dga' ldan pa / kha 'phang ma dman na yang kha bshad las/ /las 'bras rnam gzhag ma chad bzhag dka' na/ /na rga rab spangs mya ngan 'das pa la / /la la dad kyang dad pa tsam las dka'/ /snang ba btsa' na gang nas kyang ma snang / /gang yang bral snyam shar na ma bral gang / /'gal bar smra mkhan snang yang cang ma 'gal/ /a a zab pa las kyang zab pa a/ /'di bzhin gzigs shing zhi bsil ting 'dzin gzis/ /dpe med dge legs bde chen ye shes rnyed/ /nyon mongs gnod 'joms spyod mchog yongs bzod mgon/ /dus gsum su bzhugs kun tu gus 'dud zhu/ / 47

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/a+yo/ /drang nges rnam 'byed la bstod pa legs bshad sbrang rtsis myos pa'i gtam yid 'phrog bung ba'i rtsed 'jo/blo bzang mkhas dang btsun pa'i khyu mchog che/ /snyigs dus thugs bskyed zab mos thub pa'i bstan/ /'dzin mdzad 'gro khams rgya mtsho sgrol ba'i mgon/ /bka' drin mtshungs med de la lan brgyar 'dud / /shin tu rtogs par dka' ba rdo rje'i tshig /rtogs na gsung rab phye ba'i mdzod phyes te/ /nges don nor bu lag rtser gtod pa yi/ /'jam mgon thugs bcud legs bshad 'di la gus/ /theg mchog chos mdzod nam mkha'i za ma tog /kun nas 'geng ba'i brjod don snying po'i phul/ /stong nyid gtam gyi bdud rtsi bde blag tu/ /btung ba'i snyan dngags 'di la cis mi spro/ /gsung rab rin chen sgom gyi drang nges kyi/ /phra zab rgyal ba'i dgongs pa'i nor sna 'bum/ /ma mthong de srid mngon rtogs khyad nor la/ /blo gros 'jug pa zhib mo ji ltar rnyed/ /de slad klu dbang thogs med rnam gnyis zhes/ /rgyal ba rang gis chos mdzod phye ba por/ /bden pa'i lung bstan dus las ma bsnyel ba'i/ /bstan pa'i phyag rjes phyogs 'dir 'di las snang / /don zab dgongs pa 'grel ba'i gru bo ches/ /ngo bo nyid med gsung 48

— bstodatshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/rab rgya mtsho'i rlabs/ /bde blag gcod pa'i theg mchog lta ba'i 'gros / /gangs can 'di na 'di 'dra su la mchis/ /skye ba med pa'i sgyu ma sna tshogs gzhir/ /mtshan nyid med pa nam mkha'i me tog gis/ /stong ba don dam ngo bo nyid med mkha'/ /gsal byed legs bshad nyin mor byed pa yin/ /dngos 'dzin zug rngu khad kyis 'joms pa yi/ /rnam rig sman gyi ljon pa bsten pa'i tshul/ /rgyal ba'i thabs mkhas mdzad pa ji bzhin du/ /rigs tshul me tog bkram 'dis bdag yid phrogs/ /shing rta chen po'i rjes 'brang chen po brgya'i/ /legs gsung gtam gyi dri bzang 'bum phrag gis/ /kun nas spungs pa'i ngo mtshar gzigs mo brgyas/ /blo gros mdzangs la dga' ba ches cher ster/ /kun byang chos kun kun nas ro gcig pa'i/ /gnas lugs zab mor gnas skabs bkri ba'i stegs/ /legs byas chos 'khor legs par phyes pas kyang / /rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal ba gnyis par mdzad/ /dgongs 'grel skya rengs 'phrul gyis ma drangs par/ /sher phyin rig sngags nam mkha'i nor bu che/ /blo gros go la'i lam du 'dren pa yi/ /dpal ldan klu dbang khyad nor 'di na bdog /snang tsam 'od dkar bdal ba'i chos can gzhir/ /stong nyid bsil zer 'god pa bha bya'i srol/ /shar gsum gzhung gi 'od zer 'bum dang 49

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bcasam/ /chos 'di'i mkha' la rdzogs par shar ba lags/ /snang ba tsam yang gnyis snang bag chags 'phrul/ /snang med kho na 'khrul snang zad pa'i gshis/ /snang dang mi snang bden pa dbyer med pa'i/ /snang stong chos la chos 'di mig gcig gyur/ /de slad 'phags pa yab sras rnam pa lnga'i/ /byin rlabs me tog spyi bor bcangs pa'i gtam/ /bslu ba med pa du bas me bzhin te/ /nges pa'i don la zab mo'i bka' babs lags/ /gang la rigs tshul rdo rje'i mtshon bsnun pa'i/ /ma rig dgra bo'i log pa'i stangs ka yang / /'di na dang por rjen par phyung ba 'dis/ /rnam dpyod ral kha 'gyed la shin tu bzod/ /de la rigs lam rnon po'i mtshon rtse 'bum/ /shags tsam min par 'debs pa'i g.yul gyi las/ /ltag chod skyon gyis tshur la mi brdzi ba'i / /nyon mongs 'joms pa'i dgra thabs 'di 'dra rmad/ /e ma 'grel chen bzhi yi lde mig gis/ /klu sgrub stong nyid gtam gyi mdzod phyes pas/ /ma tshims da dung drang nges 'od dkar brgyas/ /zab don gsal byed zla ba slar yang shar/ /yul gyi ngos na dmigs gtad 'chal ba'i gnas/ /rang bzhan de la dmigs kyis phye ba yi/ /lung rigs 'gal ba'i lhun po bzhi bkal ba/ /dngos 'dzin glang po brjid kyang ji ltar lcogs/ /de slad rang phyogs sgrub pa'i skabs su 50

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/yang —/ /rab rib snang ba lta bur 'thas pa yis/ /blo mig ldong dang mthun pa'i skabs bral te/ /thal 'gyur mtshon gyis rgol ngan bye mar btags / /de tshe rtog ge'i tho bas ci byed ces / /smra ba'i seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa yi/ /'phags yul grub mtha'i rtse mo'i ngo mtshar phul//lag mthil rdzas bzhin gsung ngag 'di yis mdzad/ /rang bzhin med la med pa'i g.ya' med par/ /rten 'brel 'od brgya bkrag tu 'bar ba dang / /ltos nas grub par rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i/ /gnas med snang stong grogs su shar ba'i gtam/ /dam chos dga' ba'i tshal chen dbus 'gyur du'ang / /blo gros ljags kyis brjod nus dkon mod de/ /'di na zab mo'i rigs sngags de kho nas/ /lta ngan gdon tshogs gzir ba'i 'phrul chen ngom/ /kye ma gangs can 'di na mang bo zhig /phyogs su ltung ba'i ling tog gis bsgribs te/ /nges don blta slad nyin byed 'di spangs nas/ /mun khrod lag rnam byed pa las kyis nongs/ /kye hud stong nyid gtam gyi nor bu brgya/ /nyin re bzhin yang lhugs par bstsal gyur te/ /gling 'di'i chos kyi mu ge sol cig ces/ /'jam pa'i rdo rjes mngon par dbang bskur bas/ /legs bshad rin thang bral ba'i ke la shas/ /drang nges rnam par dbye ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /'di ltar sbrengs te kun la mchog sbyin kyang / /51

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/skal med blo gros kha ru 'gro ba dka'/ /thal rang gzhung shan 'byed la mngon phyogs tshe/ /lnga rig smra ba'i rgya gar mkhas pas kyang / /ma khrol paṇa chen rnams kyi rtsod pa'i tshul/ /'di na nyin mo'i gzugs bzhin gsal bar gyur/ /sems las byer ba'i don lnga ma 'gog kyang ske/ /sems tsam gsung ba'i mdo sder mi 'gal bar/ /sems dang sems byung rgyu ba 'gog byed pa'i/ /sems bskyed zab mo shin tu gsal bar phye/ /re zhig rten 'brel tshon ras 'dzin pa'i gzhir/ /bden pa sgrub pa'i rang rig cho ga yang / /mi 'thad dogs pa med pa'i mdzangs pa'i gtam/ /'di la blo gros ldan pa su mi mgu/ /las 'bras rnam par 'jog pa'i 'bab stegs su/ /kun gzhi'i rdo gcal stug po ma dgram par/ /las kyi zhig pa dngos pos bskyed pa'i tshul/ /rigs lam phra mos blang dor nges ster ba/ /a ho gtam 'di mgon po klu sgrub dang / /dpal ldan zla ba'i zhabs kyi gsang gtam ste/ /'di la 'phags bod mkhas pa mang bshungs kyang / /blo gros phra la dga' ba bskyed pa'i rgyan/ /bden gnyis dpyod mtshams phra rags za 'og ris/ /ma mthong long ba'i ca co sgrogs pa dag /zhig pas 'bras bu bskyed pa'i legs bshad gser/ /btags don 'tshol ba'i ra gan du 'khrul te/ /rang gi blo gros ngan rtog gis rul ba/ /lhug 52

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/par ston pa'i sun 'byin dri ngan brgyas/ /klan ka btsal 'dis mkhas mang khrel ba'i gtam/ /mkha' la mi gtsang gtor ltar spyi bos mnos / /mi pham dris lan mtshan nyid gsum gyi chus/ /sems tsam sgrub pa'i rgya gar paṇa chen kyang / /yang dag rigs pas bye mar btag gyur na/ /ljongs 'di'i rgol ngan 'joms la lta ci smos/ /mnyam bzhag spros bral nga ro cher sgrogs kyang / /dgag bya bkag tsam blo la mi shar ba'i/ /bye smra'i blo can dbu ma'i ming 'dzin la/ /dgag pa gnyis kyi gdams pa'i chos char 'jo/ /'khrul ba'i zhen stangs bkag tsam bsgrub pa nyid/ /ma rtogs bsgrub bya med pa'i blo gros mtshang ske/ /brdol ba'i rigs lam phra mo 'di kho na'i/ /bka' drin stong gsum nor gyis ji ltar 'jal/ /byung dang 'byung 'gyur log rtog rab rib nad/ /'byin byed rigs lam drang bo'i gser thur gyis / /rgol ngan kun la brtse ba'i mig sbyin pa'i/ /gtam 'di gzhan gyi phyogs zhes sgrog phod dam/ /ma rig mun pas shin tu g.yogs pa'i khrod / /phyogs zhen gdon gyis ci dgar brlam gyur te/ /rigs bral ltar snang tshig gi bla brdol brgyas/ /mkhas pas spangs pa'i yul du bshung la khrel/ /bka' brgyud 'di la rnam dpyod ku sha'i rtser/ /rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung bzang chu bo bzhi/ /ma 'dres 'dzin par nus 53

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa bgrang yas mod/ /chos srung rigs pa'i mtshon cha'ang 'di kho na/ /kye ma blo gros drang bos gtam 'di kun/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs par gyur min dogs pa na/ /'dir 'byung lung rigs rtse dga' 'gro ba bzhi/ /spangs te g.yo bar nus min dpyod 'tshal lo/ /a ho mkhas pa gser gyi ri bo 'bum/ /tshar du dngar ba'i dge ldan bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ /cir yang mdzes byed gtsug lag zab mo'i nor/ /'gran zla bral ba legs bshad snying po nyid/ /lnga rig nor bu'i gdengs ka mang mdzes pa'i / /mang thos klu dbang bye ba rol ba'i mtsho/ /rigs pa'i rlabs phreng 'phyo ba'i rtse dga'i gnas/ /'di 'drar ngan rtog dri ma cis mi bkru / /mdo dang dgongs 'grel lung gi me tog tshogs/ /shin tu bkra ba'i legs bshad skyed tshal 'dir/ /thub bstan dga' ston nyams su mi myong na/ /de la las kyi zug rngus ma mnar ram/ /zab cing rgya che'i shing rta chen po'i gzhung / /legs bshad nor bu phyur bur spungs pa yi/ /snying po rin chen rin thang bral ba 'dir/ /dad gsum sor mos rgyud mangs 'di brdungs dges/ /blo gros lus la kun lhan mi gtsang bas/ /mngon du sbags bzhin phyag rdzogs chos kyi bzo/ /byed mdog chos dang gang zag 'dzol ba'i las/ /bzhag ste rigs tshul 'di 'dras 'khrud par shog /ma rtogs mun pa sgron me 'dis sel 54

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/zhing —/ /log rtog dug nad sman 'dis bcom pa dang / /the tshom sgrog kyang ral gri 'dis bcad de/ /gsung rab dga' ston cir yang myong bar shog /mthong ba'i chos 'dir drang nges rnam 'byed kyi/ /legs bshad nyi ma snying gi pad+mo ru/ /nyin mtshan kun tu bsten pa'i skal bzang gis/ /dam chos dri bzang phyogs brgyar 'phro bar shog /de tshe dbu sems rigs pa'i dka' gnad brgya/ /blo gros bcud du thob pa'i shes rab rtsal/ /mi dman stong nyid mkha' dbyings bgrod pa la//blo chen rgyal sras rnams dang skal mnyam shog /bden gnyis gtam gyis ma rig gnyid slong ba'i/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i go cha cher bgos nas / /sangs rgyas zhing kun kun nas nyul ba yi/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo'i rnam thar mthar phyin shog /grangs med gsum gyi lhag mthong rigs pa'i dpung / /yongs rdzogs gsang ba mchog gi thabs mkhas kyis/ /sgrib gnyis mun pa mtha' dag sangs pa dang / /lhan cig mkhyen gnyis mtha' med rgyas par shog /ces drang nges rnam 'byed la bstod pa legs bshad sbrang rtsis myos pa'i gtam yid 'phrog bung ba'i rtsed 'jo zhes bya ba 'di ni/rgyal dbang pad dkar 'dzin pa bcu gsum pa chen po'i zhal snga nas ma hā pa: ta zhes bsngags pa'i 'jam mgon bla ma'i bstan pa'i 55

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/mnga' bdag chen po don gyi slad du mtshan nas smras te/ rdo rje 'chang7 blo bzang mkhas btsun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i zhabs kyi bka' drin las chos tshul 'di la cung zad mos pa thob pa'i dge slong rigs pa smra ba'i gzugs brnyan blo bzang mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya bas rang gi blo gros 'phel ba'i ched du dpal snyan mo ri'i gtsug lag khang gi nye logs rang shag dkon mchog gsum gyi lha khang du bris pa dge legs 'phel/ /

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/tshog /gzungs kyi rnam bshad la bstod pa/'jigs med spobs pa'i gzi byin yongs 'bar te/ /thub bstan snying po rgyal yum mdzes byed du/ /legs bshad 'od brgya 'gyed pa'i nyi ma de/ /da lta gling 'dir bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /lan gcig bsod nams shar ri'i rtse mo ru/ /blo gros cha shas rdzogs pa'i mkhas pa'i mgon/ /'di 'dra snang mod snga 'gyur pad+mo'i tshal/ /ci dgar phye ba'i dbang med yid skyo'i gnas/ /rab 'byams zhing na rgyal sras mtha' dag gi /theg mchog chos kyi dga' ston 'dzad med pa / /'dzin pa'i ngo mtshar gzhir gyur gzungs kyi rgyan/ /phye ba mkhas rnams dgyes pa'i mchod sprin te/ /dam chos nor bu'i rgyan mang nyer gsog pa'i/ /blo chen rgyal sras bye ba'i phyag bzhes 'di/ /'byed pa'i gtam snyan dbyar gyi rnga gsang 'dis/ /gti mug gnyid du yur rnams cis mi sad/ /'di 'dra'i rgyan gyis blo gros nyer brgyan te/ /thub rnams gsung rab sbrang chang yang nas yang / /gsol te mngon rtogs shed mong rdzogs pa'i thugs/ /chos kyi dbyings su myos de ngo mtshar phul/ khyad par brda la brten nas don 'dzin pas/ /a sogs yi ge'i sgo res skye med don/ /'jal ba'i rigs pa'i rnam 57

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/grangs mtha' yas las/ /bzod pa'i sgo 'byed gzungs bzhi'i gtso bo la/ /bka' bstan lung gi pad+ma'i phreng bstar te/ /rigs lam nyin byed 'od kyis phyes pa'i skyes/ /gsar bshad yid 'phrog dri bzang 'phro ba 'dis/ /blo ldan bung ba'i tshogs la yid dga' bskyed/ /a ho legs bshad zlo ba'i ljags yod na/ /theg chen chos kyi rdzing bu yongs brgyan pa'i/ /rnam bshad pad+ma gsar ba'i gtam snyan 'di/ /zlos par rigs zhes blo gsal tshogs la sgron/ /a ti'i rtogs pa'i lus rtsal rgyas bzhed na'ang / /a sogs gsung gi sgo las nyer mtshon te / /a don skye med mjal ba'i tshul 'di nyid/ /a ma kun tu bzang mo'i gsang gtam yin/zhes pa zhig sems la shar ba ltar dharma sā ras yi ger btab ste phul ba dge legs 'phel/ / —58

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/sto /rje btsun sgrol ma la bstod pa rin chen bdun gyi 'khri shing /na mo gu ru/ sgrib bral chos dbyings kyi rin chen dang po yi khams las/ /gsang gsum byin rlabs kyi rtsibs stong phyogs brgya ru bkod de/ /'gro kun 'jigs brgyad kyi mi mthun g.yul ngo las sgrol ba'i / /rje btsun 'phrin las kyi lha mos thugs rje yis dgongs la/ /snying stobs chen po yi legs smin bsod nams kyi mthu las/ /zab gsang zung 'brel gyi gser sbyangs btso ma yi dngos po/ /'khrul bral dge ldan gyi bstan pa'i 'khor lo ru grub pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal srid 'di mi nyams brtan pa ru mdzod cig /phyag mchod dar dkar gyi sham bu lhab lhub tu g.yo ba'i/ /dad gus rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la yud tsam zhig gsol bas/ /mngon mtho nges legs kyi zong brgya char ltar du 'bebs mdzad/ /rje btsun 'phrin las kyi lha mos thugs rje yis dgongs la/ /zab yangs mkhyen brtse yi rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las byung ba'i / /'bum phrag lung rigs kyi 'od 'bar lugs bzang gi nor bu//mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi dngos dgu lag rtse ru sbyin pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal srid 'di mi nyams brtan pa ru mdzod cig /rin chen margad 59

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/kyi 'khri shing dbang sngon gyis byugs bzhin/ /'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi g.yo ldan zur mig gi lcags kyus/ /rgyal rnams bde chen gyi mgron la dbang med du 'gug pa'i/ /rje btsun 'phrin las kyi lha mos thugs rje yis dgongs la/ /zab don lus phra yi 'jo sgeg mig 'phrul ltar rtse bzhin / /rten 'brel mu tig gi do shal mgrin pa ru 'phyang ba'i/ /mdzad mkhas shes rab kyi btsun mo 'gran zla dang bral ba'i/ /chos kyi rgyal srid 'di mi nyams brtan pa ru mdzod cig /srid pa'i grong khyer 'di'i lus can mtha' dag gi khams dbang / /mngon par shes pa yis gang 'dul rgyal thabs kyi spyod pas/ /sras bcas rgyal rnams kyi bzhed dgu rang dbang du skong ba'i/ /rje btsun 'phrin las kyi lha mos thugs rje yis dgongs la/ /gzhung lugs legs bshad kyi lde mig re re yi 'phrul gyis/ /drang nges gsung rab kyi mdzod brgya tshegs med du phyes te/ /dam chos dga' ston la sbyor ba'i lugs bzang gi blon po/ /chos kyi rgyal srid 'di mi nyams brtan pa ru mdzod cig /theg gsum gdul bya yi re 'dod rnam byang gi nor bu/ /srid pa'i phyi mtha' ru mi 'dzad gzhan don gyi khur chen/ /nam yang lhod med du 'khyer ba'i brtse chen gyi dbang phyug /rje btsun 'phrin las kyi lha mos thugs rje yis dgongs la/ /phyin drug rin chen gyi rgyan cha nyil nyil du bskyod 60

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/pa'i / /sems mchog thal dkar gyi glang po ji bde ru zhon te/ /bsdu bzhi'i sna zhags kyis lus can dbang med du sdud pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal srid 'di mi nyams brtan pa ru mdzod cig /'phrin las nyer bdun gyi bgrod pas sa gsum gyi khyon 'di/ /skad cig skad cig la mi 'gyang nyul ba yi myur ma/ /rgyad pa'i dgra tshogs kun rmeg med gzhom byed kyi dpa' mo/ /rje btsun 'phrin las kyi lha mos thugs rje yis dgongs la/ /rim gnyis nor bu yi sga chas ci 'dod du bkol ba'i/ /theg mchog cang shes kyi rta 'dis tshe thung 'di'i yun la/ /sku gsum 'og min gyi khang bzang mthon po ru dkri ba'i/ /chos kyi rgyal srid 'di mi nyams brtan pa ru mdzod cig /mi mthun sgrib gnyis kyi dgra las dus ring nas rgyal yang / /rgyal thabs las bzhi yi ba dan sa chen 'dir 'dzugs phyir/ /rjes chags khro gnyer gyi rang mdangs dmu rgod la ngom pa'i/ /rje btsun 'phrin las kyi lha mos thugs rje yis dgongs la/ /zab gsal rigs lam gyi mtshon cha rno ngar dang ldan pas/ /bstan la than skyel gyi phas rgol dgra sde kun brlag phyir/ /dgag sgrub dpung tshogs kyi sgra chen 'brug sgra ltar sgrog pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal srid 'di ma nyams brtan pa ru mdzod cig /rje btsun nyin byed kyi dbang mo'i byin rlabs kyi bden pas/ /bde skyid sbrang rtsi yi dri 61

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bsung phyogs brgya ru 'thul ba'i/ /thub bstan skyed tshal gyi rgyan gcig dge ldan gyi pad ma/ /ma nyams dam chos kyi dgongs pas lus can kun gsos te/ /srid pa ming med du ma gyur de srid kyi bar du/ /pha ma nyam thag gi 'gro drug sems can gyi khams la/ /chos mchog bdud rtsi yi bgo bsha' yang nas yang 'gyed de/ /byang chub chen po ru dbugs dbyung bde blag tu mdzod cig /ces rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod cing 'dod don zhu ba rin po che bdun gyi 'khri shing zhes bya ba 'di ni/ snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa chen po rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po7'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros dpal bzang bo'i zhabs pad spyi bor thob pas/'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lugs bzang la dad pa cung zad thob pa'i rnam rgyal mkhan thogs pa/ blo bzang mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya bas/ mkhas pa'i dbang phyug gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me'i rig byed ma'i bstod pa'i dgongs bzhed dang tshig gi lad mor byas te bsgrigs pa de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/62

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/༄ga /rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bstod pa/na mo gu ru badz+ra lngar hi/ yid 'ong li khris byugs pa'i byu ru'i shing —/ /zag med bde ba'i 'bras bus dud pa bzhin/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i sgyu 'phrul lha mo'i gzugs/ /deng 'dir dran no mgon khyod zhal bzang ston/ /ring nas srid pa 'byung bo'i grong khyer du/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyi longs spyod spyad pa'i bu/ /deng 'dir ma cig zag med 'khri shing ma/ /khyod kyi thugs rjes yal bar 'dor ram ci/ /gang thugs g.yo ba med pa'i bde chen gter/ /bcu drug lang tshor 'phos pa'i smin legs ma/ /chags med chags pa'i sgyu rtsal ngom bzhin du/ /ring nas dka' thub 'phrog la chas pa bzhin/ /bde stong zung 'jug mtshon gyi rno ngar las/ /bdag rtog dbyings su bsgral ba'i dmar chen rgyun/ /rnam kun sred pas lhag med rngub bzhin du/ /chags sdang pho mo gnon pa'i 'phrin las 'bar/ /gzhir gnas chos 'byung pad nyi'i gdan steng na/ /ye shes rta gdong me yi tshang tshing dbus / /sgeg pa'i nyams brgyad 'dzin pa'i gzugs kyi sku/ /mi thod rus pa gsar ba'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /de ltar chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin/ /gang 'dul gzugs sku'i rol bar 'byams klas 63

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa'i / /mgon khyod bde chen rtse dga'i 'khri shing ma/ /snying nas skyabs su bsten no dgongs lags sam/ /gdod nas rnam dag rnam pa kun mkhyen pa'i/ /kun bzang brtse bas 'gro la gzigs lags na/ /mgon med nyam thag bdag 'dra'i sems can ni/ /rnam kun mkhyen pa'i yul du ma gyur ram/ /dug lnga'i gdon gyis ches cher btab na'ang ske/ /mgon khyod dgyes pa'i sa bon cung zad du/ /khyod sku sgom dang bzlas brjod la sogs 'di/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyu'i snod du mi 'gyur ram/ /gtan gyi skyabs gnas thugs rje'i gter chen khyod/ /yid 'ong lang tsho'i gar stabs sgyur bzhin du/ /bde chen pad+mo'i rnam 'gyur ma bstsal na/ /mu med srid pa'i gcong rong nyam re nga / /mgon med nyam thag sems can grangs re mang / /las nyon 'khor ba'i 'brel thag rgyun re zab/ /tshul 'di gzigs bzhin thugs kyis bzod dam ci/ /kye ma kye hud zag med chos 'byung ma/ /nges 'byung sems kyi chu gter 'phyur ba las/ /byang chub sems gnyis nor bu rab 'bar zhing / /zag med bde chen yid kyis rab myos pa'i/ /sgyu ma'i lang tsho stsol cig rje btsun ma/ /snang mun spar lag 'byed pa'i skya rengs dus/ /mi phyed skyil krung gcig gi rnam 'gyur la/ /rdo rje'i chos bdun rdzogs pa'i dga' ston gyis/ /srid pa'i phyi mtha' bar du 64

'khyud gyur cig /ces rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bstod cing 'dod don gsol ba 'di ni/ sprul ming mi bskyod dgyes bzhad du 'bod pas/dgun zla 'bring bo'i dmar phyogs kyi nyin lnga'i sgrub mchod skabs su gang shar 'phral du bris pa dza yan+tu/ /

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/༄/ /grub chen dpal rga lo ba la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa/'jam dpal gzhon nu zhi khro dus 'khor gyi/ /rim gnyis lam gyi mchog thun grub pa'i dpal/ /yongs brnyes zung 'jug nor bu'i za ma tog /grub chen rga lo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa'i yul nas rgyud sde mang bsgyur zhing / /bden tshig tsam gyis smyo 'bog la sogs zhi/ /'gro don chen po'i smon lam 'dzad med pa'i/ /grub chen rga lo'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gzhan brje ba'i sems bskyed shugs drag dang / /dmigs pa med pa'i rim gnyis ting 'dzin gyis/ /thugs rten mchod sdong bsam mi khyab bskrun pa'i/ /grub chen rga lo'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bram zes dug sel mchod sdong bsgrub pa bzhin/ /bla ma khyod kyi gdung rten rin po che/ /mthong thos dran reg grol ba'i byin rlabs can/ /'di nyid kho na'i bka' drin bsam mi khyab/ /da dung 'brel tshad don ldan mchod pa'i rten/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing du nyer bzhugs nas/ /phyag mchog mos gus bgyid pa mtha' dag gi /tshe 'di'i nad gdon rkyen ngan zhi ba dang / /phyi ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gros yongs bsus te/ /mkha' spyod 66

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/dag pa'i zhing du rig 'dzin gral/ /thob nas gsang chen chos kyi dga' ston gyis/ /grub pa gnyis rdzogs don gnyis mthar phyin shog /ces grub pa chen po dpal rga lo la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa 'di ni mgo log snyan mo ri rnam rgyal dge ldan zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang du 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i dge slong rig pa 'dzin pa'i ming tsam 'chang ba blo bzang mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya bas gus pas gsol ba btab pa dge /spro/ /bsil ba'i tshal du 'jigs med ting 'dzin brnyes/ /bod yul khams su 'gro don rgya chen mdzad/ bsad gso'i grub sogs rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas pa'i/ /grub mchog gzhon nu dpal la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal bstan snying po 'jam mgon tsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs 'khrul bral mdo sngags zung 'brel bstan/ /bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas 'dzin pa la/ /'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen lhun grub shog /

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/tshog /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po stong kha pa chen po la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa 'jam mgon 'dzum pa'i 'od zer zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣa ya/ rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yab gcig pu/ /shes bya ma lus mkhyen pa'i ye shes gter/ /rgyal sras thu bor shar ba'i 'jam mgon lha/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i zhabs pad gtsug gis mchod/ /ring nas srid par ngal pa'i sems kyi rgyun/ /kun rtog rlung gis dbang med 'khyer ba ni/ /deng 'dir khyod kyi zhabs skyes zhi ba'i phreng / /rab tu gsal ba'i ngogs su ngal bso smon / /gang gang rgyal ba rnams kyi yon tan gter/ /de de khyod nyid kho nas lhur bzhes bzhin/ /phul byung yon tan rgya mtshor dbang 'byor ba'i/ /gsang gsum rdo rje'i bdag nyid tsong kha pa/ /nyes bral tshul khrims mu khyud zlum po'i dbus/ /ting 'dzin nor bu'i lte ba lhun chags shing / /kun rmongs mthar byed blo gros rtsibs stong 'bar/ /bslab gsum 'khor lo'i dge mtshan bdag la stsol/ /'jam dbyangs zhal gyi pad+mo las 'ongs pa'i/ /mdo sngags bstan pa'i chu klung bye ba brgya / /khyod thugs ze'u 'brur gsar du sim pa'i tshul/ /ston mdzad 68

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/mkhyen pa'i gter chen tsong kha pa/ /mtha' yas ma gyur 'gro ba rgya mtsho la/ /gnas mthar phan bde'i legs tshogs sbyin pa'i gnyen/ /theg mchog bstan pa'i 'od zer 'bum spro ba'i/ /byang chub sems kyi nor bu bdag la stsol/ /gang gi thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings las 'phos pa'i/ /legs bshad sprin gyi nga ro sgrog pa dang / /lhan gcig skal bzang gdul bya'i 'dzin ma ru/ /nges don lo tog bskrun pa'i tsong kha pa/ /lnga rig 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod ri dwags mig /'khrul ba'i skyon dang bral ba'i dri za'i glu/ /mnyam rdzogs dran dbang gzhon nu'i yid 'phrogs pa'i/ /rab gsal blo gros btsun mo bdag la stsol//rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rgya mtsho'i nang nas kyang / /phul byung gsung rab snying po sher phyin lung / /stong dang rten 'brel dbyer med bkral ba yi / /klu sgrub gnyis pa 'jam mgon tsong kha pa/ /'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po'i lugs bzang gi /chos kyi rgyal srid skyong la mi 'jigs shing ske/ /bshad sgrub zung 'brel spel la zla bral ba'i/ /phul byung spobs pa'i blon po bdag la stsol/ /byams mgon thugs kyi sprin gyi lding khang las/ /'ongs pa'i theg mchog bdud rtsi'i zhal lung ni/ /gangs can 'di na ches cher gsal byed pa'i/ /thogs med gnyis pa 'jam mgon tsong kha pa/ /lung dang rigs pa'i lus rtsal rab rdzogs 69

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pas / /'jam mgon bstan pa'i khur chen 'degs bzod cing / /log smra 'dam bu'i dga' tshal 'joms mkhas pa'i/ /phul byung snying stobs glang po bdag la stsol/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rnyog bral bstan pa'i mtsho/ /bshad sgrub zung du 'brel ba'i 'dzum dkar can/ /'bebs mdzad rgyal sras tshul 'dzin dza hu na/ /bstan pa'i bdag po 'jam mgon tsong kha pa/ /bstan 'gro'i don du ngal ba bzod pa'i lus / /gang yang bsgrod nus pha rol sems shes pas/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal srid skyong ba'i grogs/ /bstan 'dzin a shwa rat+na bdag la stsolaske/ /pha rol phyin pa'i lam gyi gzhi bzung nas/ /rim gnyis bdud rtsi'i gsang lam zab mo yis/ /snyigs dus tshe 'dir zung 'jug 'grub pa'i lam/ /gsal mdzad rdo rje 'chang dbang tsong kha pa/ /dmu rgod snyigs ma lnga yi bdud kyi dpung / /ma lus ming tsam med par srid pa 'dir/ /mthar byed gsang chen lam gyi rnal 'byor gtso/ /rim gnyis dmag dpon brjid ldan bdag la stsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i / /gsang gsum 'phrin las bdud rtsi'i char rgyun gyis/ /skye ba kun tu bdag yid mdzes gyur cig /lung dang rigs pa'i spras pa'i mdo sngags chos/ /rgya cher rtogs pa'i g.yu ral dud pa yis/ /kun 70

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/bzang zhing du mdo rgyud dam pa'i gter/ /'byed pa'i mi yi seng ger bdag gyur cig khyad par 'khrul ba'i dri ma kun bral ba'i/ /'jam mgon bstan pa'i nyi ma 'od po che/ /srid zhi'i gtsug gi rgyan du 'god pa la/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa ji bzhin bdag gyur cig /tshe rabs kun tu tshul khrims rnam par dag /gzhan don skyo med bzod pa'i go cha brtan/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i yon tan gter brnyes pa'i/ /rgyal rnams dgyes pa'i sras su bdag gyur cig /mtha' yas skye dgu rgya mtsho sgrol ba'i phyir/ /smin grol chos kyi sbrang rtsi 'thung ba yi/ /thabs shes dbyer med lam gyi lus rdzogs nas/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi nyi mar mjal gyur cig /ces kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa 'jam mgon 'dzum pa'i 'od zer zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rgyal tshab snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa/ 7 blo bzang mkhas btsun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i zhabs pad la gus pas gtug pa'i ban chung rigs pa smra ba tshangs sras snyems pa'i sdes rang lo nyi shu ba chu khyi zla ba'i dmar phyogs mgon po gang de longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur sangs rgyas pa'i dus tshes dge bar bris pa sirnyirastu// //71

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/༄ga /yab rje 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po la bstod pa yid 'phrog bung ba'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje gdul bya'i spyi dpal du/ /mkhas btsun bzang ldan bla ma'i rnam rol ba'i/ /lnga rig mkhyen pa'i blo gros 'gran bral ba/ /khyod zhabs btud de yab rje'i zhabs la bstod/ /lta ba snyigs ma'i mtshan mo'i rum du log rtog mun pa bdo ba'i tshe/ /blo bzang gsung gi 'od dkar brdal ba'i mkhas las ches mkhas zla ba khyod / /thub bstan mchod sdong gzhi nas slong ba'i grags pa'i yal ga 'dzings pa yi/ smon lam 'khri shing dus su 'khrungs 'di yab rje rjes dran sgo gcig lags/ /de tshe rab tu mi gnas bzhin yang grub mtha' gang la gnas 'cha' ba/ /yang dag rigs tshul rdo rje'i rdul phran bye ba khrag khrig las bskrun pa'i/ /mtha' bzhi'i spros pa shin tu spangs pa'i brjod med med dgag chos kyi khrir/ /yab rje khyod dang 'phags mchog klu sgrub rdo rje'i gdan gcig nyid du gyur/ /rang bzhin gyis dag dag pa'i gshis de de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang / /bdud rtsi'i bgo skal skal bas thob bzhin bzhin mdzes btsun mo la 72
