bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/rol bzhin/ /gtan du longs spyod spyod pa mi mnyam mnyam med 'dren pa'i rang bzhin na/ /mgon khyod la yang yang yang bstod byed byed pa 'dir mtshungs gzhan la med/ /med ces dgag pa 'khrul ba'i 'dzin stangs rigs pas sun phyung nyid lags na/ /na rga 'chi ba mi bzhed phyin chad 'khor lo gnyis kyi snying po mchog /mchog dman theg pa kun gyi srog ste 'di la yab rje khyod las gzhan/ /gzhan phan spyod pas 'gro 'dren mang yang zab don blta ba'i mig 'byed dkon/ /dkon pa las kyang ches cher dkon pa spros pa'i rang bzhin spangs pa'i 'og /'khor 'das spang blang rnam par bkra ba'i rten 'byung tshon ris brgya 'dzin pa/ /'di ko lags zhes klu dbang gsung gi pad+mo'i ze'u 'brur snang lags te/ /mgon po khyod la ming rkyang tsam gyi rol rtsed nyid du bston med grub/ /de lta bas na las dang 'bras bus rnam par chad pa'i grang reg gis/ /gdung ba skyob pa'i zhi ba'i gos su kun gzhi'i re lde sogs spangs te/ /'gag pa med la shin tu 'os pa'i zhig pa pañtsa li ku'i dngos/ /btags yod sen mo'i bang du shong ba'i lha brgya'i gos la ci phyir bshung / /'gal pa ltar snang snang phyogs phra mo'i 'jog tshul tshul bzhin mdzad pa yi/ /klu sgrub srol 'dzin 'dzin ma'i rgyan gyur mkhas mchog mchog gsum grangs 'dzin 73

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa'i / /zab mo'i gsung ngag ngag gi dbang phyug gis bstan bstan pa'i nying khu 'dir/ /'jug par rigs so so so rang rig yul de de ltar shin tu grub/ /grub mtha' bzhi dang theg pa gsum gyi rgyal bstan nor bu ji snyed kun/ /kun bzang spyod pa'i dga' ston gcig tu 'gal med gdams par shar ba'i lam/ /lam rim gnyis kyis gangs can 'dis mtshon rnam dpyod ldan pa 'bum gyi yid/ /yid bzhin 'dod pa 'jo ba'i nor bus chags ldan dga' bar byed pa bzhin / /de lta lags na rang gi blo/ /shing rta chen po'i gzhung lugs kyi / /yang yang byi dor byas pa na/ /dag dod khyod gsung ngo mtshar char / /gling 'dir dam chos nyin byed khyod/ /dus ring nyid nas shar na yang / /da dung rmongs pa byang bstan phug /mun pa'i khung bur gyur 'di ci/ /phyogs su lhung ba'i sems gdung bas/ /zhi ba nam yang mi mthong zhes/ /bdag nyid chen po'i gsungs pa 'di/ /'di ltar bden pa'i tshig tu gyur/ /legs par bshad pa'i bdud rtsi ches mngar yang / /log pa'i dug tu mthong nas dor ba yi/ /ris chad blo yi dri ma de lta bu/ /nam yang yid la 'jag par ma gyur cig /nges don lung gi tshon brgyas rnam phye ba/ /yang dag rigs pa'i pir gyis legs bcad pa'i/ /yab rje'i lugs bzang bde gshegs sku gzugs 74

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/kyi / /ngo mtshar ltad mo rtag tu blta bar shog /skye ba kun tu tshul khrims rnam dag pa'i/ /tshangs spyod rten la theg pa chen po'i chos/ /tshang la ma nor bka' gdams gsar rnying lugs/ /thos bsam sgom pas rtag tu 'dzin par shog /de tshe 'jig tshogs lta bas kun btags pa/ /med par dgag pa'i 'khrul ba sun phyung don/ /don gyi dam par snying nas nges 'drongs te/ /lta ba mchog 'dzin rab tu spangs nus shog /rang mtshan grub pa rdul tsam med na yang / /las kyi zhig pas 'bras bu skyed nus pa/ /snum zad pa yis mar me shi ba ltar/ /las 'bras 'jog tshul phra mor nges rnyed shog /las ma zhig par 'bras bu mi 'byung na/ /chud ma za dang thob pa mi dgos par/ /zhig pa rang gis 'bras bu nges 'byin pa'i/ /rten 'brel bslu med tshul la mkhas par shog /nam yang snying brtses yang dag rigs lam gyis/ /gzhan dag tshar gcod byed pa ma gtogs par/ /su la'ang sun 'byin tshig dang smod pa'i tshig /rnam pa kun tu byed par ma gyur cig /dam pa rnams la nam yang dgos med du/ /klan ka 'tshol ba'i bsam pa mi skye zhing //theg pa chen pos 'gro ba mtha' dag la/ /dge ba'i bshes kyi 'du shes rnyed par shog /g.yo dang sgyu yis cha tsam ma bslad par/ /gzhan sems bsrung ba'i thabs la rab goms te/ /yid dang mthun pa'i 75

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/spyod pa kho na'i sgos/ /rgyal sras spyod pa mtha' dag rdzogs par shog /ces yab rje 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po la bstod pa yid 'phrog bung ba'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rgyal ba'i gsung rab la dpyod pa'i sgo ma dod bzhin yul dam pa 'di 'dra la/ stong nyid med dgag gi khri la bzhugs nas/ zhig pa dngos po'i chos 'khor zhig bskor te sogs kyis sun 'byin pa thos nas / smad pa bstod pa'i don du song ngo snyam du yang dag pa'i rigs pa'i dga' ston nyams su myong ste/ 'jam dbyangs dngos kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rjes su bzung ba'i bka' drin las/ yab rje'i ring lugs mgon po klu sgrub yab sras kyi bka' srol du yid ches rnyed pa/ dharma sā raḥzhes bya bas snyan mo ri'i gtsug lag khang nas bris pa rgyal bstan snying po 'di nyid phyogs dus kun tu rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig / 76

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/༄/ /rje btsun bla ma dam pa la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa dad pa'i me tog 'thor ba'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu dwangs ma'i ye shes sku/ /rags pa'i gzugs su rol ba'i dge ba'i bshes/ /yongs rdzogs thub bstan 'dzin pa'i blo gros gter/ /khyod kyi zhabs pad gtsug gi nor bur mchod/ /srid pa'i 'dam dang bral zhing snying rje'i chab kyis bskyed pa'i sprul ba'i pad+ma ni/ /gtsang ma'i rigs kyi rdzing bur legs par bltams dang lhan cig kun bzang spyod pa yi/ /yid 'phrog dri bsung mngar bos skal bzang bung ba'i tshogs kun ngo mtshar mgron chen por/ /bos pa'i byis pa'i spyod kyang 'phags chen rgan po'i brtul zhugs rol ba 'di ko rmad/ /snyigs ma mun pa'i rum du skye ba'i 'od/ /ltar snang 'dres kyang rin chen sems kyi rdul/ /mi mnyam gzhan phan smon pa'i rigs sngags kyis/ /btab pa'i ye shes sgyu ma 'di la dad/ khyad par phyogs dang zla ba'i bgrang bya'i tshe/ /dus ring zhig nas rlabs chen spyod pa la/ /goms pa'i 'jigs med gad rgyangs cher bsgrags pas/ /rgyal sras ri dwags dbang po mngon sum 77

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gyur / /de tshe grong khyer skyid pa'i 'byung gnas nyid las tshong dpon nor bzang brtan pa'i bu bzhin tu/ /rgyal sras spyod la slob pa'i theg mchog chos la pad+ma'i mtsho la sred pa'i ngang ba bzhin/ /gangs can lim bu'i skyed tshal mchog gi sde la leṭa par zhugs te rigs pa'i gzhung lugs brgya/ /rnam dpyod dpal du bzhes pa rgyal ba'i sras kyi rnam par thar ba di ni ngo mtshar bla na med/ /de tshe sgra dbyangs sras po dang / /khyed nyid bshes gnyen bsten pa la/ /sha khrag btsong dang ma btsong las/ /bsam sbyor gzhan la tha dad med/ /de nas bzung ste nyin re bzhin/ /dam pa'i yon tan chu bo brgya/ /khyod thugs rgya mtshor drangs pa yis/ /mi zad yon tan gter du gyur/ /blun po sbyangs goms med bzhin du/ /yon tan 'tshol la lhag par g.yel/ /khyod nyid skyes thob rdzogs bzhin du/ /yon tan 'tshol la ngoms pa med / /ring nas sbyangs pa'i yon tan gter/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i dri bsung ltar/ /sba bar btub pa ma yin yang / /da dung tshe rabs re re bzhin / /gdul bya 'dul pa'i don gyi slad/ /sbyangs stobs yon tan bdud rtsi'i klung / /bzhes la rangs pa'i sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /'di ni ngo mtshar kun gyi phul/ /grangs med rgyal ba'i mdun sar zab mo'i don//rnam par 'bel ba'i legs bshad glu dbyangs dang / /lhan cig kun 78

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/bzang spyod pa'i rtse dga' yis/ /mngon rtogs nor bu'i mdzod la dbang bsgyur bzhin/ /snyigs ma lnga yis dman pa'i yul dus 'dir/ /dmu rgod 'dul ba'i thabs mkhas thong gshol gyis/ /gzhan phan so nam byed pa khyod 'dra yang / /kye ma skye bo phal dang snyoms rnams blun//gangs ri'i mu khyud 'dzin pa'i ljongs 'di ru/ /lo paṇa bstan pa'i sgron me mang byon te/ /chos 'dod chos kyi bgo skal la bzhag pa'i/ /ris med bstan pa'i klung brgya khyod kyis gsos/ /'on tang yan lag brgyad ldan dge ba'i rdzing / /kun la bdud rtsir gyur ba'i lugs bzang rgyun/ /bsam 'phel nor bur sngags pa'i rnam thar 'dis/ /dwangs shing blo gros ldan pa'i phul du bstan/ /lnga phrag rig gzhung pad+ma'i ldum ra cher/ /khyod kyi mkhyen pa'i nyi 'od lhung tsam nas/ /dka' gnad 'dab brgya'i 'dzum zer grol gyur te/ /legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i dus ston g.yur du za/ /theg chen chos kyi mkha' dbyings yangs pa'i khyon/ /khyod blo rnam sad 'od brgyas 'khyud pa las/ /byang chub sems kyi bsngags brjod pad dkar phreng / /skal bzang snyan gong mdzes pa'i rgyan du sbyin/ de slad khyod la 'dun pa'i lus can yang ske/ /ltar snang lam la lam du ma 'khrul bas/ /theg mchog rigs kyi nus pa sad pa ni/ /so ga'i me tog tshogs rnams rgod pa bzhin/ /stong 79

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/nyid lus phra'i 'jo sgeg mig 'phrul ltar/ /bsgyur bas mkhas pa'i tshogs kyang ngal mod de//gang gi blo gros ba dan lhun chags pa/ /rnam par mi rtog ri bo'i brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /gshis lugs nam mkha'i khams su spros pa'i sprin/ /med bzhin rtogs pa'i pir gyis bris pa yi / /'khor 'das snang grags 'ja' tshon ri mo ltar/ /ma 'dres bkra ba'i ltad mo khyod kyis gzigs/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing na rgyal sras ri dwags khyu'i/ /mchog gyur chos kyi rjes 'brang kho na'i tshogs/ /dga' bas myos pa'i zab mo'i dus ston der/ /khyod blo blo bzang rgyal ba ji bzhin mdzes/ /sdom gsum tshul khrims gser gyi snye ma che/ /khyod kyi phyag mtshan zhing du yongs bzhes nas/ /nyes ltung ba mo'i reg pas ma gos pas/ /btsun pa'i 'od stong lam mer gyur 'di rmad/ /khyod sku ma la ya yi ljon pa bzhin/ /yid 'phrog tshul khrims bzang bo'i dri ngad rgyun/ /kun nas ldang bas 'khor yug dga' byed pa/ /chos kyi ded dpon khyod min su la bdog /khyod ni snying rje'i gzhan dbang gyur ba yi/ /bzang bo'i thugs kyi zla ba gsar pa'i khams/ /phyin drug ri dwags mtshan ma las gzhan pa'i/ /kun rtog dri mas btang bas ches cher dkar/ /rnyed bkur 'dod pa'i 'dam gyis ma gos pa'i / /chags med chu yi pad+mo gnyis pa'i thugs/ /stong chen chos kyi 80

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/mkha' dbyings la rol bzhin/ /gzhan phan spyod pa'i dri bsung 'bum du 'phro/ /thabs shes mi phyed rdo rje theg mchog gi /rim gnyis bdud rtsis myos pa'i thugs gsang che/ /grub gnyis bsam 'phel nor bu'i phreng ba yis/ /'dod dgur brgyan pa'i rgyal thabs rmad du byung / /grangs med tshogs gnyis dka' thub mig 'phrul ltar/ /sdom byed bde ba'i thabs mchog bde ba che/ /phra rag rlung sems khams kyi las rlung gis/ /bde blag mngon du gyur pa'i grub mchog khyod/ /sa ra ha dang pad+ma badz+ra sogs/ /grub brgya'i khyu mchog nyid du grags rnams dang / /grub pa'i mngon rtogs mnyam pa nyid gyur pa'i/ /grub pa'i dpa' bor gdon mi za bar grub/ /da lta na yang bstan pa rin po cher / /dgongs te bka' gdams gtsang ma'i phyag bzhes kyis/ /thub bstan skyong ba'i rnam thar kho nas 'da'/ /smyo spyod grub pa'i rdzob kyang khyod mi mdzad/ /rgyud lnga'i lam la nges med 'gro ba yi/ /nyam thag sems can dmu rgod mang bo yang / /dngos brgyud phrin las don yod 'phrul zhags kyis/ /bzung nas rnam grol gling du 'dren par mdzad/ /blo chen 'phags pa'i ye shes sgyu ma nyid/ /gsum ldan sdom brtson dge sbyong la brdzus pa'i/ /'gro 'dul rgyal ba'i gsang ba nam mkha'i mtha' / /ji bzhin 'jal ba'i blo nus ga la zhig /de lta na yang dad 81

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa'i mchod sdong la/ /nges shes gzi 'od phyi phyir 'bar ba'i slad/ /nyung ngu'i tshig gis bstod pa'i byi dor 'di/ /rje btsun chos kyi rgyal pos dgyes dgongs la/ /smin grol a mra tas bkang ke la shas/ /skye zhing skye bar mngon par dbang bskur te/ /blo bzang rgyal bstan dri ma med pa'i mdzod/ /'dod dgur 'byed pa'i mchog sbyin bstsal du gsol / /ris med thub bstan 'o ma'i btung ba mchog /dri med rigs pas nying khur byas pa yi/ /chos mchog zhun mar gser sbyangs btso ma'i spun/ /g.yo med 'jig rten rgyan du gnas gyur te/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi them skas las/ /mngon mtho nges legs rin chen gzhal med che/ /don gnyis 'byor bas mdzes pa'i khang bzang der/ /bdag dang ma rgan 'gro rnams dbugs dbyung shog /༄cu/ /rje btsun bla ma dam pa dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid cher/ /dpal ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i zlos gar gyis / /thub bstan rin chen rgyan du yongs rol pa'i/ /kun mkhyen bla ma blo gros gter chen khyod/ 1 /bgrang yas bskal ba'i sngon nas byang chub kyang / /rgyal sras tshul gyis rgyal ba'i mdzad pa kun/ /legs par mdzad pa'i smon lam stobs mnga' bar/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje 82

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/mchog dang gnyis su med/ 2 /de phyir thugs rje'i chab kyis bskyed pa yi / /ye shes sgyu ma'i rol rtsed gzhal dka' ba'i/ /sprul ba'i me tog 'di la thub rnams kyang / /ngo mtshar gyur na bdag gtsugs cis mi mdzes / 3 /sku ni dka' thub can gyi drang srong bzhin/ /log 'tsho spangs pa'i tshangs spyod brtul zhugs mchog /ngoms slad rkem pa'i zol gyis skal ldan la/ /yid 'ong mig gi bdud rtsi bsgrub pa bzhin/4 /gsung ni lnga rigs shes bya'i rgya mtsho che'i/ /zab yangs rlabs kyis log rtog dri bkrus nas/ /gdams don nyams len hub gcig la 'dris pas/ /bka' gdams dam pa'i rnam thar ngom pa bzhin/5 /thugs kyi nam mkha' gya gyu'i 'gros 'dzin pa'i/ /kun rtog sprin dang bral ba'i 'od gsal ngog /byams brtse'i nyi zla'i 'od kyis g.yogs pa ni/ /mkha' khyab rgyal ba'i gsang bar mi gnyis bzhin/6 /de slad thugs ni mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas te/ /gsung ni thos dka' dam chos rin chen mdzod/ /sku mchog mthong grol dge 'dun nyid lags pas/ /skyabs gsum khyod nyid gcig pus bsgrubs pa bzhin / 7 /byin rlabs mdzod 'dzin dngos brgyud bla ma'i gar/ /dngos grub gter chen yi dam zhi khro'i bdag /'phrin las thog med dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /kun 'dus nor bu'i cod paṇa khyod 83

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/las su/ 8 /de phyir mtha' med srid pa'i tshang tshing du/ /las smon 'thor rlung shugs kyis bdas gyur kyang / /theg mchog bshes gnyen rgyan khyod ma bral na/ /phongs pa'i skabs med legs dgu'i dpal gyis bgrod/ 9 /des na chu yi zla ba'i rjes 'gro ba'i/ /sprul ba'i dge sbyong skyon bral yon tan gter/ /khyod sku mig dang khyod gsung rna ba'i rgyan / /khyod thugs yid dang nam yang 'bral med shog 10 /khyod kyi ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i rnam thar 'bum/ /dwangs pa'i me long ngos la gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /tshe rabs phreng bar yid kyi nyer 'tsho ru/ /bkod de dad pa'i dbang po brtas par shog 11 /srid 'dir sems can gcig kyang mi gnas par/ /khyod kyi gzhan phan mdzad pa'i gaṅga'i 'gros/ /chad pa med pa de srid bdag gis kyang / /mnyes pa kho na sgrub pa'i bran bgyid shog 12 /dkon mchog mthu dang bslu med rten 'brel las/ /ji ltar bsam pa'i dad pa'i stobs 'phel zhing / /ji ltar smon pa'i don chen legs grub nas/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor zab mos 'da' bar shog /ces dus gsum rgyal ba'i ngo bo bka' drin mtshungs med rje btsun chos kyis rgyal po don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na/ 7 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros dpal bzang po'i zhabs la bstod pa dad 84
pa'i me tog bskrun pa'i rdzing bu zhes bya ba 'di ni mgon po de nyid kyis thugs brtse bas bskyangs kyang yon tan gyi dris ma gos pa'i btsun gzugs dharma sā ras rang gi dad pa 'phel ched du bsgrigs/ /

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/spro/ /gsang bdag mi 'gyur rdo rje'i bstod pa don ldan gtam gyi rnga sgra bzhugs/gsang gsum mi shigs rdo rje bde chen khams/ /yongs grub bdud bzhi'i dgra las rnam rgyal ba/ /'gro 'dul grub pa'i slob dpon chen po'i zhabs / /byang chub bar du spyi bo'i rgyan du bsten/ /khyod kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dpal/ /ji bzhin rdzogs par brjod par nus min kyang / /bsod nams 'phel zhing dad pa brtan pa'i slad/ /cha tsam brjod la dgyes pas dgongs par 'tshal/ /srid gsum mi rtag g.yo ba la/ /'du byed mtha' dag sdug bsngal zhes/ /khyod thugs bden pa bzhis drangs te/ /nges 'byung bsam pas skabs phyes nas/ /zhi ba'i gling du bgrod pa yi/ /lam bzang rin chen be+edūr skas/ /ring mo zhig nas yongs 'dzegs te/ /srid pa'i 'dam du khyod ma byings/ /de tshe mkha' khyab 'gro ba yang / /khyod kyis ma ru legs gzigs te/ /phongs pas nyams nga ma bzod nas/ /theg pa mchog gi go cha bzhes/ /de phyir bdag dang gzhan gyi blo'i/ /phyogs ris bral ba'i gzigs ngo der/ /grangs med 'gro ba'i khams mtha' dag /bdag pas lhag par gces par gyur/ /de slad gzhan 86

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/phan mkho dgu'i nor/ /khyod mdzad yal ga rer dud pa'i/ /lus can mgon gyur dpag bsam ljon/ /bskal mang gong nas 'khrungs 'di rmad / /'gro ba kun gyi bde ba'i khur/ /khyod kyis rnam pa kun tu ni/ /phrag par thogs la mi ngal ba'i/ /rlabs chen spyod pa'i grogs nyid du / /gang zhig len dang gang 'dor ba'i/ /bdag gzhan so so'i 'du shes kyi/ /'khrul ba'i ri mo ji snyed pa/ /spros bral dbyings su khyod kyis bsub/ /des na chags bral tshogs rnams kyang / /gang la ngal ba'i lus can khur/ /'khur la mgon khyod mi ngal bas/ /zhi ba'i mtha' yang khyod kyis spangs/ /e ma ho dam pa'i skyes mchog khyod/ /de phyir gsang chen chos kyi mdzod/ /ci dgar phye ba'i bdag po ste/ /gcig tu gzhan don dgongs pa yi/ /thams cad mi 'gyur rdo rje'i khams / /grub gnyis nor bu'i dngos po ru/ /gyur ba'i gtam 'di don ldan du/ /shes pa'i gtan tshig bla na med/ /theg mchog chos kyi sgo 'byed pa'i/ /rin chen ke la sha yi chus/ /bkrus pa'i rang bzhin rnam dag khams/ /dri bral gyur ba'i khungs ldan gtam/ /da dung dad pa'i me tog 'bum/ /cir yang rgod slad spro bya ste/ /gtam 'dis mgon khyod gshegs pa'i shul/ /mtshon te rjes su bgrod par smon/ /gdod nas dag pa'i gnyug ma'i khams/ /lhag pa'i bden pa dbyer 87

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/med der/ /gtan tshigs chen po bzhi yi sgos/ /khyod kyi blo gros cher rgyas te/ /nyams myod srid la gzhal bzhed nas/ /gsang mchog bdud rtsi'i ro mngar po/ /yang yang btung ba'i rtogs pa'i lus/ /e ma rig 'dzin zhing du gyur/ /de tshe snang grag rig pa'i dngos/ /lha dang sngags dang chos kyi sku'i/ /rnam pa nyid du smin pa yis/ /thun min thabs kyi gter brgya rnyed/ /de lta'i rtogs pa'i lus nyid du/ /tshe 'dir theg mchog rgyal srid la/ /dbang ba'i she mong 'bum rdzogs nas / /'gro ba'i skal ba sbom por gyur/ /gsang chen thabs kyis yongs 'phags pa'i/ /khyod thugs bde chen skyes bu mchog /de nas stong nyid phyag rgya mos/ /gnyis med mgron du bos pa yi ngo mtshar 'di la rgyal ba rnams/ /gcig tu dgyes pa'i tshul de ru/ /mnyam bzhag ces byar btags pa ste/ /chos kyi sku yang de kho na/ /der ni nyon mongs dri ma kun/ /sbrul gyi pags pa bzhin bskyur te/ /chags bral rig pa chen mo'i yum/ /mngon sum bzhes 'di ngo mtshar phul/ /de tsho yod dang med pa dang / /yin min gnyis snang spros pa'i sprin/ /'od gsal nam mkha'i rang gzugs su/ /dwangs pa'i ngon rtogs rtsal chen rgyas/ /de nas bag chags phra mo'i g.ya'/ /sbyong ba'i shin tu rnal 'byor mchog /lhun grub rig pa'i dga' ston la/ /rtsol med 88

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/bzhag thabs 'ba' zhig gis/ /don gnyis lhun grub chen po'i sa/ /kun tu 'od kyi rgyal srid che/ /mngon du mdzad pa'i rol ba yis/ /srid pa ji srid bzhugs pa lags/ /zab yangs sku gsum rin chen khang bzang du/ /don gnyis phun tshogs 'byor bas brgyan pa yi/ /lus can kun la ma bzhin byams brtse mgon/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i yon tan pha mtha' med/ /de phyir phyogs re'i mngon par shes pa dang / /'gro don ltar snang grub pa'i brdzu bag sogs/ /nyi tshe'i glod pa'i yon tan brjod pas/ /bdag ni lhag par ngo mtshar ma gyur to/ /don dam nam mkha'i thugs ni nam mkhar mnyam/ /brjod med nam mkha'i gsung gis nam mkha' 'gengs/ /skye med nam mkha'i sku yis nam mkha' khyab/ /ngo mtshar de 'drar bdag blo ngo mtshar gyur/ /de lta'i yon tan cha tsam brjod pa yi/ /tshig gi me tog dad pa'i skud pa la / /nye bar brgyus te rig 'dzin slob dpon mchog /rjes su dran pa'i dga' ston bsgrub pa'i mthus/ /skye dang skye bar dal 'byor rten thob ste/ /theg mchog dge ba'i bshes khyod rab bsten nas/ /thun mong thun min gsang chen bgrod pa yis/ /sku gsum rin chen gling du phyin gyur cig /ces rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsang mdzod 'dzin pa'i grub dbang 89

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bla ma rin po che 7 gsang bdag mi 'gyur rdo rje'i zhabs la rig 'dzin bzhi'i lam nas theg pa mchog gi rgyal srid chen por ji ltar gshegs pa'i tshul las brtsams te bstod pa don dang ldan pa'i gtam gyi rnga bo che'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mgon po gang gi rigs sras rin po che bstan 'dzin nyi ma'i gsung gis 'di ltar gyis shig ces bka' yi me tog spyi bor phebs pa ltar/ shākya'i dge slong gi rtags tsama'adzin pa'i gus slob dharma sā raḥzhes bya bas bris pa dge legs 'phel// //

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/༄ga /sgrol bstod 'ga' zhig bzhugs/mo gu ru ar+ya tā re yā/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i / /srid zhi'i 'jigs sgrol ār+ya ta re'i zhabs/ /khyod min gzhan du sdug bsngal grong 'khyer 'dir/ /nyam thag re ltos 'cha' ba'i mgon skyabs su/ /de phyir deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bslu med skyabs su bsten der gsol 'debs na/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ji ltar bskyangs pa bzhin/ /nyam thag bdag kyang thugs kyis skyongs shig gu/ /dal 'byor rin chen sgrom du bzung ba'i bcud/ /chos kyi nying khu sdom gsum a mṛ ta/ /'gal rkyen snyigs ma lnga yis mi brdzi bar/ /tshe mthar thug pa'i byin rlabs mchog sbyin mdzod/ /'di nas 'phos tshe yid dga' chos 'dzin du/ /rjes btsun bla ma 'jam dpal snying po'i drung/ /skyes nas theg mchog chos sgo mang nod de/ /rlabs chen byang chub spyod la 'jug nus shog /mug /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las gzugs/ /'jigs brgyad las sgrol bla ma rje btsun ma/ /rang sems dwangs pa'i ngo bor legs bkod te/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'phags ma'i thugs rjes gzigs/ /tshe dang chos la bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /tshul 91

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/khrims rnam dag thos bsam sgom gsum gyi/ /dal ba'i rten bzang don dang ldan pa yis/ /'phags ma ji bzhin don gnyis lhun grub shog /༄7/ /na mo gu ru/ /gang mtshan tā re'i rigs sngags me lces kyang / /'jigs brgyad bud shing thal bar brlag byed na/ /rgyal yum khyod la sgrol mar zhing kun tu/ /grags pa don ldan yin snyam bdag yid 'phrog /sku ni sngo ljang mar gad ljon pa'i ngos/ /mtshan gyi yal ga so gnyis re re la/ /'khyud pa'i dpe byad me tog ches bkra bas/ /tshul 'dis mig gi bdud rtsir deng mdzod cig /gsung mchog dam chos sbrang rtsi bye ba'i ro/ /tshangs dbyangs gdangs re bzhin du rab rdzogs pa'i/ /nges legs gling du skal ldan 'khrid pa'i gtam/ /bdag gi rna ba'i bcud du ded mdzod cig /'gyur med thugs kyi thig ler rnam kun tu/ /gnyis snang rtog pa'i gra zur yongs bral te/ /chos dbyings dga' mar rol ba'i bde ba che/ /shas tsam bdag la bgo bsha' nyid du mdzod/ /phrin las ji srid srid pa ma stong bar/ /sems can khams la la la tsam min par/ /'jug pa'i 'phags ma ma dang 'dra ba kye/ /bdag la dngos grub grub gnyis mchog stsol cig /ces pa dang rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i don bstod dngos 92

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'di yang rig gnas pa dharma ri hwas bskul ngor chos gzugs smra ba dharma sa raḥbris pa 'phags ma'i byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug pa'i rgyur gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/ /༄7/ /mthon mthing sku yi lcang lo'i zar bu la/ /ut+pal tshom bur brgyus pa'i rgyan ldan pa'i/ /rje btsun lhag pa'i lha mo da tsam na/ /'dzum ldan bzhin gyi zla ba mi ngom sam/ /gsol 'debs bu chung nyam thag bdag 'dras kyang / /brtse ldan lha mor phyi thag mi bstung na/ /'gro kun bu ltar dgongs pa'i rje btsun ma/ /khyod kyis ci'i phyir bdag la phyi thag bstung / /khyod mtshan rigs sngags thos pa'i me lces kyang —/ /sdug bsngal 'khyags rim rmig med bcil gsung na/ /rtse gcig yid kyi ze'u 'brur khyod bkod nas/ /gsol 'debs sbrang chung glu dbyangs mi gsan nam/ /kye kye 'phags ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs ma/ /'jigs rung skye 'chi na rga'i gcong rong 'dir/ /las kyi zhags pas dam du bcings pa'i mdud/ /khrol la g.yu lo bkod par 'khrid du gsol/ /gnas skabs su yang dam chos nor bu'i khur/ /phyur bur spungs pa'i tshe yi shing rta'i 'gros/ /chad med chu klung bzang po'i rgyun bzhin du/ /mthar gyis gzhol te nam zhig 'chi ba'i tshe/ /'phags ma khyed sku nyin byed 'char kha'i gzi/ /yid la lam mer 93

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gsal ba'i dran rig 'gros/ /rgyal yum khyod thugs spros med bde ba che / /'od gsal nam mkha'i lhums su zhugs gyur cig /gang mtshan riṭa sngags rnon po'i me lce'i dbal/ /dran pa tsam gyi bdud sde'i bud shing 'bum/ /bsreg mdzad lhag pa'i lha mo khro gnyer can/ /gsol 'debs bu la thugs rjes ci'i mi dgongs/ /'jigs chen bcu drug rab rngam sprin nag rum/ /tshe bsod 'od snang yib pa'i rgud pa la/ /zhi bsil phrin las rlung gi skyabs sbyin ma/ /deng 'dir gdung bas 'bod do thugs rjes dgongs/ /sngar zhig khyod mtshan dran pa'i phan yon 'bum/ /ches lci 'dir yang nyams pa med pa'i 'bras/ /thugs rjes 'khri shing dpal gyis bzung ngo zhes/ /thos pas lhag par smre sngags 'bod do kye/ /ma cig khyod kyi bu ngan bdag gi tshul/ /mkhyen bzhin lags kyang 'o dod kyis gsol na/ /rmongs chen gdon gyis dbang med bzung ba yis/ /kun 'byung gzeb tu tshud pas shin tu skyo / /sdug bsngal nye bar len pa'i rang gzugs 'di/ /mtho ris grong na spyod pa'i khul lags kyang / /mi 'dod du mas gtses pa'i gnas skabs la/ /bdag la 'phags ma las gzhan gtad so ci/ /chos brgyad mnyen tshog bu mo'i lag pa la/ /dam du 'khyud pa'i chags chen bdag la sogs/ /ngan song g.yang sar lhung la khad nye bas/ /94

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/'phags ma'i skyabs sbyin phyag rgya spyi bor zhog /'khrul gzugs phyi ru shar ba'i gdon chen po/ /tshe chos dpal la rgol ba ches mang yang / /tā re'i rigs sngags zlos pa'i bsil grib las/ /gab sa gzhan med 'phags ma brtse ldan ma/ /lung rigs lang tshos sgeg pa'i sher phyin mar / /rtse 'dod dben par dga' bas 'dod pa'i dngos/ /sgrub pa'i mthun grogs khyed la gus bcol gyi/ /thugs rjes myur du skyongs shig myur ma kye/ /mdor na a ti sha dang 'brom nyi sras/ /thugs rjes bzung bzhin bdag kyang byang chub bar/ /'bral med rjes su skyongs zhes gsol 'debs bur/ /yal bar ma 'dor 'phags ma rje btsun zug / /zhes pa 'di yang bar skabs su yid la shar ba ltar rje btsun ma la gsol 'debs byas pa sirnyi rastu dharma sā ras so//95

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/sto /sa chen bsod nams rtse mo'i zhabs la bstod pa bzhugs/oṃ swa ste/ gang gi bsod nams zhal bzang bzhad pa'i ngo mtshar yid la ches lci ste/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul rol mo rdo rje theg pa'i dbang phyug che/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i dga' ba'i tshal du 'khrungs pa'i yi ge'i ri mo la/ /mgon khyod mig yangs ma tshogs bris pa'i grub pa'i rtse mo bdag gi skyabs/ /de tshe shākya'i rgyal po'i sku dang yul gyis dgyes pa'i lang tsho ni/ /mtshan dpes mdzes shing skyil krung gis bzhugs bdag nyid byis pa'i spyod pa las/ /'das so zhes pa'i 'jigs med nga ro tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis lan gnyis su/ /rnam par sgrog pa'i bsod nams dbang phyug 'phags tshogs rtse mo khyod las su/ /bgrang bya gsum par 'jam dpal nyid kyis 'jam dpal dang ni kye rdo rje/ /ār+ya tā re'i zhal gzigs tshul bstan rgyud gsum dang ni bde mchog rgyud/ /kun las btus lnga thugs las gsung ste sngon nas sbyangs pa'i 'bras rtags kyis/ /'phags yul paṇa chen bcu gcig brgyud de 'khrungs pa gzhan la'ang mngon sum bzhin/ /mdo rgyud man ngag chu klung 'bum bzhes thub bstan chu yi gter 96

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/'dzin zhing / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i zegs ma 'bum 'phro khyad par rgyud don rgya mtsho la/ /dbang bsgyur grub pa'i klu dbang zhes byar gaṅgā tshun chad grags pa'i rnga/ /phyogs kyi bu mos brdung ba'i tshul 'dis brtan pa mi 'phrogs blo ldan su/ /lam dang 'bras bu'i chos kyi zhal lung skal bzang gsos su bstsal ba'i tshe/ /nam mkhar mchod tshogs sprin bzhin 'khrigs dbus 'jam dpal dbyangs dang birlu ba/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi sku yi rnam pas chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs gnang bas/ /ting 'dzin khyad du 'phags pa'i bde bas skal bzang tshogs rnams myos 'di rmad/ khyad par grags pa'i bsod nams dpal du sprul ba'i dkyil 'khor mngon mdzad de/ /ting 'dzin rtse mo bde chen sgo brgya bsam mi khyab pa dbye mdzad pa'i/ /mgon khyod nges par rdo rje 'chang dngos chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin/ /sna tshogs 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal du tha mal dge ba'i bshes kyi gzugs/ /de ltar don du skye 'chi gnyis med mi shigs rdo rje'i skur brnyes pas/ /'khor tshogs du mas bskor ba'i dbus na chos kyi zhal lung gsung gi 'phror//lha yi rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bde ba can du sku de nyid/ /mngon sum gshegs mdzad bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rtse mor gyur pa khyod la 'dud / /de ltar dad pas bstod pa'i ko ki la/ /sa chen bstan pa'i 97

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ljon shing yal ga ru/ /mngon par 'khyud pa'i dpyid kyi dus ston ni/ /spel byed rigs pa smra ba e gu rna/ /'di las byung ba'i dge tshogs ston zla'i zer/ /sa chen ring lugs dri bral ku mu das/ /'thung ba'i blo gros dri bsung yongs 'phel te/ /bsod nams rtse mo ji bzhin bdag 'gyur shog /sa chen ring lugs bstan pa spel ba dang / /sa 'dir phan bde'i gzhi rtsa 'dzugs pa la/ /dpal ldan gur gyi mgon pos grogs mdzad nas/ /sa chen yab sras thugs dgongs rdzogs gyur cig /ces sa chen chos kyi rgyal po rje btsun 7 bsod nams rtse mo'i zhabs la bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa 'di nyid/ snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa chen po rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po/ 7 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga nas las skyes shing /sa chen yab sras la g.yam rgyug tsam min pa'i dad pa thob pa'i ban chung rigs pa smra ba tshangs sras snyems pa'i sde zhes bya bas rnam rgyal chos grwar bris pa dza yan+tu// //98

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/༄/ /sa chen kun dga' snying po'i zhabs la bstod pa bzhugs/oṃ swa ste/ dpal ldan rigs sngags grub pa'i lang tsho be+eḍūr lcang lo'i thor cog rtser/ /chos skyong rgyal po'i brtul zhugs zla zer bsnyel med kun nas lhung ba yis/ /dga' ba'i 'dab brgya snying nas 'dzum pa'i mgon po grub pa'i dpal yon can/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod kyi zhabs sen srid pa'i mthar yang spyi bos mchod/ /dkon mchog gdung rigs chad pa med slad chos kyi rgyal po'i sgyu rtsal ni/ kha sarba ṇa'i gzugs kyi rnam pas skye med skye bar mngon zhugs te/ /srid zhi'i mchod sdong gcig pur gyur ba'i grub pa'i zhal ras bdud rtsi'i 'od//'jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i snying po yongs su bzhad la phyag 'tshal lo / /yab kyi blo gros bum par bzung ba'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i sgo 'phar brgyal/ /'di dang pha rol kun tu dga' ba'i lugs kyi bstan bcos dang lhan cig /rnam par 'thung bas myos pa'i rnam dpyod chos kyi snying por ches lci bas/ /byis pa byis pa'i spyod yul las 'das sa chen brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcu gcig bgrang byar 'jam dbyangs bsnyen pas grub pa'i mtshan ma mngon brnyes pa/ /a tsā la 99

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dang ār+ya tā res bar chad kun bsal dgyes zhal ngom/ /smra ba'i siṅga'i mtshan dpe'i dga' ston zla ba drug na mngon gyur te/ /mdo rgyud snying po zhen pa bzhi bral gdams pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dpal zhal bzang mngon du gyur pas mi 'jigs spobs pa mchog brnyes kyang / /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i pha rol son pa'i mkhas dang grub pa'i tshogs bsten nas/ /gzhung lugs kun la legs par sbyangs pa'i mang du thos pa'i dga' ston dang / /ting 'dzin snying po ma rtog bde chen mngon du mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi blo gros chos kun gyis brgyan grub pa'i dga' ston smin pa yis/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i gsung gi 'od kyis lta ba ngan pa'i mun sel ba/ /dpal ldan snying rje'i bdag por gyur khyod sku yi bkod pa drug la sogs/ /gcig char mdzad pa'i grub pa'i rtse dga' mngon du mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen rim par bltar ba'i mu sti ka /phan bde'i gser gyi srad bur brgyus te zhing gzhan bsod nams dus smin tshe/ /mi byed bde chen zhi bar gshegs te slar yang o rgyan la sogs par/ /'chi med rdo rje'i sku yi bkod pa du mas rol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdo rgyud yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang dbang bsam bzhin du/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir dge 100

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/ba'i bshes kyi rnam par rol ba'i sgyu 'phrul la/ /sa skya pa zhes sa steng kun tu grags pa'i dga' ba 'dzin pa khyod/ /snying nas gus pas skyabs su 'dzin na mgon pos rjes su gzung bar mdzod/ /de skad gsol 'debs dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i mgrin/ /sngon bsags bsod nams char gyis brlan pa las/ /'ongs pa'i rang bzhin brjod pa'i snyan tshig sprin/ /kun dga' snying po kun nas dgyes slad brtsams/ /'di las byung ba'i dge tshogs ston zla'i zer/ /sa chen ring lugs dri bral ku mu das/ /'thung ba'i blo gros dri bsung yongs 'phel te/ /rje btsun yab sras rjes su bdag 'jug shog /sa chen chos kyi rgyal po yab sras kyis/ /'bad pas btsal ba'i 'khrul med ring lugs kyis/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan kun nas bsgreng pa la/ /kun dga' snying po ji bzhin bdag 'gyur shog /sa chen ring lugs bstan pa spel ba dang //sa 'dir phan bde'i gzhi rtsa 'dzugs pa la/ /dpal ldan gur gyi mgon pos grogs mdzad nas/ /sa chen yab sras thugs dgongs rdzogs gyur cig /ces sa chen chos kyi rgyal po 7 kun dga' snying po dpal bzang bo'i zhabs la bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa 'di yang /snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa chen po rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po7 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga nas 101
las skyes shing / sa chen yab sras la g.yam rgyug tsam min pa'i dad pa thob pa'i ban chung rigs par smra ba/ tshangs sras snyems pa'i sdes rnam rgyal chos grwa ru bris pa dza yan+tu// //

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/sto /spyod 'jug la bstod pa man+d+ra ra'i phreng ba zhes bya bzhugs so/ /zab cing rgya che'i rlabs chen spyod pa'i tshul/ /thub dgongs ji bzhin gsal bar ston pa la/ /'gran zla med pa'i legs bshad gsung mar+sār/ /skal bzang lha brgya dge 'byed 'jug ngogs yin/ /dal 'byor gru gzings sems bskyed nor bu yis/ /phyur bur bkang ba kun mkhyen rgyal srid la/ /med du mi rung yon tan chen po'i tshul/ /lung rigs kyis 'doms rigs kyi sman chen yin/ /dag byed yan lag bdun gyis nyer drangs te/ /gzhan phan sems kyi 'byor ba rlabs chen pos/ /don gnyis sgrub pa'i thugs bskyed 'khor los bsgyur / /yid mkhar bsu ba sngon med dga' ston yin/ /sems bskyed nor bu'i gdengs gas legs brgyan nas/ /byang chub spyod pa'i me tog mdzes pa'i tshal/ /gtan du bde ba'i khang bzang der zhugs te/ /bag yod 'doms pa bsgrub la bskul ba'i lcag /de tshe dran pa'i ra ba brtan po ru/ /sems kyi ri dwags btsud pas phyin drug rwa/ /mi mthun rngon pas mi tshugs bsrung ba'i phyir/ /shes bzhin gdams pa gser gyis khugs dka'i skyes/ /sdang sems tsher mas 103

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gang ba'i tha rgod gzhir/ /gzhan phan bsam sbyor sman gyi myu gu mchog/skye bar dka' slad bzod la 'doms pa'i chus/ /bran 'di nyams rtogs so nam 'gran med yin/ /theg chen gnyis ma'i rlabs chen spyod pa'i 'gros/ /kun nas myur ba'i shugs 'chang brtson 'grus rta/ /bzhon tshul mkhas pa'i phyag bzhes gdams pa 'dis/ /tshogs gnyis yangs pa'i rgya khyon yud kyis gcod/ /cho gas bzung pa'i rin chen sems kyi nor/ /chags med yid kyi za ma tog bzang bor/ /bcud du blugs pa'i sems sbyong bsam gtan la/ /rigs lam rnon po'i lcags kyu 'di ches rmad/ /phyi nang dngos smra'i bden par sgro btags dang —/ /lhan skyes 'dzin pa'i zhen stangs drungs phyung ste/ /dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi yi lhag mthong tshul/ /sher phyin zab mo'i rigs sngags zla bral yin/ /rnam dkar chu klung stong gi 'jug pa kun/ /gzhan phan bsam pa'i yur ba gcig kho nar/ /drangs te kun mkhyen dpag bsam shing smin slad/ /bskyil ba'i bsngo ba theg mchog khyad nor te/ /mdor na rang brgyud klu sgrub lugs kyi srol/ /nye brgyud 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal lung gnyis/ /nyams myong srang la bcal ba'i nyams rtogs che/ /legs bshad gzugs kyis mjal du yod pa 'di/ /kye kye skal ba bzang ngo shes ldan dag /rang res nyams su len dgos snying 104

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/gi grogs/ /'di 'dra'i legs bshad gzhan med shes dgos la/ /'di la mi 'bral smon pa'i bag chags zhog /gzhan sdes sgro btags 'gog pa'i rtog ge tsam/ /ma yin bdag nyid gces par 'dzin pa'i bdud / /brlag byed thun min rigs lam mtshon rnon po/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i phyag mtshan chen po ste/ /'di las 'chad 'dra gzhan nas mi 'byung bas/ /rang sde'i 'bum phrag gzhung lugs thams cad kyang / /kun mkhyen sgrub pa'i thabs bzang yin mod de/ /'di dang mi mnyam che ba shes pa'i blos/ /'khor bar 'khor ba'i tshe rabs thams cad du/ /gzhung bzang 'di don yid la byang gyur te/ /theg chen lam gyi gzhung shing srong ba la/ /'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs dang mtshungs par shog /ces rmad du byung ba'i slob dpon chen po gnyis su grags pa'i ya rgyal ngo mtshar rnam thar bdun ldan gyi rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po sha bā de wa'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung bzang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa zhes grags pa'i theg chen thun mong min pa'i rigs gzhung gsal la rno ba'i legs bshad 'gran zla dang bral ba 'di nyid/ mkhyen dpyod phul du byung ba'i mchog sprul dam pa thub bstan ka dag ye shes lags nas rang gi thugs dam du phyag ris 105

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/mdzad de mkhas pa'i bzo rgyun gyi glegs bam ngo mtshar ba bskrun skabs / dad mos dang rjes su yi rangs pas mtshams sbyar te gzhung mchog de nyid la bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di nyid/ theg pa chen po'i zab rgyas kyi gdams pa mang du thob kyang rgyud la ma 'byor ba'i chos kyi sprang ban dharma sa raḥzhes 'bod pas snyan mo ri'i rnam rgyal dge ldan gyi rang shag dkon mchog lha khang du bris pa dza yan+tu// //

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/༄khya/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi gsol 'debs/na mo gu ru lo ki shwa ra bh+yaḥ nam mkha'i khyon la shong bar dka' ba'i 'gro drug srid pa'i 'khor lo cher/ /sdug bsngal khur chen rtag tu 'khur ba'i ma rgan sems can ji snyed pa/ /snying rje chen pos zhags pa dam pos phyogs ris med par bsdams byas te/ /nges legs rin chen gzhal med khang du 'khrid pa'i ded dpon spyan ras gzigs/ /bdag gi ma rgan drin chen 'gro rnams 'di ltar skye 'chis gdung gyur te / /gces pa'i gnyen dang bsags pa'i longs spyod yid la 'khreng bzhin bskyur nas ni/ /bar do 'jigs pa'i lam po che der gcig pur lag stong song bas na/ /'o dod drag pos mgon po khyod nyid ram zlar bsgron la cung zad gson/ /nyon mongs 'ching bas cir yang bsdams pas skye 'chis dub pa de tshe yang / /rgyal sras khyod kyi snying stobs go cha mnyam pa med pa'i khongs gcig tu/ /las can mtha' dag phyogs ris med cing dog pa min par shong gyur na/ /deng sang khyod nyid kho na min par skyabs gzhan su zhig bsten par 'os/ /nyon mongs dpung gis nam yang mi gnon thugs bskyed spos kyi glang bo'i stobs/ /nyin re bzhin yang ches cher rdzogs pa'i she mong 'di 107

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/yis rab bsags te/ /tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho mngon par bskyil ba'i dge mtshan nor bu'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ /phun tshogs 'byor ba'i pha rol son pa khyod la mi 'bod su la 'bod/ /bsod nams me shel khams su grub pa'i ye shes 'od brgya'i snang ba can/ /tshogs gnyis nyin mor byed pas brgyan pa'i chos dbyings nam mkha' yangs pa'i ngogs / /nyes pa'i mun pa mtha' dag sangs pa'i 'od gsal ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ /mngon byas chos sku'i rgyal srid 'dzin pa khyod la gdung ba'i yus kyis 'bod/ /ji ltar brtags kyang dmigs par dka' ba'i rdzun pa'i 'khor lor stong bar zhig /stong ba'i rang gshis dmigs gtad med bzhin cir yang dmigs pa'i rab rib 'phrul/ /cig char mjal ba'i mkhyen pa'i ral gri gang gi phyag na thogs pa yi/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang bo khyod kyis ma rgan 'gro 'di mi dgongs sam / /phra rags sdug bsngal ma lus gzigs shing de dang bral 'dod ring goms pas/ /bu gcig ma yi snying brtse las ni bye ba brgya stong las lhag pa'i/ /mi bzod snying rje chen po'i ngang na rgyun chad med par yongs bzhugs pa/ /mgon po mig mi 'dzum pa de la smre sngags mi 'don su la 'don/ /zag pas ma bskyed las kyis ma 'phangs brtse chen kho na'i sgyu thabs kyis/ /sha khrag min zhing 'od kyi lus min ye 108

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/shes nyid kyi rang snang zer/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan gyis spras shing dpe byad brgyad cu'i dpal 'bar ba'i/ /theg chen chos kyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i mgon po khyod sku gang na bzhugs/ /phra rab rdul gyis mtshon du mi btub srid pa'i 'gro ba ji snyed pa'i/ /rang rang las kyi bgo skal bzhin du sprul ba'i rnam rol de nyid kyis/ /phan bde'i dngos dgu rgyun mi chad par legs par stobs zhes grags lags na//bdag dang ma rgan skal ba ma zhan thugs rje'i 'dzum gyis skyongs shig gu / /bsod nams brgya las grub pa'i sku mchog phra rab rdul gyi gor yang shong / /mi mjed 'jig rten snod kyi pad+ma skyil krung gcig gis rgyas par 'gengs/ /ba spu'i khung bu gcig nyid las yang zhing kun mtha' dag 'god nus pa'i/ /ya mtshan ngo mtshar bye ba'i phung bo kye ma bdag gis mjal ma nus/ /mig sman ltar gnag ral bas mdzes pa'i ye shes sku mchog gangs ri ltar/ /dri med dag pa'i lang tsho nyid ni ches cher dkar ba'i 'od zer gzis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi snying rje'i rang mdangs cir yang mtshon pa'i sku'i phyag rgyas/ /'gro drug 'dren pa'i mgon po nga zhes gsal bar mtshon pa khyod la dad/ /thabs shes mi phyed ro gcig bsdum pa'i nges don gsang ba'i rgyal thabs kyis/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong nyon mongs dgra sde bag la nyal bcas 'joms pa 109

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dang / /de nyid gnyen po'i chos sgo ma lus bde blag 'dum pa'i phyag rgya che/ /phyag sor pad+ma zlum pa'i rol rtsed 'di la bdag sems 'jug par spro/ /brgya phrag sdug bsngal drag pos mnar ba'i skal ngan 'gro ba'i rang bzhin la/ /lhag par gzigs pa'i snying rje'i rig sngags rgyun mi chad par 'dren mdzad de/ /phan bde'i 'phrin las de snyed sbyin pa'i nor bu chu shel phreng ba yis/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na nye bar mtshon 'dis bdag gi sdug bsngal bgrang lags sam/ /srid pa'i 'dam gyis rdul tsam ma gos srid pa'i rgya mtsho nyid du phyogs/ /zhi ba'i rgyad par nam yang mi gnas zhi ba'i rang 'od cir yang 'bar /byang chub sems gnyis pad dkar gzhon nu phyin drug 'dab mas rnam mdzes pas/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na nye bar mtshon 'dis bdag la mchog sbyin mi mdzad dam/ /gang gis brgyan pa'i rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' ches mdzes dang / /gang zhig brgyan pa'i mtshan dpe'i phung po lus can kun gyi mchod sdong che/ /gnyis su mi phyed ye shes sgyu ma brgyan dang rgyan gyi rnam 'phrul du/ /shar ba 'di ni lha yi yang lha 'di 'dra las gzhan su la yod/ /tshangs dbyangs gsung gi gdangs gcig nyid kyis 'gro ba so so'i sgra skad dang / /brjod bya'i rnam pa kun tu brjod pa'i cho 'phrul chen po'i chos kyi sgra/ /'bad 110

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/rtsol med par lhun gyis grub pa lha yi rnga bzhin sgrog mkhas pa'i/ /gsung gi dbang phyug phyag na pad+mo bdag la chos kyi bgo skal mdzod/ /gnyis su snang ba'i bag la nyal kyang mi dmigs gtsang ba'i pha rol phyin / /theg mchog chos kyi bde chen mngon byas rtag pa dam par 'tsho gzhes shing / /zag med 'byor ba rgya mtshor dbang bsgyur bdag gi pha rol son pa'i mgon/ /'jig rten dbang phyug snying rje'i gter chen khyod la ma skyabs su la skyabs/ kha ba can gyi nyam thag 'gro rnams 'phags mchog khyod la 'brel che zhing / /khyod kyang bod khams gdul byar 'dzin pa'i thugs bskyed lhag par rgya che bas/ /bdag gi drin chen ma rgan gtsor byas 'brel thogs sems can ji snyed pa/ /rigs drug gnas na so sor 'khyam rnams snying nas bcol gyis rjes su zungs / /sdug bsngal bye bas bar med gang ba'i srid pa'i grong khyer nyam nga bar/ /ma rig 'khrul ba'i mun pa stug pos blang dor gnas kyang ches bsgribs te/ /ngan song g.yang sar yang yang lhung ba'i nyam thag tshul 'di ngo shes na/ /mchi ma'i char rgyun nyin mtshan med par 'bab la som nyi ji ste yong / /mi bzod sdug bsngal 'di tsam myong bzhin da dung ches blun bdag cag gis/ /sdug bsngal tsam gyi 'du shes ma rnyed bde bar re nas rgyug pa 'di/ /kye ma kye hud 'phags 111

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pas gzigs sam gzigs bzhin btang snyoms mdzad lags sam/ /gdung ba'i yus 'di 'phags pa khyod min ma 'dris mdza' bshes su la zhu/ /bzod dka' sdug bsngal tshor bas gdung ba'i ngan 'gro'i gnas ngan 'khyams mod kyang / /lan cig dwangs pa'i sems kyi a long bdag cag snying la yod nges pas/ /de la thugs rje lcags kyu rnon pos myur du btab ste mi 'dren na/ /khyod kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i stobs kyang stobs med nyid du mi 'gyur ram/ /gaṅga'i klung gi bye snyed rgyal ba'i mtshan gyi byin rlabs stobs las kyang / /snying rje sgyu ma gzugs su grub pa'i 'phags mchog khyod mtshan lhag pa yi/ /bden pa'i bka' yi yid 'di drangs nas phur tshugs gsol ba 'debs lags kyis/ /bdag dang nyam thag ma rgan gzigs bzhin yal bar ma 'dor 'phags pa kyai/ /khyod kyi ye shes phar phyin drug ldan snying rje'i tshon gyis kha bsgyur te/ /'bru drug sngags kyi ngo bor shar ba'i rang byung gsung gi gdangs chen po/ /nyam thag bdag sogs mgrin pa'i do rar rang sems dge bas rnam bkod de/ /'phags pa'i thugs rje cir yang bskul na bden pa'i byin rlabs mngon du mdzod//snying rje'i lam bzang ston pa'i bshes gnyen rtag tu 'phags pas yongs mdzad nas/ /snying rje'i chos gcig kho na'i khong du chos kun 112

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/bsdus pa'i yid byed kyis/ /snying rje'i yul gyur ma rgan 'gro rnams 'khor ba'i gnas ngan 'di nyid las/ /snying rje chen po'i nus mthu gcig gis 'dren pa'i skal ba bdag la stsol/ /tsha ba'i dmyal bar snying rje'i chab kyis kun tu bsil ba'i dpal ster zhing / /grang ba'i dmyal bar snying rje'i drod kyis lhags pa bcom ste snang bar byed/ /yi dwags rnams kyang snying rje'i bdud rtsi ro brgya ldan pa btung bas tshims / /dud 'gro'i tshogs kyang snying rje'i 'phrin las ji ltar 'tsham pa'i dbugs 'byin shog /de bzhin mi dang lha min lha la mi 'dod sdug bsngal bsal gyur te/ /chos dbyings mkha' la rnam par shar ba'i 'phags pa'i snying rje'i nyi ma che/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las 'od stong 'phro 'dis las ngan mun pa sangs gyur nas/ /rigs drug 'gro rnams gru 'dzin zhing du da lta nyid du 'dren par shog /de skad thugs rje bskul ba'i smre sngags gdung ba'i glu ru blangs gyur te/ /snying rje'i gter chen bsil ljongs mgon la 'o dod drag tu bos pa'i don/ /ma rgan 'gro 'di'i gsos su smin te 'phags pa'i thugs rje'i bgo skal la / /longs su spyod pa'i dga' ston mchog gis myur ba myur du grol gyur cig /ces 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la gsol 'debs gdung 113

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dbyangs su byas pa thugs rje bskul ba'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/rang gi drin can ma rgan tshe dus las 'das pa'i tshe/ btsun gzugs blo bzang mdo sngags kyis gang dran gsol ba btab pa de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /dge zhing bkra shis/ /༄7/ /na mo gu ru/ /rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i gdul bya la dgongs ste / /rgya chen thugs bskyed smon lam lnga brgya yis/ /mi mjed zhing 'di'i 'gro ba'i mgon gyur ba'i/ /ston pa thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs / /'di nas byang chub bar du gar skyes kyang / /skyid sdug legs nyes khyed nyid kho nas mkhyen/ /dam pa'i chos la blo kha phyogs pa dang / /bar chad med cing mthun rkyen tshang bar shog /tshogs gnyis rgya mtshor nges 'byung pad sdong rtser/ /dri med thabs shes nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /sku gsum lhun rdzogs rdo rje slob dpon che/ /o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /thub bstan snyigs mar spyod pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i mdzad pa byed do zhes/ /rgyal ba'i lung bstan rgyal ba gnyis pa'i zhabs/ /rje btsun tsong kha pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /'di nas byang chub bar du gar skyes kyang / /skyid sdug legs nyes khyed nyid kho nas mkhyen/ /dam pa'i chos la blo kha phyogs pa dang / /bar chad med cing mthun rkyen tshang bar shog /114

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/mi khom brgyad bral rten bzang 'di thob tshe/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed byin rlabs las/ /dam chos char gyis sems la brlan 'debs pa'i/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'di nas byang chub bar du gar skyes kyang / /skyid sdug legs nyes khyed nyid kho nas mkhyen/ /dam pa'i chos la blo kha phyogs pa dang / /bar chad med cing mthun rkyen tshang bar shog /mchog dman 'gro ba su zhig gsol btab kyang / /myur zhing dpa' ba'i 'phrin las mi snyel ba'i / /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum 'gyur sher phyin ma/ /rje btsun ār+ya tā rer gsol ba 'debs/ /'di nas byang chub bar du gar skyes kyang —/ /skyid sdug legs nyes khyed nyid kho nas mkhyen/ /dam pa'i chos la blo kha phyogs pa dang / /bar chad med cing mthun rkyen tshang bar shog /skyabs gnas dam pa thugs rje can rnams la/ /snying nas re ltos 'cha' zhing gsol 'debs na/ /'di dang phyi ma'i gnas skabs thams cad du/ /nyam thag bdag la brtse chen spyan gyi gzigs//mtshan ldan bshes gnyen dam pas rjes 'dzin cing / /dal 'byor rten thob mi rtag rgyud bskul nas/ /phyi ma ngan 'gro'i g.yeng sar 'jigs skrag ste/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar shog /srid gsum me dpung 'bar ba'i btson khang du/ /yang yang skyes te 115

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/sdug bsngal myong ba la/ /skyo shes blo sna shugs drag rgyun ring bo'i/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bsrung bar shog /byams dang snying rje'i 'phrul gyis yongs bskyod de/ /byang chub sems kyi 'jug sgo nas zhugs te/ /rlabs chen phyin drug spyod pa'i go bgos te/ /theg mchog lam gyi brtul zhugs lhod med shog /bying rgod bral ba'i ting 'dzin brtan po yis/ /drangs pa'i zab mo dbu ma'i lam bzang gis/ /snang stong 'gal med grogs su legs shar te/ /mtha' bral gnad la sgro 'dog chod par shog khyad par tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /myur lam zab mo rdo rje theg pa yis/ /sku gsum lam 'khyer mchog gi gnad zin te/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang thob par shog /116
nga nga

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/༄7/ /na mo gu ru bha ya/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa'i gsang gsum gcig 'dus/ /'dren mchog dpag bsam ljon pa'i 'khri shing gcig pu/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu mi yi gar du rol ba'i/ /kun gzigs blo gros nyi ma yid kyi ze'u 'bru/ /a ho ye yid kyi ze'u 'bru / /e ma la dga' ba'i rgyan gcig /a o ye skyid pa'i nyi ma/ /e e ye da ni shar song / /mkha' la ral gri'i lcang lo lam gyis 'phyar te / /kun rmongs glang bo gsod pa'i tshab rngam las kyis/ /dus gsum kun tu brel ba'i gur kum gzugs can/ /rje btsun khyod min gzhan na mi 'dug thag chod/ /a ho ye mi 'dug thag chod/ /e ma la dga' ba'i rgyan gcig /a o ye skyid pa'i nyi ma/ /e e ye da ni shar song / /lag la pad ma dkar bo'i rnga yab thogs te/ /'gro drug srid pa'i tsha gdung sel la chas pa'i/ /yid 'ong zla ba'i mdangs 'dzin gangs ri'i mgon po/ /rje btsun khyod yin khyod las gzhan na mi 'dug /a ho ye gzhan na mi 'dug /e ma la dga' ba'i rgyan gcig /a o ye skyid pa'i nyi ma/ /e e ye da ni shar song / /nam mkha'i lus can snying rje'i thugs kyi 'dzum zer/ /gdug pa can la khros pa'i gzugs su ston pa'i/ /gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin rdo rje can gyis dbang phyug /rje btsun khyod yin khyod las lhag pa su zhig /a ho ye lhag pa su zhig /118

mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/e ma la dga' ba'i rgyan gcig /a o ye skyid pa'i nyi ma/ /e e ye da ni shar song / /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas zer yang dga' ba'i mthong lugs / /dam chos rnam grangs mang ste khyod thugs gsang ba/ /'phags tshogs dge 'dun 'gro 'dul 'phrin las rnam rol/ /skyabs gsum bla ma'i ngo bor 'ubs kyis 'dus 'dug /a ho ye 'ub kyis 'dus 'dug /e ma la dga' ba'i rgyan gcig /a o ye skyid pa'i nyi ma / /e e ye da ni shar song / /dngos brgyud bla ma'i grangs 'dren gdul bya'i snang tshod/ /yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs sku yi rnam 'gyur/ /ma tshogs mkha' 'gro bde chen grogs kyi rdzu bag /kun kyang bla ma'i rnam rol kho na red 'dug /a ho ye kho na red 'dug /e ma la dga' ba'i rgyan gcig /a o ye skyid pa'i nyi ma/ /e e ye da ni shar song ske/ /las ngan rlung gis bdas te grogs med gcig pur/ /srid pa'i thang chen dbang med nyul nyul nyul kyang / /rje btsun byams brtse'i phyag la 'ju sa rnyed kyis/ /da ni gcig pur mi 'khyam grogs bzang yod do/ /a ho ye grogs bzang yod do/ /e ma la dga' ba'i rgyan gcig /a o ye skyid pa'i nyi ma/ /e e ye da ni shar song / /sngar bzhin byas byas bsags bsags sdig pa'i 'khor lo/ /bsgrubs bsgrubs ngal ba don med rkyang ba yin te/ /da phan sgo gsum 'du 119

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/byed phal mo che zhig /rje btsun gzhan don rlabs chen spyod dang 'dres 'gro/ /a ho ye spyod dang 'dres 'gro/ /e ma la dga' ba'i rgyan gcig /a o ye skyid pa'i nyi ma/ /e e ye da ni shar song / kha bshad 'doms pa'i mi slebs gzhung brgya'i skyor zlos/ /tha snyad tshig gi zhib tig dgos dgos dgos te/ /nges shes 'phrigs su tshud pa'i sa mkhan med na/ /tshig skam shags kyi mtshon chas rang gzhan phung skad / /mi rtog gnyid kyis 'khor ba'i nam ring 'phul ba'i/ /bde gsal sgom gyi sems 'dzin dgos dgos dgos te/ /bsam don lam du 'gro ba'i bogs 'byin med na/ /blun po mgu mgu 'dra ste ngo mtshar min skad/ /gsung rab mdo rgyud po ti gang nas klog kyang / /zab zab ngo mtshar chos sgo kho na yin te/ /gnad 'gag bla ma'i rnal 'byor gcig la dril 'di/ /gsar rnying mkhas grub brgya yi phyag bzhes 'chugs med/ /'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po'i ngo mtshar sgrub brgyud / /zung 'jug grub pa'i phreng ba rnam pa gnyis gas/ /mdo sngags klung brgya 'dren pa'i gnad kyi yur ba/ /rnal 'byor gcig la dril 'dis sems pa spro song / /bla ma'i rnal 'byor zer yang gsol 'debs 'don chog kha tsam kho nar gyer rgyu'i ldeb grangs 'ga' re/ /klog tsam ma yin snang tshul gang nas gzhal kyang / /mos gus rkyen du 120

mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/gyur pa'i dad pa dad pa/ /a te ye dad pa dad pa/ /da ni mi bshad rje btsun yid la bcags na/ /thar lam nor ba med pa'i sa mkhan mdzad 'gro/ /da ni mi bsgom gsol 'debs rigs bsngags bgrang na / /byin rlabs brgyud pa thob pa'i rten 'brel yod do/ /'di yin gtad so ma pher 'di snang pa pir/ /'di min nges pa mi 'dug dgra gnyen 'gyur ldog /yin min blang dor mi rung pha ma sems can/ /de de bzhin du rje btsun thugs rjes nges rgyu/ /a ho ye ya skyid pa'i nyi ma / /e e ye da ni shar song / /dge'o/ /༄/ /skal bzang grogs kyi spyod par dga' zhing rang gi ngang tshul gyis skyo ba'i bro glu ring mo 'di 'then no/ /kwa ye grogs mchog chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ kha dog ser bo'i zhwa phreng bsnams nas/ /ga shed cig nas rnyi yig brgyud nas/ /ngar 'dzin 'joms pa'i bgro gleng byed snyam/ /e ma la dga' ba'i gar zhig 'khrab bo/ /ca co med pa'i snying gi mched po/ /cha byad bzang bo grwa ba'i chas kyis/ /ja thug bzhes 'os ston pas gnang ba/ /nya mos chu bzhin spyad nas bzhugs snyam / /e ma la dga' ba'i gar zhig 'khrab bo/ /tā re'i gsung sgrog mdzad pa'i skabs sogs/ /tha mal spyod ngan 'chang ba nga yang da lta thugs la bzung nas yod snyam/ /na rgas mnar yang sems pa spro 121

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'dug /e ma la dga' ba'i gar zhig 'khrab bo/ /pa ra mi ta'i thal phreng re res/ /pha rol mi gnas myang 'das mtshon te/ /ba spu g.yo ba'i dad mos ngang na/ /ma bzhin dung ba'i grogs de bzhugs snyam/ /e ma la dga' ba'i gar zhig 'khrab bo/ /tsa la'i sems 'di lang shor bdag kyang / /tsha grang dka' ba khyad du bsad nas/ /dza ya dgyes pa'i spyod 'chang grogs khyod/ /wa ler dran tshe nam yang dga' 'dug /e ma la dga' ba'i gar zhig 'khrab bo/ /zhwa bzhin thod du bsten pa'i bshes gnyen/ /za ma re bzhin spyod lam ltar gnas/ /'a 'ur rigs gzhung lhang lhang sgrog bzhin/ /ya mtshan yon tan bzhes khyod skyid do/ /e ma la dga' ba'i gar zhig 'khrab bo/ rwa ltar gyong ba'i sems nyid bkug par/ /la la tsam min rgyal bstan yong rdzogs//shākya'i bstan mchog dge ldan lugs bzang / /sa steng nor bur mjal ba skyid do/ /e ma la dga' ba'i gar zhig 'khrab bo/ /ha shang lta sgom phyogs sngar blangs pa'i/ /a don sgom rim lhag mthong chen mos / /ha cang mdzes pa'i byang chub lam rim/ /a ho da ni rang res sgom ran/ /e ma la dga' ba'i gar zhig 'khrab bo/ /las ngan nga ni brgya bsam gcig kyang / /mi 'grub bsod nams bsags rgyab chung bas / /srin yul 'di nas phyi ru ma 'phags/ /kye ma bsams na 122

mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/sems pa skyo 'o/ /sprul ba'i zla tshes thod nas yal rjes/ /rang shong khang bur re zhig yibs te/ /bla ma lha la gsol 'debs bsam yang / /lo shas tsam las sdod du ma ster/ /deng sang byang thang kho kho o sur/ /dga' skyo 'dres ma'i nyams kyi ngang nas/ /nad ros mnar ba'i skal ngan grogs rnams/ /sman la re nas sdod khul lags kyang / /las kyis 'phangs pa'i rnam smin zug rngu/ /sngo ldum zas kyis bzlog par dka' ba'i/ /las 'bras me long mig la bkod bzhin/ /gyi nar sdod pa ban rgan ngang tshul/ /skabs re ring nas goms goms bsags bsags / /sdig pa'i yo lang sgrib pa'i mun nag /ji ltar chod snyam sdug bsngal sems 'di/ /'jigs shing skyo ba khong nas langs 'dug /skabs re bla ma mchog gi thugs rje/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dran na/ /'khor bar 'khor yang ya nga med snyam/ /dga' ba'i yid 'di mnan kyang mi non/ /da ni skyid sdug ji ltar gyur kyang / /srid par nam gnas bla ma rje de'i/ /rlabs chen gzhan don spyod pa'i bran du / /phul ba'i dam bca' yang yang grub pas/ /ji ltar byas kyang bla ma'i bran khol/ /gang ltar byas kyang brgyud nas gzhan don/ /rang dbang dor nas rje btsun phyag la/ /mos gus sna thag phul phul phul lo / /chos kyi mched po las can khyod kyang / /snying dbus pad ma 123

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'dzum pa'i ze'u 'brur/ /rje btsun yid kyi dga' ston bkod de/ /gsol 'debs glu dbyangs yang yang mdzod dang / /byang chub bar du byang chub nas kyang / /rje btsun dam pa'i zhabs kyi drung du/ /gzhan don sgrub la phan tshun grogs kyi/ /mdza' gcugs chad pa med pa gzhir bzhag /tshe rabs 'dir yang gzhan don rdzogs nas/ /rang re rang dgon lhan cig 'dzoms te/ /yab rje'i thugs bcud sgrub pas myong ba'i/ /smon 'dun rdo la ri mor bris shog /'dab chags rgan po re zhig nga yang / /dus kyi rgyal pos ma khrid gyur na/ /lhan cig yang dag 'jog la spyod pa'i/ /shugs drag 'dun pas bsgug nas sdod do//zhes springs so/ /༄7/ /na mo gu ru/ dri zhim rlung gis bskyod pa yi 'dab phreng na//ge sar ze'u 'bru ngom pa yi me tog de/ /yid la shin tu 'phrod nas ni sbrang chung kho/ /srab 'jam gshog rtsal zhan na yang lding zhing thal/ /dwangs bsil chab kyi rgyun bzang zhig 'bab pa na/ /rlung gis nyer nyer skyod pa yi rdzing chung de/ /yid la shin tu 'phrod nas ni nye'u chung kho / /rtsal chen lus la ma rdzogs kyang 'khyug cing thal/ khu byug skad snyan sgrogs pa yi nags shig na/ /'khri shing yal ga ldem pa yi rtse mo de / /yid la shin tu 'phrod nas ni bye'u chung kho/ /lus stobs rgyas pa 124

mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/min na yang shar gyis thal/ /rigs lam dga' ston dar ba yi gzhung bzang na/ /dgag sgrub dpyad tshul mang bo yi legs bshad de/ /yid la shin tu 'phrod nas ni ban chung kho/ /rnam dpyod chen po min na yang sems shing thal/ /a ho 'jam mgon bla ma/ /khyed kyi gsung rab kho na/ /rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung gi/ kha 'byed lde mig yin no/ /rtsa 'jug ṭika chen rnam gnyis/ /klu dbang zla ba'i dgongs bzhed/ /phra zhib rigs lam 'bum phrag /thang mar brdal nas yod do/ /kye ma gsar rnying grub mtha'i/ /phyogs zhen ling tog gcig gis/ /legs bshad blta la bsgribs pas/ /skal ba chung rnams snying rje/ /da ni 'jam mgon gzhung bzang / /snying gi ze'u 'brur bcangs nas/ /tshul khrims them skas btsugs te/ /dag pa'i zhing du chas 'gro/ /zhes pa'ang nyams dga' dgar glu ru blangs so/ /༄ga /rje btsun gyi bla ma sangs rgyas dngos/ /khong sangs rgyas las kyang drin che ba'i/ /mgon 'jam dpal rnam rol sprul ba'i sku/ /rje blo gros can de yang yang dran/ /yang sngar zhig bla ma rje de yi sras/ /chos gdams pa mthong ba'i skyid dgu'i bu/ /dus deng sang skyabs med mgon med kyi/ /nga dwa phrug las sdug pa su zhig yod/ /sems khong so klod pa'i bsam ngo la/ /chos tha snyad kyi 'char sgo bkra ba yi/ /125

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/khyod blo bde gu yangs rnams ci dgyes mdzod/ /sems sdug bsngal can nga la smra 'dod med/ /yang tshig la zhib tig byed pa yi/ /khong thos bsam pa tsho ci dgyes mdzod/ /nga dwa phrug gi rtog ngor bla ma las//tshig tha snyad kyi spu ris mi 'dug lags/ /yang don gyi nyams myong lhur len pa'i/ /khyed sgom chen pa rnams gang dgyes mdzod/ /nga dwa phrug gi yid la bla ma las/ /sems rang babs la zhen pa mi 'dug lags / /yang rang grol gyi gdeng tshad yod gsungs pa'i/ /khyed rtogs ldan pa tsho ci dgyes mdzod/ /nga dwa phrug gi sems la bla ma las//khong grub pa'i gsang lam de med do lags/ /khyod lta ba klong gyur gyi rigs can tsho/ /yang kun rdzob dang don dam 'go phyes te/ /don bden rdzun gyi rnam grangs mang mod cing / /nga dwa phrug gi snang tshod bcos med la/ /rje sangs rgyas dngos de gshegs pa bden/ /dus da lta mgon skyabs med pa bden/ /don bden pa 'di 'dra bsam pa'i tshe / /sems khong nas skyo ste mchi ma dku/ /de dku yang 'phyid thabs ci zhig yod/ /chos gzhung lugs kyi zhal lung su yis 'bog /don gdams ngag gi ngo sprod su yis 'debs/ /nga dwa phrug gi skyo ba ji ltar sangs / /rje bla mas bor ba'i mya ngan gyis/ /yid pi wang khog pa'i rgyud lam na/ /smra 'dod kyi rgyun thag chad lags pas/ /don yin 126

mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/min gyi shags 'debs mi 'dug lags/ /chos mdo sngags kyi mtha' rgya ma chod cing / /sems nyams len gyi gnad don ma phug bzhin/ /rje spyi gtsug gi rgyan de bor ba dang / /da nyam chung du tha mal sdod pa lags / /khyod rig 'dzin gyi dgongs bzhed zab zab skad/ /ngas chig dril du nyams len mi nus shing / /don 'gal 'du can du gleng ba'i rtse/ /nga'i gre ba'i phugs na mi bdog la/ /yang mdo sngags kyi bstan pa thams cad kun/ /ngas mnyam nyid du rtogs pa lags med de / /da 'gal 'du can du 'ang ma go bas/ /nga smra bsam brjod med kyi cha chung lags/ /mdor dril na bla ma'i snang ba tsam/ /nga dwa phrug gi yid kyi 'char sgo ste/ /don yin min gyi smra brjod mi spro bas/ /khong so so rang lam gyi nyams bzhes mdzod/ /dge legs 'phel/ /༄gi /na mo gu ru/ ka ma la yi ze'u 'bru'i steng na/ kha dog dmar ser mtshan dpe'i phung po/ /ga nas mjal kyang yid rab 'phrog pa'i/ /nga yi lha skal mgon po 'jam dbyangs/ /ca co min te nged kyi mgon du/ /cha lugs dge slong rnam par byon pa/ /ja chang dkor gyi log 'tsho spangs te/ /nya phyis lta bur thugayorgyud dag pa/ /tā res skyong ba'i bshes gnyen chen po/ /tha mal gdul bya 'dul ba'i dren mchog /da lta'i dus 'dir 'gran zla bral ba/ /na tsha'i sdug 127

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bsngal bzod pa'i dpa' bo/ /pa ra mi tar nang byan chud pa/ /pha rol myang 'das lam la mkhas pas/ /ba spu g.yo ba'i byams dang snying rje / /ma rgan 'gro don 'byongs pa'i byang sems/ /tsa ri la sogs gnas chen bskor kyang / /tsha grang lta bu'i nyon mongs nad la/ /dza ya'i chos kyi sman mchog ster mkhan/ /wa ler btsal yang khyod 'dra rnyed dka'/ /zhwa ser ring lugs 'dzin pa'i skyes mchog /za chog gto mdos mkhas pa tsam gyis/ /'a 'ur mi tshe sdig skyel min pa/ /ya mtshan chos kyi gter mdzod yin pa/ /rwa ltar mi mkhregs snabs ltar mi 'byar/ /la lar mi sdang 'ga' rer mi chags/ /sha khrag gis kyang gzhan don nus pa'i/ /sa chen thob pa'i sems dpa' chen po/ /ha shang lta bur yid byed spangs pa/ /a don sgom la 'khrul ba'i log rtogs / /ha la bzhin du ngo sprod 'debs pa'i/ /a ti sha yi rjes 'brang chen mo/ /a ma las kyang lhag pa'i drin chen/ /ha cang byams brtses skyong ba'i mgon gcig /sa steng 'di na 'di las lhag pa/ /sha khrag zad zad btsal kyang dka' ba'i/ /la li ta sogs mkhas grub stong bas/ /ra ba gangs ris bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir/ /ya ma ra dza'i bstan pa'i sgo ru/ /'al 'ol tsam min lung rags rnon pos/ /za mas byis pa rim gyis skyong ltar/ /zhwa ser mnabs pa'i paṇa chen 128

mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/brgyud du/ /wa dang seng ge'i dpe dang 'dra ba'i/ /dza ya'i dgongs pa yin min phyes te/ /tsha grang khyad du bsad nas bcug pas/ /tsa la'i sems 'di cung zad khugs song / /ma skyes stong ba'i ngo sprod mdzad de/ /ba spu ldang tsam dad pa byung ste/ /pha rol phyin pa'i lam kyi 'gros la/ /pa ri pi ra'i go thos skyes song / /na 'chi'i bar chad yang yang bsal te/ /da lta bar du lhag pa lags shing / /tha mal nga 'dra'i tshod la dpag na/ /ta thā ga ta rgyus yod red 'dug / nya mo 'khyug 'dra'i bag med spyod pas/ /ja chang bud med 'dod yon bsten pa'i//cha byad ngan pas rang rgyud bsregs nas/ /ca le co le ngo ma min 'di//nga yi skyabs gcig bka' drin mtshungs med/ /ga nas bsams kyang yid bzhin nor bu/ kha tsam min par yid ches rnyed pa'i/ /ka ru tsā de'i bka' drin lags so/ /zhes pa yi ge'i phyi mo lugs 'byung dang sbyar te bla ma'i yon tan dran zhing / lugs ldog dang sbyar nas bka' drin dran pa'i nyams dbyangs 'di ni/ dharma sā ras bar skabs sems la shar ba ltar bris pa'o/ /༄7/ /chu lha'i mngal nas skyes nas ni/ /brgya byin pang du 'jug pa lta'i/ /klung bzang g.yu 'brug 'gro ba'i 'gram/ /dar rgyas 129

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gral du bsgrigs pa yi/ /dar la rgyas kyis brgyan pa'i gsham/ /snyan grags ri po'i spo zhig na/ /tsan dan nags kyi tshal zhig yod/ /nags tshal de na snyan pa'i glu/ /dus dang dus su len pa yi/ khu byug tshogs kyang 'ga' zhig yod/ khu byug rnams kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /nags na bag yangs spyod pa yi/ /bye'u'i khyu zhig kyang yod de/ /cil cil rigs sngags klog par byed/ /bye'u'i tshogs kyi nang shed na/ /'jam la ma dul khong skran can/ /bye'u chung rnam dpyod gshog pa yis / /rnam g.yeng rlung gi gzings zhon pa/ /de 'dra zhig kyang mchis gyur te/ /dus kyi 'gyur ldog la sun nas/ /shing lo'i gzeb tu yib pa yi/ /khu byug rgan po gtses so lo/ /nags kyi 'khri shing de rnams la / /sngon gyi drang srong gis btab pa'i/ /sman de mya ngan 'phral kha yang ske/ /myong bzhin mngar ba'i ro brdol nas/ /mngar ba gtug pa med spyod de/ /'chi med lha yi lus grub ste/ /dga' ldan gnas su bgrod gyur nas/ /mi pham gsung gi bdud rtsi la/ /ci 'dod spyod pa'i bcud len rdzas/ /shin tu rnyed par dka' ba yod/ khu byug rnam ni yang dang yang / /byi'u'i tshogs la mi skad du/ /sman mchog 'bras bu 'di zos zhes/ /nan tan chen pos bskul mod de/ /byi'u mkhas pa 'ga' dang 'ga'/ /nags der mngon par dga' ba yis/ khu byug 130

mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/mkhas pa'i gsung bzhin du/ /sman de zos pa'i phan yon gyis/ /lus kyi mdangs rgyas spu mdog legs/ /ngag snyan kun gyi yid phrogs shing ske/ /yid la dga' ba'i dpal thob ste/ khu byug rnams dang lhan cig rtse/ /bye'u phal cher blun pas na/ /'phral du kha ba'i ros sun nas / /zos kyi phugs su legs pa yi/ /yon tan mi mthong gyi nar dor / /de tshe sdig pa can gyi zas/ /srin bu phra mo longs spyad de/ /nags la dga' ba bral ba yis bas mtha' bas mthar bag yangs 'gro / /de tshe skyabs dang bral ba yis/ /rgya khra 'jigs su rung ba rnams / /glags lta'i go skabs rnyed gyur te/ /byi'u'i 'tsho ba 'phrog par byed/ /'ga' zhig khyim du chud gyur te/ /byis pa'i tshogs kyis gtse bzhin du/ /mgo la nag rtsis byugs gyur te/ /bya tshogs khrel ba'i gnas su gyur/ /skabs der khu byug rgan po'i kha/ /gyi nar gtse ba'i bye'u yang / /sman mchog de la mi za bar/ /nags tshal de yi grwa zhig na / /nam mkha' stong ba'i dbyings shed na/ /rnam g.yeng rlung la rta byas te/ /gshog chung rtse mos gar 'khrab bzhin/ /cil cil ngag gyal kho nas 'da'/ /de tshe khu byug rgan po de/ /yid la dga' ba med na yang —/ /dga' ba'i zol gyis bye'u der/ /don ldan tshig gi gros 'di btab / /legs par bzhes na yon tan 'byung gyur te/ /ma spyod nyes 131

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa lhag pa mngon sum pa'i/ /sman mchog lha brgya'i zas 'di rnyed bzhin du/ /longs su mi spyod rang la mi brtse ba mthong ba'i chos la mngon par dga' ba'i ngang / /'jig rten pha rol mi pham bla ma'i drung / /bcud len sman mchog nus pa'i skad cig la/ /brdzus te skye ba dam pa'i rnam thar yin/ /de skad mdzad na legs sam nyes/ /rang gi rnam dpyod kyis rtogs la/ /legs na rlung la ma zhin par/ /sman 'di zo zhig bye'u chung kye/ /zhes smras so/ /༄7/ /na mo gu ru/ blo bzang snyan brgyud gdams pa'i gshog rtsal rdzogs tshe/ /dkor nag thed la mi rngam brag dmar rtse la/ /dgra gnyen chags sdang mi byed nam 'phang gcod rgyu/ /bya rgyal rgod po nged gnyis blo rtse mthun na/ /gzhung lugs sa chen rig pa'i mchong gis chod tshe/ /'du 'dzi'i grong la mi dgyes nags kyi tshal na/ /rnyed bkur mi gtsang mi za shar gyis mchong rgyu/ /rgya stag ris bkra nged gnyis blo rtse mthun na/ /byang chub sems sbyong brgyud pa'i skal ba thob tshe / /grags 'dod brag cha mi nyan gangs dkar rtse la/ /log 'tsho'i dug lo mi za gtan du sdod rgyu/ /gangs seng dkar mo nged gnyis blo rtse mthun na/ /chos brgyad sgyu ma'i grong la gting thag chod tshe/ /skye bo'i mig sngar mi 'phrad rdza ri'i khrod na/ /'di snang lam la mi zhen ri 132

mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/sul 'grim rgyu/ /zhol chen 'brong mo nged gnyis blo rtse mthun na/ /mang thos sprin sngon 'khrigs pa'i dus kyi tshe na/ /bag med grong la mi rgyu shing lo'i gseb tu/ /re dogs bag 'khum med par gsung snyan sgrog rgyu/ khu byug gzhon nu nged gnyis blo rtse mthun na/ /tshe lhag lug mjug tsam yang yod nges dka' ste/ /gal te yod na 'di snang re dogs bcad nas/ /skyes bu gsum kyi lam la bag chags bzang bo/ /'jog pa'i dam chos 'grub pa'i skal ba yod na/ /bla ma mchog gsum dam pa'i byin rlabs bzang bo/ /bka' sdod srung ma'i tshogs kyi 'phrin las bzang bos/ /smon pa'i don 'di 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur mdzod la/ /'di bde phyi skyid byed pa'i skal ba zhu'o/ /zhes bya ba 'di yang bar skabs yid la shar ba ltar dharma sāḥras bris/༄7/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros/ /snying rje'i gter chen rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan/ /grub dbang zab gter 'byin mdzad las rab gling ba/ /rnam gsum tshe rabs gtan gyi skyabs gnas yin ya/ /a ho ye yin ya/ chos dang legs par 'phrad kyang chos kyi nyams len/ /chos bzhin spyod pa'i bya bas shin tu phongs mod/ /chos smra'i dge ba'i bshes la blo rtse gtad pa'i/ /133

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/chos kyi rgya mtsho bla ma'i bu gces yin ya/ /a ho ye yin ya/ gces phrug ma 'o btung ba'i gzhon nu'i lang tsho/ /bgrang bya nyi shu'i na tshod yar yar yin te/ /'chi bdag nub ri'i grib ma tshur tshur gug nas/ /ban rgan nga 'dra da ni dus kyis gtugs song / /dus la sdod pa yod na sang bya gnang bya'i/ /chos dang 'jig rten rtsis grangs los 'debs yin te/ /nam 'chi nges med bsam pa'i blo rtse gcig gis/ /ro brgya shal gcig da ni byed snying 'dod do/ /rang la gtad so med pa'i zhal gdams chos bshad/ /gzhan la yid ches med par bshad lo nyan los/ /bla slob lad mo byed pa'i spre'u'i rtsed mo/ /byas byas byas te da ni skyur snying 'dod do/ /mi med nags na 'jol mo'i gre 'gyur rgyud du/ /thub dbang gsung gi legs bshad glu ru bkug ste/ /rang sems rang gis gso ba'i skyo shas gcig gis/ /rje btsun bla ma mchog rnams mchod snying 'dod do/ /lung rigs sgo brgya bstan te yang yang bcos kyang / /tha mal sems rgyud 'gyur tsam 'byung ba dka' ba'i/ /dmu rgod gdul bya mi 'dul rang sems 'dul slad/ /smyon pa 'ur lang byed rgyu'i skal ba yod na/ /gzhan la bshad na tshig skam mtshang 'dru'i tsher ma/ /rang gis bsgom na smin byed sman kyi dwangs ma/ /nyes skyon rtsa nas 'byin pa'i gdams pa'i mde'u rtse/ /da 134

mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/ni phyi la mi skor nang la skor snyam/ /skyon brgya drungs nas 'byin pa'i gsung rab thur mas/ /gzhan skyon srin bur mi 'dzugs phog thug shor 'gro/ /rang skyon sbrul gyi 'khyog 'gros ga ler ded nas/ /rang sems tsan dan lo ma byi dor byed ya/ /lo shas zla shas ya rabs lad mo byed pa'i/ /btsun chung 'ja' tshon snang ba re zhig mdzes kyang / /cung zad lon tshe gar song cha rgyus med 'dis/ /ban rgan nga tsho da ni sun snang skye'o/ /gcig gis bsam tshad kun gyis bsam pa min zhing / /gcig gis smras tshad kun la 'phrod pa min pas/ /gdams ngag mkho na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsungs kyang / /sa rdul nyi ler rang gar bzhugs nas yod do/ /dang po ya rabs gral du nan gyis 'tshang yang / /phyi nas ma rabs rjes su bkag kyang mi khog /bsam bzhin bkol du thub pa'i mi ni dkon pas/ /deng sang btsun chung ze 'then sus kyang dka' na/ /da ni mi bshad bshad na tshig skam lo ma/ /da ni mi byed byed na rang nyid ngal bas/ /don med slob ma skyong mdog 'dre dkar cha lugs/ /bzhag ste rang sems ngo la cer gyis blta'o / /phu chu lhung lhung 'bab pa'i brag ri'i skyibs na/ /sngo ljang shug lo gsar ba'i bsil gdugs phub ste/ /ban rgan thos tshad ma bshad smyon pa'i lad mo/ /gang thos bdud rtsi da ni 'thung ran yin 135

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/zhes / /nga la 'phrin zhig dben pa'i grogs des btang bas/ /ban rgan bshad snying ma 'dod sgrub snying 'dod nas/ /re zhig khom pa med pas gces phrug lo brgya/ /nga la khro ba ma mdzad rang lam longs song //sku tshe ring / zhes dharma sā ras mkhas btsun dpal ldan la bris pa'o/ /spro/ /na mo gu ru/ rab dkar rtse mo dgung la bsnyegs pa'i gangs ri yi stongs shig na/ /sngo ljang ral ba'i lcang lo sig sig bskyod pa yi ri dwags shig /spang ljongs me tog mdzes kyang bag yang ci bde ru mi rgyu bar/ /gangs rtse na bun dkar bos g.yogs pa'i nang zhig na lhod de rgyu/ /gnag snum ljon pa'i tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i nags tshal gyi sbubs shig na/ /dmar ser kha dog bkra ba'i spu ris ngom pa yi gcan gzan zhig /skye bo'i rgyu 'grul mang ba'i grong khyer gyi srang sgo ru mi 'khyam par/ /nags kyi lcang lo 'dzings pa'i nyams dga'i bsil grib na bde bar nyal/ /brag dmar la thod bcings pa'i rab mtho ri rgyal gyi rtse zhig na/ /gshog yangs mkha' la brkyangs nas nam 'phang gcod pa yi bya rgyal zhig /mtshe'u chung btung du re nas khron pa'i dong du ni mi 'jug par/ /las kyi gnas su grub pa'i rang byung brag them na tsog ge 'dug /sde snod thang mar brdal ba'i dgon pa'i gtsug lag nyams dga' na/ /thal phreng rigs lam klog 136

mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/pa'i khrims ldan dge 'dun gyi btsun chung tsho/ /mdzes mdzes slu brid mkhas kyang mo rigs na chung la mi dgyes par/ /bsrung sems snying la bcags nas mkhan slob spyan snga na lhod de bzhugs/ /seng ge spang la yong na rgya grog bying khog tu zhugs te 'chi/ /rgya stag nags las 'khyams na rngon pas rtsib mda' zhig sprod nyen yod/ /bya rgod grog mor babs na byis pa'i rdo rtsed kyis phog par 'dug /btsun chung grong du sdod na dam sdom ska rags de lhod nas 'gro/ /rang rang spyod lam mdzad na rang 'go mthar thon zhig 'ong lags te/ /min na grong sgo'i gla ba than ltas yin pa bzhin nyes dmigs che/ /de phyir btsun chung khyod kyang dam chos rnal ma zhig bzhed gyur na/ /gnas grogs bya ba thams cad btsun pa'i spyod lam ltar mdzad na legs/ /zhes pa 'di yang btsun chung 'jam dbyangs skal ldan la/gsal 'debs kyi glu ru blangs pa dge'o/ /༄gi /yang / spang ljongs me tog tshal na/ /stag chung bung ba 'phyo zhing / /sbrang rtsi'i kha zas bza' ba/ /nyams dga'i spyod lam yin 'dug /a ho ye yin 'dug /dwangs bsil rdzing bu'i nang na/ /gser mig nya'u chung 'phyo zhing / /'khyug 'khyug zlos gar rtse ba/ /gu yangs ngang tshul yin 'dug /a ho ye yin 'dug /nags tshal lcang 137

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/lo'i rtse na/ khu byug gshog 'gyur byed cing / /skad snyan 'gyur khugs mtho ba/ /dpyid kyi dus ston yin 'dug /a ho ye yin 'dug /sde snod gsum gyi drung na/ /blo gsal snang ba skyid cing / /thal phreng rigs lam 'god pa/ /skal ldan rnam thar yin 'dug /a ho ye yin 'dug /zer/spro/ /yang / dbyar gyi me tog cig bkra yang / /stag chung bung ba kho min pa/ /'bu srin phal ba tshos mi myong / /kye ma la skal ba 'di'i ngan lugs la/ /rdzing bu yid 'ong zhig 'khyil yang / /gser mig nya mo kho min pa/ /sbal lcong su yin gyis mi mthong / /kye ma la las ngan 'dis nongs lugs la/ /'khri shing yal ga zhig rgyas kyang / /khu byug 'jol mo tsho min pa/ /bya rog skad snyan zhig mi sgrog /kye ma la mgrin pa de ngan lugs la/ /'chad nyan legs bshad cig dar yang ske/ /blo gsar mos ldan tsho min pa/ /ma rabs thur lta rnams mi dgyes / kye ma la bsod nams 'di'i chung lugs la/ /a ho ye 'jam mgon bla ma'i thugs rjes/ /dus da nas bzung ste tshe rabs kun tu/ /chos thos bsam sgom la brtson 'grus bskyed nas/ ma 'gro drug sems can 'dren par shog cig /glu tshan pa 'di 'jam dbyangs skal ldan gyi gsal 'debs su 138

mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/dharma sā ras blangs pa dge legs 'phel/ /༄7/ /rje btsun sku bzhi yi dbang phyug khyab bdag 'jam dpal gyi rnam rol/ /dad pa'i snying dbus kyi rgyan du/ /blo gros gter chen khyod bzhugs dang / /sna tshogs nyams snang gi zlos gar/ /'dra min du ma ru rtsed dus/ /dga' min skyo min gyi glu 'dis/ /btsun chung gzhon nu de bskul lo/ /stag chung bung ba ni khra bos/ /me tog rtsi bcud cig 'thung nas/ /skyi ser lhags pa la skrag ste/ /btsan po'i rdzong zhig ni bsnyegs song / /ma bsnyegs ldum ra ru lus na/ /phyi dro'i lhags rlung zhig langs te/ /shi min gson min du 'gro bas/ /sbrang chung 'gro tshod cig zin song / /bya rgyal thang dkar ni rgod po/ /sdig med sha khrag re zos te/ /dmu rgod gnod 'tshe la skrag nas/ /brag dmar spo mtho la chas song / /ma chas grong mtha' ru lus na/ /sdig can bshan pa zhig slebs te/ /sgro gshog bsgrigs legs de gtor bas / /thang dkar 'phur tshod cig zin song / /gsung snyan khu byug ni sngon mo/ /sos ku'i sprin char zhig 'thung nas/ /nam zla'i grang ngar la skrag ste/ /lho mon drod khung du phebs song / /ma phebs shing lo la chags na/ /ston gzhug skyi ser ni btsan pos/ /sku lus rid nas ni 'gro bas/ khu byug phebs tshod cig zin song / /spyan mig gyen ltos 139

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/kyi btsun chung / /lus sems na tshod cig rdzogs nas/ /grong ba'i cho ga la skrag ste/ /grogs bzang lha gral zhig zin dgos/ /ma zin bzhugs yun zhig ring na/ /skyes dman ha la dang 'phrad de/ /'di med phyi med du 'gro bas/ /ban chung rang tshod cig 'dzin ran/ /de skad zhal gdams kyi mkhan po/ /dman pa nga 'dra ni min kyang / /cis kyang bris shig pa'i gsung ngor/ /rtsed mos tshul du ni smras so/ /༄7/ /mchog gsum skyabs kyi bsil gdugs bzang bo zhig yod de/ /sdug bsngal tsha bas gdungs kyang phub mkhan ni mi 'dug /kye ma las ngan snang tshul 'di 'dra rang min na/ /bzod med ngan song gtan yul byed don kyang ci yod/ /tshul khrims mtho ris bgrod pa'i them skas shig yod de/ /ngan song g.yang kha 'grims kyang 'dzeg mkhan ni mi 'dug /kye ma skal chad spyod lam 'di 'dra rang min na/ /sdug bsngal 'dam du btsugs nas sdod thabs rang ci yod/ /skyo shas blo sna bzang bo'i nges 'byung zhig yod de/ /mi 'dod than dgu mthong yang skyo bar ni mi 'dug /sdug bsngal bde bar shar ba 'di 'dra rang min na/ /'khor ba srin mo'i gling 'dir zhen don zhig ci yod/ /bslab gsum gtsang ma'i rgyan zhig 'dog rgyu rang yod de/ /las nyon btson dgus mnar yang 'dog mkhan ni mi 'dug /bzang ngan rnam 140

mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/'byed med pa 'di 'dra rang min na/ /gnas ngan 'khor ba 'di la gtan du rang ci sdod/ /sems bskyed rgyal sras bye ba'i lam chen zhig yod de/ /dam chos sgrub lo zer yang zhen mkhan ni mi 'dug /theg chen 'jug sgo stor ba 'di 'dra rang min na/ /lam gol dman pa'i mtshang zhig yod don ni ci yod/ /phyin drug spyod pa'i 'jug ngogs bzang bo zhig yod de/ /theg chen zer ba mang yang 'jug mkhan ni mi 'dug /sla chos kho na bsam pa 'di 'dra rang min na/ /theg mchog rtogs pa mi skye'i rgyu mtshan zhig ci yod/ /zab lam lta ba'i ngo sprod klu sgrub rang zab ste/ /rigs tshogs gzhung la zhen log 'di 'dra rang min na/ /stong dang rten 'brel dbyer med nges don gyi lta sgom/nyin skar ltar du dkon pa'i rgyu mtshan rang ci yod/ /gsang sngags tshe gcig 'tshang rgya'i myur lam zhig yin te/ /bsgrubs kyang sgrub lugs mi shes 'di 'dra rang min na/ /dbang chos 'brel ba thob tshad thabs mkhas kyis grol nas/ /o rgyan yul bzhin grong 'khyer stong tshod rang min nam/ /dge zhing bkra shis/ /༄ga /kye kye snying grogs/ /e ma ngo mtshar/ /skal bzang khyed la//ya mtshan che'o/ /rim gnyis ting 'dzin/ /brtan po dka' ba'i/ /'o skol so skyes/ /las dang po la/ /dngos grub grub pa'i/ /rtags mtshan 141

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dka' bas/ /zhal gzigs brgya las/ /yi dam gcig min/ /rigs brgya'i byed po/ /bla ma'i ngo bo/ /dngos su grub ste/ /sgo drung slebs so//de dang de 'dra'i/ /ngo mtshar gnas la/ /thugs spro bskyed la/ /ngo mtshar mdzod dang / /gshin rje gshed dang / /bla ma'i rnam pa/ /gdul bya'i dbang gis/ /so sor shar gyis/ /don du brtag na/ /rgyal kun ngo bo/ /bla ma'i cha shas/ /gshed por brdzus so/ /sku tshe ring mdzod / /skal bzang snying grogs/ /bsgrub 'bras smon pa/ /phyi ma'i don dang / /de yang gtso bo/ /lam gtso gsum la/ /shes rgyud 'khrul ba'i / nyams myong brtan po/ /tshe 'dir 'byung phyir/ /shugs drag gsol 'debs/ /legs par mdzod dang / /bslu ba med do/ /'di yang chos grogs de'i thugs dam dga' spro'i gsol 'debs su rang la mdo med kyang smra mkhas pa dharma sā ras bsgrigs te phul ba sirnyi rastu/༄7/ /a ho ye dkon mchog /byin rlabs kyi sna ring / /khyod nyid la dad kyis/ /sems rgyud la phebs shog /'khor ba 'dir 'khor tshe/ /tshe rabs ni du mar/ /las 'brel de zab pa'i/ /snying grogs khyed gson dang / /mtshan ldan gyi dam pa'i/ /gsung sgros la 'khrul nas/ /gsung nyes shig mi nyan/ /thugs dpyad re mdzod 142

mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/dang / /tsi na yi las byed/ /hos hos kyi dmag dpung / /de tshe la dkar rtags/ /gru gsum gyi dar chen/ /phan gnod kyi mtshan ma/ /so so ru shar te/ /rtog btags kyi dpe ru/ /bla ma rnams gsung mod/ /de don la dpyad tshe/ /rtog pa yis gang bcos/ /de de ru grub pa'i/ /don zhig ni min te/ /ha cang yang thal 'gro/ /gnod byed dang skyob byed / /so so ru snang bzhin/ /yul steng nas gnyis char/ /ma grub par nges lags/ /gnod byed du snang ltar/ /rang ngos nas grub tshe/ /phyis su yang dngos des/ /skrag pa zhig bskyed 'gro/ /dkar rtags su snang ste/ /skyob byed rang bden na/ /'jigs skrag gi dngos por/ /dang po zhig mi mthong / /gnyis ka de mi bden/ /rdzun pa yi 'khor lo / /gcig gcig gis byas pa'i/ /ngang tshul la dpyod dang / /snang tshod kyi don de/ /gnyis char yang med na/ /phan gnod kyi dngos por / /rtog pa yis phar bzhag /yin min de los yin/ /mdo 'gags su dril na/ /rang ngos nas med de/ /rtog btags kyi don yin / /rtog pa yi phar btags/ /rang bzhin gyis med pa'i/ /go don du 'dug pas/ /thugs la rang nges mdzod/ /zab don 'dir dpyad na / /srid pa ni hril bor/ /byed pa yi zhal bzhes/ /klu sgrub kyi mdzad pas / /thugs rtog rang mdzod dang / /gsol 'debs kyi yi ge /143
