sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/skabs skabs su 'bul gyis/ /rnam g.yeng la ma 'phyan/ /dus brgya yi zas gcig /da res kyi skabs 'dir/ /thar ba yi bag chags/ /thebs pa zhig gal che/ kha bshad la mkhas kyang / /lag len la rdugs pa'i/ /myu gu yis sug bris/ /shar mar du phul lo/ /tshog /thub bstan gling bzhi'i khyon la dbang ba'i/ /chos rje chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba/ /gdul bya'i mi la mi ru brdzus nas/ /lam ston bla ma sangs rgyas min na/ /sangs rgyas zer ba'i skad po che yang //stong shob kho nar 'gro ba lags pas/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro la rang tshod sprul ba'i/ /bla ma sku gsum dbyer med yin 'dug /a ho ye dga' ba la/ /e ma la skyid pa la/ /lam ston gyi sangs rgyas bskal don du ma song / /nyam thag sdug bsngal mchi ma dku bzhin/ /bzod med srid pa'i grong na 'khyams pa'i/ /'gro drug sems can gang dang gang snang / /drin gyis bskyangs pa'i pha ma min na/ /skye ba snga phyi thog med brgyud pa'i/ /gtam 'di rdzun ris kho nar thal bas/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba skye shi'i gar mkhan/ /byams brtse'i gnyen gcig ma rgan yin 'dug /a ho ye skyid pa la/ /e ma la sdug pa la/ /drin chen gyi ma rgan rnams ngo ni ma shes/ /snang ba sna tshogs cir yang 'char ba'i/ /skyid sdug dgra gnyen blo ngor dngos po/ /snang ba tsam las snang bzhin 144

mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/grub pa/ /ji ltar btsal kyang stong ba min na/ /stong nyid gtam gyi tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan/ /nges don gsung rab min par 'gro bas/ /brtags shing dpyad na gang gang snang ba/ /stong ba'i gshis la thim par 'dug go /a ho ye mtshar ba la/ /e ma la spro ba la/ /snang tshod 'di kun kyang btags pa tsam zhig tu gda' 'o/ /zhes dharma sā ras slob bu dge chos la gdams pa'o/ /༄/ /rang srid ri bo mdzes pa'i thor tshugs su/ /gong ma'i gangs dkar yod na ches legs te/ /byams sems drod kyis bzhus pa'i mdzad bzang chus/ /'dod dgu'i gshongs su 'bras bu ma spel lam / /chos srid rked pa g.yogs pa'i nags kyi drung / /mthun dgu'i yal 'dab sbrel ba 'di kho nas/ /'jigs med gzi brjid ngom pa yin legs kyis/ /'di la rtsod pa'i sta re ci ste 'jug /mtho dman las kyis bzos pa'i ri phran brgyas/ /brtan pa'i yal ga phyogs su bres pa'i tshe/ /nyam chung de'u gcig kyang rnam kun tu/ khyad gsod shwa 'od rlabs kyis 'ded pa phangs/ /de phyir dge legs spo mtho lhun po'i ngogs/ /bde skyid me tog 'dzad pa med pa'i tshal/ /phyogs med ri dwags dal gyis rgyu ba yi/ /bste gnas de 'dra sngon gyi skye bo'i lugs / /145

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/༄7/ /na mo gu ru/ /spros med ye shes kyis sems dpa'i rnal 'byor / /srid pa'i 'khor lo kun drungs nas 'byin byed/ /tshur mthong blo 'das kyi shes rab rmad byung / /a wa dhū ti ru grol bar smon no / /btags tsam tha snyad kyi 'jog mtshams phra mo/ /lung rigs mdzub rtse yis rjen char gzhal bas/ /thabs byung rang bzhin gyi myang 'das de la/ /nyin mtshan khor yug tu rol bar smon no/ /yum chen chos dbyings kyi btsun mo'i gnas la/ /shes bya rab 'byams kun gcig tu 'dum pa'i/ /sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor la sgyu mar lta ba'i/ /gnyug ma'i blo gros la rgyun mar re'o/ /ming tsam rten 'brel gyi sgyu 'phrul dra ba/ /a 'thas bden pa ru rlom pa'i byis pa'i/ /mi shes rmongs sems kyi dpyang thag gcod la/ /rtog ge'i ral gri yi rno ngar phyung nas/ /yab mes zhal lung gi byin cig phab ste/ /stong ba'i nam mkha' la stong bar 'phyar nas/ /gti mug glang bo de'i srog rtsa gzhom ste / /stong ba'i rgyas 'debs la brtson par smon no/ /chos kun btags yod kyi rwa bar sdum phyir/ /dngos zhen glang bo dang dngos su 'galaba'i/ /dbu ma'i blo gros 'di ji bzhin smra la/ /rtog ge sgom rgan dag 'ud cig che'o/ /snang tsam kun rdzob kyi rdzu bag 'di ka /bslu med tshad grub tu smra ba lags na/ /'khor 'das med rlom gyi ham 146

mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/'gros 'di la/ /lung rigs rnon po yi gnod pa med dam/ /btags tsam tha snyad kyi gshis lugs de na/ /btags don mdzub mo yis 'dzugs sa 'di zhes/ /rang bzhin rdul tsam zhig grub pa med na/ /snang ba ling ling de spros pas ci go /snang ba sgra rtog gis btags tsam lags na/ /a 'thas sgro 'dogs kyi lta bar mi gtod/ /stong ba rten 'brel gyi gar mkhan lags na/ /dmod ngan skur 'debs de byed don ci zhig /snang tsam rten 'brel las lhag pa'i stong ba/ /stong ba'i phyag rgya las 'das pa'i snang ba/ /snang stong 'gal 'du yi rtag chad lta la/ /u tshugs mkhan po rnams rtogs tshod ma red/ /stong nyid yin skad kyi rgyu 'bras 'tshol zhing / /rgyu 'bras yin no lo bden par zhen pa'i/ /lta ngan cho lo la ngos mang 'dug kyang / /ming rkyang btags yod kyi theg chen nyag cig /a wa dhū ti ru gol sa ci zhig /snang stong zung 'jug gi gzhi rten 'di la/ /spros bral yan gar zhig 'tshol ba dka' bas/ /klu dbang zla grags kyis bshol ba lags na/ /mtha' bral dbu ma der ngal gso chog go /a ma sgeg mo yi mngal gyi grong khyer/ /gang snang stong chen gyi gzhal med mdzes kyang / /rigs bzang byang sems kyi pha jo med na/ /byi phrug mgo rdol de rgyal lam mi rnyed / /bden gnyis zung 'jug gi gzhi yi gnas tshul/ /blo chen 147

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bsod nams kyi dga' ston yin na/ /blo dman bdag 'dra la ming tsam 'di ci/ /chos kyi rgyal po yi bka' drin lags so/ /de skad zab don gyi glu yi rol mo/ /tshangs sras snyems pa'i sde'i yid kyi mtsho las /rnam dpyod mtsho byung gi rgyud mangs dar dir/ /go yul dbang gzhu yi ri mo lags so/ /sa / /na mo gu ru/ dus gsum rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i ye shes kyi rol ba/ /dam chos snang ba ster ba'i bshes gnyen gyi brtul zhugs / /bdag yid chos kyi 'khor lo'i ze'u 'bru la bzhugs bzhin/ /skal bzang smon pa 'grub pa'i dpang bo ru dgongs mdzod/ /thun mong lam gyi na tshod cung zad cig rgyas nas/ /dag byed dbang bzhi'i chu bor byin rlabs kyi dbang phog /rim gnyis gos bzang mdzes pa'i dam sdom gyi ska rags/ /mig gi 'bras bzhin bsrung ba'i ngang tshul la chas 'gro/ /rang snang tha mal zhen 'dzin bag chags kyi gos ngan / /stong gzugs dkyil 'khor gom pa'i me phreng gis bsreg na/ /he ru ka dpal 'bar ba'i nga rgyal gyis sgeg bzhin/ /sgrub med lhan skyes rang bzhin gcer bu ru mchong 'gro/ /rnam kun mchog ldan mi 'gyur stong chen gyi lang tsho/ /mthing sngon ral ba'i lcang lo'i chun po zhig bcings nas/ /gtum chen snying rje khros pa'i rdzu bag gis rol 148

mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/bzhin / /bde chen dur khrod 'bar ba'i tshang tshing la chas 'gro/ /snod bcud 'jigs pa'i chos kyi rang bzhin de mtshon pa'i/ /mi rus skam rlon rgyan cha sil sil du 'khrol bzhin/ /bde stong chang la rngam pa'i thod phor zhig bsnams nas/ /bde chen kun tu bzang bo'i dga' ston la chas 'gro/ /brtan g.yo sgyu ma'i phyag rgya'i rang bzhin gyi lta ba/ /kha sbyor bde chen ro la dgyes chags kyi sgom pa/ /bcos ma'i tshul 'chos spang ba'i drang srong gi spyod tshul/ /ri dwags rtse dgar g.yo ba'i lung stong nas 'cham 'gro/ /kun rtog rtsa lag bcas pa'i sha ba yi khyu gcig /gnyis bral rdza ri dkar bo'i mgul rdzong nas gsod pa'i/ /gnyis med ye shes mda' gzhu mnyam sbyor du 'geng bzhin/ /ri dwags srog la rngam pa'i rngon pa ru chas 'gro/ /bde chen zla zhun khol ba'i rkyen snang gi shes rab/ /nyer bzhi'i gnas kyi dpa' mo'i 'du ba las phebs pa'i/ /dga' chen rnam bzhis 'khyud pa'i dbyings phyug ma'i lang tsho/ /dbyings na rgyal ba kun dang ro mnyam du chas 'gro/ /'gyur med mgrin sngon mdangs can sgra gcan gyi lto bar/ /mkhar gnas zla ba dkar bo'i zas skal zhig byas te/ /dpe don rim par byed pa'i ye shes dang lhan cig /zhi chen gzugs kyi cho lo'i zlos gar la chas 'gro/ /de skad snyigs ma'i dus kyi tshe thung gi yun la/ khyab 149

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bdag mchog gi go 'phang thob byed kyi lam bzang / /rim gnyis lam gyi rtse dga' nyams myong du bstar ba'i/ /smon 'dun 'grub pa'i bden tshig bla ma la zhu'o/ /bka' drin 'khor med mtshan ldan bla ma yi thugs rje/ /gtum drag bde chen khros pa yi dam gyi byin rlabs/ /zag med bde ba'i yid 'dzin mkha' 'gro yi 'phrin las/ /deng 'dir smon pa 'grub pa'i mthu chen la ma g.yel/ /zhes rim pa gnyis kyi lam la bag chags 'jog pa'i phyir du go yul gyi gtam nyams myong gi tshul gyis rten 'brel byas te bsgrigs pa po ni myu gu'o/ /༄7/ /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi thugs dam bskul ba'i glu 'chi med nā da'i rol mo zhes bya ba/ a ho/ o yig mchog tu zhi ba'i ye shes kyi lus can/ /rnam kun mchog ldan sku thugs zung 'jug gi bdag nyid/ /rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam dpal rdo rje de dran byung / /snying dbus mi shigs thig le'i ngo bo ru bzhugs dang / /a yig lhan skyes sems kyi rdo rje yi rang bzhin/ /skye 'gags med pa snang tsam spros bral gyi bdag nyid/ /chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin mkhyen gter de dran byung / /chos nyid mngon sum 'byed pa'i dngos grub cig stsol dang / /a yig chos kun rnam pa so so ru 'byed kyang / /rtag bral rtogs pa'i lang tsho'i ye shes kyi rtsed 'jo/ /sor rtog ye 150

mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/shes rang bzhin mkhyen gter de dran byung / /chos rab rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab cig stsol dang / /ra yig srid dang zhi ba'i chos so cog kun kyang / /mi phyed bde stong phyag rgyas ro gcig tu btab pa'i / /mnyam nyid ye shes rang bzhin mkhyen gter de dran byung / /snang stong mnyam nyid mchog gi shes rab cig stsol dang/ /pa yig gnyis med ye shes me long gi ngogs su/ /chos rnams rnam pa so sor bkra ba yi sems mchog /me long ye shes rang bzhin mkhyen gter de dran byung / /sgrib bral rig pa'i 'od kyi shes rab cig stsol dang / /tsa yig don gnyis chu skyes gsar ba yi chun 'phyang / /mchog tu grub pa'i rtsed dga'i mdzes sdug gi dpal mo/ /bya grub ye shes rang bzhin mkhyen gter de dran byung / /don gnyis pha mthar phyin pa'i shes rab cig stsol dang / /na yig lhan skyes sems kyi rdo rje yi rang bzhin/ /bde dang stong ba bdag nyid mi phyed pa'i gshis lugs/ /chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin mkhyen gter de dran byung / /kun bzang rigs pa'i rtse dga'i shes rab cig stsol dang / /dhīḥyig blo gros mthar phyin kun gzigs kyi ye shes/ /sgrib bral rjes su chags pa'i rang bzhin gyi zlos gar/ /mkhyen brtse'i gter chen shes rab 'od zer de dran byung / /zab rgyas tshogs pa'i blo gros yar zla ltar mdzod 151

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dang / nyam chung gsol 'debs springs glu dri za mo'i gling bu/ /mchog tu dad pa'i sor mo'i mnyen lcug gis sbrel na/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog ye shes 'khor lo yi nyin mo/ /bdag blo'i pad ma'i lto ba'i ze'u 'bru ru mdzod dang / /lung rigs sbrang rtsi'i gong bu'i bshes gnyen gyi pad dkar / /'jam dpal zla ba'i spang rtogs zil dngar gyis rol ba /mtha' bral blo gros lang tsho'i nyer 'tsho la rnam kun/ /kun dga'i yid ni gnyis med 'jug pa ru smon no/ /༄7/ /dbyangs can ma'i thugs rgyud bskul ba'i glu phreng 'chi med rol mo zhes bya ba/ a ho/ oṃ yig bde stong ye shes 'gyur med kyi lang tsho/ /phul byung sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i mtshan dpe la yongs shar/ /mi shigs sku yi rdo rje dbyangs can mar 'dud do/ /ye shes lus mchog gzhon nu'i dngos grub cig stsol dang / /swa ra srid zhir mi gnas byang sems kyi lam dag /gsung gsang rnam pa kun gyi sgra dbyangs la 'jebs pa'i/ /'gags med gsung gi rdo rje dbyangs can mar 'dud do/ /snyan 'jibs yan lag drug cu'i dngos grub cig stsol dang / swa ste bde legs grub pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin/ /'gyur med bde dang stong ba zung 'brel gyi bdag nyid/ /mkhyen brtse'i thugs kyi rdo rje dbyangs can mar 'dud do/ /'chi med don 152

mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/dam ye shes dngos grub cig stsol dang / /hrīḥzhes ye shes lnga ldan 'od gsal gyi phyag rgyas/ /srid zhi'i gdung ba skyob pa'i yid bzhin gyi 'dod ster/ /dpal ldan yon tan rdo rje dbyangs can mar 'dud do//spang rtogs mchog tu grub pa'i dngos grub cig stsol dang / /swā hā mchog tu zhi ba'i ye shes kyi rol ba/ /brtan g.yo kun la khyab pa'i kun bzang gi rtse dga'/ /lhun grub 'phrin las rdo rje dbyangs can mar 'dud do/ /rtag khyab rtsol med mdzad pa'i dngos grub cig stsol dang / /gsang ba bsam las 'das pa'i bdag nyid kyi dga' ma/ /chags bral chags pa chen po'i rang bzhin gyi glog phreng / /nyam thag gsol 'debs bu yi blo gros la 'khyud pa'i/ /don gnyis dag byed rgyun gyi dngos grub cig stsol dang / /e ma snang dang stong ba zung 'jug gi ye shes/ /rab mdzes mtshan dper shar ba'i zlos gar gyi snang brnyan/ /rang snang rig 'dzin dga' tshal 'o mtsho la mnga' ba'i//'phags ma khyod kyi zhabs dang 'bral med du shog cig /ces pa 'di yang rgyal ba thams cad kyi yum gcig ngag gi lha mo dbyangs can ma'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i btsun pa/ 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i blo gros tshangs sras snyems pa'i sde ru 'bod pas/rang lo bcu bdun pa sa lug ston zla 'bring bo'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes 153

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/la rig 'dzin dga' ba'i tshal gnyis pa snyan ri rdo rje 'dra ba'i bshad sgrub kyi bste gnas/ rigs thams cad kyi byed po 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs pad rol ba'i ga la ba der gus pa chen pos gsol ba btab pa bde blag tu 'grub gyur cig /༄༄/ /rje dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / /mgon mi yi rnam par rol ba'i gar/ /chos mdo sngags bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs pa'i/ /mtshan brjod par dka' ba rin po che/ /rje legs bshad rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo/ khong gsum ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i sku/ /chos smin grol gang 'dod stsol ba'i gsung / /bu gcig bzhin byams brtses dgongs pa'i thugs/ /sgo gang nas bsams kyang yid bzhin nor / /bstan 'gro yi dpal mgon mtshungs pa med/ /rje sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin can/ /sgos skal dman bdag gi skyabs gcig pu / /dus da lta glo bur zhi dbyings su/ /gshegs pa yi tshul 'dis yid skyo ste/ /nyam thag bzhin gdung bas 'bod lags na/ /zag med kyi dbyings nas yud tsam dgongs/ /sems kun rtog gis ma bslad gzhug ma'i gshis/ /thabs gsang chen gyi bzo bo'i 'phrul 'degs las / /lha zung 'jug gi ngo bor bzhengs pa yi/ /skyabs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rnam grangs kun/ /rje khyod las gzhan du med ces te/ /lung 154

mgur tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs/rigs pa brgya yis grub mod kyang / /tha mal du 'dzin pa'i log rtog mkhan / /bdag 'dra la byin rlabs ji ltar 'jug /da 'on kyang mos gus phra mo'i chus/ /sems cung zad brlan pa'i zhing sa 'di/ /mgon khyod kyi gsang gsum nyi ma'i 'od/ /dus deng nas ro gcig 'jug par zhugs/ /chos mdo sngags kyi nyams rtogs skye ba'i gegs/ /tshe 'di snang la zhen pa'i rtag 'dzin bdud/ /'dus byas kyi snang tshul 'di 'dra ba/ /chos mthong nas thul bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lam zab mo brgya yi 'gag gcig pu/ /rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa kun gyi srog /thabs bla med byang chub sems mchog de/ /pha khyod bzhin rgyud la skye bar shog /yang gang snang tshugs thub bden pa'i dngos/ /dpal klu dbang zla ba'i man ngag bzhin/ /gshis stong bar lan tshwa chur bzhu ltar / /dmigs gtad de da nas 'jigs par shog /yul rang steng nas ci yang mi rnyed pa'i/ /mtha' bral gyi stong ba'i rnam 'gyur nyid/ /ming tsam gyis phar btags 'khor 'das la/ /spang blang gi nges shes rnyed par shog /chos snang stong gnyis gcig grogs gcig shar bas/ /dpal tshogs gnyis kyi nyams len dam pa'i khams/ /thabs rim gzhis zab mos kha bsgyur te/ /chos myur bar rdzogs pa rgyal bar shog/chos zab mo skyes bu gsum gyi lam/ /mgon a ti sha dang rje bla mas/ /155

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/phyi rabs kyi btsas su bzhag pa bzhin/ /rje khyod kyis dgyes bzhin gnang ba 'dis/ /dus da nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /yongs mi 'bral snying gi bcud byas te/ /mgon khyod kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs nus pa'i/ /sgrub pa yi rgyal mtshan tshugs par shog /'khor ba ru 'khor ba'i gnas skabs kun du/ /rje khyod dang nam yang mi 'bral bar / /lam ston gyi dge ba'i bshes mdzad nas/ /bsam sbyor gyis tshul bzhin bsten par shog /yang gnas skabs mtha' 'khob gdul dka'i 'gro/ /thugs brtse chen gyi klong nas mi 'dor bar/ /bstan 'gro yi mgon du sprul ba'i sku/ /dus da lta gegs med 'byon par zhu/ /dbyings mkha' la thugs rje'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs/ /byin rlabs kyi char rgyun sil bur babs/ /rgyud dge ba'i me tog ches bkra ste/ /legs tshogs kyi rten 'brel dar bar shog /ces pa 'di yang gus slob dharma sā raḥs gsung dbyangs su byas pa'o / /156
dbyazhung

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/༄7/ /dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid rje btsun dam pa bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su bzung du gsol/ ma rig mun pa 'thibs pa'i 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon 'dir/ /thugs bskyed smon lam zab mos rang dang 'tsham pa yi/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gzugs kyis gsung rab sgron me yis/ /thar ba'i lam bzang ston rnams gus pa'i phyag gis mchod//tshe 'di'i bde ba kho na la/ /zhen pa gtso bor mi byed pa'i/ /skal bzang grogs pos bskul ba'i ngo / /mi ldog tsam du 'di ltar spel/ /bdag ni thos pa nyung zhing rgyud ma dul bas yon tan rin po che'i nor gyis dbul ba la gzhan gyi rgyud la phan pa'i gdams ngag gi bgo bsha' byed rgyu med pa ni sprang bos sprang bor zan bslangs pa dang 'dra yang —/ /sangs rgyas dngos dang 'dra ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams las cung zad thos pa'i chos rdzi'u'i nang gi phye thig lta bu las khyed la nyung shas shig gsol bar bya ste/ /de yang rgyal ba'i sras po zhi ba lha'i zhal snga nas/ dal ba'i rten 'di shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /skyes bu'i don sgrub thob par gyur pa la/ /gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na/ /phyis 'di yang dag 'byor bar ga la 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa der 158

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/gda' / tshigs su bcad pa 'di glu ngag sgrung rgyud ltar ma song bar rgan po'i sha tsha'i gros ltar snying gi ze'u 'brur bcangs nas/ da res rnyed par dka' ba rnyed/ phyis su yang yang mi 'byor ba'i tshul la 'dris par byas te/ dbul bos nor bu rnyed pa la 'dod don ma zhus pa dang / nad pa sman dang 'phrad kyang ma btung ba lta bur rang don chud zos su ma song ba'i 'du shes shugs drag po re nyin dang mtshan/nangs dang nub byas nas sems la phur ba btab ste/ rten bzang bo 'di la dgos don legs par chod pa zhig cis kyang dgos/ de yang dal 'byor la snying bo len pa'i tshad ni/ rje btsun tsong kha pa'i zhal snga nas/ de ltar rgyu dang 'bras bu theg chen gyi/ /lam mchog gnyis kur dgos pa'i thun mong lam/ /ji bzhin bskyed nas mkhas pa'i ded dpon gyi/ /mgon la brten nas rgyud sde rgya mtsho cher/ /zhugs nas yongs rdzogs man ngag bsten pa des/ /dal 'byor thob pa don dang ldan par byas/ /gsungs pa de lags/ des na mdo sngags mtha' dag la bag chags yag po zhig e thebs blta dgos/ de thebs par byed pa la lam ston gyi mkhas pa'i ded dpon sna sha sbyin btub pa zhig btsal te/ kha mnyam lag mnyam du mi 'dzin par bla mar bzung nas bsten tshul rnam par dag pa zhig gal che ste/ bdag 159

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/nyid chen po po to bas man ngag thams cad bsdus pa'i mgo ni/bshes gnyen dam pa mi btang ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa de red/ bla mar bzung ba'i don yang zhing gong mar 'dzin pa zhig la zer bas/zhing gi 'jig rten na so nam legs na ston thog phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i gzhi dang / ma legs na ston thog ma rnyed pas phongs par 'gyur ba'i gnas la zer ba ltar/ bla ma yang tshul bzhin bsten na gnas skabs kyi bya ba lam 'gro yan bzung ste nyams rtogs yon tan gyi lo tog dpag tu med pa 'byung ba'i gzhi dang / ma bsten na de mi 'byung bas chos kyis phongs te gnas skabs dang mthar thug kun tu sdug bsngal bar 'gyur bas na de las dpe gras shing zhes zer ro/ /de yang zhing gzhan las so nam sla zhing 'dod dgu'i lo tog bzang bas zhing mchog dam pa rje btsun bla ma zhes gsungs/ rgyu mtshan de lta bus na rang dang 'dra mnyam du mi 'dzin par rang las gong ma'am bla ma'i khyad par du 'phags par 'dzin dgos pa der 'dug bsten tshul la yang bsam sbyor gnyis las bsam pas bsten tshul gal che/de med na gzhan yang 'byung bas thog mar bsam pa'i ngos nas bla ma de nyid rang gi blo ngor ji ltar 'char gyin yod bltas te skyon rtog gi blo 'gog lugs dang / yon tan sems pa'i blo sbyong tshul dang /160

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/bka' drin rjes dran gyi gus pa skyed tshul rnams gcig tu na ji ltar dgos skyes bu gsum gyi lam khrid la bsten nas shes rgyu gal che/gnyis su na kha bshad tsam du ma song bar lag len la thob pa zhig gal che/ gsum du lag len thebs pa yang dus de ring nas bzung /bsam pa'i kha dang du bskor te/ da snga su la chos mnyan/ chos smra ba po la zhe rtsis ci 'dra zhig 'jog gin yod/ bla ma de rang gi bsam ngor lci ye re ba zhig 'char gyin yod med/ gong du bshad pa ltar bla mar mthong nas dga' ba dang / tshe 'dir rgyu zas kyi phan thogs nad gdon gyi 'jigs skyob sogs 'phral gyi bya ba cung la phan 'dogs 'gal spong res dga' ba yin brtags te ngan pa bcos bzang bo bsgrub rgyu zhig byung na bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi chos skor ram/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor zer ba de 'ong ba red pas de nas bzung ste rgyud la byin rlabs kyi gter kha rdol nges can du 'dug chos kyi dbu nas ma nor ba dang / rten 'brel gyi mgo nas ma 'chugs pa zhig cis kyang gal che bas/ khyed chos shig bzhed na de ltar mdzod/ de la mdo sngags so sor 'brel ba'i phyi nang gsang ba'i rnam grangs mang yang yig nag nag 'gros su bri tshod med cing bri srol yang med pas bla ma'i ngag las shes dgos/ de ltar bsten nas rang gi bla ma dam pa'i 161

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/chos la 'dzud pa la/ thog mar shes dgos / shes nas nyams su len dgos pas chos kyi rgyus shes par byed pa la bka' gdams pa'i bla ma rnams kyis/ po ti mdzo khal tsam pa la bya ba ma byas par be'u bum lag mthil tsam re ston pa tsug sbed pa tsug byas pas gar yang mi byin gsungs pa ltar tshe mjug rgyal ba'i gsung rab 'chad nyan dang lta rtog la 'dril thub pa zhig e 'ong zhes smon lam tshun chad thob la 'dun pa der gtod/ tshe mjug thos bsam gyis bzad nas nam zhig na de'i don sgom snyam pa dang / su la bshad snyam pa'i log rtog ma skyes/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab rin po che'i don shes na bshad sa zhig rnyed dgos pas ga la khyab/ rang gis cung tsam re sems steng du blangs na ngal ba don med du ji ltar 'gro/ de 'dras thos bsam gyi kun slong mgo nas skyon can du song ba red pas de ltar ma byed par rang blo chos la cung tsam e 'dris kyi 'dun pas rna bas thos thos/sems la bsam bsam gyi dpe 'dzin skyor sbyang thams cad 'gag gcig tu 'dril e thub ltos la 'jig rten na rkang rdo thog tu bcag pa lce thog tu smin dgos zer ba ltar chos thos bsam gyi nus pa sems la 'ju ba zhig byed rgyu thugs la chongs/ de nas skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim 'di shing rta mchog chen gnyis kyi brgyud pa'i chu bo gcig 162

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/tu 'dres pa'i rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad kyi nying khu yin pas 'gag bsdu sa der bsdu dgos/ bshad tsa na mdo sngags kyi bshad pa gnam sa'i kha bar du mi shong tsam la/ lag len la 'dril tsa na skyes ba gsum kyi lam rim du bsdus nas thun rer ma zad/ kun slong gcig la yang cha tshang ba/ dper na lha'i dar zab kyi gos lta bu zhig dgos zhes khri gung thang rin po ches gsungs pas de 'dra zhig dam pa'i chos la mkhas pa red/ des na spyir na thos bsam phyogs med kyis / lag len lam rim du dril dgos pas lam khrid re cis kyang nyon la sngags lam rim gyi po ti dang nam yang mi 'bral ba zhig mdzod / las dang po ba dka' tshigs med par chos la 'jug gi sna khrid / nyon mongs pa'i rnam rtog gi zug rngu drag la rtsub pa phal mo che ngang gis 'jil ba'i zhi byed gcig thang gi sman mchog ni rags pa'i mi rtag pa la nges pa 'drongs pa nyid yin 'dug pas de nyid yang yang bsams te sems kyi mthil du longs/ deng sang lo shas las gnas grogs gnyen bshes kun kyang rang dang 'brel med 'dris med mgron po'i tshogs kyi ngal gso lta bur 'dug go snyam du thag chod la/gnas la gtan yul dang / grogs la yun ring 'grogs rtsis dang /nor rdzas la mkho zhen chen po mi byed par 'dis bdag 'dor/163

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bdag gis 'di 'dor zhes yang nas yang du sems la zhen pa'i thag pa bcad ci thub/ chags pa'i rgya mtsho skem ci nus shig mdzod la/dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs bzang la nyin mtshan dal khom med par dad gus kyi sna thag gis sbrel ci thub kyi sgo nas las 'bras drang thig gi gser lam la zhen nas ya yo dang 'khya 'khyog ma byas na mngon mtho rin chen gyi gling du sang sleb gnang sleb las ci yod/des skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i chos skor tshags su tshud pa red / de tsam gyis mi chog par nges 'byung gi bsam pa yag po re e skye blta dgos pas de la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsgom dgos/ de bsgom pa la tshor ba sdug bsngal gyis yid skrag cing sun pa tsam ma yin par khams gsum gyi gnas ris mtho dman med par sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du mthong ba'i sdug bsngal sgom tshul khyad par ba zhig dgos/ de la zag bcas nye bar len pa'i phung bo lnga 'di blangs tsam nyid nas tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi zug rngu dngos su mi ldang ba gzugs gzugs med kyi phung bo lta bu yin kyang zag bcas kyi las nyon gyi 'du byed las mi 'dod pa dang gnod pa brgya phrag du ma'i bdag nyid du skyes pa'i mi lcogs pa'i khur du bka' dang dgongs 'grel du gsungs pa ltar thag bcad de yang yang 'dris par byas 164

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/nas nyer len gyi phung bo'i rang ldog nas yid 'byung ba zhig dgos/don gyi dbang 'dis/ 'du byed sdug bsngal la dgongs nas/ /sdug bsngal bsgom par gsungs pa yin/ /zhes rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis gsungs par gda'/ des na gzugs gzugs med kyi phung po yang mi 'dod pa'i bdag nyid dang gnod pa'i bdag nyid du grub kyang ting nge 'dzin khyad par ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi mi g.yo ba'i dge ba'i sems pas 'phangs shing 'dres ma min par dkar bo'i las kho nar gtogs pas na re zhig chu lon gyis chu bkag pa ltar/ gang zag mtha' dag gis thun mong du skyes tsam nas mi 'dod par mthong ba'i sdug bsngal gyi zug rngu rags pa dge ba'i las kyis bkag kyang /khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa'i sa bon dang 'brel zhing rnam byang gi phyogs la bkol du mi btub pa'i gnas ngan len du ma'i bdag nyid dang —/ nges par dbang med du 'dor dgos pas yid brtan du mi rung ba sogs skyes bu dam pas brtags na mi 'dod pa las kyang mi 'dod pa'i rang bzhin yin pas khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zer/de lta bu'i phung bo la nying mtshams sbyor ba log pa'i sems steng gi bral ba ni 'gog pa'i bden pa'am thar ba zer ba de red pas de lta bu'i thar ba la don gnyer bcos ma ma yin pa zhig skyes na nges 165

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'byung gi bsam pa rnyed de thar lam zin pa yin pas 'di la chos mngon pa mnyan te 'khor 'das so sor 'byed pa'i shes rab phra la mdzangs pa zhig sngon du song ba med na gong ma rnams la go dka' bas zab cing phra/ thar ba thob pa la srid pa'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin lhan skyes kyi 'dzin stangs sun 'byung ba'i shes rab kyi bslab pa dang /de'i rten du sems kyi rnam rtog gi rta ma dul ba 'dul ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ de la lus ngag gi spyod pa ngan pa tshar gcod pa'i tshul khrims gsum ya bral du ma song bar nyams su len dgos la/de yang dang po nas tshul khrims nas rkang rtsa tshugs dgos pas nyi ma re re bzhin yang rang rgyud kyi tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ji ltar song 'dug blta dgos la/ de la dam pa'i chos 'dul ba la sde bzhi las lhag pa'i bslab bya zhig med pas 'dul ba lung re thon/ las 'bras la yid ches rnyed na tshul khrims dag pa rang shugs kyis 'ong bas 'dul ba lung gi las 'bras kyi byung ba rnams sems/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' las lhag pa'i nyams len zhig dang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i lam ston zhig yod par thal nas snyigs ma'i dus 'dir zab zab mo yin zer tshad kyi kha la brgyugs nas khyi bya bsnyegs ma byed/ gdams ngag sangs rgyas kyi bka' la byed pa ni bka' 166

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/gdams gsar rnying gi phyag srol red pas rgyal ba'i bka' la nyams len gyi mthil du mdzod/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang mi mthun par spyad pa'i nyes ltung da snga ci 'dra zhig bsags/ da lta gsog gin yod med / phyis su gsog par 'gyur ma 'gyur rnams zhib tu rtogs la bsags zin bshags pas 'dag nges dang / gsog bzhin pa'i 'phro rbad chod/ gsog 'gyur gyi sgo yang yang sdom pa bcas 'phral dang 'phral du sems thog la longs la rang gis bsams kyang brtags thub pa'i rang rgyud gtsang sang nge ba zhig nyi ma re re nas mdzod la/rang sems me long gi byi dor byed byed gyis dang / de las lhag pa'i sems ngo zhig mi dgos te/ rgyal ba chen pos/ sems bsrung brtul zhugs ma gtogs pa/ /brtul zhugs mang bos ci zhig bya/ /zhes gsungs pa red/ de 'dra zhig byung na skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong ba'i chos skor la bag chags thebs nges/ de'i steng du theg pa chen po'i chos la bslab dgos te/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob bar du rang gzhan gyi don gnyis mthar phyin pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ de yang skyes bu chen po'i chos skor rnams na dngos gzhi dang / chung 'bring thun mong ba'i lam rim rnams de'i sngon 'gro'i yan lag yin tshul sogs lam rim che chung du gsal bar gsungs pa rnams go na sems 167

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/la bogs che/ theg pa chen por 'jug pa la 'jug sgo byang chub kyi sems rin po che yin pas 'di nyid bskyed pa gal che/ rgyal sras chen pos / dam chos 'o ma bsrub pa las/ /mar gyi snying khu byung ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad kyi brjod don gces dgu'i yang snying dang / 'gro ba'i mgon po srid pa'i lam rgyu zhing ske/ /bde ba'i longs spyod spyad par 'dod pa la/ /'di na bde ba'i mchog tu nyer gnas te/ /sems can mgron chen tshim par byed pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sems can la phan 'dogs pa'i sgo bla na med pa dang / rang don yang mthar thug pa'i rgyu sems rin po che 'di nyid kho nar nges pa'i nges shes bskyed de byang chub kyi sems la bag chags yag po zhig thebs dgos/ de ma thebs na 'phags pa'i zhing mchog theg chen gyi chos thang mar brdal ba'i yul du skyes nas theg chen gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad pa sogs kyi rten 'brel chos mchog tu gyur pa 'grigs pa la ltos te dal 'byor la snying po ma lon par lag stong du song ba yin zhing / phyis su yang yang chos ldan gyi rten tsam thob pa dka' na theg chen dang mjal bar dka' ba lta ci smos/ des na long bas glang mjug zin pa ltar brtson pas 'ju ba gal che/ de la lam rim du byang chub kyi sems sbyong tshul shing rta 168

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/chen mo'i lugs gnyis ka bkod la/ bla ma las nyon la rtsad brdar chod / yang yang dpe bltas gyis/ dpe thog tu ma 'jog par sems la skor/ de'i rgyab rten du spyod 'jug la ltos dang de na gzhan don gyi blo sbyong ba la yid 'khul tshabs che ba'i rigs pa'i rno so mang du yod / rgyu mtshan des a rig dge bshes chen mos kyang nged kyi rigs pa'i dbang phyug rgyal sras zhi ba lha la zer ba yin gsungs te go rgyu che/byang chub kyi sems sbyang ba la gzhan don la blo 'gro ba gal che/gzhan don don gnyer gyi bsam pa sbyong ba la mar shes drin dran sogs kyis sbyang lugs dang / bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang brje ba'i sems bskyed de sbyong lugs gnyis sher phyin gyi mdo sdong bo bkod pa sogs las gsungs shing byams 'jam dbyangs kyi man ngag gi bum par bzung ste/ shing rta chen po gnyis nas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan a ti shas gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir drangs te sras kyi gtso bo 'brom rje la gtad cing / de nas bzung brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa las rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po nas bdag gir bzhes te/ ji skad du/ sems bskyed theg mchog lam gyi gzhung shing ste/ /sogs nas/ rnal 'byor ngas kyang nyams len de ltar bgyis/ /thar 'dod khyed kyang de bzhin bskyang 169

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'tshal lo/ /gsungs pa dang / thar 'dod phyi rabs kyi skal ldan mkhas grub gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu'i gser mdog cod pan 'dzin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas kyang gsung de kho nar blo sbyong bas de'i brgyud pa'i gral 'dabs nas yar mnyan rgyu byung ba 'di bsod nams dpag tu med pa'i skyes chen po lags pas/ sems rin po che la ma ltos par sngags kyi zab khyad kho nas sa gcod mdog gi snyan snyan mo la rna ba khobs/ byang chub kyi sems skye ba la gnad 'gag gnyis yod/ sems can su mthong yang nye ring med par yid 'ong gi rnam ldan du skye ba zhig dgos/ de la sems can gyi ngos nas rang la drin che tshul shes shing gting nas blo 'khul ba zhig dgos/ drin dran tshul la sngar gnyen gyi dwangs mar gyur te bskyangs tshul sems pa dang /da gzod rdzogs byang gi go 'phang tshun chad kyi legs tshogs thams cad sems can gyi zhing la brten pas 'thob dgos tshul sems pa gnyis yod/ gnyis po sbrags na rgyud 'khul tshabs che bar snang /yang rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang de yon tan mtha' yas pa'i bdag nyid yin pa dang / khyad par du rang gzhan gyi don gnyis mthar phyin pa yin pa la/ yang dgos su gzhan don la blo 'khul ba la gzhan don sgyu 'phrul dra ba rnam pa thams cad pa 'bad med lhun 170

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/grub tu yod lugs sogs theg chen gyi mdo dang bstan bcos nas 'byung ba ltar shes shing sems pa gal che/ de ltar sems pas rdzogs byang de nyid don gnyer gyi bsam pa 'byung sla/ de ltar na mgon po byams pas/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa de ji bzhin par 'byung rgyu zhig yin tshod red/ spyod pa nyams len gyi rten byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskyed nas phyin drug slob pa'i lam gyi go rim gsungs kyang las dang po pa 'o skol lta bus lam yongs rdzogs la bag chags thebs dgos pas sbyin sogs kyi nyams len kyang lam khrid ltar thugs la zungs / lam mchog sgo 'byed las/ sems tsam bskyed kyang tshul khrims rnam gsum la/ /goms pa med na byang chub mi 'grub par/ /legs par mthong nas rgyal sras sdom pa la/ /brtson pa drag pos slob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar spyod pa nyams len gyi bya ba thams cad kyang nyes spyod sdom pa dang / dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum du bsdus nas nyams su len tshul shes dgos/ yang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yang mdo sde rgyan sogs nas bshad pa ltar dang por shes su chugs la rgyal ba'i sras kyis sems can bsdu ba'i tshul ni 'di ltar yin no zhes ston gnam g.ya' 171

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dag ltar dwangs pa'i yid kyis de ltar bsdu'o snyam pa'i dam bca' dang bsdu nus par gyur cig snyam pa'i smon lam tshun chad yang yang thobs dang bag chags khyad par can thebs 'gro bas cis kyang gal che / lhag par mdo sde rgyan nas bshad pa'i phyin drug gi grangs nges rnams dang / slob dpon seng bzang gi phyin drug gi grangs nges gnyis gsungs pa rnams lam rim chen mor bkod pa ltar yang yang sems thog tu blangs na rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la go ba ster phul che zhing nges shes 'drongs sla/ phyin drug gi lam po che las gzhan du rdzogs byang du bgrod pa'i myur lam yin mdog gis kha gzhan du 'dren par mi nus pa'i nges pa gting tshugs pa skye zhing / des lam ltar bcos pa la yid nam yang mi gol bas bgrod pa gcig pu'i lam 'di kho na khog srog tu 'ong bas sa chod kyang che/ lam gang la yang de ltar sems thog tu blangs te dpyad pa byas pas nges shes kyis rgyud 'khul ba re 'ongs na de las lhag pa'i sgom byed tshul gtan nas med pa bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gsung rgyun yin/ rtog ngan re re skyes pas kyang rtog pa de nyid 'gag pa'i tshe sems rgyud la slar yang rtog pa ngan pa de 'dra'i rigs 'byung rung gi nus pa 'jog pas nus pa de la sa bon dang bag chags zer/ de lta bu ni rgyal ba'i gsung rab rin po 172

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/che'i dgongs don la dpyad pas don gang yin kyang de ltar los yin snyam pa'i 'dzin stangs thag chod pa byung ba la nges shes 'drongs pa zer / de yang lung rigs kyi rgyab brten bzang bo'i lag rjes las byung ba de nges shes rnam par dag pa yin/ de dang dus mtshungs par don de la yid dwangs sing nge ba dang / yid ches pa dang / don du gnyer ba sogs kyi dad pa dang / de la mngon par spro ba'i brtson 'grus dang / dmigs rnam de nyid mi brjed pa'i dran pa dang / de la yid rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab nges shes rang gi ngo bo yin pas rnam byang phyogs la dbang byed pa'i dad pa sogs dbang po lnga ldan gyi sgom 'di lta bu lan re skyes pas kyang sems rgyud la de 'dra'i blo phyi ma 'byung rung gi dge ba'i nus pa 'jog cing /sems ni rnam 'grel las gsungs pa ltar rten brtan pa dang / yon tan de yang goms zin 'bad rtsol bskyar ma la mi ltos pa'i chos yin pas nam yang chud zos su mi 'gro/ des na de ltar dpyad sgom gal che tshul lam rim na rgyas par gsungs pas der ltos la nges shes rnam par dag pa dpyad pas 'dren dgos pas zhi gnas kyi sgom ma yin pa la dpyad sgom du bsngags tshul shes dgos/ sgom yin na 'jog sgom yin dgos/ 'jog sgom yin na sems tsom me ci yang mi bsam par 173

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'jog dgos snyam pa 'di deng sang phal cher la 'char rgyu zhig yin pas de 'dra'i gegs dang gol sa la ma 'khrul/ sgom brgyab pa'i lag rjes la yar gyi sangs rgyas byang sems dang bla ma slob dpon la dad gus / bar gyi grogs mched dam tshig gcig gis bsdus pa la dag snang / mar gyi rigs drug sems can la byams snying rje sogs 'byung dgos pa la ci yang ma bsams par sems tsom mer bzhag pas mi 'byung ba ni 'o ma 'dod pas rwa 'jo ba dang 'dra bar slob dpon chen mo ka ma la shrī las gsungs/ des na rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug tshul yang so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis phyin ci log gi 'dzin stangs sun dbyung ste 'jug dgos tshul kho bos grub mtha' phyi rol ba bshad skabs yang yang bshad pa der gda'/ don 'di la rgyab rten tshad ma 'od srung gis zhus pa'i mdo las shing gnyis drud pa'i dpes gsungs tshul sogs dran na nges shes 'drongs sla/ de ltar dpyad sgom zab na rgyal ba'i gsung rab rin po cher blta rtog ma byas pa la dpyad bya dpyod byed ci yang med pas/ dpe char gzigs rgyu gal che/slob gnyer byed pa 'di dpyad sgom gyi rgyu tsam du ma zad rang dus der yang dpe 'dzin skyor sbyang nam byed la dpyad pa yin pas dpyad pa logs na med cing / sgom gyi don goms par byed pa la zer bas 174

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/'dzin rtsod skyor gsum sbrags te sems de'i phyogs su goms cha gtong ba las lhag pa'i sgom zhig 'dod na khyed mo gsham gyi bu dang 'phrad 'dod par gda'/ des na so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad pa gtso bor byed cing / dpyad mthar nges shes kyi rgyun la 'jog pa re yang bya dgos pas dpyad 'jog spel mar mdzod/ khyad par du phar phyin tha ma gnyis la slob tshul ni/ dang po rtse gcig pa'i zhi gnas dang / dpyad sgom gyi lhag mthong so so'i ngo bo/ de dag ji ltar bsgrub pa'i tshul/ grub ste zung 'brel du 'gro lugs sogs lam rim che chung ltar shes pa gal che zhing / shes nas kyang dge ba'i dmigs rnam gang dang gang blo yul du byed na yang ting nge 'dzin gyi man ngag rnams ldan par bskyangs na bogs che bas/ sgom zer rgyu de mdo sde dgongs 'grel dang / shing rta chen po thogs med kyi sa sde spyi dang ske/ khyad par nyan thos kyi sa/ ka ma shrī la'i sgom rim gsum/ shani pas sher phyin man ngag sogs nas zhib rgyas gsungs pa'i don rje bdag nyid chen pos lam rim du bkod pa las lhag pa zhig dus gsum gyi rgyal bas kyang mi rnyed/ da lta rnying phyogs kyi rdzogs pa chen po'i rig ngo skyong tshul dang / spyir btang sgom gyi ldog pa gcig tu 'khrul nas gsang sngags kyi thun mong min pa'i 'od gsal lam byed 175

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'ga' re rgyu mtshan du bzung nas so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyi sgom spangs pa ni ci yang mi shes pa yin/ thun mong ba'i sgom ni ting nge 'dzin skyon med 'tshol ba yin la/ thun mong min pa'i 'od gsal lam byed ni 'od gsal gyi rtogs pa 'dren pa'i ched yin pas dgos don dang skyong lugs sogs mi gcig pa bla ma'i zhal las shes dgos/spyir zhi lhag zung 'brel tsam ni phyi nang gnyis ma'i thun mong yin la/ /nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i thun mong min pa'i lhag mthong ni/ bdag med rnam can dang bden pa'i rnam can gyi lhag mthong yin pas de la grub mtha' so so'i bdag med phra rags kyi 'jog tshul mang du gsungs pa rnams grub gzhung rnams nas byung ba ltar shes rgyu dang /lhag par shing rta chen po klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa'i mthil rjen par phyung ba'i zab mo lta ba'i man ngag jo 'brom yab sras dang / 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i thugs dam nyams bzhes su mdzad pa ni/slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pa'i 'grel chen rnam gsum dang /dbu ma la 'jug pa ltar lags pas don de ni ches rtogs par dka' zhing rtogs na don che ba yin phyir da res kyi rten 'di la bstan pa'i snying bo 'di la bag chags brtan po zhig thebs dgos/ de la dgongs 'grel mang yang lhag mthong che chung lta bu shin tu dkon pas 176

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/der blta rtog byed rgyu gal chung du byas nas nor bu dang mching bu ma nor bar tshe mjug 'di 'jam mgon bla ma'i gsung rab la gcig dril gyis 'da' bar mdzod/ zab mo'i lta ba la dang por dgag bya nges pa gal che bas dgag bya khyab che chung gi skyon spangs te rang lugs kyi dgag bya ngos 'dzin rgyu dang / dgag bya ngos bzung nas de nyid thal rang gang gis 'gog pa dang / de dag gis 'gog tshul nyi ma brgya phrag dus gcig tu shar ba las kyang gsal ba'i legs bshad kyi snang ba chen po lhag mthong chen mor yod pas de la go rtogs ci 'gro mdzod/ gnad don mthar thug pa ni/ deng sang gzhi bden pa gnyis kyi rnam dbye byed pa ni/ lam nyams len gyi dus na bden gnyis so so la brten pa'i lam rim gnyis sam bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis 'byung ba'i ched yin la/ lam rim gnyis dgos pa ni 'bras dus su chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis 'grub pa'i thabs yin zhing gzhi kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag la bston du med pa'i nges shes med na de'i lam rim mi 'ong zhing / don dam bden pa la nges shes legs po med na yang de'i lam rim 'byung tshul med pas gnyis ka la nges shes 'dren dgos/ de yang nges shes gnyis gcig gis gcig la gnod na gnyis ka 'dren tshul med cing / stobs sam 177

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/nus pa che chung shor na yang lam rim gnyis kyang de bzhin 'gro bas thabs shes gnyis la stobs che chung shor bas theg pa chen po'i lam rim dpyis phyin pa med/ des na bden gnyis la nges pa stobs che chung mi rung la/ nges pa stobs mtshungs su 'dren tshul yang kun rdzob nges pas don dam la nges shes ster zhing / don dam nges pas kun rdzob la nges pa ster ba zhig 'byung ste/ phan tshun nges shes gnyis gcig grogs su gcig 'gro ba'i tshe nges shes stobs mtshungs su skye ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i nges shes skyed lugs ni/ ji skad du/ snang ba rten 'brel bslu ba med pa dang / /stong ba khas len bral ba'i go ba gnyis / /ji srid so sor snang ba de srid du/ /da dung thub pa'i dgongs pa rtogs pa med/ /nam zhig res 'jog med par cig char du / /rten 'brel mi bslur mthong ba tsam nyid nas/ /nges shes yul gyi 'dzin stangs kun 'jig na/ /de tshe lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs pa lags / /zhes gsungs pa ltar snang stong gnyis gzhi gcig gi steng du 'du mi rung ba dang / /gal te 'du yang snang ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas snang ba nges pa'i blos gzhan la ltos med du bden grub kyi dmigs gtad 'jig pa dang / stong ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas stong ba nges pa'i blos blo gzhan la ltos med du las 'bras kyi nges pa la yid ches 178

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/rnyed pa mi 'ong bas snang stong so so'i rgyu mtshan logs nas 'tshol dgos pa dang / snang ba nges pa'i blos stong ba 'char ba la sgrib pa dang —/ stong ba nges pa'i blos snang ba 'char ba la sgrib pa'i tshe snang stong so sor snang ba yin la/ de srid du thub pa'i dgongs pa mthar thug pa la rtogs pa nang byan chud pa med cing / nam zhig na gong du bshad pa ltar rgyu 'bras rten 'brel la nges shes 'drongs pa de'i tshe nges shes de ga'i byed pa rgyu mtshan gzhan mi 'tshol bar nges shes de nyid kyi yul gyi dmigs gtad zhig pa zhig byung na snang stong gnyis kyi blo snga phyi yin kyang gtan la 'bebs tshul so so la ltos pa'i res 'jog med par nges shes gnyis cig char du skye ba 'ong ba'i tshe lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs par gsungs pa ltar lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs pa zhig e 'ong blta dgos la/ de yang rje bdag nyid chen po'i gsung sgros nyag ma re re yang dngos shugs kyi nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas lhag mthong che chung ring du blta zhing / 'dris par byed pa'i sgo nas chos dang gang zag gang yin kyang yul gyi sdod lugs kyi ngos nas grub pa med pa dang / yul can blo la snang lugs kyi ngos nas 'jog dgos pas gnas lugs don dam par ma grub pa dang / kun rdzob bam tha snyad du 'jog pa'i tshul/ de gnyis kyi nges pa bshad ma thag 179

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa ltar 'drongs pa la tshig tsam min par nyin mtshan ltos med du 'bad rigs pa ni/ 'di la the tshom zos pas kyang / /srid pa hrul bor byed par 'gyur/ /gsungs pa ltar lags pas 'bad par mdzod / de ltar lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyang bzhin du thun mong min pa rdo rje theg pa la bag chags che thebs chung thebs byed dgos pas de la deng sang gsang sngags bla med kyi gser chos thang mar brdal yod pas lam gyi 'jug sgo dbang skur tshad ldan rgyud dang grub chen gyi man ngag ltar legs par zhu zhing / dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam sdom la srog bsdos byed pa ni/ lam gyi srog rtsa gal bo cher gsungs pas dam tshig bsrung ba dang / sngar las kyang lhag pa'i rdo rje slob dpon mnyes pa sgrub pa dang / mi mnyes pa spong ba'i phyag len sla chos su mi gtong bar byin rlabs dngos grub kyi gter kha 'gug pa'i lcags kyu gcig pur nges par byas te/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su blta ba'i dad gus kyi rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs bskyon te rim gnyis kyi mos sgom byas na nyams rtogs kyi nor bu ci 'dod du lag rtser 'phen pas na/ tshe mjug 'dir sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs pa zhig mdzod/sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs pa la yang sgom thag rgyag pa dang / sgo 'dag sbyar dang / bzlas grangs mang bo 'khyol e thub dang / ri khrod 180

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/pa dang / bya bral gyi skad grags chen po gang yang mi dgos/ don chung zhing bar chad 'jug pa'i nyen che/ 'gro'am 'dug gam spyod lam ci byed kyang rang rgyud la rtogs la rgyun du rang sems dad pa'i me long g.ya' dag pa la byin rlabs kyi gter chen po bla ma'i gzugs brnyan yang dang yang du bkod de/ 'di phyi thams cad kyi skyabs gnas gcig chog tu mnga' gsol bzhin/ so thar gyi sdom pa la zhu dag byang sems kyi bslab pa la smon 'dun/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig la bsngo bgrang nyi ma re re bzhin gyis la/ kha mig sems gsum bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi gzhung bzang rnams dang ma bral na rgyal mtshan tshugs pa yin zhes dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis gsungs pa de bzhin du mdzad par thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa lags so/ /rang la med pa'i dge sbyor la/ /grogs khyed bskul ba khrel 'das kyang / /nyid kyi thugs la nan che phyir/ /bla ma'i gsung rgyun gleng ba lags/ /de la dge tshogs cung zad yod srid na/ /de mthus rgyal bstan spyi dang 'jam mgon lugs/ /khyed thugs yangs pa'i gshong du ma dros bzhin/ /'khyil te gtan bde'i dpal la spyod par shog /dharma sā ras bris pa dge'o/ /༄7/ /'jam dpal snying bo slar yang bsam bzhin du/ /bstan 181

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'gro'i mgon du rnam par rol ba'i rje/ /gnas lnga kun gzigs blo gros mtshungs med pa'i/ /yab rjes khyod la bkra shis mdzad gyur rigs / /snying ltar gces pa'i btsun chung sdom brtson gyi rigs su gnas pa blo bzang rdo rje lags/ spyir mi lus tsam yang zhib tu bsams na rnyed dka'/ chos ldan gyi lus rin chen de bas kyang dkon / bla ma dam pa rnams dang mjal ba yang srid mthar snang /chos lugs dang grub mtha' mang yang snying nas grol ba don du gnyer ba la phyogs ris tsam ma yin par gcig tu thub pa'i lugs bzang tshang la ma nor ba'i gser sbyang btso ma lta bu'i 'jug ngogs mchog tu gyur ba rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha pa'i rang lugs dang 'phrad pa rnams ni / shin tu rnyed par dka' bas rnyed pa legs par rnyed pa yin pa la / nor bu mching bur ma 'khrul bar rang gi tshe rabs gtan gyi 'dun ma zhig sgrub bsam pa ni/ lan cig tsam min par yang nas yang du bsam dgos la/ bsams pa ltar dal ba'i rten la snying po rnam par dag pa zhig lon dgos pas/ de la 'jig rten gyi bu bzang bo dang / rta mgyogs pa'i grags skad/ khyi dang phag pa ltar lto 'dun chen pos gang byung za ba sogs tshe 'di'i bsam sbyor tha mal ba'i rtse ma nyams par phyi ma 'tshangs pa'i chos rgyags bzang bo gtan nas mi 182

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/'grub pas na/ bla ma gong ma tsho'i gsung sgros la/ gyong lto gos gtam gsum la bskur dgos gsung ba yin pas tshe 'di'i don ci byung gang byung byas te chos la 'jug dgos pa ni/ dper na srang mda'i mtho dman ltar yin pas tshul de dgongs la chos la 'jug pa'i sta gon mdzod / chos nyams su len zer ba ni/ bya bral dang / sgom chen dang /lus ngag gi dge sbyor can la sogs pa'i ming thogs mi dgos shing de dang de'i gzugs brnyan yang 'khrab mi dgos par ji skad du/ ngo mtshar bka' ni sde snod rnam pa gsum/ /gdams pa skyes bu gsum gyis mdzes pa yin/ /bka' gdams rin chen gser gyi phreng ba 'di//'gro ba su yis bgrang yang don yod 'gyur/ /gsungs pa ltar sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi gzhung gi bang mdzod skyes bu gsum gyi man ngag gi lde mig gis phyes te rgyud la goms 'dris 'gror bcug nas sbyar ba zhig yin te/ nyams zhes pa rang gi shes rgyud sems steng du / gang len na lung gi dbang du byas te sde snod gsum/ rtogs pa'i dbang du byas te bslab pa gsum/ ji ltar du len na tshig blo la bzung ste gshar sbyang dang / don sems la bskor te lag len la 'debs pa rang yin/ de yang gzugs la blta ba la mig gal che ba bzhin / kun byang la 'jug ldog byed pa la thog mar yang dag pa'i 183

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rigs pas shes par bya ba ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa rnam par 'byed pa'i chos kyi mig ni spyir na mngon pa dang / de'i nang nas da lta lkog tu gyur pa'i don dkon mchog gsum po rigs pas ched du bsgrubs nas rnam grol don gnyer gyi skyes bu'i 'jug ngogs gcig tu nges par byed pa'i tshad ma ni/ shin tu ngo mtshar zhing med mi rung ba yin pas / khyod blo tshad ma'i gzhung la cung zad zug pa shin tu skal ba bzang na rtog ge'i tshig don brgyad po'i dgos don mchog gsum 'grub pa'i thabs su dril ba shin tu gal che bas/ tshad ma'i dbu gzhung mjug gsum rje'i lam ṭika ltar nyams len la dril lugs la rtog dpyod mdzod/ de ltar na lam gzhan du nam yang bsgyur mi btub pa'i rigs stobs kyis nges shes gting tshuṭa pa'i dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brang zer ba de 'ong ba red/ de nas dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pu'i lam po che theg pa mchog gi nyams len gyi chu phran mtha' dag 'dus pa'i chos kyi rgya mtsho chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin la/ 'di ni mdo sde thams cad kyi rab dang phul sogs yin zhing ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo yang rgya chen po ston la/ de'i zab mo blta bar dka' ba'i gnas logs su bkol ba sgrib gnyis dngos su 'byin pa'i snying bo dam pa ni dbu ma yin la/184

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/'di ji lta ba gtso bor gtan la 'bebs pa mngon par bsdus kyang chog la/ zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin rtsal du 'don pas mdo sder bzhag na legs 'dug pas dbu phar gnyis mdo sde'i sde snod yin no/ /tshad mas rigs pa'i mig phyes te gang la blta ba'i 'jug ngogs ni 'di gnyis yin la/ de la blta ba'i tshe gtso bor lus ngag gi spyod pa nyon mongs dang 'brel ba'i mtha' gnyis su ma lhung bar ji ltar spyod pa'i tshul ni 'dul ba yin pas bka' pod lnga sngas su bcug nas nyams len gyi chos kyis phongs mi dgos pa ni rin po che'i gling du slebs na nor bu min pa gang yang mi rnyed pa dang 'dra na de ngo shes dgos/bka' pod lnga bo de nyi ma de ring tsam nas thun re re bzhin du stan thog gcig gi nyams len du 'ub kyis bsdu ba'i man ngag ni skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim yin/ 'dir yang lam gyi gtso bor byang chub kyi sems sogs yin mod/ las dang po ba la gal che ba'i nyams len ni skyes bu chung 'bring gi chos skor kho na yin pas thog mar phyi ma don gnyer gyi blo bskyed pa gal che/ de la mi rtag pa mang du sems dgos par gda'/ 'di'i khungs yang mkhyen gsum gyi nyams len thams cad kyi thog ma med pa'i rnam pa yin pa der gda'/ des na rtsa ba gsum dang rgyu mtshan dgu'i sgo nas yang yang soms la/ chos la blo 185

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/thag bcad pa gsum po de shin tu brtan po zhig e 'ong ltos/ 'di thog mar gal che ba'i chos la bskul ba'i lcag yin/ thog ma tsam du ma zad mi rtag pas yid 'khul ba'i nges shes kyi rgyun yod pa de srid du chags sdang rags pa la sogs pa'i nyon mongs mang bo'i mgo gnon zhing / sdig ltung mang bo yang 'chags sdom nus pas stong nyid byang sems las kyang thog mar 'di drag de nas rim pas shes 'ong zhing lab chog pas gnas skabs de ltar mdzod/ kha ton dge sbyor gyi rim pa la/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i sgo nas bla ma dang rje rin po che dbyer med du gyis la gsol 'debs dmigs brtse mas gsol ba shugs drag tu thobs/ yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed la byed dgos pas gnas skabs rgyas bsdus 'tshams pa re thon/ chos srung la skyes bu gsum gyi chos skyong bsten dgos pas/ myur mdzad ma/ brkyangs brkum ma/ mi 'jigs seng ge ma sogs ma chag mdor na chos lugs la phyogs ris su gcod mi rung bar kun la dag snang sbyang dgos kyang —/ rang gi nyams su len rgyu'i rtsa ba dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i snyan brgyud kyi man ngag 'di dag gis byed dgos/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang da lta bod gangs can na rgya gar 'phags yul gyi shing rta chen po'i rang lugs byin rlabs kyi ngad ma yal ba zab rgyas gang sa 186

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/nas tshang la ma nor bar yod pa 'di kho na yin/ gzhan tsho bzang yang skal ldan gyi spyod yul du song ba sogs mdor na las dang po ba'i sa nas sangs rgyas kyi bar bgrod pa'i brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i gdams ngag thub bstan spyi'i dbang du byas pa zhig dus dbang gis mi bzhugs/ blo drang bo'igatam yin/ gzhan tshos de 'dra go na ha las rgyu red de/ ha las rgyu med/ shin tu brtag na nges par yin/nged kyi rdo rje 'chang gi zhal snga nas zab mo lta ba'i skor la blta ba'i yig cha gcig kyang dge ldan pa'i ming thogs ma thogs dang / zhwa ser mi ser la khyad par yod gsungs te/ de shin tu thugs dag pa deng sang go yang / rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyis chos lugs dang grub mtha' mang zhing 'then 'khyer che yang ga ler ga ler rtogs dang bu chung la bu ram sbyin pa ltar chog shes med pa zhig rje bla ma'i lugs 'dir go rgyu yod gsungs te da tsam na dad gus gzhan tshos bsgyur mi btub pa re 'ong gi 'dug khyod kyang nga'i snying ltar brtse zhing nga la yang bla ma'i 'du shes shig 'char gyin yod na/ 'jig rten gyi zhen kha dang / pha mes snga rabs kyi lugs ka sogs gtsor 'don mi byed par chos rnam dag cig e 'grub bsam yod pas/ de lta na 'jig rten mi gtso bar chos dbang btsan par byed pa dang / blo snying gting nas gtod tshe 187

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ngas kyang 'jig rten gyi ngo 'dzin min par khong gi snying phyung ba la/khyod ri bo dge ldan pa'i bka' brgyud rin po che 'dir 'jus nas ma btang ba zhig gal che zhes gdam rgyu yin/ gsang ba'i gtam yin/nged kyi skyabs rje mchog de yang chos lugs kun 'dzin zhing gzhan la spel yang thugs kyi gting na yod tshul ni 'di yin/ nga la yang 'di 'dra mang bo gsung myong / su yin la gsung de 'dra mi 'byon/ nga'i khong na yon tan sna gcig nges par med kyang / khyod rang gis bla mar mthong ba la mi legs pa med/ nga rang mi bar khyis chod pa'i dper song yang nga'i rdo rje 'chang des nga la sgrib g.yogs med pa'i ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs yod rgyu zhig yin te/ dper na pha yis bu gces ring thung gang na yod kyang yid la bcags pa dang 'dra bar thugs cung zad yang ma sun pa'i bu gces shig nga rang yin/ de'i mthus khyod kyang a myes tsha bo la gces pa ltar dgongs gzigs mdzad yod pas gsol ba thobs dang byin rlabs nga rang brgyud nas 'jug mi 'jug la the tshom med/ nga'i mtshams gzugs grol nas zhib par bla ma'i gsung sgros mdo sngags kyi gnad gang shes khyod la ston pas da reb mang bo mi bri/ chos cung zad sgrub pa la tshe gal che bas tshe mdo cis kyang gzob la thon/ rigs lnga'i dam tshig bcu dgu 188

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/tsam ma yin par rigs lnga spyi dang so so rtsa ba dang yan lag der ma zad byang sems dang / so thar/ skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya bcas la nyi ma re re bzhin blta rtog legs po gyis la/ 'gal ba rnams phyir bcos dang / phyin chad sdom blo/ ma 'gal ba rnams la rjes su yi rangs dang / dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo ba sogs gyis/ 'o skol gnyis ma zad jo bo chen pos kyang de ltar mdzad na nyams len gyi snying bo ma nor/ byams snying rje byang sems stong nyid kyi lta ba bsgom bya'i gtso bo yin kyang / las dang po ba'i blo chos su 'gro ba'i thabs gal bo che dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang / khyad par du 'chi ba mi rtag pa sgom pa 'di yin pas mi rtag pa'i 'du shes 'di yang nas yang du soms / re zhig la stong nyid sgom pa bas rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs gi gnyen por 'gro ba 'di kho na zab/ byang chub kyi sems kyang shin tu bzang mod/ 'on kyang / rang gi don du 'di 'dra'i sems/ /sogs gsungs pa ltar rang re rang gi tshe phyi ma'i don la yang rtog dpyod mi 'jug pa zhig la de tsam zab rgyu med/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis lam la go rim nges pa zer ba de 'ong ba red/ gal che ba mi rtag pa'i 'du shes dang ma bral dang des tshe 'di'i snang shes ngan pa 'di phyi'i don gal bo che brlag pa'i chos brgyad rnam rtog gi 'dre ngan 'dul nus pas de 189

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/nas da ci byas byas yin/ sku tshe ring / khyod blo shel dkar khang ba ru//bla ma'i thugs rje byin rlabs mthus/ /zab rgyas gzugs brnyan 'bum rdzogs nas/ /chos kyi ltad mo mthong gyur cig /snying gi bu/ re zhig de tsam gyis gdams ngag gi bya ba gyis/ /spro/ /dbu mdzad lags/ kho bo deng sang blo kha nang du bskor tshe rang nyid gar 'gro gtol med pas/ gzhan la gdam mkhan gyi shag po gtan nas min 'dug pas smra ba bskyung ba las su bya ba'i gtso bor byed dgos 'dug mod/ khyod gcig tu da lta byed spyod yar dga' ltar snang ba dang / gnyis su bag med pa la rigs mi ston/zhes pa'i bslab bya dang 'gal gyis dogs nas tshig gsum zhu na/ da snga kho bos/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis de/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang / /sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ /zhes dang / tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes pa'i tshig rtsa rnams rtsa bar bzung ste mgrin pa 'gags 'gags su bshad pa de las gzhan med/ 'u cag shi dgos / nam 'chi mi shes/ shi tshe thams cad thams cad bskyur nas 'gro bas chos shig min pa gang gis kyang mi phan/ chos de la gong du drangs pa ltar gnyis yod/ gnyis po 'dzin lugs kyang bshad pa 190

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/byed pa dang / de'i don sems rgyud la bskor te sgrub pa byed pa gnyis yod/ 'dzin lugs gnyis po de las gzhan pa'i gar 'cham dbyangs rol/ 'ur 'ur zang zing gis rgyal bstan la bya ba byed pa kho na'i rnam gcod kyis bcad nas/ lo chung snang ba g.yeng la bskyon te/blta dga' dang nyan dga' ma che/ 'dur rgyu dang rgyug rgyu ma mang bar/ban de bya ba gser zho gang gi rang tshugs 'dzin dgos pa yin/ rgyal bstan gnyis po 'dzin lugs gnyis kyis 'dzin pa la/ gzhi tshul khrims gtsang ma gal che bas sdom dam tshig 'di nyar tshags gyis/brnyes 'tsho rgyu sdom pa red/ rdzi bos 'tsho rgyu gnag phyugs red/ rdzi bo gnag phyugs dgra khar brgyab pa dang / ban de sdom pa rtsis med shor ba gnyis las phyi ma sdug sdom pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'di tshe 'di'i rgyan yin/ tsan mdar zhig gi lhag yin/ phyi ma'i rgyags yin/ rtsam pa sgro gang gi lhag yin/ bud med cig dang kha ma 'bag tsam min par sdom pa bya ba sdom gsum bsngo bgrang ltar sgo gang thad nas nyes lang 'gog ci thub re ma 'chugs/ sdom gsum gtsang mar bsrung ba 'di rang re ri bo dge ldan pa'i phyag bzhes kyi mthil zhig red 'dug pas ma 'chugs/ rgyun du sdom pa dag ma dag la rtog dpyod thongs/rdzi bos 'tsho 'tsho zhig gyis dang chos la de las lhag pa zhig med cing 191

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/mi dgos/ 'jig rten yang des thon yod pas rem rem/ de'i steng du dpe cha la blo che zug chung zug byed dgos pas/ rang gar ma sdod par bsdus grwa dang blo rtags gdan du thongs/ dbu par gyi na bza' kha sbyar te bzhes/ mngon 'dul gyi ska rags nyis sbrel zhig chongs la/gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i dbu zhwa zhig bsgron nas mdo sngags gnyis ku'i gnad 'dus kyi skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim gyi sbrang chang mngar mo de gsol zhing sdod dang / dgon pa 'di'i rten cig 'ong /rang gi 'di phyi gnyis ka 'grub/ gzhan la yang phan thogs pas bya ba gang yin pho bzang gi las ka don che la gnad thog tu thebs pa zhig mdzod / pho yeng yeng gi bya ba sad sud de ma byed/ sku tshe ring /zhes bla rgan blo bzang mdo sngags kyis gang dran lhugs par bsam pa bzang bos gsal 'debs su byas pa yig nyob cig tu rtsis med du 'phangs na kha gtses pa yin no/ /༄7/ /bla ma mkhyen/ nga lta bu zhal gdams mi la 'chad mkhan dang —/ khyod lta bu zhal gdams grog ger nyan mkhan e yin na/ nga ni mdang da nangs sos dal du bsdad nas mdzub mo gdong la btsugs te rang ji lta bur song bltas pa na/ shes rgyud ni gyong / phyi ma ni ma dran/ tshul khrisams ni kha ral sna ral du song ba'i steng du shi 192

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/gson gyi dkor mang bo zhig la 'bag cing da dung bstan don du rlom nas rang gzhan gyi phyogs ris phyes te chags sdang gi ngang na yod pa 'di cung zad mthong bas/ de rang sang zhig shi na rkan gzar du rdo bsgril ba bzhin ngan song du 'gro bar thag chod pas khyod la ci zhig gdams / kye ma kye hud/ khyod ni bla ma sprul ba'i skur sgro btags kyang btags pa ltar gyi skabs su babs pa'i las don gcig tsam mi bsgrub par ma babs pa'i mi bzang sku drag gi lad mo/ kha mkhas dang lce bde/ shes can dang dpyod ldan 'khrab nas/ rang mgu rang tshim du song nas/ chos 'dul ba'i lag len/ phyi ma'i lam rgyags/ tshe 'di'i mdzes rgyan/ rang gis bsams na zhe 'tshang ba/ rogs kyis mthong na thal mo sbyor ba'i skyes bu dam pa'i rnam thar de ro gos lam zhabs su bskyur ba ltar par dor nas/ gcig tu ma rabs rnams dga' zhing dang du len pa'i rta yi mgyogs dal/ mtshon gyi gzi 'bab / bre rgya'i che chung / tshong gi khe skyed/ kha mchu rgyal pham kho na gleng ste/ gcig tu dal 'byor rin po che/ gnyis su sprul sku'i ming go sa / gsum du lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad chud zos su btang nas lo na tshod 'di nyi ma re res 'dzad ci thub byas te/ ha ha dang ho ho'i ngang na yod na zhal gdams kyis ci byed/ o ha bo/ bla rgan 193

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/nga'i kha gtses te zhal gdams dgos ci'i phyir zer/ phyi rol ba 'dod chags can gyis bud med la snyan ngag gi tshigs su bcad pas sgro btags kyi bstod ra ltar nyams dga' dga'i bstod ra 'dra e 'ong bsam pa yin na/ khyod lus kyi dbang du btang na/ gcin skyag rkyal ba gang la rus pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi lhu tshigs rgyus pas sbrel te sha khrag gi 'dam gyis zhal bas g.yogs nas ko lpags kyis btum pa zhig tu mthong bas ngas bstod mi shes/ sems kyi dbang du btang na rnam g.yeng gi rlung dmar tshan po ches chags sdang gi rdul mang bo gtsubs nas/ thos bsam shes rab kyi sgron me'i 'od snang chen po ga la yod de/ bsdus pid kyi khyab skor 'ga' re'i dkar me chung ngu zhig gna' zhig la sbar ba nag thib kyis bsad de/ rang gzhan gnyis kyi kha mig nyes spyod rdog zhabs kyi rdul gyis bkang nas yod pa la ngas ci bstod/ gal srid mi srid srid pa'i tshul gyis khyi rgan smyon pa'i sems kyis rang ngo re zin pa yin srid na/ bka' sde snod gsum po de zhal gdams yin/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhal gdams yin/de la mig gis ltos dang mthong ba'i dug med/ de la rna bas nyon dang thos pa'i dug med/ a la de tsho rtsed mo yang yin/ ngo ma yang yin / khyod rang na tshod ni gzhon/ nad ni med/ yon tan re 'gos 194

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/na mi mkho rgyu cang e yod na/ 'chi ni dgos/ nam 'chi ba la cha bzhag ni med/ 'chi tshe phan pa chos yin pas chos re 'grub na mi mkho rgyu cang e yod na/ or che 'jam dpal lo lo lags/ /lo brgya'i sdod shom ma byed par/ /nad med na tshod gzhon dus 'dir/ /chos shig e 'grub dgos so lo/ /lus sems bral ba'i phyi ma'i lam /mgyogs kyang rta yis mi chod pas/ /rta la blo rtse ma gtad par/ /chos la blo sna khugs shig ang / /sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i lam po che/ /mda' mtshon gzi yis mi phog pas/ /mtshon la blo rtse ma gtad par/ /chos la blo sna khugs shig ang / /bde ba rang gis nyo ba dang / /sdug bsngal gzhan la btsong dka' bas/ /tshong la blo rtse ma gtad par/ /chos la blo sna khugs shig ang / /tshe 'di'i skyon dang yon tan dang / /phyi ma'i bde dang sdug bsngal sogs/ /rigs pa'i 'phrul gyis bsgyur ba dang / kha lce bde bas bcos dka' bas/ /drang srong chen po sangs rgyas kyis/ /drang bo'i lam nas go 'phang mchog /mngon du byas te thugs drang bos/ /drang bo'i gtam gyis drang srong lam/ /rang re'i skal bar gnang ba bzhin/ /drang bo'i lam la zhugs nas ni/ /mi dregs rta mgyogs ma 'khrab par/ /blo rtse gtad sa ma nor dgos/ /sku tshe ring mdzod sku 'jam pa/ /lo brgya thub mdzod gces lo bo/ /ma 195

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rabs rnams la mi blta bar/ /ya rabs spyod la yar ltos mdzod/ /mdor dril na blo rtse gtad sa de ma nor/ 'di phyi kun tu 'tshang nges pa'i thabs de gang yin ltos la de la blo rtse gtod/ tshe 'dir yang sdug bsngal gyi rgyur 'gro ba'i bya byed ngan pa de la blo rtse ma gtod/ lo brgya tshe ring / /spro/ /na maḥdhīḥ da lta dal 'byor lus rten bzang bo thob/ /mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes su bzung / /dri med lung rtogs bstan dang mjal ba'i dus/ /rang don yal bar 'khor na smyon pa dngos / /gnyen bshes rtsa lag bar skabs re yi grogs/ /nor rdzas longs spyod lo 'ga'i slu brid tsam/ /zhes phugs gtan du gtod pa'i rtag 'dzin can/ /de 'dra de la sems zhig yod re skan/ /dal 'byor rten bzang sgyu ma'i rta glang 'dis/ /da lta nyid nas chos kyi tshong brdal na/ /phyi ma'i bde skyid rin chen lon 'gyur gyis/ /da lta rnam g.yeng dbang du ci'i phyir gtong / /gal srid rtag 'dzin gdon gyis bshol gyur na/ /'chi bdag sgyu ma mkhan po'i rigs sngags kyis//lnga phung tshogs pa so sor gyes pa'i tshe/ /rang don stor na de tshe ci zhig byed / /da lta nad sogs 'gal rkyen bral dus 'dir/ /dam pa'i chos la nan tan ma byas na/ /da gdod 'chi 'am mi 'chir dogs pa med/ /196

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/'chi la 'jigs kyang 'jigs pa phyi nas 'gyod/ /da lta dkon mchog skyabs su ma bzung na/ /'chi ba thon dus skyabs bzang mi dran zhing / /dran kyang 'brel ba med pas 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /thugs las chung ngur gyur na su la 'bod/ /kye ma ma 'ongs 'chi ba 'jigs skrag che/ /da lta'i sems 'di rnam g.yeng rlung gis 'khyer/ /'das pa'i las ngan 'bras bu smin ma reg /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i tshul 'dis yid re skyo/ /kye hud legs par dpyod dang myu gu khyod/ /de rang nyid nas 'bad pa drag po yis/ /rang drin rang la che ba mi byed par/ /tshe 'dir sems na dngos su bdud kyis bslus/ /da lta nyid du'ang mi 'chi'i gdeng med cing / /gal srid tshe mthar son pa'i dbang byas kyang —/ /lo grangs lnga bcu tsam las med pas na/ /de srid sprang yang mi 'chi tsam los 'ong / /phyi ma'i 'phrang ring nges par 'grim dgos shing / /phyi ma'i sems rgyun chad dus med pas na/ /de tshe phan pa'i chos shig mi bsgrub par/ /de las gzhan pa'i don chen ci zhig sgrub/ /tshe 'di ring bor yod dam med pa nges/ /med las che ba grogs kyi skye 'chis shes/ /phyi ma nges par yod la zad pa'i dus/ /med pa rang gi sems kyi rgyun 'dis shes/ /kye ma kye hud lo ngo nyer gcig par/ /myu gus phyi ma'i 'dun pa cher ma byas/ /thos bsam byas lo de yang tshig 197

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/tsam du/ /song ba'i rang mtshang 'di la zhe re 'gyod/ /de ring nam mkhar mdzes pa'i nyin byed dang / /da lta sprul ming thogs pa'i myu gu gnyis / /do dgong mnyam du pha rol song gyur na/ /gces dgu'i gnyen bshes su yis dam du 'dzin/ /de nas ma dag zhing gzhan 'gro ba la/ /pha mar 'du shes da lta'i gces dgu'i grogs/ /yid yul tsam du'ang dran pa mi srid na/ /sems can su la nye ring chags sdang byed / /skye ba 'di sngon gang du skyes pa'i gnas/ /grogs dang longs spyod 'bral mi phod pa kun/ /da lta dran pa tsam yang mi srid bzhin/ /'di nas gzhan du 'gro na su la chags/ /dgra gnyen spu ris 'byed pa'i chags sdang blo/ /bsams shing bsams na skye ba'i gnas med de//'khrul ba a 'thas can gyi myu gu khyod/ /da ni 'khrul ba'i dbang du btang de shi /mtho dman khyad par 'di yang 'khrul ba ste/ /mthon po'i lan gyis 'chi bdag mi byams shing / /rgyu 'bras log pa nam yang mi srid pas/ /mchi mas brnangs bzhin 'chi na mthon po gang / /snyan dang mi snyan 'di yang 'khrul ba ste/ /snyan pa sa gsum rna bar bkod na'ang / /'chi bdag rgyal bo'i rna bar mi 'jebs pas/ /khros bzhin srog dbugs len na snyan pas ci/ /bde dang mi bde 'di yang 'khrul ba ste/ /lha mi'i 'dod yon gcig tu myong na'ang / /ngan song 198

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/sdug bsngal brgyud mar nges bskyed na/ /de la blo ldan su zhig bde bar rtsi/ /rnyed dang mi rnyed 'di yang 'khrul ba ste/ /'dzam gling nor gyis bkang ba'i rnyed thob kyang / /lta dbang tsam yang med par 'chi dgos na/ /rnyed pas ci byed bsod nams zad pa'i rkyen/ /'khrul med don kun gzigs pa'i thub dbang gis/ /'khrul ba'i 'khor lo 'jig rten chos brgyad po/ /mgo snyoms mdzod ces gsungs pa'i bden tshig gis/ /'jig rten bde legs byas pa mi dran nam/ /tshe 'di'i bde skyid bde skyid ma yin te/ /phyi ma nyam nga'i gnas su mi bzod pa'i/ /sdug bsngal tshabs chen bskyed pa'i rgyu yin na/ /tshe 'di'i bde ba sems na myu gu smyos/ khu khrag smin pa'i sha rgyus gong bu dang / /lhan cig tshogs pa'i rnam par shes pa dag /dbugs kyi rgyu ba phra mo 'di las gzhan/ /sprel byed med na ci'i phyir rtag par 'dzin / /rgyus gong dur khrod gnas 'dabs la lhung zhing / /sa gzhir khrag gi thig le bris gyur te/ /skra yi skud pas phyogs rnams sbrel ba yi//myu gur de 'drar gyur pa nam zhig 'ong / /char sprin 'khrigs 'dra'i du ba 'khyil ba'i khrod/ /rab 'bar me lce 'khyog por 'gro ba'i dbus / /rdo yi gdan la ma g.yor rol ba yi/ /myu gu 'das pa'i gnas skabs nam zhig yin/ /de tshe gcig pur rgyu ba'i yid kyi lus/ /199

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dkar nag 'du byed rlung gis ded pa yis/ /rang dbang med par 'khyams pa'i dus de na/ /sprul ming sgyu ma'i myu gu gang du song / /'dzum pa'i bzhin gyis bsu ba'i sgyu ma'i grogs/ /snying gi ze'u 'bru rnams dang nam zhig na/ /lhan cig spyod pa lta ci bzhin ras tsam /mthong ba'i skabs kyang med na des ci byed/ /tshe gang bsags pa'i rin thang can gyi nor/ /mya ngam thang du dgra yis phrogs pa bzhin/ /gcig kyang med par lag stong yin yang na/ /bye ma'i mkhar 'dra'i don med ga la byed/ /snying du sdug pa'i a ma rgan mo dang / /a ma'i sbyin pa'i sgyu lus g.yar bo la'ang / /lhan cig 'grogs dang spyod pa'i dbang med na/ /da ni grogs dang longs spyod gang bder zhog /myu gu 'chi tshe dga' ba bskyed pa'i gzhi/ /dam pa'i chos dang chos kyi nang nas kyang / khas blangs tshul khrims dga' ba'i them skas te/ /chos ldan mngon mthor bskyed pa'i 'jug ngogs yin/ /de tshe myu gus dge ba goms pa yi/ /shes rgyud chos kyi bag chags kyis mdzes na/ /gzhon nu nyid nas dam pas rjes bzung ste/ /chos kyi dpal la bde blag 'jug par 'gyur/ /de lta lags na gzhon nu myu gu khyod/ /mngon mtho'i khang bzang gcig nas gcig brgyud de/ /thar ba'i gling du yun ring mi 'gyangs par/ /slebs par 'gyur na de las skyid 200

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/ci yod/ /de dag kun gyi rtsa ba da lta 'dir/ /bshad sgrub 'khor lo gnyis kyi gzhi byas la/ /lhod pa med par bgyid la rag las na/ /rang don tshugs par gyis shig myu gu kye/ /'di ni sras bcas rgyal kun zhal mthun par/ /khyod la lung du bstan pa'i don yin gyi/ /na chung gdon gyis btab pa'i ban rgod re'i/ kha la gang byung tsam dang 'dra re skan/ /sa ma ya/ /a/༄7/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo/ /mthu stobs bdag po gsang 'dzin las rab gling / /snying rje'i gter chen blo bzang dpal ldan rje/ /rigs gsum rnam rol rnam gsum bla ma'i zhabs / /spyi bor mchod de dam pa'i rnam thar la/ /rjes su mos pa'i skal ldan de yis ni/ /dam pa'i spyod tshul spros zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ /mi ldog tsam du tshigs bcad 'ga' 'bri ste/ /'on te skyes sbyangs shes rab dman pa dang / /dam pa'i gsung sgros rna bas thos na yang / /nyams myong med pa'i rang rgyud skam po 'dis/ /ci zer 'di zer med pa sdug re che/ /de slad bdag la dam pa khyod dgyes pa'i/ /legs par bshad pa'i mchod pa gtan med kyang / /dri bar lan ldon ma byas mi rung phyir/ /nyi ring 'phul ba'i gtam 'dis khyod snyan gtse/ /mgo gser mdo sngags ston pa mi gcig ces/ /sgrogs kyang brtags 201

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/na gsar rnying su yin kyang / /zas gtsang sras po'i rjes 'jug byed dgos snyam/ /thub pa'i bstan pa'i dbang du byas te gsol/ /de la 'dzam gling rgyan drug ya gyal che/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pa dbyig gi gnyen po yis/ /ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis gsungs pa dang / /de 'dzin smra dang sgrub pa kho na zhes/ /rnam gcod tshig gis gsungs pa'i don bzhin du/ /rgyal bstan nyams len byed tshul ston pa'i lung / /sde snod gsum dang de ni nyams len pa/ /bslab pa gsum yin de las gzhan med gsungs/ /thog mar nyes spyod ldog thabs ston pa yi//gzhung mchog bstan dang ston pa gnyis ldan pa/ /'dul ba yin zhes mkhas pa rnams gleng na//de la khyed thugs spro ba yod lags sam/ /de nas lus ngag tsam du ma zad pa/ /g.yo ba'i rnam rtog rta rgod gcun pa'i thabs/ /ston pa'i sems 'dul gdams pa'i rgya mtsho ni/ /mdo sde nyid de de la dgyes sam ci/ /de steng 'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'khrul ba'i mun / /sel byed rang spyi'i mtshan nyid 'bum dbye ba'i/ /rnam 'byed snang ba ster ba mngon pa ste/ /de la grogs khyed dgyes sam mi dgyes lags / /sde snod gsum 'di gdams ngag yin no zhes/ /bon pos bswo bzhin skad gdangs mthon po yis/ /sgrog pa jo 'brom brgyud par bcas lags te/ /'di la gdams ngag yin pa go ba dka'/ /202

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/sngags kyi gzhung yang rgya gar mkhas pa rnams/ /sde snod gsum kur gtogs dang gsang sngags ni/ /mdo sde'i tshul du bshad ces mdo sde ru / /bzhed na sde snod gsum las logs na med/ /thar ba 'dod phyin thar lam ston pa la/ /'gran zla med pa go tam de yis ni/ /thar 'dod btsas su bzhag pa sde snod gsum/ /yin phyir gdams ngag bzhed na de la mdzod/ /blun po nga 'drar ma zad mkhas rnams kyang / /sangs rgyas gsung las lhag pa 'chad rgyu med/ /yod kyang chos log nyid du des 'grub pas/ /chos shig mdzad na sde snod gsum bzhin mdzod / /dang po thos pa'i sgron me ma sbar na/ /lam dang lam min ci yang mi mthong zhes/ /gsar rnying mkhas grub kun yang zhal mthun na//sde snod thos bsam byas na mi legs sam/ /thos don rgyud la bskor te sgrub pa yang / /lha bsnyen sngags bzla 'dag sbyar la sogs tsam/ /min phyir sde snod gsum gyis gang bstan pa/ /bslab gsum nyams su len 'di yin lags te/ /dang po rgyu dang mi rgyu'i rten byed pa/ /sa chen 'di bzhin yon tan kun gyi rten/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras kun gyis mgrin gcig tu/ /bsngags pa'i legs byas zad mi shes pa'i gter/ /tshul khrims lags zhes rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas/ /da lta'i bla ma rnams la thug gi bar/ /gsungs pa'i chos kyi gzhi ma gal bo che/ /203

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'di la yin la yin ngo shes sam lags/ /tshul khrims ldan la sgom yang skye sla zhes/ /'phags bod mkhas dang grub pa rnams bzhed mod//deng sang tshul ldan nyan thos gral 'dzud la/ /nyan thos 'gog pa rmugs par 'thum snyams shing / /'od gsal sems kyi rig ngo skyong ba'i sgom/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas su la yod zer na/ /ral ba'i khur dang rgad mo'i gdos thag can/ /de nyid kho nar yod ces zer na yang ske/ /thub pas tshul khrims ting nge 'dzin yin zhes/ /bslab gsum rgyu 'bras nyid du gsungs pa 'dis/ /tshul khrims sgom gyi tshogs su shes mdzod la/ /tshul khrims dag pas sgom la brtson na legs/ /gang gi bsgom par bya ba de yang ni/ /gsal tsam rig tsam shes pa'i mtshan nyid tsam/ /ma yin dge ba'i dmigs pa re re yang / /dpyad dang 'jog pas goms pa spel ba'i tshul/ /sgom rim gsum du dgag sgrub du ma yis/ /mkhas pa pad ma'i ngang tshul des gsungs te/ /deng sang de la mgu ba dkon pas na/ /khyod snyan mi gtse smra ba bskyung ba lags / /bsam gtan sems kyi las rung de'i steng nas/ /phung bo khams dang skye mched bdag med du/ /legs par bsgom pa'i shes rab chos kyi bcud/ /'di nyid kho nas sgrib pa spong ba'i tshul/ /dang po bod 'dir bo rnyi sa twas gsungs/ /bar du bod 'dir ka ma shī 204

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/las bstan/ /tha mar bod 'dir a ti shas bkral na/ /rgya gar paṇa chen lugs la dgyes sam ci/ /'khor ba'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin zer ba'i mur/ /bdag med sgom pa med 'dzin yin pas na/ /re zhig tsam las mtha' bral min no zhes/ /gsung mkhan mang ste lta ba'i tshul 'di dag /tshig tsam min par blo ngor shar tshod de/ /gsang sngags snga 'gyur mkhas pa snga ma yis/ /bkral ba'i nang rgyud yo ga rnam gsum gyi / /nges don lta ba yin min brdar sha chod/ /don dam ngos na don med mkha' 'dra yang / /kun rdzob tsam du kun byang kun 'thad pa'i/ /bden gnyis dbyer med 'di 'dra snga 'gyur gyi/ /mkhas pa'i thugs bcud yin snyam 'char mod de/ /lta ba snyigs ma'i dus 'dir lta ba la / /rang gzhan phal cher gzhan lugs rang lugs zhes/ /bshad rgyu mang yang don la bshad tshod ltar/ /gnad du phog pa dka' bas gnad smin gces/ /de ltar sde snod gsum dang bslab pa gsum/ /gdams ngag mchog dang nyams len mchog nyid du/ /grub pa med na drang bor gsol 'dir dpyod/ /yod na rjes su yi rangs 'bul ba lags / /rang sems nyon mongs dbang du song gyur te/ /chags snang rtog pas las ngan mtsho brdol nas/ /'di phyi kun tu mi bde'i sdug bsngal brgya/ /'dren pa nang ba kun gyi lugs yin na/ /dang po nyon 205

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/mongs tshul khrims kyis sun byung / /bar du nyon mongs ting 'dzin gyis 'go mnan/ /tha mar nyon mongs shes rab kyis spangs te/ /bslab gsum nyon mongs dgra gcig 'dul thabs lags/ /des na bslab pa gsum po 'di las lhag /rang rgyud 'dul ba'i nyams len yod snyam na/ /dga' rab byed pas bstan dang phyes zin pas/ /bslab pa gsum la nan tan cis kyang zhu/ /theg pa che dang gsang sngags lugs kyi yang / /sdom pa gnyis na tshul khrims bslab pa ste/ /sems bskyed bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin thun mong min/ /'od gsal rtogs pa zab mo'i shes rab lags/ /de slad sde snod gsum dang bslab gsum 'dis/ /thub bstan mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho che/ /mtha' dag bsdus pa'i tshul 'di dgongs mdzod la/ /sangs rgyas bstan la ci nus goms par mdzod/ /mdor na mi lus lan cig thob dus 'dir/ /don med rnam g.yeng mal du gnyid log nas/ /don chen dge ba'i las ka shor bcug ste/ /rgyus med sa tshigs lag stong gcod dgos na/ /cir 'gyur yang nas yang du dpyod mdzod la/ /bla ma pha ma nye du grogs mched sogs/ /nyin re bzhin du gcig 'chi gnyis 'chi'i rjes/ /da ni yun ring mi sdod 'gro dgos pas/ /bsam rgyu ma mang bsam tshad phyi ma soms/ /byed rgyu ma mang byas tshad dam 206

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/chos gyis/ /'chi bdag do dgong tsam du thog dbab tu/ /slebs kyang 'gyod pa med pa bya ran 'dug /de skad zhus 'di rang la med bzhin du / /dam pa khyod la bskul ba ngo tsha ste/ /'on kyang khyed thugs dgyes slad rna thos tsam/ /mi mtshang mgu phyir 'dre dkar tshul du bsgrags/ /de la dge ba cung zad yod srid na/ /dus kyi mtha' 'dir thub bstan rin po che/ /rang gzhan kun gyi rgyud la rgyas gyur te/ /'di phyi'i lam sna zin pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /pad bsam zhes bya dam pa'i spyan snga ba/ /gang des dar bcas tshig gi skyes gnang ste/ /chos gtam ma ṇi sgrogs zhes bskul ba'i mod/ /ne tso de yis de skad thal lo kye/ /zhes gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba'i bstan pa'i gdugs dkar 'degs pa'i skyes mchog rin po che phyag tsha nges don mchog gi sprul ba'i sku'i nye gnas dam pa'i thugs bzhed mi ldog tsam du/ rang nyid ji ltar 'gyur cung zad tsam yang mi shes bzhin du gzhan la chos 'chad par rlom pa'i mdo med khrel 'das/ dharma swa ra zhes bya bas bsgrigs te spyan lam du gus pas phul ba la dgongs khrel med par zhu/ /༄gi /na mo gu ru/ blo bzang rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed byin rlabs mthu / /mkhas btsun bzang bo'i dge ba'i bshes kyi tshul/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i mos ngor shar ba yi/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rnam rol 207

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/de la 'dud/ /bdag ni yon tan nor gyis phongs pas na/ /gzhan la gdams pa'i mkhan po min mod de/ /re zhig gzhon pa khyed la gzhen bskul gtam/ /ne tso'i chos bshad bzhin du gleng ba na/ /thog ma nyid nas med du mi rung ba'i/ /lag len gtso bo tshul khrims yin gsungs na/ /chos 'dul bdud rtsi'i btung ba bzhes pa yi/ /bzang bo'i skal ba khyed la yod dam ci/ /chang dang bud med 'phral dga' phugs 'phung ba'i/ /kim pa'i 'bras la nyin mtshan sred gyur te/ /phyin ci log gi bag chags 'thas pa yi/ /gnas ngan len la khyod nyid dgyes sam ci/ /'dod don dug gi lo ma zos zos pa'i ngan goms byur gyis mnar ba'i lang shor blos/ /'khrig bder zhen pa'i chu 'gog gnyen po'i rags/ /khyod thugs rwa bar nan tan bskor ram ci/ /bag yod rdzi bos dran shes thag pa yis/ /dmu rgod kha lo med pa'i sems kyi rta/ /kun spyod gtsang ma'i rtod phur la 'dog pa'i / /ya rabs spyod la khyod thugs dgyes sam ci/ /tshul khrims sa gzhi byi dor byas pa'i gzhir/ /mang thos gsung rab nor sna 'bum brdal te/ /dri med rigs pas rin thang gzhal ba yi/ /bsam pas nges shes 'tshol la khyod dgyes sam/ /bden gnyis shes bya'i gos bzang za 'og ngos/ /rang spyi'i gser gyi ri mo 'bum bkra ba/ /rnam 208

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/dpyod mig gis mjal ba'i bsod nams can/ /mkhas pa'i tshong dpon mdzad la khyod spro'am/ /spong dang klog pas rgyal bstan snying bo'i nor/ /blo gros mdzod du bcug pas 'du byed kun/ /rnam dkar kho nar gzhol ba'i bstan 'dzin gyi/ /skal bzang skyes bu khyod kyis mdzad bzhed dam/ /kye ma deng dus snyigs ma lnga bdo bas/ /ya rabs spyod la mig ltos byed mkhan dkon/ /ma rabs spyod la rang mos gzhan 'then pas/ /rgyal bstan gtsang ma'i phyag bzhes ji ltar 'ong —/ /rab byung sdom pa len pa'i thog ma ru/ /a li ka li'i glu dbyangs gyer ba nas/ /'tsho ba phyid pa'i thabs la 'di bzang zhes/ /rten 'brel mgo nas snad pa ma yin nam/ /bslab pa gsum gyi nor bu len pa'i thabs / /lung gi gru bo rigs pa'i dar chen gyis/ /bskyod pa tsam nas shi dge gson zas kyi/ /mching bu gsog pa'i 'dun pa mi byed dam/ /yid kyi yol go mang thos nor bu yis/ /bkang ba las kyang gor mdo'i chog khrig gi /phyag len phra mo byang ba tsam zhig gis/ /rang tshims gzhan gyis ngo so mi bstod dam/ /lo nas zla shas dam chos skyed mos tshal/ /'grim mdog dge 'dun gral du 'tshangs pa yi/ /khyim pa rku thabs zhugs pa'i spyod lam gyis/ /grwa sa chod pa'i spyi brtol mi byed dam/ /stabs legs ltas kyis mtshan 209
