sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/snyan ram gyi tshos/ /bsgos pa'i gzugs brnyan lpags pa sngon po yis//dkor sdud rgyal po'i go sa rnyed tsam na/ /nying dgos grub pa deng sang mi mang ngam/ /kye ma bla ma mdzad kyang nying dgos 'di/ /kye hud sprul skur 'khrungs kyang nying dgos 'di/ /las ngan rang gi bsam pa'i phugs kyang 'di/ /grogs ngan gzhan gyi gtad so'i phugs kyang 'di / /'di 'dra'i bsam sbyor gdon gyis thebs bzhin du/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i phyag len byed mdog kyang / /mi gtsang kyis bkang rgyan ldan bum pa ltar/ /mjal snang spro yang rul dri mi bro'am/ /gdon 'di phral thabs yod dam sprul ba'i sku/ /gegs 'di sel thabs yod dam snying gi bu/ /yod na dam chos 'grub pa yod lags kyis/ /med na bstan 'dzin zol gyis za thabs dang / /de skad smras pa'i skyon 'di sel thabs dang / /yon tan dam pa'i rnam thar 'tshol 'dod thugs / /phan tshun 'gran pa lta ba'i rnam thar gyis/ /spyan mig gyen ltos mdzad na mi lags sam/ /ngag gi rdzing bur skyon yon gzugs brnyan cha/ /'gog med shar ba'i blo gros pad mo'i zas/ /dam chos 'khor lo'i lag can ngang ba khyod/ /dgyes pa'i slad du rgan pos phul ba lags/ /zhes dharma sā ras grags pa rab rgyas la gsal 'debs su byas 210

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/pa'osto/ /༄༄/ /yang 'jig rten lugs las brtsams te smras pa/ chos dang 'gal med ya rabs srol bzang bo'i/ /chos spyod bslab pa'i gzhi ma 'jug pa yi/ /chos bzhin skyong ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de / /chos dkar dad pa'i ze'u 'brur rnam bkod de/ /blo gsal gzhon nu khyod kyi lag len tshul/ /blo la 'di ltar nges par gyis shig ces / /blo gros chung yang dam pa'i gsung rgyun 'ga'/ /blo ldan mkhas pa'i lad mos 'di ltar 'bul/ /kye lags sras bcas rgyal ba'i spyan sngar ni/ /dgyes bskyed tshul ldan mang thos 'di lags te/ /ma sbyangs mu cor smra ba'i blun khrod du'ang / /yon tan rgyan 'di bston med mdzes lags na/ /mdzes shing 'phyor la dgyes na mdzangs blun kun/ /dga' ba'i ston mo yon tan rin chen rgyan/ /bzhes nas mthong thos yid la mgu ba'i skyes/ /sbyin pa mi yi lugs ka zla med lags/ /bsod nams char gyi rlan zhig yod srid na/ /zang zing nor gyi rtsi thog skye nges pas/ /lus kyi zags pa khyi la'ang mi ster ba'i/ /'jung pa mi yi chos la shin tu smad/ /'dod pa'i lcags kyu ngo tsha khrel med par / /mdza' dang bar ma'i dngos dgur yang nas yang / /'debs pa'i brkam chags thams cad mthil 'dzin pa/ /grogs la zhe sun 211

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bskyed pa'i ngan gshis lags/ /yon tan nor la ci yang mi sems par / /rang don gtso bor byed pa'i bsam sbyor 'di/ /mi yi nang na khyi bzhin smad pa'i chos/ /de 'dra'i skyon la skyon du mthong ba'i sgos/ /ldog phyogs yon tan me tog legs bkur nas/ /bsam sbyor gang yang spyi snyoms gzhan phan gyis/ /skye bos bsngags pa'i dri bzang 'phro bar gyis/ /zhes pa'ang dharma sā ras grags pa rab rgyas la gsal 'debs byas pa'o/ /༄7/ /na mo gu ru/ /'di dang phyi ma'i phan bde'i lam bzang / /brtse bas 'doms mdzad drin chen bla ma/ /sku drin dran pa'i gus pas 'dud kyis/ /tshe rabs kun tu thugs rjes gzung mdzod/ /sngon smon las kyis lhan gcig bsdus pa'i/ /mchog sprul me tog gsar ba'i phon po/ /yon tan dri bsung 'thul ba lags na/ /dam pa'i mched gral mdzes rgyan yin no/ /sku yi me tog skyes pa legs kyang / /grogs ngan ba mo'i rkyen dang 'brel na/ /gshis bzang rang 'od bag la zha ste / /spyod ngan rang mdog ston pa lags so/ /kye kye rigs rgyud bzang bor 'khrungs pa'i/ /na tshod gzhon nu'i gnas skabs 'di 'dras/ /yon tan bdud rtsi bzhes pa min na/ /skye sprul yin kyang mdo shor 212

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/lags so/ /shes bzhin go bzhin mdo shor mdzad nas/ /sprul sku'i mtshan snyan chud zos ma mdzad/ /rang mtshang rang gis 'bru ba lags kyis / /sems shig yod na sos dal ma bzhugs/ /bskal mang thos dka' thos pa don che'i/ /thos pa'i yon tan nor bu'i phreng ba/ /snyan drung mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig lags te/ /bzhes snyam med na bdud kyis brlab bo/ /dam pa'i lha gral bzang bor bzhugs tshe/ /gzhung lugs gtam gyi dga' ston myong ba'i/ /dam pa'i drung na bzhin ras dma' ba'i/ /dam pa'i skye sprul ngo re tsha'o/ /gzhung brgya'i don bzang gser gyi thang ma/ /ya rabs grogs kyis yang yang brdal kyang / /len 'dod lan gcig tsam yang med na/ /mi lus g.yag sems ngo mar 'dug go /bla ma gong ma'i sku skyes zer bzhin/ /ma rabs tha ma'i bsam sbyor 'dzin pa'i/ /bstan pa'i bla btsong de 'dra mdzad la/ /sems shig yod na sun tshod lags so/ /thub bstan rin chen mar la 'grib pa'i/ /dus ngan 'di 'drar skye sprul yin na/ /bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshul khrims gos bzang / /gsol ran lags kyis gsol ba min nam/ /dge ba'i bshes dang grogs kyis bcings pa'i/ /bag yod ska rags gzhi nas lhod de/ /za 'du 'bar 'du'i nyin mtshan 'da' na/ /bdud kyi brlab pa dogs gnas lags so/ /nyes 213

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims rgyan gyis/ /legs par bsdam pa'i grogs bzang yod bzhin/ /de la kha mig yar lta med na/ /khyi bzhin skal ngan smad pa'i gnas so/ /ya rabs grogs la grogs su mi 'dzin/ /ma rabs gzugs mdzes dang du blangs nas/ /spyod ngan mi gtsang gcig gcig sdud pa'i/ /las ngan de 'dra da lta mang ngo / /tshul khrims rin chen na bza'i phung bo/ /legs par bzhes la khur bzhin dka' na/ /bar chad bdud kyi dbang du song kyis/ /lha dang bla mar gsol 'debs ran no/ /da lta rnyed pa'i lus rten 'di ku'i/ /don 'bras gang byung rang la rags shing / /de yang dang po kho na yin gyis//rang byar rtogs pa'i thugs sems med dam/ /nyin re zla re lo re bzhin nas/ /gang bsgrubs ci 'grub ci yang med par/ /had de lus nas mi tshe zad la/ /gting nas dogs zon mdzad tshod lags kyis/ /yon tan sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan snyogs pa'i/ /thugs kyi bung ba brel ba'i stabs kyis/ /'khor lo gnyis kyi 'phur lding rtsen te/ /'di phyi gnyis kyi don chen mdzod cig /dge'o/ /༄7/ /ka dag lhun grub zer ba'i rig 'dzin bu brgyud cig yin mdog kha dog dkar dmar rtsod pa'i zhwa ser gyi rang lugs la mi dgyes / /ga shal gos bzang gyon nas dar zab kyi rgyal mtshan ltar 214

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/'jol lo/ /nga tsho'i bla mas gzigs na khyod 'dra de khrel ba'i gnas yin no/ /ca cos gzhan tsho'i skad gdangs lad mo gyer dbyangs 'dra byed bzhin/ /cha lugs chos mthun gcig med byung rgyal du spyod pa la dga' bzhin/ /ja sha bsod po'i zas kyis grogs ngan dang 'bar 'du la bsdebs te/ /nya chung chu la rtse 'dra'i bag med la 'byams pa khyod sdug go /tā re'i gsung chog zlo ba'i skam rlon gyi 'tshogs sa na yod na/ /tha mal rang mtshang ston pa'i bsam sbyor gyi rig byed de ngom zhing / /dar dir thal phreng rtsod pa'i nga ro la grogs mched tsho chas tshe/ /na zug khong nas ldang ba'i ngo shor gyi mdo med khyod sdug go /pa tra'i ri mo 'bri sogs rnam g.yeng gis nyin mtshan kun 'da' bas//pha rol phyin sogs mdo rgyud gzhung bzang la blta rtog de bskyur bas//ba lang bzhin du za nyal kho na la mgo 'thom du song bas ma rig gdon gyis btab pa'i blun po khyod sdug tshabs rang che'o tsa ri la sogs rgya dbus gnas chen gyi lo rgyus re bshad cing / /tsha grang dka' ba khyad bsad mar mi yi rnam thar re klog nas/ /dza ya'i rjes 'jug yin rlom kha tsam gyi chos brdzu yi ngang nas/ /wa mo ri sul 'khyam bzhin ri gog 'dir mi tshe gzad sdug go /zhwa ltar spyi bor 'khur rgyu'i mkhan slob dang dge rgan la rtsis med/ /za ma mo rigs 215

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/mthong na rjes ded la khra chung mig rgyug pa'i/ /'a 'ur mang tshogs gar yod grogs mched kyi lha gral bzhin skor ba'i/ /ya ma gshin rje'i za rgyu'i dam nyams zhig red nyen rang che'o/ /ra sgog bzhin du chos mthun ya rabs la gdug rtsub rang che la/ /la la ngan spyod 'chang la snying grogs su 'bral blag rang med par/ /sha za mi srun 'dres khyer bar chad kyi gzhan dbang du song khyod/ /sa steng 'di na yod dgu'i ngan spyod kyi lam du ni song zin/ /ha bo ha bo blo gsal na chung gi rten bzang zhig yod de/ /a ma 'gro drug 'dren pa'i bla ma zhig yong re yang byas te/ /ha la ngan spyod sna dgus shul med du gtan brlag rang byed 'dug /a ho bla ma dkon mchog ra mda' la phebs pa zhig zhu'o / /yab rje bla ma'i zhabs la dad mdog kha sgrung du gyer bzhin/ /de yi bka' la mi brtsi khong gi chos lugs la mi mos/ /grub thob brgyud pa'i lugs srol snga 'gyur gsang chen la mos mdog /khong tsho'i phyag srol la yod 'bum lnga'i sgrib sbyong tsam mi byed/ /'dul 'dzin btsun pa min na gzhan la dag snang yang mi ster/ /rang gis phyi dro'i kha zas gcod tsam lag len la mi byed/ /lam ston bla ma yin kyang rab byung min na cang min mdog /slob ma rang gis rags pa bcu grangs 'dren tsam yang shes dka'/ /phar ngos su yang mkhas pa 216

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/med na ni smad cing / /tshur ngos rang gis tshigs bzhi legs po yang mi blta/ /chos skad kha la 'dogs lugs chos la don gnyer re yod 'dra / /chos gegs rnam g.yeng byed lugs snying nas chos spong la dgyes snyam/ /gang nas ji ltar brtags kyang 'gal 'du kho na la spyod khyod / /rang sdug steng du rogs sdug khur chen zhig yin pas/ /thos bsam slob gnyer mi mos skyid nyal rnam g.yeng la dga' zhing / /btsun tshugs spyod bzang mi mos bag med kho na la dga' na/ /blo thag gcig tu chod la 'phral dga' 'dod yon gyi dwangs ma/ /nag chang ji 'dod spyod la khrel med bag yangs shig mdzod cig /min na mi tshe stong bar gzad thabs kyi rnam g.yeng de bsgyur nas/ /bco brgyad na tshod rdzogs pa'i sha khrag dar bab kyi lus bzang / /thub bstan 'khor lo gnyis kyi bya spyod bzang bo yi snam du/ /'dug ran ma zad 'phyi nas thal ba de ngo rang e 'phrod ltos dang / /bu mo yin na gnas la 'gro ran du 'dug la/ /stag shar yin na rang khyim phib tshod cig lags pas/ /sprul sku yin tshe rang bya skyong rgyu zhig srid na/ /mgo 'phang smad de bsam mno zhib btang zhig ran no/ /nga 'dras bltas na kha la chos brdzu zhig btags nas/ /lo shas gnas pa'i tshe nas rnam g.yeng zhig byas te/ /tha ma rang khyim so tshis 'bad 'bad 217

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/du byed pa'i/ /skya min ser min zhig las 'ong rgyu zhig med snyam/ /sdug sems gting nas skyo yang byed rgyu ni mi 'dug /nga 'dra kha tsam ma yin glo ba yi dkyil na/ /phan 'dogs grogs shig yin pa'i 'du shes ni dka' bas/ /lan 'ga' cung zad lab kyang las rgyu zhig ma byung ske/ /bla ma dam pa rnams kyis zhal ras la dpag nas/ /rang tshod phan pa'i bslab ston snga phyi ru byas te/ /rang gi ngos nas bka' drin 'tshob byed du byas kyis/ /khengs dregs khyod 'dra'i ngos la ltos pa zhig mi 'dug /bsam bzang gtam zhig phan pas smras lo zhig byas kyang / /thugs la 'phrod pa med na rdog pa yis dril dang / /dman bu nga rang mi khro ci dgyes shig mdzod ces / /dum chod tshig 'ga' rlung la bskur nas ni btang ngo / /dge leṭa la gdams pa'o/ /dge'o/ /༄7/ /ka ye snying gi bu gces khyod nyon dang / kha ta bslab ston cung zad byed 'dod kyis/ /ga ler sems la skor dang ma brjed dang —/ /nga 'dra ngan yang khyod la lhag bsam drang / /ca co'i bzang mdog kha po'i g.yo sgyu'i 'phrul/ /cha lugs chos ltar bcos pa'i rdzun zob kyis/ /ja sha dkor rdzas bag med spyod chog kyang / /nya sogs dud 'gro'i rigs las lhag ci 'ong / /ta thā ga ta zhes bya'i sangs rgyas la/ cho/tha na tshig tsam skyabs 'gro ma byed par/ /da lta phyugs 218

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/bzhin za nyal dus 'da' na/ /na 'chi glo bur byung tshe ci zhig byed/ /pa ra mi ta la sogs gzhung lugs nas/ /pha rol skyes chen 'degs pa'i lo rgyus la/ /ba lang bzhin du mgo 'thom mi dge'i las/ /ma byed nyin bzhin rang sems dpang bor tshugs/ /tsa ri la sogs gnas rten skad grags can/ /tsha grang khyad du bsad nas 'tshol ba ni / /dza yas bsngags pa'i chos spyod yin snyam nas/ /wa ltar 'khyam mkhan mang mod cir 'gyur dka'/ /zhwa mdog dmar sar rtsod pa'i yul dus 'dir/ /za chog gto chog tsam las chos dkon mod/ /'a 'ur g.yam rgyug min par dam pa'i chos/ /ya mtshan che ba deng sang mang rnyed skabs/ /rwa ltar mkhregs pa'i sems 'di 'dul thabs la /la lung mang bo'i gtam don mi 'grub pas/ /sha khrag zad zad thos bsam bsgom brgyab ste/ /sa lam yon tan e rnyed sems la zungs/ /ha ha ho ho'i rtsod pa'i brdar sha yang / /a don skye med gcig la chod dgos pas/ /ha la 'di snang 'ja' tshon ma ded par/ /a ma stong chen rtogs pa'i lag len mdzod/ /slar yang phan pa'i bslab ston nyung shas shig /snying 'dra'i gces par snying gtam tshul du byed/ /snying la chongs la snying bo med pa'i las/ /tshe 'di'i bya bar sun thabs ci yod mdzod/ /dam chos dam par 'jog pa'i sgo gcig pu/ /219

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'di snang lag len 'di la ma 'dres pas/ /yin la yin pa'i nges shes gang rnyed dgos/ /chags snang chos la ma 'khrul snying gi bu/ /thos bsam gser gyi prog zhu 'od po che/ /spyi bor bskon la phyi 'then byed mkhan gyi/ /bdud kyis bsgyur ba deng sang mang bas na/ /mang thos rin chen rgyan 'dis chog ma shes/ /tshul khrims yon tan dri bzang 'phur ma'i skyes/ /gang la yod des legs spyad chos kyi rjes/ /dkar bo'i phyogs kun lcags kyus glang bo bzhin/ /dbang med 'gugs na de la su mi dgyes/ /yul dus pha ma gna' bo'i chags zhen gyis/ /bdud rtsi dug bzhin ma sems chos gtso bas/ /yab rje 'jam mgon bla ma'i rang lugs kyis/ /mdo sngags lam la nges shes gang rnyed mdzod/ /bsam pas dpyad tshe nam mkha' gang ba'i chos/ /'gal 'brel shes bya'i 'khor lo grangs mang yang / /sgom pa'i rgyud la sbyar tshe lam rim du/ /gcig tu 'grel ba'i lag len mkhas par gyis / /bshad chos sgrub chos so sor ma 'dzin par/ /'dre sgrung ra khyu bsdu dang bkram pa ltar/ /shes rab 'chang bar gzhung brgya 'du ba'i sgo / /rnon po'i so kha sems la dbye bar mdzod/ /chags sdang sprin phung g.yo bral sems kyi mkhar/ /bden gnyis rtogs pa'i nyi zla 'od po che 'ur yang 'char ba'i theg mchog dga' ston de/ /myong la 220

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/rang ma ngan na gegs gzhan ci/ /yul 'di gtan yul ma yin bskyur rgyu dang / /grogs rnams gtan grogs ma lags lo 'ga'i zla/ /nor rdzas gtan nor ci zhig 'bral nges na/ /khyod thugs dam chos las gzhan gang la g.yeng / /da lta pha ma nye du la sogs pa/ /re zhig 'chang ba lhod pa'i gnas skabs 'dir/ /sna thag rang mgor legs par dkri shes na/ /'di snang 'khri ba chod la dka' ba med/ /rang gis rang nyid 'dam du btsud gyur na/ /'brel med mi dang tha na sa rdos kyang / /mthar bgrod dka' ba'i sgrog tu 'dzud lags pas/ /zhib tu dpyod la thabs mkhas gang drag mdzod/ /de ltar bya spyod gang yang chos gegs su/ /mi 'gro chags med nam mkha'i bya bzhin du/ /lung rtogs chos kyi brag dkar spo mtho'i rtser/ /'gro ba'i bu de 'di bde phyi skyid yin/ /des na snying 'dris gces pa khyod la yang /chags med chos pa bya rgyal rgod po'i zlar/ /'ong ba'i re 'dun snying la brnags pas na/ /re ba'i don de cis kyang 'grub par mdzod/ /༄7/ /na mo gu ru/ ka ye sngon smon las kyis bsdus pa'i chos grwa ba tsho/ kha yengs mig yengs ma byed blo kha nang du skor dang / /ga ler sdom gsum e dag rang rgyud cir song ltos dang / /nga rgyal byas pas mi 'ong rang zhe 'gyod med dgos so/ /ca ga yo byad gang bzang 221

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gcig la gcig 'gran byed bzhin/ /cha tsam chos la mi sems cha lugs ci mdzes byed pa/ /ja sha dkor gyis brgyags kyang rgyal bstan rmang nas 'jig pa'i/ /nya mo chu la 'phyo 'dra'i bag med de 'dra mi rung —/ /ta la'i ya thog rkam 'dra'i sdom pa rtsad nas gtong ba'i/ /tha mal spyod pa mi srun mi tshangs spyod sogs bzhi bo/ /da tsam byas pa med kyang yang yang sdom sems med na/ /na ning bdud rtsi'i lo mas yun ring pher ba dka'o/ /pa ri pi ri 'don pa'i btsun chung phreng ser 'dren rnams/ /pha rol shi ba'i 'og na bde sdug ci 'dug bsams tshe/ /ba spu 'gul tsam med na ya rabs byed mdog byas kyang ske/ /ma rabs spyod ngan gshis la gcig rjes gnyis sleb yin no/ /tsa sogs tsher ma'i reg byas lus la reg pa bzhin dang / /tsha ba'i sman gyi ro bzhin rang rgyud rtsub mo ma byed/ /dza ti'i dri bsung ldang bzhin 'jam zhing dul ba'i spyod pa/ /wa ler dran pas zungs la sems rgyud 'chos par mdzod dang / /zhwa bzhin thod du bkur 'os bla ma slob dpon bsten nas/ /za ma mo rigs ma bsams rang gis rang la brtags nas/ /'a 'ur gzhan tsho'i lad mo snang ba gang dran min par / /ya mtshan che ba'i chos la rang blo ci 'gro mdzod cig /rwa ltar gyong ba'i sems 'di 'dul thabs ci drag las gzhan/ /la lung skye 222

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/bo'i lad mo mthong tshad lag tu ma len/ /sha khrag lus kyi sgyu ma gces dgus gsos pa'i don po/ /sa lam yon tan e rnyed sems kyi mthil du zungs dang / /ha pa brgyags pa lta bur mal na 'gre ldog byed bzhin / /a li o le'i ngang la mi tshe stong bar zad nas/ /ha la bdud rtsir rlom pa'i 'di snang lag len kho nas/ /a don thos bsam sgom gsum chud zos ma byed sku mkhyen/ /dge'o/ /ka pa li la gzigs na gting nas skyug log 'ong 'ong / kha dog dkar dmar brtsad na don med kha shags yin mdog /ga nas thugs bsam btang yang thos bsam thugs la mi 'dogs/ /nga che nga bzang zer ba'i ma rabs ma byed sku mkhyen/ /ca ga yo byad don la tshong dang g.yo sgyu'i skor mgo /cha lang rdeb bzhin 'gyu nas chos grwa 'grim mdog byas kyang / /ja thig dkor gyi sdig pas sang gnang shi ma thag tu/ /nya mo spang la phyung 'dra'i rnam smin ma gsog sku mkhyen/ /tā re'i gsung chog la sogs chos thog re re'i dge sbyor/ /tha mal skye bo'i dam chos tshe gang 'grub rgyu dka' na/ /da lta le lo ma byed nan tan lag len mdzod la/ /na 'chi glo bur byung yang 'gyod med mdzad rgyu sku mkhyen/ /pa ra arba zhes bya gang snang stong ba'i ngo bo sa ma 'gro drug 'dren pa'i byams dang snying rje'i sems mchog /ba spu g.yo 223

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ba'i bar du yang yang gsol 'debs mdzad nas/ /ma dag tha mal sems rgyud chos lob mdzod dang sku mkhyen/ /tsa ri tsa gong bskor ba'i rkang ba'i 'phrul 'degs med kyang / /tsha ba'i sman gyi nus pas grang nad rtsad nas 'don bzhin/ /dza bh+yo phaṭa kyis byed pa las nyon gdon la btab nas/ /wa ler bla med byang chub yid la zungs dang sku mkhyen—/ /zhwa ser lugs bzang 'di 'dra yang yang mjal ba dka' bas / /za 'du 'bar 'du'i ngang la mi tshe stong bar ma bzad/ /'a 'ur thal phrang rtsod pa'i rigs pas brdar sha chod dang / /ya mtshan che bar 'dug go thugs la zungs dang sku mkhyen/ /rwa ba gangs ris bskor ba'i sman ljongs 'di na skyes te/ /la lung brgal dgos ma byung dam chos sgo rtsar slebs pas/ /sha khrag zad zad bar du thos bsam sgom gsum byas nas/ /sa thob sems dpa' e 'ong snying nas ltos dang sku mkhyen/ /ha cang snyan grags g.yo ba'i slob dpon bdag nyid chen po/ /a ti sha dang 'brom rje 'jam mgon bla ma'i rnam thar/ /ha bgad rtsed mo'i gtam min gang nas ji ltar bsams kyang / /a ho ngo mtshar che 'dug spyan mig gyen ltos sku mkhyen/ /zhes pa 'di yang mtshan nyid pa rnams la thams cad dge bskul gyi gsal 'debs su/ dharma sā ras thun gseng du gang dran bris te 224

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/phul ba dge/༄7/ /ka pa li la gzigs shing sun/ kha nas gang byung btsog gtam smra/ /ga shal gos bzang gyon la dgyes/ /nga ni de 'drar yongs ma dga'/ /ca co'i shags kyis nam zla gcod/ /cha byad bud med gzhon nu bzhin/ /ja phor yan chad dngul gyis dkris/ /nya mo chu la 'phar bzhin rtse/ /tā re tsam yang 'don rgyu med/ /tha mal tshong dang bud med sgom/ /da lta ban de yin mdog kha/ /na ning zer dus skya bo'i gral/ /pa na gcig gtong gnyis len gyis/ /pha rol shag po'i mgo brdung mkhan/ /ba 'dra za nyal la dga' ba'i/ /ma rung de 'dra deng sang mang / /tsa ri la sogs gnas bskor mkhan/ /tsha grang theg pa'i sdug rus can/ /dza ya ji 'dra mi shes pa'i/ /wa mos ri gseb nyul 'dra'ang yod/ /zhwa mdog dmar ser zhen kha yis/ /za chog tsam re'i phyag len gyis/ /'a 'ur mi tshe stong bzad mkhan/ /ya ma yengs de shin tu mang / /rwa ltar mkhregs pa'i sems rgyud la/ /la las sems ngo skyong zer nas/ /sha tsha snying rje med pa yi/ /sa thob de 'dra yod mdog byed/ /ha ha su dang gang snang yang / /a ho ngo mtshar cang mi 'dug /khyed kyang de 'dra'i lugs srol gyis/ /mdo shor byed rgyu los yin red/ /yon tan thos bsam yin kyang byed mi mos/ /thar 225

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/lam tshul khrims yin te srung mkhan dkon/ /yar 'dren bshes gnyen lags kyang 'khur mi btub/ /rang dgar bsdad de rang don 'grub pa dka'/ /gling pad+ma la smras pa dge/spro/ /na mo gu ru dhīḥ a/ dam pa'i rang mdangs ji ltar rigs pa yis/ /mdzes pa'i 'od 'bar 'dam gyi pad ma de/ /ma grang rgod pas rdog pas ma dril bar/ /thabs kyis bsten na yon tan sbrang rtsi yod/ /bkur 'os 'khur ba dam pa'i rang gshis de/ /dam pa min la de 'dra'i rang lugs med/ /ya rabs spyod la dga' ba'i sems yod na/ /pad+ma de 'dra thod du bcings na mdzes/ /a dang po'i nyams len no/ / a/ las smon bsod nams mthun pa'i nags tshal na/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ljon pa gzhon nu dang / /ma reg ma brdar drang bo'i rang tshugs kyis/ /lo ma 'phel ba ya rabs shing gi gshis / /skal mnyam grogs la nye ring snyoms pa yis/ /'grogs tshul mkhas pa mkhas pa'i phyag bzhes te/ /ya rabs spyod la dga' ba'i sems yod na/ /ljon pa de 'drar mnyam bskyed bsrings na mdzes/ /a gnyis pa'i nyams len no/ / a/ snying rje'i chu rgyun nyam thag gshong bu ru/ /'bab pa 'jig rten 'di na chos nyid de/ /dman pa'i khyi la'ang dbyug pas nan brnyas tshe/ /mche ba'i mtshan ni ral 226

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/gri'i so bzhin rno/ /dman rnams nam yang khyad du ma gsod par/ /byams pa'i grib mar mgron du 'bod pa yi/ /ya rabs spyod la dga' ba'i sems yod na/ /bskyang 'os dman la skyong ba'i brtse sems bskyed / /a gsum pa'i nyams len no/ / a/ sman dang dug tu ngos 'dzin dka' ba yi/ /rdzas la blun po min pas mi bza' zhing / /me dong thal bas g.yogs pa de yi nang / /shes rab can rnams lag pas nom pa min/ /bstod na bstan dang 'grogs la gnod dogs shing —/ /smad na rang dang gzhan yang nyams dogs pas/ /dogs pa'i chu bo brgal bar dka' bas na/ /sems kyi ri dwags btang snyoms ri la sdod/ /a bzhi ba'i nyams len no/ /dge'o/ /༄gi /na mo gu ru/ 'khor bar 'khor ba'i tshe rabs kun tu/ /skyid sdug cir yang blo yi gtad so/ /bla ma rje btsun de la 'dud kyis//byams brtse'i thugs rjes lhan ner skyongs shig /kye kye btsun chung kye kye blo gsal/ /nga 'dra rkang ba gnyis kyis 'gro yang / /bsam spyod rkang bzhi phyugs bzhin yod pas/ /khyed la gdams pa smyon pa'i las ka /thos bsam rin chen lo ma mi za/ /yon tan bdud rtsi 'thung du mi 'dod/ /rnam g.yeng bya ba'i ngan skyug bsten pa/ /nga 'dra khyi yin shes sam snying grogs/ /lha chos lugs byas sdom dang dam tshig /gar 227

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/song med pa'i mdo shor ngang na/ /gsung rab blta ba'i mig gnyis long ba'i/ /yon tan nor med sprang po'i yang rtse/ /mi chos lugs byas rnam g.yeng ngang na/ /yar skyes mi yis mthong tshor med la/ /mar rgas rang gis go rtogs med par/ /na tshod yol ba'i mi ngan mdo med/ /lha chos phyi ma'i lam rgyags mi bsam/ /mi chos tshe 'di'i 'dun ma mi bsgrig /rang zhe rang la sbom pa'i ngang nas/ /lo zla 'phul ba'i smyon pa klad med/ /zog red byas na rkang ba gnyis can/ /mi red byas na khyi bzhin mdo med/ /kye ma kye hud skyabs gcig rje btsun / /las ngan nged tsho'i gnas tshul e dgongs/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyu ji ltar rno yang / /dad pa'i a long shin tu phra bas/ /'dren pa'i nus mthu de tsam zhan 'dug /dkon mchog khyed la yi chad ci yod / /lang tsho dar skabs snang ba skyid skyid/ /mdo med ngang la mi tshe bzad cing / /na so rgas dus lus sems rgyad de/ /gang byung ngang la sdug gis 'da' na/ /gzhon te ma byung snang ba skyid 'byams/ /rgan te ma byung lo zla sdug 'phul/ /lha chos mi chos dam pa'i phyag len/ /da ni 'ong ba'i dus zhig nam yod/ /kye kye skal bzang snying gi grogs po/ /nga tsho'i lad mo de 'dra ma mdzad/ /ya rabs dam pa'i rnam thar skyongs la/ /yon tan bdud rtsi da lta bzhes shig /'gal rkyen nad 228

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/dang rgas kyis ma mnar/ /mthun rkyen chos dang bshes gnyen 'dzoms na/ /sems shig yod tshe lag pa stong bar/ /phyi ma'i lam ring bgrod mkhan su yod/ /skal mnyam grogs mched khrom gyi dbus na / /tshul khrims gos bzang g.yang lugs gsol te/ /mang thos gser gyi rgyan chas mdzes pa'i/ /yon tan gzi 'bar khyed tshos mdzad na/ /ngo tsha'i gos med gcer bur song bas/ /spyod ngan 'doms la sba gsang med par/ /dam pas khrel zhing skyug bro'i gnas ngan / /smyon pa nga 'dra tha chad lags so/ /lha chos shes na tshe 'di'i 'dun ma/ /ma bsgrubs bzhin du 'grub pa chos nyid/ /mi chos mkhas na 'di dang phyi ma/ /skyid dgu'i lag rtser yod lugs yod kyis/ /'di snang 'di la su yang 'tham mod/ /phyi ma bor de 'di ngogs kho na/ /ci tsam bsgrubs kyang grub dus med pa/ /dam pa 'i gsung bzhin mngon sum lags so/ /ched du skyong ba'i 'bad rtsol bskyur yang / /rgyal khams kun yang byams pas gnyen du/ /dka' tshegs 'gyur ldog med par 'khol ba'i/ /gnyen gyi skyong lugs de 'dra yod do/ /gang zag re gnyis ris su bcad de/ /dkar nag ngo la 'tsho skyong byas byas/ /tshe 'dir mi phan phyi mar gnod pa'i/ /gnyen gyi skyong lugs de 'dra yod do/ /dgra gnyen re dogs rtsis gdab lhod pa'i/ /3 29

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gu yangs ngang na gnod byed zad bzhin/ /mtho dman sus kyang thal mos bkur bas/ /dgra yi 'dul skyong 'khor ba'i chos lugs/ /ched du bsgrubs na 'grub rgyu med par/ /ma bsgrubs bskyur na lhun gyis grub grub/ /'di 'dra'i chos nyid mkhas pa'i spyod yul/ /gzhon pa khyed tshos shes shes 'dra na/ /bsgrubs kyang mi 'grub rnam g.yeng bya ba / /rbad kyis bcad de gcig bsgrubs kun grub/ /dam pa'i chos la thugs thag chod dang / /gzhung lugs ma ṇi dbyangs su 'then bzhin//don med sdig pa'i las la brel ba'i/ /gzhon chung ne tso'i spun zla mdzad na/ kha chos kho nas rang nyid bslus 'gro/ /gdams ngag rin chen sde snod rnam gsum/ /thos pa tsam yang bsod nams che na/ /deng sang de la 'phrad nas yod pas/ /thos pa'i mtha' rgya legs par chod dang / /gdams ngag thos pa'i dgos pa nyid ni/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs phyir yin na/ /thos pa rna rgyab rlung 'ur min par/ /thos don sems la gnad du snun dang / /thos pa byed tshe don chung las la/ /gal bo che mdog rang mgo bskor bskor/ /thos don sgrub tshe tshig skam go lo/ /shags gyi mtshon chas gzhan sems dkrug dkrug /bya ba byas tshad gnad du ma phog /mi tshe stong zad mdo shor chos lugasam/ /de 'dra 'byung nyen shin tu che bas/ /thugs brtse ma yengs 230

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/rang gshis rtogs dang / kha phyir 'khor ba'i blo ngan dred pos/ /zhus dag mi la gtong gin 'dug ste/ /rnal 'byor rang bca'i thugs bsam yod na/ /zhus dag rang gis rang la mdzod dang / /'dul mngon mdo sde'i shel dkar me long / /rang rgyud bzhin ras rtog byed yin pas/ /ston pa mchog des phyi rabs gdul byar/ /blta ba'i btsas su bzhag bzhin ltos dang / /sde snod me long mi la ston bzhin/ /rang rgyud skyon gyi dri ma mthug po/ /ma mthong mun pa 'dom 'jal byed mkhan/ /nga 'dra mang mod dgos don chung ngo / /de skad smra ba chos kyi rgya mtsho/ /rang gshis sbrul gdug 'khyog por 'gro bzhin/ /gzhan mtshang 'don pa'i dug gi kha rlangs/ /khyed la btang la dgos pa ci yod/ /de skad skul mkhan ye shes rgya mtsho/ blo gsal rig pa'i 'char sgo yangs kyang / /deng sang nga tsho'i lugs gnyis bya gzhag /zhag gsum yin pas de bar gzigs dang / /zhes pa 'di yang /dharma sā ras bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄sto /mkhyen gnyis ro gcig ye shes sku/ /gur kum gsar ba'i skyed tshal ltar/ /yongs mdzes mtshan dpe'i lang tsho can/ /bla ma 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'dud/ /legs byas rdzing bur 'khrungs pa'i lus / /dal ba'i 'dab ma brgyad ldan pa'i/ /pad ma gzhon nu mi 231

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/nyams slad/ /ya rabs gtam gyi chab 'di gsol/ /mi gtsang sa lud za ba yi/ /khyi phag srin bu la sogs par/ /ma gyur mi yi lus rnyed skabs / /tshe rabs gtan don bsgrub dgos te/ /lha yi chos la tshul khrims gtso/ /mi yi chos la bden pa gtso/ /gnyis ka la ni mi gzhi gtso / /gtso bo gsum po 'di la dgos/ /lha chos gzhi ma tshul khrims kyi / /me tog sad kyi 'gal rkyen gtso/ /mi tshangs spyod sogs bzhi bo 'di / /srog la thug kyang spangs na legs/ /mi chos rtsa ba dus nam yang / kha bden khog drang su la yang / /bsam pa bzang bo 'chang ba zhig /mi yi rgyan yin med thabs med/ /mi gzhi ji ltar legs pa'i tshul / /mi rnams kyi ni ngag sgros la/ /mi de gser dang 'dra'o zhes/ /mi dpyod ya rabs tshad du brtsi/ /de phyir mi la gser lta bu/ /dgos 'dug mi dang gser gyi tshul/ /cung zad sbyor ba'i bslab bya 'di/ /brtse ba'i sems kyis khyod la bya/ /gser ni kha dog bzang bas na/ /su war+ṇa ste mdog bzang zer/ /de bzhin mi yi gshis de yang / /mi mkhregs bzang bo'i ngang tshul dgos/ /gser ni reg bya lci bas na/ /rang gi go sa gnon la bsngags/ /mi yang 'gyur ldog ma skyen par/ /rang gis rang tshugs thub pa dgos/ /gser ni rlan gyi rkyen sogs las / /g.ya' yi dreg pas chud mi za/ /de bzhin nam yang grogs d+ngha/3 2

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/rkyen las/ /spyod pa ngan pas chud zos spongs/ /gser ni ci tsam bzhu btul yang / /rang bzhin mnyen la je bzang zer mi yang rang dang gzhan gyis ni/ /bcos kyin yon tan je che dgos/ /gser ni nor gyi gtso bo ste/ /'jig rten 'di na dkon pa'i tshad/ /de bzhin yon tan ldan pa'i mi/ /dkon pas mi yi chos la 'bod/ /gser ni rin thang che bas na/ /su la yod des dbul ba sel/ /de ltar mi lus sus shes na/ /rang nyid phongs pa cis kyang sel/ /gser ni dngos po bzang bas na/ /nam yang mi la mi 'grim med/ /mi bzang bsam spyod legs pa yang / /kun la gtsigs che tshad mar 'dzin / /gser ni rgyal blon khyim bdag sogs/ /'byor ldan la yod gzhan la med/ /mi chos bzang bo'i ngang tshul can/ /rigs bzang la yod gzhan la med/ /de ltar yon tan brgyad kyis ni/ /gser dang 'dra ba'i mi gzhi de/ /lugs gnyis kun gyi srog yin pas/ /rang gi rang bzhin 'chos par mdzod/ /mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ /lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring / /lha dang mi yi them skas la/ /'dzegs na thar ba gam na 'dug /de skad smra ba yab gcig 'jam pa'i dpal/ /snying la rol ba'i blo gros 'bum 'dzin pa/ /gang gis dgyes bzhin bskyangs pa'i btsun pa'i gzugs/ /dharma sa raḥde yis bris pa dge /233

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/mi gzhe gser lta bu'i gser chos gtso bo rang bzhin bzang ba dang gcig rang tshugs thub pa dang gnyis/ grogs ngan gyi rkyen gyis spyod ngan gyi g.ya' langs te chud mi za dang gsum/ mkhan slob dge ba'i bshes sogs ya rabs kyis bcos kyin yon tan 'go zhing bkol btub pas dul ba ste bzhi yin no//ldog pa ra gan no/ /tshog /'jam dbyangs thugs rjes sprul ba'i 'od zer cha/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i dpal du rol ba'i mgon/ /blo gros mtshungs med shes bya kun gzigs pa'i/ /drin chen bla mas bdag dang ltos bcas skyongs / /lnga rig gzhung la blo gros mi rgyas kyang / /dam sdom me tog sad du mi ster bar/ /ya rabs skye bo'i lha grwal 'dzin snyam pa'i/ /rnam rtog rdo yi ri mo yin srid na/ /lha chos dam pa'i lugs srol mkhas pa'i gzhung / /thos bsam sgom par byed na shes 'gyur la/ /re zhig mi chos gtsang ma ya rabs brgya'i/ /phyag len de la shi 'jus re 'tham 'tshal/ /mi chos de yang g.yo sgyu'i bslu brid kyis/ /gzhan mgo bskor bar mkhas pa zer ba min/ /gzhung bzang phyi thag ring ba 'di gnyis po/ /lugs brgya'i rnam dbye sdud pa'i mdo rtsa yin/ /gang zhig bzang ba'i gzhung ni sems kyi rgyud/ /ji ltar bzang ba drang po'i lam srong ba/ /drang po gang yin g.yo sgyu med pa ste/ /'di ni mi lugs 234

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/dngos te chos kyang yin/ /dran tshad kha ru 'don de drang po min/ /don med gzhan mtshang 'dru de drang po min/ /nang rtsub phyi 'jam byed de drang po min/ /de slad drang po 'khyog por ma gol gces/ /drang po'i gzhi ni bsam pa bzang bo ste/ /gnod sems log pa'i yid kyi dge ba yin/ /de yi 'khor ni brkam chags chung ba ste/ /brnab sems med pa kun dang mthun pa'i rgyu/ /drang po'i rgyan ni rang bzhin mdzangs pa ste/ /skyon yon blang dor 'byed mkhas shes rab yin/ /shes rab snang ba brdal ba de yi mod/ /nang gi log lta'i mun pa sangs par 'gyur/ /yid kyi nyes pa mi srun sbrul gdug dag /rgyu ba'i spyod pas skyed tshal mi mdzes te/ /de dag bral ba'i sems rgyud gzhung bzang po/ /'di phyir dge ba'i ya rabs kun gyi gzhi/ /rtsa ba sems rgyud drang la yal ga 'dra'i/ /lus ngag drang ba dngos po'i chos nyid de / /sgo gsum g.yo zol med pa'i shes rab can/ /de 'dra pho rabs brgya yi yang rtse lags/ /dgos med gtam sna mi mang ran par smra/ /smra tshad phog thug med pa'i 'jam po dang / /mthun gnyis dbye ba'i phra ma mi byed pa'i/ /ngag de rang bzhin nyid kyis mdzes pa yin/ /khyad par gtam la bden pa gal che mod/ /deng sang dus na na gzhon 'di dag gi sa la bden pa'i tshems dkar mi 'dug pas/ /235

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ya rabs dga' ba'i 'dzum zer yod ma yin/ /ngag gi pad+mo bden pa'i sbrang rtsi can/ /de la skye bo'i yid kyi bung ba 'du/ /de phyir bong ba'i nu bcud ltar min par/ /tshig gi 'o mar bden pa'i mar yod mdzod / /rang lag brdar te gzhan srog gcod pa'i las/ /rab byung gzugs brnyan 'di yis khegs mod de/ /tshe 'dir kha na ma tho'i gzhi chen dang / /phyi mar rnam smin mi bzod myong ba yi/ /gzhan la bcol ba'i srog gcod bshas tshong sogs/ /ma rabs ngan dgu'i las la thabs mkhas por/ /rlom nas glang gis sa phyag mi byed par/ /ngo lkog 'pher ba'i rang zhe gtsang seng mdzod/ /gzhan nor rku ba khyi rkun spyod pa ste/ /de la mi khrel ma rabs 'ga' las med/ /rkun ma gang yin mi gtsang ba 'dra ste/ /de la mchog dman su zhig btud par nus / /ji ltar ltog kyang mi gtsang gcin skyag la/ /bza' dang btung ba'i re ba su yis byed/ /de ni mi yi tha chad rkun po la/ lugs gnyis shes 'ong nam mkha'i pad+mo'i zla/ /lkog tu brkus pa min kyang gzhan gyi nor / /g.yo sgyu'i thabs kyis ma byin bzhin du len/ /de la phyi ma'i nyes dmigs che tsam du/ /ma zad shes ldan skye bo brgya yis khrel/ /de bas pho rabs 'dun ma lugs gnyis lam/ /ya rabs skye bo'i spyod pa gser lta bu/ /don chung nor sna 'ga' la brje ba yi/ /mig med chu 236

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/mchong cis kyang ma byed cig /ngur smrig chos gos gyon pa'i btsun gral du/ /dbang ba'i dkar bo gcig thub gal brgya'i 'gag /tshangs spyod gser gyi snye ma 'od po che/ /ma nyams gang gi phyag na thogs pa der / /phyi mar 'tshang ba'i lha yi chos yod de/ /tshe 'dir skyid pa'i mi yi chos kyang yod/ /'di bde phyi skyid grags dang bsod nams gzhi/ /sems shig yod na de la dgyes par mdzod/ /dpal de nyams pa'i grags pa min pa'i rkyen/ /bud med la ni 'grogs 'dris che ba ste/ /de slad nye dang mdza' ba'i khul gyis ni/ /rang gis rang nyid brlag par ma byed cig /de ltar dge bcu'i dpal yon mu tig phreng / /brgyus pa'i gzhung bzang rin chen do shal de/ /khyod kyi snying gar legs par 'chang gyur na/ /tshe 'dir mi yi khrod du khyod mdzes la/ /phyi ma nyam nga rgyus med gshin rje'i 'phrang / /bgrod tshe 'tshang ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi zong / /de yang khyod la nyung ba ma yin pas/ /'di phyi'i don chen ma shor 'di la 'bod/ /'jig rten chos la phyi thag ring ba 'di/ /legs pa'i yon tan brgya yi mthu chen de/ /dkar po'i chos kyi bang mdzod mi nyams par/ /srung ma'i sgo ba mchog kyang 'di nyid yin/ /bla ma bsten na phyi thag bsring dgos te/ /ngo mi rtag pas dge ba'i bshes spong zhing / /mched la 'grogs kyang phyi thag 237

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bsring dgos te/ /gsar 'grogs che bas ya rabs grogs rnams sun / /sdom pa blang na phyi thag ring dgos te/ /blo mang bya bas dam sdom mthar 'khyongs dka'/ /mdor na don chen gang yin 'grub pa la / /phyi thag bsring ba shin tu gces 'dir ltos/ /de ltar lhag bsam ston zlas byin pa yi/ /tshig phreng 'od zer dkar po'i gzegs ma 'dis/ /khyod blo ku mu da kha phye ba las/ /ya rabs spyod pa'i dri bzang spro bar smon/ /zhes pa 'di yang sras mchog la/ dharma sā ras bsgrigs te phul ba lags la smyo kha gtses pa ltar ma byed par rang nyid spyod pa zhu dag byed pa'i me long du gces par bcings nas rnam pa kun tu nyar tshags byed par 'tshal/༄ga /na mo gu ru/ 'jam dpal spyan ras gzigs dang gsang 'dzin bdag po'i/ /rnam rol grub pa'i dbang phyug bka' drin mtshungs med/ /yab rje blo gros mtshan can byang chub bar yang mi 'bral spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs par smon te/ /blo gsal skal ba bzang po'i btsun chung khyod la/ /lhag bsam drang bos bslab ston tshig gsum gsol gyis/ /snyan rgyab bser bu ma mdzad thugs la zungs dang / /gzhon pas rgan la nyan pa ya rabs srol lags/ /dal 'byor mi lus thob pa da res tsam zhes/ /gsar rnying mkhas grub stong gis yang kyang gsungs te/ /dbyar dus srin bu kho na'i grangs la dpag na / /mi lus mang po ma red thugs la chongs dang / /'dus byas skad 238

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/cig 'gyu ba'i glog dang 'dra zhes/ /rgyal ba bden par gsungs pas yang yang bsgrags te/ /lo re bzhin yang 'gro ba'i skye 'chir bltas na / /rang re yun ring mi sdod nges can red 'dug /shi nas med du mi 'gro skye ba len dgos/ /skye sa bde 'gro ngan 'gro gnyis las med de / /bde 'gror dkar po'i las kyis 'phen rgyu yin na/ /rnam dkar las kyi tshong zong ci yod gzigs dang / /dge sems glog gi snang ba lan re tsam las/ /sdig sems mun pas khebs pa'i rang rgyud mtshan mor / /mi dge'i byed pa shin tu stobs chen yin zhes/ /rgyal sras chen pos gsungs pas de lta lags na/ /shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song gsum po las gzhan/ /bde skyid gnas su mi 'gro nges can lags na / /dkon mchog skyabs kyi nor bu'i cod pan thogs te/ /bslu med las 'bras lam la zhugs par mdzod dang / /blo ldog rnam bzhi'i chos kyi them skas 'di go /mkhas pa brgya yis bshad kyang bshad pa'i nying khul/ /grub thob stong gis bsgoms kyang bsgom pa'i bogs 'byin/ /sngon 'gro'i chos 'di gal chung byed rgyu min 'dug /mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad bsten te/ /mdo sngags chos la nyan bshad sgom sgrub byed pa/ /gsar rnying mkhas grub yongs kyis phyag bzhes lags na / /btsun chung khyed kyang de bzhin mdzad na lags so/ /dang po bla 239

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ma bsten pa lo shas mnyam 'grogs/ /bar du gdams ngag zhus pa rig gnas slob lugs/ /tha mar nyams len 'jig rten kha thabs skyong rgyu/ /de 'dra'i chos kyis phyi ma'i lam rgyags mi pher/ /bla ma bsten na snying khong rus pa'i gting nas/ /mos gus chu bo'i rgyun bzhin thang lhod med pas/ /gang byed rang dbang dor nas pha mdzangs bu bzhin/ /sna thag bla ma'i phyag tu 'jog rgyu yin 'dug /gdams ngag zhus na shog grangs re gnyis tsam zhig /man ngag gcig chog yin lo'i u tshugs min par/ /sgrub rgyud lag len mi 'chug mdo sngags chos kyis/ /'khrul blo'i rang mtshang rdol rdol gdar sha gcod dgos/ /sgrub pa nyams len mdzad na thugs kyi gtad so/ /tshe 'di'i che thabs tsam min phyi mar dgongs te/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mthong ba'i skyo shes ngang nas/ /bslab pa gsum gyi phyag bzhes gtsang ma dgos 'dug /kye kye chos kyi dngos gzhi yod na gcig chog /theg chen 'phags pa yongs kyi thams cad spyi nor/ /rin chen byang chub sems 'di yin yin yin te/ /de la nges shes 'drongs pa mkhas pa'i phyag bzhes/ /lo shas gzhung lugs sbyangs kyang mthar zhig nyams len/ /rin chen sems 'di'i phyogs dang yul na med pa'i/ /zab zab man ngag yin lo'i kha phos tshims te/ /thun 240

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/mongs sems gnas tsam rer mgo bo ma 'khor/ /'khor rtsa gcod la yang dag lta ba dgos kyang / /rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum lta bu'i nges don gzhung bzang / /yang yang thos dang bsam pa'i nges shes med pa'i/ /stong ba kha rgyug tsam gyi lta bas ci byed/ /des na snying nas dam chos thugs la dgongs na/ /de skad gsol 'di rang gi nyams myong min yang —/ /mkhas pa'i gsung rgyun yin pas thugs la bzung na/ /'di phyir phan pa'i bslab bya dngos gtsang yin 'gro/ /dge ba 'di yis sangs rgyas bstan la dgyes pa'i/ /btsun chung blo rig gsal ba de yi snyan du/ /mdo sngaṭa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i 'gram du yod bzhin/ /nyon mongs skom pas gdung ba'i ban rgan des bsgrags/ /༄7/ /yon tan rgyal ba kun dang ro gcig kyang / /bka' drin rgyal ba kun las lhag pa yi/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la phyag byas te/ /ne tso'i ma ṇi lta bu'i gtam 'di zhu/ /sngon bsags bsod nams gru bo ches drangs pa'i/ /dal brgyad 'byor bcu nor bu'i skyes bzang bo/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di nas rnyed pa'i tshe/ /nor la nor ngo shes sam sprul ba'i sku/ /dal rten yid bzhin nor bu lon na yang //'chi ba klu bdud gdug pa'i ra mda' yis/ /lus dang grib ma lta bur rjes 'brang nas/ /glo bur 'phrog 'di shes sam sprul ba'i sku/ /241

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/phyi ma'i lam chen bgrod tshe ngan 'gro'i 'phrang / /sgrol ba'i 'jigs pa'i skye lam skyabs gnas gsum/ /gsol 'debs thuṭa rje bskul ba'i skyabs sbyin rgyas/ /rang sems tshim nges yod dam sprul ba'i sku/ /nam yang mi bslu dkar nag las 'bras lam/ /drang po'i thig ring mtho dman su la yang / /bde sdug ri mo sna tshogs 'di song na/ /blo ngor 'chug gam ma 'chug sprul ba'i sku/ /tshul khrims gtsang ma'i skyed tshal nyams dga' bar/ /dpyad 'jog ting 'dzin 'dab stong rnam bkra'i ngos/ /shes rab sbrang rtsi stong ba'i ro mngar po/ /myong bzhed thar 'dod yod dam sprul ba'i sku/ /mkha' khyab zhing na bde med sdug bsngal brgyas/ /gtses pa'i nyam thag 'gro ba snying rje'i gnas/ /'di kun don med 'bral med ma yin par/ /drin can pha mar mthong ngam sprul ba'i sku/ /byang chub sems zhes grags pa'i lam gcig gis/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras shes byar bzhugs so cog /don gnyis lhun grub khri la mnga' gsol na/ /rin chen sems la dgyes sam sprul ba'i sku/ /phyin drug bsdu bzhi'i spyod pa'i khrus kyi rdzing / /rgyal sras lha brgya rol ba'i 'jug ngogs der/ /bdag 'dzin dri ma 'khrud cing nyams rtogs lus/ /gso slad rtse 'dod yod dam sprul ba'i sku/ /snang grags shes bya'i ri mo ji snyed pa/ /rtag pa'i pir gyis bris tsam kho na las/ /242

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/gzod nas yul gyi rtsig ngos la med pa'i/ /bden gnyis tshul 'di mkhyen nam sprul ba'i sku/ /rgyu la 'og min ston 'khor phun tshogs pa/ /ngo sprod gsang chen theg pa'i rim gnyis la/ /dam sdom gtsang ma'i ska rags kyis bcings te/ /myur lam snyegs 'dod yod dam sprul ba'i sku / /bstan 'gror dgongs te phebs pa'i sku skyes des/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don la phyag rjes shig /'jog dgos gsungs bzhin 'jog 'dod g.yam rgyug tsam/ /min pa nges par yod dgos sprul ba'i sku/ /mdor na sde snod mkhyen pa'i mang thos spyan/ /mi shes ling tog 'thum pos ma bsgrib par/ /tshul khrims thar bar bgrod pa'i rkang ba'i 'gros / /ma 'tshal zung 'brel mdzod dang sprul ba'i sku/ /zhes sprul ba'i sku mchog ngag gi gsung ngo ma ldog tsam du thugs dme gsal 'debs su rnyarma sā ras 'phral du bris te phul ba dge legs 'phel/ /dge'o/ /༄gi /namo gu ru/ mtshungs med drin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ /rje btsun 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros/ /tshe rabs kun tu snying gi ze'u 'brur / /'bral ba med par bzhugs par mdzod cig /las smon bzang pos mi lus gtsang ma/ /legs par rnyed pa'i skal bzang grogs la/ /thugs blo chos la dbang med 'gyur ba'i/ /gdams ngag mkho na nga rang min kyang / /mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhal gyi gsung sgros/ /243

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'di phyir dge ba'i gtam gyi bdud rtsi/ /bzhes par spro na 'di 'dra lags zhes/ /gsang don mi 'dug khyed la zhu'o/ /chos kyi lan tsha myang la brel ba'i/ /chos 'dod yin lo deng sang mang yang chos bzhin bshad pa'i gtam sna mang na/ /chos kyi ro la kha snang 'char ro /chos 'di dgos don ci zhig lags zhes/ /legs par brtags na 'di phyi kun tu/ /chos kyis phan phan gzhan gyis dka' bas/ /chos rgyus yod na 'jug 'dod skye yang / / na tshod gzhon pas bsam pa'i khyer so/ /snyan snyan mdzes mdzes mi yi mdza' chos/ /de 'drar 'gro phyir de 'dra'i chos kyis/ /'jig rten phyi ma'i lam rgyags mi pher/ /chos bzhin bshad na dgos rgyu mang bas/ /chos la 'tsher snang skye bar 'dug phyin/ /chos spong las ngan ngam ngam gsogs tshe/ /chos kyi gtam la nyen yang yod do/ /chos la spro yang chos rgyus med la/ /mun khung sgron me btegs pa'i dpe ltar/ /chos kyi rang bzhin sa ler mthong bas//chos kyi gtam la khe yang che 'o/ kha zhe med par chos shig bsam na/ /chos 'dis 'di phyi'i don chen 'grub pas/ /dka' yang lag len 'debs par rigs kyis/ /zhor la 'grub pa'i sla chos mi 'dug /tshe 'di'i lto rgyab sgrub pa'i rtsol ba/ /sha khrag zad zad 'di tsam dgos na/ /tshe rabs kun tu dge ba'i don chen/ /dam pa'i 244

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/chos la ji ltar mi 'bad/ /chos kyi 'jug sgo dang por gces pa/ /mtshan ldan bla ma bsten pa lags na/ /ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i sgo nas/ /rten 'brel dang por mgo nas 'grig dgos/ /dbang khrid lung gi chos kyi char ba/ /mang du phab ba'i slob dpon lags kyang —/ /skyon gyi gong bur mthong bzhin 'grogs pa/ /dmyal ba sgrub pa'i tshogs ngan lags so/ /dam pa'i chos la bar du gces pa/ /mngon mtho'i them skas thar ba'i 'jug ngogs/ khas blang tshul khrims dag pa yin na/ /dam sdom bsrung ba gnad brgya'i mdo 'gag /dang por ma brtag 'phyor 'dod bsam pas/ /sdom gsum khas blang mang du byas te/ /lag len dus na gcig shor gnyis shor/ /tha ma lag stong 'gro ba mang ngo / /mthar thug chos kyi dngos gzhi rnal ma/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab rin chen mdzod la/ /'jug pa'i lde'u mig rgya bod gzhung bzang / /thos bsam sgom pas nyams len gal che/ /thos bsam sgom pa gang yang med par/ /rgyal bstan 'dzin pa'i shom ra che yang —/ /blun po mgu ba'i thabs tsam ma gtogs/ /bstan pa'i bya ba ngo ma dka'o/ /de slad rgyal ba'i bstan la zhugs nas/ /dam chos lag len e thebs dgongs na/ /thog mtha' bar gyi spyod tshul de dag/thugs kyi ze'u 'brur bcang bar zhu'o/ /de ltar bshad la dge tshogs 245

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/srid na/ /khyed blo chos la 'gyur ba'i thabs su/ /legs par gyur te chos spyod bya ba/ /mthar phyin don gnyis 'grub par smon no/ /zhes pa 'di yang rnyarma sā ra ཿzhes bya bas/ skal bzang grogs kyi thugs dam gsal 'debs su smras pa de de bzhin du grub par gyur cig /༄7/ /ba ma rje btsun chen po'i bka' drin dran te/ /yang yang gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab nas/ /bu khyod chos la blo kha phyogs pa yin na/ /dran tshod tshig gsum zhu'o snying la chongs dang / /'khor ba'i gnas 'dir sdug bsngal 'dzad med 'phrang ring / /gnyen po bslab gsum min pa gang gis nam yang / /mi chod lam chen nyul ba'i 'o skol so skye/ /rang sdug rang gis shes na shes tshod yin na/ /mi shes 'phral gyi so tshis 'di gas phung ste/ /yang yang ngan song 'khyams pa da snga'i 'gro lugs/ /da dung tshe 'di'i chags sdang blo phug bcug na/ /sdig pa'i bang mdzod gsog las ci yang med do/ /a kye mthu stobs lags/ /ci yang med do/ /nges par med do/ /mi lus bzang po 'di 'dra thob pa lags te/ /dgra 'dul gnyen skyong longs spyod gsog srung las yis/ /nyin mtshan sprel ba'i mu la 'chi bdag kho rang / /glo bur slebs te btsan khrid byed rgyu yin na/ /bzlog med gshin rje'i zhags pas kher khrid byed tshe/ /mig nas mchi ma sgar re gson la 'phrang yang / /sdod thabs med par 'gro na dam 246

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/chos nor bu/ /sems kyi skud par brgyus pa'i lam rgyags dgos 'dug /a kye mthu stobs lags/ shin tu dgos 'dug nges par dgos 'dug gal chen tshe rabs gtan gyi skyid sdug 'dor len/ /da res dal 'byor thob dus mi bsgrub nam bsgrub/ /snang ba yengs la mi tshe shor nas 'gro ba'i/ /'di snang las ka mang po chos kyi gegs te/ /gnyen bshes mdza' grogs sdig pa'i las kyi gzhi ma/ /mang po mang po lab pa'i dug gi g.yo skol/ /btung gin btung gin dam chos sman dang byer nas/ /mngon mtho nges legs srog rtsa chad nas 'gro'o/ /a kye mthu stobs lags/ chad nas 'gro 'o/ nges par 'gro'o/ /cis kyang phyir mar phan pa'i lha chos bsam na/ /chos kyi thog ma rten 'brel mgo nas bsgrig pa/ /mtshan ldan dge pa'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul yin zhes/ /bka' dang dgongs 'grel mkhan pos yang yang gsungs te/ /khyod blo chos la 'gyur ba nges par yod na/ /nga 'dra ltar snang bla ma min pa'i drung du/ /sgo gsum g.yo zol med par snying gi khong nas/ /sna thag bla ma'i phyag tu legs par 'jog dgos/ /a kye mthu stobs lags/ legs par 'jog dgos/ nges par 'jog dgos / dam chos thar ba'i lam bzang bgrod snyam yod na/ /thar ba'i sa mkhan dge ba'i bshes kyi drung nas/ /dus gsum 'phags pa 247

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/thar bar bgrod pa'i gshegs shul/ /lhag pa'i bslab gsum lam chen yin par 'dug na/ /lam 'di mtshon pa'i slad du rgyal ba de yis / /thugs brtses sde snod gsum gyi zhal gdams 'di go /rang re'i don du mi nyung gsungs nas bzhag yong / /de la thos bsam med par sgrub tshul med do/ /a kye mthu stobs lags/ sgrub tshul med do/ /nges par med do/ /thos bsam skyog gis bcus pa'i tshig tshogs phye thig /rang sems ljags steng blangs te yang yang myang nas/ /nyams rtogs lus kyi she mong rgyas pa'i tshod du/ /dpyad 'jog spel mar byed pa rgyal ba'i rang lugs/ /chos la blo kha 'khor na 'chugs med yin na / /'du 'dzis g.yeng ba bshol te da ni myur bar/ /chos mthun grogs dang lhan cig phyag bzhes de tshe/ /nges par phyag len 'debs rgyu ran nas 'dug go /a kye mthu stobs lags/ ran nas 'dug go /nges par 'dug go /zhes pa'ang sprul ba'i sku mthu stobs lags la gsal 'debs su smras pa la/ khron par rdo 'phangs yin min blta'o/ /dge'o/ /spro/ /dal brgyad 'byor bcu yi 'dab ldan/ /rten bzang me tog kho rnyed dus/ /dam chos sbrang rtsi yi ro mngar/ /ces kyang myong rgyu zhig ma 'chugs/ /'chi bdag gdug pa yi kha na/ /rang re rngub chog tu yod lugs/ /grogs kyi 'chi lugs 'dis shes pas/ /ma yengs 248

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/dam chos la rems mdzod/ /shi nas las 'bras kyi rang gshis/ /dkar nag gang byas bzhin myong bas/ /da lta rang dbang zhig yod dusal/ /'dir bde phyi skyid cig mdzod dang / /'khor ba mtho dman ni gang na/ /blo gtad pher ba yi bde skyid/ /nges par med pa rang lags na/ /thar lam snyog rgyu zhig ma 'chugs/ /thub bstan rin chen gyi khang bzang / /gnas mthar bde skyid kyi gnas kyi/ /'jug sgo skyabs 'gro rang lags pas/ /skyabs gsum gtsug tu ni bsten cig /ces pa'ang rig dpal gyi bzhed ngor/ dharma sā ras bris pa dge /༄ga /bka' drin mtshungs med bla ma rin po che'i/ /zhabs kyi pad mor spyi bos phyag byas te/ /snying brtse'i mkhan bu khyod la sha tsha'i blos / /gros 'debs tshig gsum smra na sems la 'chongs/ /mi lus rin chen rnyed nas chos sgor zhugs/ /chos kyi don ston bla ma rnams dang mjal/ /chos thob chos kyi tshig don 'ga' shes skabs/ /chos 'di gal chung byed na bdud kyis bslus/ /'khor ba ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar 'phen pa yi/ /nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims gos bzang ni / /gyon nas ngo tsha khrel yod ska rags kyis/ /mi dkri gcer bur thon na bdud kyis bslus/ /'khrul med shes bya'i gnas tshul yang dag don/ /lta byed legs bshad shel mig 'di bzhag nas/ /ma rig 249

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gos kyis bkab ste ngan song du/ /lceb la ci mi snyam na bdud kyis bslus / /dal 'byor nor bu 'di phyi'i don chen po/ /ci 'dod bde blag 'grub pa'i rten bzang 'di/ /ci 'grub 'di 'grub med pa'i yal yol ngang / /mi tshe stong zad byed na bdud kyis bslus/ /mi lus 'dre yis 'khrid rgyu brgya lam re/ /mi sems bdud kyis bslus pa deng sang mang / /kye ma don med don log ma byed par/ /gcig tu dge ba'i bshes la blo rtse gtod/ /gcig tu dam pa'i chos shig e 'grub bsam / /gcig tu rgyal ba'i gsung la thos bsam rem/ /gcig tu thos don lag tu e lon ltos/ /de ltar byas na don chen 'grub nas 'ong —/ /rang la yon tan ci yang med na yang / /mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung rgyun dam dum zhig /khyed la cung zad phan pa'i re ba yis /rna drung bskyal gyis rna rgyab rlung ma mdzad/ /zhal gdams gzhan la 'chad pa nga min kyang / /zhal gsung 'di 'dra gzhan la bstan pa'i dgos / /zhal phyag rwa rmig sder mo can sogs kyi/ /zhal ras mi sdug las ngan spangs par shog /a bu gces phrug gces pa lo lo bo/ /sha tsha snying gi bden gtam zangs ma 'di/ /snying nas mi brjed snying gi zhe dam de/ /rdo la ri mo ltar du mdzad rogs gyis/ /zhes rnyarma sā ras dgon lo la gang dran sha tsha'i bslab ston du bgyis pa'o/ /250

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/༄ga /dar zhes bya ba'i yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gzhir/ /dar la babs pa'i btsun pa'i tshogs gsar du/ /dar ba'i chos sde rnam rgyal dge ldan 'di/ /dar bar gyur cig snyam du smon mod de/ /rang bya mi shes thos bsam phar bskyur nas/ /phal cher za dga' la la nyal la dga' / /la las tshong dang khe spog mdzad pa yi/ /snyan dgon bla sprul de tsho mthol lo bshags/ /lhag ma phyin nas gtad so gcig med kyang ske/ /pham pas kyang ni gos sam ma gos zhes/ /brtag na gtsang thag chod pa mi 'dug pa'i/ /snyan dgon dge slong de tsho mthol lo bshaṭa / /bsdus grwa lo gsum lon nas dbugs zad de/ /yar 'tshog re bzhin gcig shor gnyis lhag gis/ /dbu phar dga' ston myong ba mi 'dug pa'i/ /snyan dgon dpe cha ba tsho mthol lo bshags/ /gzhan don brdzus ma'i g.yo yis shi gson dkor/ /zos zos a thang chad nas mtshams gzugs khong / /chags snang rtog pa spel bzhin chos 'chad mdog /snyan dgon mkhan zur bla rgan skyug re bro/ /rang bya bsam na rang la zhe khrel zhing / /gzhan bya bsam na gzhan la yi mug pas / /da ni skyid sdug ci 'byung bla ma zhes/ /gdungs dbyangs gcig gis nyi ma 'phul snying 'dod/ /ces pa 'di yang bar skabs su sems la shar ba ltar skyo tshig tu bris pa'o/ /251

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/༄7/ /byin rlabs gter chen bla ma dam pa'i zhabs/ /spyi bo'i rgyan du cod pan ltar bcings nas/ /skal bzang grogs de'i zhal ngo mi ldog slad/ /mkhas pa'i gsung 'ga' rjes zlos tshul du zhu/ /kye lags chos kyi gnad brgya 'gag bsdus tshe/ /'chi ba dran nas 'di snang zhen log dang / /nyes dmigs dran nas 'khor ba spong 'dod dang / /sems can dran nas gzhan don byed 'dod gsum/ /med thabs med par mkhas pa rnams kyis gsungs/ /de phyir blo ldog bzhi dang byang chub sems/ /snying gi ze'u 'brur bcang ba'i nyams len gyis / /chos dang rang rgyud rdo rus gtug na legs/ /snang stong 'gal med phun tshogs grogs shar ba'i/ /klu dbang rang lugs zla bas bkral ba de/ /gang na su la yod pa gzu bos blos/ /dpyad de sher phyin rigs sngags bgrang na legs/ /thun mong lam gyi rta la ma bzhon par / /thun min sngags kyis lam ring gcod 'dod nas/ /'od gsal rig pa'i mig de phye rlom yang / /don gnas 'ong ba dka' bas bzhag na legs/ /byang chub sems kyis bcos min smin pa'i rgyud / /mos gus srog tu bzung ba'i bla rnam sgos/ /sems rig phye ba'i zang thal la bzla yis/ /chos sku'i rang zhal mjal na shin tu legs / /de skad gsol 'di rang la med gyur cing / khyed la grub 252

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/zin sgrub pa yin lags te/ /lha yul bya(zhal mtshar tsam du sgra mtshungs tsam sbyar ba yin snyam/ sgrig pa po'i mtshan/)bzhin gsal 'debs tsam du ni/ /sprang ban dharma sā raḥzhes byas smras/ /dge'o/ /༄7/ /bla ma'i zhabs pad gtsug tu bsten/ /dal 'byor snying po len 'dod bskyed/ /mi rtag dran pas long med sems/ /phyi ma ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal sgoms/ /skyabs gsum gtsug gi nor bur mchod/ /las 'bras blang dor zhib mo gyis/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal yang dang yang —/ /mdo sde las gsungs nges pa yis/ /thar 'dod blo sna shugs drag pos/ /so thar tshul khrims gtsang ma mdzod/ /rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun dang ni/ /bdag gzhan mnyam dang brje ba'i blos/ /rnyed dka' rin chen byang chub sems/ /yang yang yid kyi ze'u 'brur mdzod / /sems bskyed de dang mthun pa yi/ /rgyal pa'i sras kyi spyod pa yang / /phyin drug bsdu bzhi nyid lags pas/ /slob 'dod thams cad mthil du gyis/ khyad par bying rgod bral ba yi/ /ting 'dzin brtan pa'i bzhon pa la/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi/ /rig pa'i skyes bus bzhin par mdzod/ /de tshe dmigs gtad med pa yis / /stong ba khas len bral bzhin du/ /tha snyad phar btags tsam nyid du/ /'khor 'das rten 'byung 'thad pa lags/ /de nas zab mo 253

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rdo rje theg /tshogs gnyis 'dum la 'phrul che bas/ /rdo rje slob dpon mnyes pa'i sgos/ /rim gnyis smin grol nyams bzhes mdzod/ /rang gi ma myong rgya gar gtam bzhin tu/ /dam pa'i gsung sgros rna bar byang ba 'ga'/ /dam pa'i rigs can khyod thugs gsal 'debs slad / /lha yul bya bzhin dharma sā ras smras/ /༄7/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dal 'byor mi lus theg mchog dge ba'i bshes sogs/ /dam chos mthun rkyen bzang po'i rten 'brel 'grigs kyang / /blo gros chos la goms pa ci yang med par/ /blo ngan chos la dred pa nga 'dra'i kha na/ /thugs rgyud chos la bskul pa'i gdams pa'i bdud rtsi/ /mo gsham la ni bu bzhin yod pa min mod / /'on kyang zhal ngo mi bzlog tshigs bcad dum chod/ /rtsom pa'i nyams sad dgongs na los 'bul lags so/ /gdams ngag mkhan po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lags te/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gang du nyul yang / /bden gnyis ris 'jog med par mngon sum gzigs pas/ /khong las mkhas pa su yang yod tshod mi 'dug /thar ba'i lus zung gso ba'i gdams ngag sman chen / /dri ma med pa'i sde snod rnam gsum yin pa/ /mang thos khyed 'dra'i thugs la sngar nas grub na/ /'chal bo nga 'dra'i kha de gtses pas ci phan/ /'dul ba'i 254

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/me long ngos la gzigs rtogs mdzod dang / /sdom khrims bzhin ras dag gam ma dag shes kyi/ /ma dag bzhin du ci mi snyam du bzhugs na//sde bzhi lung yang gdams ngag ma song lags so/ /byang rgod rnyog pa sel ba'i mdo sde'i nor bu/ /sems kyi rdzing bur yang dang yang du bkod de/ /dge ba'i dmigs rnam bskyang ba khyed la yod na/ /mdo sde las gzhan gdams ngag ci zhig dgos te/ /rna ba'i bu gar thos thos bser bu mang yang / /thugs kyi gor mo sra snyi sngar bzhin lags na / /nga 'drar ma zad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsung yang / /zab mo'i gdams par shar ba med pa lags so/ /gang snang snang tshul rang spyi'i mtshan nyid sgo nas/ /ku sha'i rtse ltar ma 'dres so sor bkra bas/ /ril bor 'dzin pa'i lhan skyes blo ngan 'gog pa'i/ /gdams ngag thong so rnon po mngon pa yin na/ /gdams ngag de tshe thugs la thebs pa yod na/ /bdag med lta bu'i nor bu byi dor byas te/ /bslab pa gnyis kyi dar shams rtse la bkod nas/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba skyid dgu'i yang rtse/ /sde snod thos pa mang yang bsam pa nyung la/ /sdom gsum blang ba mang yang srung ba dkon pa'i/ /sdug dred nga 'dra yin na grong mtha'i khyi bzhin/ /ma rabs ngan dgu spungs pa'i phung po lags so/ /sde snod gsum 'di gdams par shar ba'i 255

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/nyams len/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang po'i phyag bzhes lags te/ /khyed kyang snying nas chos la spro ba yin na/ /theg mchog chos mdzod 'byed pa'i lde mig bzang bo/ /mgon po a ti sha yi phyag nas byung 'dis / /chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung rab gter kha phyes te/ /blo gros na tshod skyed du bsring na legs pa/ /rang la med kyang gsal 'debs slad du zhus so/ /de skad sde snod 'dzin pa gang gi snyan du/ /tshig dang don gyi nyams ldan snyan dngags mchod sprin/ /'bul rgyus phongs yang sde snod rnam pa gsum po/ /gdams par sgrog pa'i chos gtam tsam zhig byas so/ /dharma sā ras gus pas phul/ dge'o/ /༄ga /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snying nas chos shig sgrub 'dod na / /ngo lkog med par bla ma bsten/ /ci gsung sems kyi bcud du longs / /dus rgyun spyan mig yar bltas te/ /thang lhod med par dpe char ltos/ /gcig shes gnyis shes rgyud la sbyor/ /gzhung bzang re re'i tshig gi cha'ang / /yang yang thon la blo la longs/ /don la gzhan la 'dri rtog dang / /rtsod pas gdar sha e chod ltos/ /rtsa ba snying rdo i thi ba/ /bsrung sdom yin pas shin tu gzob/ /nyin re bzhin yang rtog dpyod dang / /lo zla re bzhin 'tsho skyong mdzod/ /de ltar byas na mi 'gyis par/ mang thos tshul khrims ldan pa re/ /'ong nas rang gi 256

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/don 'grub cing / /gzhan gyis bsngags pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ /de min mdo shor byed 'dod na/ /dam sdom gar song cha med la/ /slob gnyer ya li yi le gyis/ /ltog mug 'khyag gsum myong bzhin du/ /nam zla zad zad sdug skur mdzod/ kha mang gyod kyi gleng 'dre dang / /lag mang yo byad bcag grum gzhi/ /blo mang gtad so med pa yis/ /rgyun par rang sdug rang nyo mdzod/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa'i lha grwal nas / /phyi ma'i lam rgyags chos ma 'grub/ /'jig rten mi yi bza' grwal nas/ /tshe 'dir dgos pa'i skal mi dbang / /de 'grub 'di 'grub med pa yis/ /skra dkar tshems kyi ze'u 'bru 'thor/ /lus kyi me tog bkrag nyams te/ /dkon mchog mnyes pa'i mchod rdzas min/ /grogs mched dga' ba'i mdzes rgyan min/ /rang lto sbrang ma tsam 'tsho ba'i / /longs spyod nor gyi sbrang rtsi med/ /'di med phyi ma med pa yi/ /gnyis med khyi rgan 'khyam po gnyis/ /gang mdzad 'dam kha rang la yod / /de la thugs kyis rtog dpyod mdzod/ /zhal gdams snyan mo ngas mi shes/ /zab mo'i gdams pa nga la med/ /gna' bo'i bla rgan rgyud drang rnams/ /rtsub mo'i kha ta byed srol bzhin/ /nga yang cung zad smyos pa'i gtam/ /rna bar 'bab na de 'dra lags/ /deng sang dus kyi mar gsham na/ /mi ngan rang rgyus ma lon rnams/ /bslu tshig 257

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ngo bstod la dga' yang / /ngo bstod don med yin pas bzhag /tshig pa za na mthol lo bshags/ /rta rma sā ras bris pa dge legs 'phel/dge'o / /༄khya/ /'jam dbyangs chos kyi khang bzang dam pa ru/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen drung / /'di phyi dge ba'i bsod nams zong gi phreng / /ci dgar spel bzhin sos dal sdod pa dang dzha/ /tig tig rigs sngags klog pa'i sa 'og gi /ri dwags drang srong rang shong phug pa'i sgor/ /mjug mas rnga yab g.yo bzhin rgyu ba la / /bsod nams min pa gsog bzhin rgyu ba gnyis/ /gang zhig phyag bzhes mdzad pa'i 'dam kha ste/ /chu nang pad+ma gsar ba'i rjes 'gro pa'i / /pad+ma'i tha snyad 'dzin pa khyod la yod/ /de slad rnam dpyod ral gri'i so phyungs shig /༄ / /rje btsun bla ma sangs rgyas dngos de'i zhabs la/ /gus pa chen pos phyag ni sngon du btang ste/ /lugs gnyis ci yang mi shes blun po nga 'dras/ /gdams rgyu med kyang bsam bzang gtam 'ga' smra na/ /mi lus thob pas mi chog mi bya 'grub dgos/ /mi bya 'di phyi'i don ni gnyis shig yod de/ /'di bas phyi ma gtso bo yin par 'dug pas / /phyi ma'i don chen ma shor yid la zungs dang / /phyi ma dkon 258

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/mchog 'dra ba'i skyabs gnas dka' bas/ /da lta gsol ba ci btab rang lag yin thog /'jug sgo ma nor skyabs 'gro'i nyams len steng nas / /'di phyi'i don chen bsgrub na ngo mtshar che 'dug /skyabs su song nas ston pa sangs rgyas de yis/ /thar ba'i lam zhig rang rer bstan ni yod de/ /dam chos snum zad yi gar 'ong ba 'gog pa'i/ /rnam g.yeng mkhris pa'i nad 'dis za dbang mi ster/ kye ma kye hud da ni ci zhig byar yod/ /sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i nags su yang nas yang dul/ /mi 'dod ltog grir 'chi la bzod sran tshugs nas/ /sdug bsngal spos rgya'i ri mo mtha' ded byed dam/ /min na dam chos sdug bsngal 'jom pa'i sman mchog /'di nyid bza' la yi ga e phye blta dgos/ /gad byed gzhon nu'i rnam rig shel dkar ltar du/ /bkra ba'i me long ngogs la gang legs ltos shig /rgan po rnyarma snga ras so/ /(g.yang skyabs la sprod gsung —/)༄ga /na mo gu ru/ rje dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas bla ma'i gar/ /dpal bde ba chen pos rnal 'byor ba/ /mgon 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros zhabs/ /'bangs bdag gi spyi bor mchod byas te/ /khong chos 'dod kyi blo gsal btsun pa'i gsung / /yang mi ldog tsam du gsal 'debs tshig /don nyams myong rang la med na yang / /bya ne 259

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/tso'i ma ṇi bzhin du brjod/ /chos snga 'gyur gyi gsang sngags rnying ma dang / /phyi 'gyur gyi sa bka' jo dge sogs/ /bod gangs can 'dir chos rgyud mang byon te/ /de kun kyang mdo rgyud dgongs pa'i mthil / /lam zab mo'i lta grub re yin pas/ /yang dag snang mos gus kyis myang dgos kyang / /khong mkhas grub kun gyi dgongs mthun du / /las dang po ba yi gdul bya la/ /chos zab mo chos kyi sna 'dren mchog /nyams rtogs pa mthon po'i gzhi 'debs pa'i/ /chos blo ldog rnam pa bzhi bo de/ /rten don ldan byed pa'i thabs mchog yin/ /de yin tshul yang yang dpyad pa yis/ /bka' mdo rgyud gsung rab zhal bsdur na/ /don go bar sla ste grogs khyed kyang / /chos de la thugs dam mdzad na legs/ /yang theg chen chos kyi 'jug sgo mchog /rang ma zad gzhan gyi don chen po/ /bsgrub sla ba'i thabs mchog byang chub sems / /de'i phan yon che ba mthong gyur te/ /khong skye 'phags rgyal sras thams cad kyi/ /chos 'di la gces spras brgya phrag gis/ /dus kun tu thams cad mthil mdzad na/ /grogs khyed kyang thams cad mdzad na legs/ /lam zab mo'i dngos gzhi yang dag lta/ /dpal klu sgrub zhabs kyi bzhed pa bzhin/ /snang ba dang stong ba zung 'jug gi /gzhi bden gnyis 'jog tshul gal che lags/ /don de 'dra'i nyams 260

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/myong med gyur cing / /lus bro nad kyis gdung bas mnar na yang / /zhal mi zlog tsam gyi rkang chag tshig /grogs khyed kyi snyan du sgron pa 'di / /don bden nam mi bden thugs dpyad sgos/ /yang thugs la 'thad pa byung gyur na/ /snyan rgyab kyi bser bu mi mdzad par/ /don phyag len nyid du bstar bar zhu/ /zhes ba 'di yang ngang ba bla ma bsod nams bstan 'dzin gyi thugs bzhed bzhin/ rnyarma sā ras smras pa'o/ /༄7/ /'o lags so/ /de yang 'dir bzhugs dge 'dun pa rnams thams cad la gsal 'debs kyi rim pa cung zad cig zhu na/rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas/ 'di la gla rngan byin nas ni/ /da ni rang gi don byed chug /phan pa med par 'di la ni/ /thams cad sbyin par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dkar gyi phud dang / dmar gyi dwangs kyis gsos pa'i sgyu ma'i lus 'dis dge phyoṭa kyi bya ba sgrub pa'i rten cig ci nas kyang byed dgos te/ de min na/ khyod kyi mi gtsang bzar mi rung / khrag kyang btung du mi rung la/ /rgyu lto'ang gzhib pa mi rung na/ /lus 'dis khyod la ci zhig byed/ /gsungs pa ltar yin no / /des na thams cad sku ha cang bgres pa dang / ha cang gzhon pa'i skyon bral sha dag par bzhugs gshis/ o brgyal cung zad bzod 'gro bas da reb kyi sku rim zhabs brtan 'di la thams cad 261

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gcig dril zhig mdzad 'tshal/ de yang 'dir bzhugs dge bgres dngos slob rnams dngos slob tu yod pas rang gi 'di phyi'i lam ston gcig pu de nyid nges don du skye 'chi ga la yod kyang gdul bya'i ngor sgyu ma'i mdzad pa re 'ga' ba 'di lta bu'i skabs nyin byed gsar du 'char ba la/ 'ug pa tsam min pa'i srogs chags su yang dga' brod kyi kha shar du blta ba bzhin/ rnal 'byor rang bca' dang ba rnga rang lcag yod 'gro bas de lugs gong 'phel zhu rgyu las zhu bya gsar ba med la/ zhal mjal gsung thos cher med pa rnams kyang / nga la chos 'brel dang / dga' 'dun med pa cher med gshis/ nga la sems tshe/rgyud sde rin po che'i dkyil chog rnams las/ khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ /gsungs pa ltar nga'i rdo rje 'chang / skyid dus dang / brgyag dus kyi lo shas tsam min par byang chub kyi bar gyi rigs kyi cod pan de nyid kyi sku'i ba spu'i khung bu gcig kyang / stong gsum gser gyis bkang ba las kyang 'dam che bas/ sku rin po che'i de nyid kyi rim gro phran tsam bsgrub na yang / nga la dga' ba'i dngos por shin tu che/ma zad rang re rnam rgyal dge ldan gyi bla grwa'i khongs su yod pa'i bstan pa'i bdag po gcig pur gyur ba'i skyabs mgon dam pa khong kho na yin gshis/ sku la 'das grong song yang mchog sprul yid bzhin 262

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/dbang gi rgyal po'i cod pan zhig rnyed la khad pa ni/ sa steng gi nor sna gcig tu spungs te rnyed pa las kyang ya mtshan che bas sku'i rim gro la sems shi ga yod nas bzung g.yel thabs ga la yod/ rgyu mtshan de dag la dgongs te zhabs brtan hur thag bskyed de/ gnang ba zhu ba so'i yang mi byed thabs med lta bu'i las don bzlog med ma gtogs snga phyi nam byas kyang chog pa'i rigs dus der gtad de gnang ba sogs ma zhu/ de mtshungs sbyin pa pos kyang bdar sha bcad de khag mi 'dug snyam pa ma gtogs de ci 'dod du sbyin nas sbyin pa'i phyir lan e rdzogs ma blta/ mdor na thams cad kyis rim rim/ ngas nyin re bzhin snga dro phyi dro byas nas kyang dge legs nor bu la bzang spyod kyi 'tshogs su su yod su med 'dri rgyu yin/ dris nas yi ger bkod de gzod khyed tshos legs nyes gang byas 'di red ces ston rgyu yod pa byed nges pas/ da reb ya le yo le byas na nga la 'dang ma btang ba dang la/ dgon pa grwa tshang la bsam pa ma dkar ba dang / rang la dge ba'i blo med pa yin/ chos e 'grub snyam na chos bya ba 'di dag las lhag pa logs na yod na khyed tsho ngas bslus pa yin/ khyad par du khyed rang tsho'i nang na byang chub kyi sems la myong ba thon pa 'dra yod na ma gtogs/ nga dang skal mnyam tsho la da lta chos gzugs sgo gsam 263

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gyi bya ba ci byas kyang rang ngos nas rgyal sras kyi spyod par gtan nas mi 'gro ba la/ thabs la mkhas pa'i sgo nas/ rang re'i skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi sems can gyi don du kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa rlabs po che mdo sde 'di nas bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin du mdzad pa'i spyod pa de dag dang bdag gi srid pa'i phyi mtha'i bar gyi sgo gsum gyi spyod pa gcig tu 'dres nas/ sems can la phan pa kho na lhur len par shog cig ces pa'i don sna gcig po 'di kho na rgyal ba sras bcas dpang por zhog la sems la yang yang chogs dang / gang gis bzang spyod smon lam 'di btab pas/ /des ni ngan song thams cad spong bar 'gyur/ /sogs nas/ byang chub mchog la som nyi ma byed cig /ces pa'i bar gyi phan yon rnams 'byung bar ngas kheg theg de min na ni dka' ste tshig bton pa tsam la min par don la bsam pa'i phan yon du snang ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang rang re'i skyabs mchog rdo rje 'chang gis dbu mdzad pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas la tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyi gsol 'debs dang smon lam du yang 'gro ste/bzang po spyod pa rab tu ston pa rnams/ /de dag dang yang rtag tu 'phrad par shog /de dag bdag gis nam yang yid mi dbyung / /zhes gsungs pa las lhag ci zer/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rlabs po che 264

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/yang rdzogs te/ gang yang phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams mtha' yas pa/ /nas / bsod nams dam pa'i mchog tu 'di 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ bsod nams chen po bsags na don thams cad bde blag tu 'grub pa ni/ rgya cher rol ba las bshad pa ltar yin/ dpe cha slob gnyer bsam na yang smon lam 'di btab pas tshe 'di dang tshe rabs gzhan du dam chos 'dzin pa'i bag chags brtan po sems rgyud la theb pa yin te/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi / /'khor lo'i tshul rnams rab tu bskor ba yi/ /de dag gi yang gsung dbyangs mi zad la/ /blo yi stobs kyis bdag kyang rab tu 'jug /gsungs pa 'dis thos pa rlabs po che'i rigs nus sngar med gsar du bskrun pas na de lta bu la thugs 'dang re yang cis kyang btang 'tshal/ dge'o/ /༄7/ /thams cad kyi thugs la nges rgyur/ da lta ma ṇi'i sku rim 'dir thams cad kyi gsung sgrog hur thag bskyed rgyu zhig mkhyen mkhyenaske/ che bgres rnams nas gsung ngag mi gcod par ngag las su mi rung / chung chung rnams nas lag pa 'dug rgyu med par lus las su mi rung / bar sha ba rnams tshong ba bu lon rdib pa ltar 'dang brgyab ste sems las su mi rung ba de 'dra ma mdzad/ sku mkhyen/ dal 265

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'byor mi lus thob pa de res la/ /dam pa'i chos dang mjal ba da res tsam/ /'jig rten phyi ma cis kyang ya nga bas/ /'dang zhig rgyag na thugs 'dang de la rgyobs/ /phar phyin drug gi mngon rtogs yi ge'i gzugs / /'bru drug gdangs kyis trīḥyig 'phags pa'i thugs/ /skul byed gsang sngaṭa zab mo byin che bas/ /smra 'dod kha 'di rigs sngags rgya yis thob/ /btsun chung sku yi shing lo yangs pa'i 'dab/ /rtse rgod rnam rtog rlung gis bskyod rnams la/ /'bru drug ma ṇi 'dul byed dbyug pa ru/ /shar ba'i mtshon 'di 'phags pa'i phyag mtshan yin/ /las ngan rdzing bur nyon mongs rlan gsher du/ /sdug bsngal skye srid bzung ba'i mi srun 'gro/ /lan chags snyog pa'i sbal gcong grangs mang bas/ /'phags pa'i gdul byar 'gyur ba'i smon lam thob/ /bgegs rigs lan chags gtsor gyur 'gro drug khams/ /srid las sgrol 'dod snying rje chen po yis/ /gzhan don sgrub la rtse gcig 'dun pa'i blos/ /byang chub sems kyi ngang nas yig drug sgrongs/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ hrīḥ zhes 'dus sde rin po che'i spyan lam du bskul 'debs kyi tshul du springs pa dgongs dbyings su 'chang bar zhu zhu zhu/ zhes dharma sāḥras bris/ /༄gi /'jam dbyangs chos kyi 'dun sa las 'ong ba'i/ /dpal ldan legs bshad gtam gyi rol mo 'bum/ /bdag gi rna ba'i bu gar 266

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/sbyin mdzad pa'i/ /blo gros rgya mtsho drin chen bla ma'i zhabs/ /spyi bos mchod do blo gsal khyod kyi ngag /ma bcag tsam du tshig bcad thor bu'i skyes/ /byis pa dga' ba'i me tog 'phreng brgyus bzhin/ /dbul bar bgyi yi yid kyi rgyan du zungs/ /kye lags gsung rab sprin gyi ngos yangs nas/ /dal ba'i rten 'di rnyed par dka'o zhes/ /lan gcig min par bsgrags pa'i dbyar skyes rnga/ /khyod snyan bu gar son pa yod lags na/ /rnyed dka'i rten de khyod kyis legs rnyed pas/ /da ni bag med gnyid du ma yur bar/ /chos bzhin smra zhing spyod pa'i bshes gnyen drung / /skom pas chu la 'dun bzhin snyegs re ran/ /mi rtag srin mo glal ba'i mche ba'i rtser/ /chags pa'i 'di snang sbrang rtsi'i ro mngar bos/ /chog shes med par bslu ba'i skabs shig rung / /dbang med srog la rgol ba byis pa'i gshis/ /de slad chos la 'dun pa khyod nyid kyang / /lo zla rim pas 'gyangs pa'i phyi bshol 'dis/ /bsgrub snyam yod kyang 'grub dus med 'gro bas/ /smyon pa 'ur langs byas na mi legs sam/ /dam pa'i chos ni phyi ma'i lam rgyags te/ /phyi mar phan thabs kho nar sgrub pa las/ /chos sgrub 'dod bzhin lto gos gang bzang la/ /gcig pu byed pa chos kyi lag len min/ /de slad tshe 'di'i lto gos gtsor 'don la/ /phyi ma'i dam chos 'grub pa mi 'ong 267

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/bas / /khyod thugs chos la spro na lto gos la/ /gang byung tsam res chog shes mi byed dam/ /gnyen gyi dga' sdug sos ga'i gnam gyi sprin/ /dkar nag 'gyur ldog brtsis pa'i mi lang gis/ /rang sar glod na rgyal khams gnyen yin zhes/ /dam pa'i gsungs pa thugs la 'ben lags sam/ /dgra yi phan gnod byis pa'i rtsed mo ste/ /ci tsam de bzhin mtha' med ngal ba'i rgyu/ /rang sar bzhag na bag yangs sos dal zhes/ /chos rgyus can rnams gleng ba dgongs lags sam/ /dgra gnyen 'dor len 'jig rten skye bo'i lugs/ /'di la dgongs na chos la snyad ma 'dog /dam pa'i chos ni tshe 'di blos btang ste/ /de la dgongs na dgra gnyen ci bder zhogs/ /chos dang 'jig rten me chu so so'i las/ byang sems thabs la mkhas na mi 'gal yang / /dang po'i las can gnyis ka mi 'ong zhes/ /mkhas grub stong gis mthun pa'i gtam du gleng / /de phyir khyod kyang na gzhon blo gsal pas / /chos la mos na 'jig rten blos thongs la/ /chos bzhin spyod pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa'i drung / /bshad sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng na legs/ /de skad rang la nyams myong med pa'i gtam/ /rgyus med sa cha bshad bzhin smras 'di yang / dam pa'i gsung rgyun rna bar byang ba 'ga'/ /gsol ba lags pas chos mthun gtam yin zungs/ /268

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/dang por dge ba tshul khrims sa gzhi la/ /bar du dge ba thos bsam me tog 'khrungs/ /tha mar dge ba nyams rtogs sbrang rtsi'i ros tshim pa skal bzang mkhas pa'i spyi srol de/ /khyod kyang de bzhin thog mtha' bar dge ba'i/ /ya rabs spyod pa'i phyag len myur 'grub nas/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu dam ba'i lha gral du/ /bzhugs pa'i smon 'dun rang re gnyis byed de/ /de ltar smra ba smra la dga' ba yi/ /nyes dmigs ngan pas ngan par song ba yi/ /btsun pa'i gzugs brnyan gzugs brnyan chos smra pa/ /chos med chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya bas/ /blo gsal blo tshul blo dang bstun nas ni/ /chos med chos gtam chos bzhin bshad pa'i dgos/ /dge med dge bstan dge ba'i lugs bzhin du/ /legs lam legs khyod legs tshogs mthar phyin shog /sarba maṅga lo/ /༄sha /'jigs rung nags kyi tshal na dub pa yi/ /bde med ri dwags brgya yis ngal gso'i gnas/ /ro mngar sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan g.yo ba yi/ /drang srong bste gnas dgon pa'i ne'u sing yin/ /rnyed bkur ngan skyug phyur bur spungs pa'i rdzob/ /grong gi nye 'dabs lha brgyas spangs pa der/ /ngang ba mtsho la 'khor ba'i brtul zhugs ni/ /ya rabs skye bo rnams kyis smad de soms/ /zhes bya ba 'di ni rnam rgyal dge 269

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/sbya/na gyi chos smra ba'i gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa zhig gis bris pa dge zhing bkra shes par gyur ༄7/ /rje btsun thugs rje can de'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge slong sbyin pa rgya mtsho lags/ zhal gdams bris shig zer mkhan mang zhing lta rtogs mi byed pa'i sun zhing lhag tu nad ros mi lcogs kyang / khyod sha tsha zhing sems la e mi 'dzin snyam nas shi chos kyi lag len mdor bsdus gnad du dril te brjed thor 'god na/spyir po ti lnga'i gzhung bshad kyi lag len skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim nyid la blo rtse gtod la thos bsam sgom gsum tshig dril mdzod/ khyad par du legs tshogs thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen mig 'bras ltar bsten/ ci gsung dang du longs/ mi lus thob pa da res tsam yin pas chud zos su cis kyang mi gtong snyam pa'i zhe dam yang nas yang du 'chos/ mi btad lugs la/ skyes nas ma shi ba su yang med pas nga rang yang nges par 'chi snyam du sems/ 'chi ba de yang do dgong tsam yang mi 'ong ba'i nges pa ci zhig yod/ 'ong chog chog yin/ 'ong tshe sgyu lus sha khrag gi phung bo 'di tsam yang mi dbang na gzhan nye 'brel nor rdzas sogs kyis mi phan nges can yin zhes yang yang sems la/ 'di snang gi bkod rgya mang bo'i blo sna je thung du thongs/ shi ba'i 'og tu rang re so skye tha mal ba la skad cig re 270

zhal godams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/bzhin sdig ltung gi gter kha brdol ba lta bu yin pas ngan song du 'gro ba'i nyen che/ song na sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho khol lugs mdo sde rnams nas gsungs tshod la dpag na ji ltar bzod des na de ring sang nas ngan song gi skye sgo khegs pa zhig cis kyang dgos snyam du snying la rus pa tshugs/ de yang skyob nges kyi skyabs dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum yin pas nyin re bzhin yang nas yang du skyabs 'gro rang sems 'tshangs nges gyis la bstan pa'i sgo khang nas yar nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i gral du phebs/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis skyob mi skyob kyang / rang la thug pas bslab bya dang las 'bras blang dor gyi lag len zhib mo gyis/ las 'bras dang 'gal ba'i sdig pa bcas mtshams dang 'gal ba'i lhung ba rnams ci mi snyam du mi 'jog par stobs bzhi'i bshags bsdom nyi ma re re bzhin du ma skyur la me long gi g.ya' phyis pa bzhin du rang rgyud phyi dor gyis/ phyi ma yang chos bsgrub pa'i rten rnam smin yon tan brgyad ldan gyi lus rten bzang bo thob pa'i rten 'brel da nas sgrigs/ 'khor ba mtho dma' med par sdug pa'i tshul yang yang sems la/ mngon mtho tsam la yang ma zhen par thar ba don gnyer gyi nges 'byung gi bsam pa bskyed la de'i spyod pa tshul khrims gtsang ma la 'bad/ 'khor ba'i gnas 271

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/'dir dgra gnyen bar ma'i snang tshul la nges pa gtan nas med pas blo btang snyoms kyi sa gzhi khod snyoms par mdzod la de'i steng du mar shes sogs gsum gyis byams pa'i chus brlan nas phyogs ris dang bral / snying rje'i myu gu 'khrungs la de nyid lhag bsam gyis skyed bsring nas byang chub kyi sems kyi sdong bo kho lag rdzogs pa la phyin drug dang bsdu bzhi'i 'bras bu shar nas gzhan phan gyi ro mngar lus can mtha' dag gi myong du rung ba'i theg mchog dpag bsam gyi ljon pa bzang bo zhig bskyed dgos pas de 'dra'i lag len ci 'ong gyis/yang dang yang du de yang 'ong ba'i ched du tshogs bsag sgrib sbyang dang smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor rnam par dag pa gyis/ de'i steng du gsang sngags kyi snon pa 'debs dgos pas chos sgo dbang gis phyes pa ltar dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam sdom dag pa dngos grub kyi rtsa bar shin tu gal che bas thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas sdom pa gsum gyi lag len la skyes bu'i rtsal ci yod phyungs la 'bad par mdzod / de ltar byas na rje bla ma'i lam rim nyams mgur du gsungs pa ltar gyi dal 'byor la snying bo lon pa yin pas lag len de 'dra zhig cis kyang mdzad rgyu ma 'chug mkhyen mkhyen zhes thal mo sbyor ba lags / dharma saḥras bris pa dge'o/ /272

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus bzhugs/༄gi /bla ma mkhyen/ rang nyid mi mthong gzhan rnams mthong ba yi / /blo gros mig gis re zhig bltas pa na/ /mtshar dgu mi mthong mtshang dgu mthong nas ni/ /bu gces stor ba'i rnga mong bzhin du ngu/ /thugs rjes gzigs sam bla ma rin po che/ gna' zhig lus ni rga bas non pa bzhin/ /mthong rgya che bas rnam dpyod dar bar brtsi/ /da ni lus blo lhan cig rga ba yis/ /rgud ces rgan la 'phya ba'i rgyang 'phen slebs / /mu stegs las kyang yang stegs 'di la ltos/ /lus sems bskyed pa'i pha ma slob dpon la/ /gtso bo byed pa gna' bo'i lugs srol te/ /na tshod mnyam dang bzhin mdangs su legs la/ /ya dper 'dzin pa da dus ngan pa'i gshis/ /dus tshod 'di 'drar dam pa su la 'grems/ /chos mthun grogs la chos kyi mched zer te/ /phyogs ris spangs pa dam tshig can gyi srol/ /ngan spyod byed la blo gros mthun pa'i tshe/ /mdza' gcugs che ba mdo shor rnams kyi lugs/ /tshogs mchog dge 'dun su yis bsten tshul shes/ /kye ma bla ma sangs rgyas dngos zhig gis/ /gsung sgros dam dum yid la bcang gyur te/ /phyogs ris med par phan pa'i blo 'chang yang / /skal ngan rnams la khyi la dar zab bzhin/ /da ni su la ji ltar phan par nus/ /phan pa'i bslab bya sha tsha'i gros gyi gtam/ /rnam dpyod can la rin thang che 273

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/mod de/ /bsod chung shes rab dman la zlos na yang / /mi bzod khong khro'i rdul ni ldang ba'i gzhi/ /sman la dug tu 'khrul ba 'di 'drar ltos/ lugs gnyis spyod pa gang dang 'phrad ma thag /'phral du mngon tshan che bas 'bar na yang / /de ma thag tu 'dor bas yun thung ba/ /deng sang skye bo rtsa yi sgron me 'dra/ /'bar yun thung dang snang nus chung la ltos/ /gshis bzang dkar 'jam 'o ma ltar snang bas / /ya rabs spyod la nan gyis bcug pa na/ /yon tan mar med nyes spyod dri ngan can/ /deng sang skye bo bong bu'i 'o ma 'dra/ /bcos gyin rang gshis ngan pa mngon la ltos/ /phar la drin gyis ci tsam bskyangs gyur te/ /mi gral chud pa de tsam nga rgyal nas/ /tshul la drin chen ma yi spu btog pa'i/ /deng sang skye bo skya ga'i phru gu 'dra/ /phan pa'i drin lan log pas 'jal la ltos/ /dam pa'i bshes dang grogs kyi sngon pa la/ /re zhig 'khril yang rang gshis yang bas na/ /grogs ngan rlung gis g.yang sar 'phen nges pa/ /deng sang skye bo shing lo brul ba 'dra/ /zla shas song nas dma' bar lhung la ltos/ /phug gi 'dod don 'di dang 'di 'dra'i slad/ /'phral gyi bya ba 'di dang 'di rtsom zhes/ /rnam par dpyod pa'i blo sems bral ba yi/ /deng sang skye bo mi yi ro dang 'dra/ /gzhan gyis gar bsgyur 'gyel ba'i tshul la 274
