chab shog gi skor tsho bzhugs/len brgya rtsa'i las kyi nan tan yang / khyod gcig med na 'byung bar mi 'gyur bas/ /bstan pa'i bdag po myur du phebs par zhu/ /rtsa ba'i lung don bshad pa'i sde bzhi nyid/ /dgag sgrub gnang ba'i bslab pa phra mo'i cha/ /yid ches lung gis dpog pa ches dka' bas/ /ston pa'i zhal 'tshab myur du phebs par zhu/ /byang chub sems sbyong brgyud pa'i chu bo gnyis/ /a ti sha nas 'dres pa'i bka' gdams lugs / /smon 'jug cho gas 'bog mkhan mi bzhugs pas/ /theg mchog dge ba'i bshes khyod phebs par zhu/ /rlabs chen phyin drug spyod pa'i khog song bar/ /byams chos lnga dang rig tshogs drug sogs kyi / /shing rta chen po'i gzhung lugs ches dgos pas/ /mkhas pa'i dbang bo khyed nyid phebs par zhu/ /skal bzang sngags kyi theg par 'jug pa'i sgo/ /rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i dbang gi chu bo yis/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon bskrun nus ches dkon pas/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang khyod nyid phebs par zhu/ /lam srog dam tshig zab mo'i rmang bting dang / /rgyud sde spyi dang bye brag bla med kyi/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i las kyi byed po ru/ /rdo rje slob dpon mchog khyod phebs par zhu/ /mdor na dam pa snga mas bor ba yis/ /dam chos snang ba bral ba'i yul ngan 'di / /da lta khyod kyis bdag gir ma mdzad na/ /phyis 'byung bstan 353

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa'i na tshod ji ltar smin/ /de phyir dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams zhes / /ming don mthun la yod snon mi dgos pas/ /bstan pa'i rin chen mchog gis ma khyab pa'i/ /phyogs 'dir chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur bar zhu/ /go log sdig pa'i mun pa sangs pa dang / /mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyi ma shar ba'i bar/ khyod kyi zhabs pad rdo rje'i khri 'phangs la/ /brtan par bzhugs pa'i thugs bskyed gnang bar zhu/ /de skad gsol ba btab pa'i zhu tshig nyid/ /lha rdzas dkar pos 'degs rten dang bcas te/ /rnam rgyal dge mtshan ldan pa'i gtsug lag khang / /'dzin pa'i gus slob dharma sā ra nas/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag dang bcas te phul ba'i zhu yig lags so/ /༄7/ /bskal mang legs par byas pa'i 'bras bu che/ /dge legs 'bum gyi gzi 'bar bka'i cod pan/ /spyi bor bcings pa'i gus 'bangs myu gu yis/ /thag ring yul nas snyan tshig zhu ba 'bul/ /spros pa mi mnga' gnyis su snang med pa'i/ /don dam mkha' la khyed dang rgyal ba kun/ /bka' bgros med bzhin ro gcig lhun grub pa/ /de 'dra sems tshe bsnyun 'dri ji ltar 'os/ /'on kyang thub rnams thugs rje'i 'dzum dkar che/ /lhan gcig rgod pa'i gsung gi 'od zer ni/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gar du snang ba yis/ /drangs pa'i 354

chab shog gi skor tsho bzhugs/don bzhin slob thas 'di ltar zhu/ /mtha' yas tshogs gnyis chu gter las 'khrungs shing / /shin tu dul ba'i bkrag brgya 'bar ba yi/khyod sku rab mdzes puṇ+ḍa ri ku'i dngos/ /thub bstan skyed tshal rgyan du gzhes lags sam/ /rig pa'i tsha zer 'bum dang 'grogs pa yi/ /legs bshad snang ba mi zad spros gyur te/ /thub dgongs mtha' dag lag mthil rdzas bzhin du/ /gsal byed gsung gi dbang phyug bde lags sam/ /rig dang grol ba'i nor bu'i cha byad 'bum/ /thogs te theg mchog sems kyi rtse brgya'i 'phrul/ /snyigs ma lha min dpung la ngom pa yi/ /thugs rje'i spyan stong ldan pa bde lags sam/ /theg mchog longs spyod sprin gyis 'khor yug kun/ /rdzogs par brgyan pa'i chos sku'i lha lam nas/ /rnam 'dren stong bzhin sprul bsgyur 'gog med pa'i/ /yab rje sku bzhi'i dbang phyug bde lags sam/ /'di na khyod kyi byin rlabs zer/ /'phos pas dge blo ma dor bzhin/ /phung lnga'i ljon pa 'tshe bral te/ /gsol 'debs dbyangs kyis 'tsho ba'i skabs/ /mtshams zhu/ ched du gus phyag bcas gsol ba 'debs par / ma 'dres 'gro ba'i mdza' bshes zla med pa/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal rnams lags mod bdag gis ni/ /skyabs gnas khyed las gzhan du ma dmigs pas/ /rgyal rnams khyod kyi ngo bor 'dus sam 355

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/snyam / /de phyir khyod kyi gsung gi zur tsam yang / /sgrub pa'i skal bzang tshogs kyis sgrub dgos na/ /'bad pa med par gsung gi bdud rtsi nyid/ /spyi bor thob pa da res tsam lags kyang / /snyigs ma las kyang ches snyigs dus kyi mtha'i/ /sems can mi srun spyod pa dmu rgod cing / /rkyen ngan thub pa'i rnal 'byor stobs zhan pas/ khyod gsung sgrub la bdag ni las kyis nongs/ /'di snang gu dog sna tshogs bya ba'i dpya/ /bsdus kyang mi chog spos rgya'i ri mo'i rjes/ /bcad de gu yangs dben tshal bla ma'i drung / /snyog pa'i bsod nams bdag la yod dam ci/ /nyam chung dang po'i lus can bdag 'dra la/ /rkyen dang bsre ba'i spyod pa ga la yod/ /gnas brtan nags su bkris pa'i dka' thub la/ /'gran pa'i skal ba bdag la yod dam ci/ /nges 'byung yid kyis drangs pa'i byang sems dang / /zung 'brel yang dag lta ba ches dka' yang / /bcos ma'i pir gyis rtog ngor lam gtso gsum / /sos dal 'dri ba'i bsod nams yod dam ci/ /brjid ldan rdza ri'i na bun gos gyon te/ /lhung lhung phu chus shog ces 'bod 'dra'i mdangs/ /mthong tshe yid kyi ri dwags mi bzod par/ /ri la 'khor ba chos shig yin nam ci/ /rab yangs ne'u sing me tog rab mang gis/ /mdzes pa'ang mthong tshe khyed dang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /356

chab shog gi skor tsho bzhugs/mngon sum dmigs te mchod pa'i legs byas 'bras/ /gu yangs smon pa nam zhig bdag gis 'grub/ khyad gsung nyi 'od phra mo lhung pa yis / /dge sdig gzugs brnyan rags rim smra shes mod/ khyod zhabs mnyes pa gsum gyis bsten byas nas/ /gdar sha chod pa bdag gis nam zhig go /zhi drag mdzad pas da bar bskyangs na'ang / /rang gi ngos nas g.yeng bas khyer ba yis/ khyed 'drar 'phrad pa'i don po ma rnyed pa/ /da lta bdag gis mngon sum bzhin du mthong / /'gyod pas bdas pa'i yid kyi khye'u chung ni/ /nyin bzhin khyed kyi gam du snyog mod de/ /rnam rgyal dge legs stong ldan 'dir 'khri nas/ khyed gsung khur du lci nas yang yang gshol/ /bdag 'dra'i rtsi rkyang bsdoms pa'i ka ba yis/ /thub bstan ba gam 'degs pa ches dka' bas / /byin rlabs 'od brgya 'bar ba khyed kyi zhal/ /mig gi bdud rtsir byed pa don che snyam/ /de slad spos kyi glang bo chen po'i khur/ /byi ba'i rgyab nas phog ste bla dpon nyung / /lha ldan chos kyi khang bzang las byung ste/ /dbang chen yul grur chos srid me bzhin sbor/ /bdag kyang 'dod pa med dang chog shes pas/ /'khar ba'i grogs sbran long yod rta zhon te/ /gang du khyed kyi dgyes zhal ngom pa der/ /slebs pa'i bdag rkyen bdag la mi gnang ngam/ /dbang chen stod kyi skye bo 357

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/stong phrag bzhi/ /lhag tsam rigs ldan drag po sgrol ba yi/ /skal bzang thob pa'i lhan cig byed rkyen gyis/ khyed thugs dgyes pa bdag gis bsgrubs zin dgongs/ /skyabs gcig khyed nyid kho nar re ba bdag /ci byed de bsgrub 'gro sdod thams cad kun/ khyed gsung legs lam stsol ba'i don bzhin du/ /sgrub par zhu'o thugs rjes dgongs par mdzod/ /gser sbrul gnam lo mdzes pa 'di'i khongs su/ /phyogs de'i bstan 'gro'i don chen legs mdzad nas/ /rta mchog gsar tshes lhan cig dgyes brtses kyis/ /bkra shis zhabs zung rnam rgyal pad+mor phebs/ /slad mar yon tan nor bu'i 'byung gnas mchog /'gro ba'i 'dren pa srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan che/ /khyed kyi zhabs pad bdag sogs spyi bo'i khrir/ /bskal ba rgya mtshor rtag tu brtan par zhu/ /mtshan dpe'i kho lag rdzogs pa'i bde gshegs zhal/ /ma lus kyis kyang mtshon du mi btub pa'i/ /bsod nams me tog phog pa'i rdo rje'i sku/ /g.yo med chos kyi khri la brtan par zhu/ /ma rig mun pa sel ba'i nyi ma dang / /phan bde'i 'od dkar 'gyed pa'i zla ba che//'dod dgu'i yid bzhin 'jo ba'i dpag bsam ljon/ khyed zhabs bstan 'gro'i rgyan du brtan par bzhugs/ /de skad zhu yig rten gyi lha rdzas bcas/ /rnam rgyal dge ldan nyid dang 'dabs 'byor ba'i/ /358

chab shog gi skor tsho bzhugs/bkra shis chos dung dkar po'i do ra nas/ /gus 'bangs chung ngu myu gus dad phyag bcas/ /zla tshes la phul ba'i zhu yig lags/༄ / /don dam dge la don gnyer 'dun pa yis/ /lhag bsam bzang bos lhag par brtson pa can/ /bsod nams che mnga' bsod nams mtha' can gyi/ /dge ba'i bshes de'i dge legs mdun sa cher / /ming don mtshungs par bsam sbyor go log pas/ /mgo log ces grags 'jigs rung srin yul du/ /bro zhabs rtsam pa'i gtsug lag khang 'dzin pa/ /chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes byas mchid 'di gsol/ /rig bzang dad can rgyud du 'khrungs gyur te/ /theg pa chen po'i gling nas yon tan nor/ /gang dgos khur du thog nas dad ldan tshogs/ /dge ba'i mgron du 'bod la bdag yi rang / khyod thugs 'di snang dgra gnyen spos rgya'i ris/ /mi gzigs chags med dge ba'i me tog rtser / /bslab gsum zla 'od dkar bos 'khyud do zhes/ /sgrog pa yid la 'chi med btung ba'i spun/ /nga 'dra las ngan rlung gis bdas nas ni / /lan gcig rnyed pa'i dal rten me tog kyang / /nyes spyod khyi lud spung ba'i mi gtsang rdzab/ /yul ngan phyags dar khrod du skyes 'dis nongs / /de lta na yang rgyal ba'i phrin las ni/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin dus las ma yol te/ /rgyal kun bshes gnyen zol du bsgyur ba 359

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/yi / /rje btsun chos rje'i thugs rje'i phyag gis zin/ /kye ma bzang bo'i skal ba 'di gcig ste/ /de yang ma dag snang ba ltar zhen nas/ /skyon rtog rlung gis 'khyer la khad nye bas/ /kye hud bdag 'dra'i las ngan su zhig yod/ /'khor ba'i chu bo skye 'chi'i rba rlabs can/ /nyon mongs chu srin gdug pas gang ba 'dir/ /rje btsun phyag gis bzung yang phyi phyir du/ /bying ba nga ni thar ba'i re ba dka'/ /kye lags dge ba'i bya bar 'dun pa yis/ /bsod nams zong brgya 'phral 'phral sdud pa can/ /rnam dkar chos kyi bang mdzod khyed lta ba'i/ /mgon dang bcas na phyogs de stong ma gyur/ /thub bstan nyi ma nub rir gzhol pa'i dus/ /snyig sa ma ngan dgu'i rlung dmar 'tshub pa'i khrod/ /chos kyi sgron me sbar ba dka' mod de/ /ston pa'i bka' drin gso phyir 'bad par zhu/ /bslab gsum sbrang rtsi'i khu ba btang ba la/ /sde snod gsum gyi me tog btu dgos shing / /da lta rgyal bstan lung gis 'dzin pa'i dus/ /yin phyir sde snod 'chad pa'i khur bzhes 'tshal/khyad par rgya gar mkhas mang gtsug gi rgyan/ /a ti sha zhes sa skyong lha'i bla mar/ /gsol ba byang chub sems kyi mnga' bdag des/ /bod 'dir bzhag pa skyes bu gsum gyi lam/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang 'brom rje sogs/ /chos 'dis mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i dpal 360

chab shog gi skor tsho bzhugs/mgon tu/ /byin gyis brlabs te dbu ru byang phyogs su/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma yun ring shar ba'i srol/ /phyi dus 'jam dbyangs bla ma tsong kha pas / /bdag gir bzhes te sngar las lhag pa yi/ /mdo rgyud kun gyi nying khu mdzad pa 'dir/ /mchod gral bzhugs pas kho nas yid re skyo / /be'u 'phrang pa'i ba ni ma bzhis par/ /zhag 'gar bskyur ba 'gyod pa'i gnas yin na/ /bstan pa'i btsas 'di mi 'chad mi sgom par / /rang gar bskyur 'di ji lta bu zhig lags/ /dpyad 'jog spel ma'i 'jo theb re res kyang / /mngon mtho'i 'o mngar 'dzad med 'byung ba'i steng / /nges legs mar dang rnam pa kun mkhyen gyi/ /mar gyi nying khu ci 'dod stsol ba'i dpyid/ /chos mchog 'dod 'jo'i ba mo 'di bzhag nas/ /bzlas brjod 'bag 'bug byed sogs lus ngag las/ /snying bo med la mgo bo 'khor ba yi/ /skal ngan rnams la ngo sprod mdzad 'tshal lo/ /srid zhi'i dbul ba sel ba'i nor gcig pu / /rin chen byang chub sems 'di yin no zhes/ /bsgom pa lta ci lan re bshad pas kyang / /theg pa mchog gi bag chags mi 'phel lam / /thog mtha' bar du gal che'i khyad nor che/ /snying rje'i gdugs dkar gcig gi bsil grib tu/ /ngal gso'i rgyal sras re re'i yon tan la/ /smon pa tsam yang zhi bde thob las lhag /de slad rnam 361

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dpyod rdzing bur 'grogs pa yi/ /legs bshad dri bzang 'thul ba'i pad+mo'i zhabs/ /zab rgyas lam rim sbrang rtsis brgyan gyur na/ /skal bzang bung ba cis kyang 'khor zhing 'ong / /yang sgos klu dbang zla ba las 'ong ba'i/ /srid rtsa gcod pa'i ral gri lta ba la/ /dri med rigs pas byi dor byas pa'i gtam/ /mi bral 'jam mgon rjes 'jug ji ltar 'ong / /snang ba btsal na mi rnyed stong bar 'gro/ /stong pa nyid du bzhag kyang sna tshogs snang / /snang stong ro gcig mi bden rdzun po che'i / /sgyu ma'i ltad mo gsung ba gzigs sam ci/ /yod ces byas na gang yang gar yang med/ /med ces byas na ci yang cir yang snang / /yod med las 'das brjod pa'i yul min pa/ /de 'dra ngo mtshar mi brjod rang dbang ci/ /tha snyad gser gyis bris pa kho na yi/ /shes bya'i ri mo gang dang gang yod pa/ /de de tsam zhig ming tsam der bstun nas/ /yod yod smra ba'i yab rje'i lugs bzang 'di/ /brag cha lta bur rjes su zlos tsam yang / /sher phyin zab mo'i rig sngags yin pa'i phyir/ /sdug bsngal zug rngu bskyed pa'i bdag 'dzin smra/ /gsos pa'i sman mchog zla med lags zhes gsungs/ /de slad phyogs de'i mun pa 'joms pa'i slad/ /lhag mthong 'od dkar 'phro ba'i zab rgyas kyi/ /dam chos zla ba cis kyang 'dren mdzad ces/ /dman bus 362

chab shog gi skor tsho bzhugs/thal mo sbyar te gus pas gsol/ /de skad gsol ba'i zhu mched me tog tshogs/ /dad cing dga' ba'i snyim pas yongs blangs te/ /dam pa khyod nyid mchod pa'i phyir 'bul gyis/ /dgyes par bzhes nas slad kyang brtse gzigs mdzod/ /ces zla tshes la snyan mo ri nas lha rdzas bcas gus pas phul/༄7/ /mang thos mkhyen pa'i spyan ras stong g.yo zhing / /theg mchog sprin dkar bzhon pa la bcibs pa'i/ /bde chen zho 'thung rus pa'i mtshon cha can/ /bshes gnyen lha dbang mchog gi khri drung du / /blo bzang rgyal ba'i mdo sngags chos kyi tshul/ /rgya mtsho che las chu thigs lta bu la/ /longs su spyod pa'i gus 'bangs bdag gis ni/ /thal mo sbyar te gdung ba'i glu 'di len/ /yab rje sangs rgyas dngos 'dra yab sras zung / /gdan 'dzoms chos kyi dga' ston gnang ba'i tshul / /dran pa'i mkha' la rtog pas 'dri bzhin du/ /skyo ba'i rgyud mangs rgyud du glu 'di len/ /bsod nams ye shes me shel rdul bsags pas/ /yangs pa'i ljongs kyi rmongs mun sel ba'i gnyen/ /dgyes 'dzum zhal gyi 'od ris 'bum 'gyed pa'i/ /sku mchog nyin mor byed pa bde legs sam/ /brtson 'grus gser gyi zong gis nyos pa yi/ /lnga rig mkhyen pa'i nor bu rin thang can/ /shes 'dod blo 363

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gsal blo gros 'phel ba'i slad/ /rigs pas byi dor byed bzhin bzhugs lags sam/ /sna tshogs snang ba'i rba rlabs nyer bskyod pa'i/ /kun rdzob dug can chu gter nyer brgal nas/ /rnam grol chos nyid nor bu'i gzigs mo la/ /nyin mtshan dal khom med bzhin bzhugs lags sam/ /'di na bsam 'phel nor bu'i gtsug rgyan dag /bor ba'i phongs pas mnar bzhin sdug bsngal mtshor/ /'chi bdag mkha' lding gdug pas ma zos par/ /gyi nar 'khyam zhing gnas pa lags zhes 'khums/ /mtshams zhu/ chos mchog bdud rtsi mngar bo'i btung pa'i rgyun/ /brtse chen phyag gi bum pas cher gnang ste/ /chos ldan dam pa'i skyes bur dbang bskur ba'i/ /yab sras bka' drin shin tu gzhal dka' mod/ /nyon mongs lcags rdul bsags pa'i yol go'i yid / /mdo sngags gdams pa'i tho bos ma thul bas/ /rtogs ngan kha dog sngo nag 'tsher bzhin du/ /deng sang tha mal lus 'dis yid re skyo / /skyo ba'i na bun go su klubs pa yi/ /kun rtog gcong rung mang bo'i yid kyi rdza/ /bdag 'dzin mi srun gdug pa'i drod nyal tshang / /'di 'drar thugs brtses thar ba'i srog sbyin pa'i/ /yang dag dge ba'i bshes kyi mgon ni med/ /chos mthun mig ltos 'cha' ba'i grogs ni med/ /rang la gdeng du khel ba'i lta sgom med/ /de slad 364

chab shog gi skor tsho bzhugs/bdag gi 'gro ba ji ltar 'gyur/ /kye lags yab rje'i sras kyi thu bo lags / /kye lags yon tan nor gyi bang mdzod lags/ /kye lags thugs brtse mtshungs pa med pa lags/ /kye lags ring nas 'dres pa'i mdza' bshes lags/ /rang rgyud lcags kyi gong bu ngam gnag la/ /dug lnga rgya ma'i grangs 'dzin 'di bzhu slad/ /lam rim me dpung kun tu sbar ba la/ /dmigs rnams bud shing mi 'byor gyi nar yod/ /gzhan rgyud ya rabs spyod pa'i ri gzar ngos/ /gyen du 'dren pa'i thabs mkhas shed mong gis/ /gang 'brel don chen las la sbyor ba yi / /gzhan don dgos pa mi ldan gyi nar yod/ /yab rje mchog rnams sangs rgyas bstan la dad/ /bstan la ri mor byed la bdag 'khos chung ske/ /drin chen mchog rnams 'gro phan las la dgyes/ /'gro la phan pa'i bsam sbyor de bas dman/ /kye hud bdag ni sder bzo'i bla ma ste/ /kye hud bdag ni ri mo'i mar me yin/ /rang gi don med gzhan don ga la yod/ /gnyis med khyi rgan nga 'dra gzigs lags sam / /dad gshin dkar bo mi gtsang kho nas 'tsho/ /don med bdag 'dzin gzhan sdang ngu zug byed/ /bzang ngan spyod pa'i dri ro mi phyed pa'i / /blun rmongs khyi rgan nga la thugs rje gzigs/ /sngar zhig dam pa'i chos kyi char phabs kyang / /deng sang bshad sgrub gtsang ma'i chu 365

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rgyun gyis/ /stong ba'i dmu rgod 'dus 'tshogs spyod ngan gyi/ /dri ma brnag par dka' 'dir thugs rjes gzigs/ /sgra tshad rig pa'i rnam 'phrul re res kyang / /gzhung brgya'i bang mdzod phye dang lhan cig tu / /bzo dang gso ba'i snang ba 'bum brdal ba'i/ /dran dbang khyed 'drar rnam kun glo ba dga'/ /nang don gzhung brgya thos pa'i rnam grangs kyis/ /snyigs mas thub bstan chud mi za ba'i gnyen/ khyed 'dras rgyal bstan chad pa'i srog mthud phyir/ /bas mtha'i bstan 'gro nyam thag 'di la dgongs/ khyad par zab gsang chos kyi lag len brgya/ /rdo rje 'chang de'i zhal lung dri ma med/ /blo gros bum par thogs pa khyod lags na/ /byams brtse'i phyag gis gdung ba sol cig gu / /bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i 'phrin las 'od/ /pad rtsa ltar dkar cir yang 'dzin pa yi/ /gang sku zla ba gnyis pa'i cod pan mchog /'phel 'grib med par brtan par bzhugs par zhu/ /de skad gsol 'debs tshig gi nyams 'byin pa'i/ /rang sems skye bo'i glu yi rgyud mangs 'di/ /gsang chen chos kyi slob dpon de yi drung / /dga' dad spro ba'i ngang gis cir yang brdung / /zhes zhu 'degs mtshon rten lha rdzas bcas/ /༄7/ /'jig rten gsum du lha dang mi yi gtso'i/ /'gro ba'i 366

chab shog gi skor tsho bzhugs/mchod sdong gcig bu thub dbang dang / /de yi dam chos snod mchog dge 'dun bcas/ /rin chen gsum gyis khyed la shis pa stsol/ /yangs pa'i ljongs kyi bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon du/ /chos srid 'phrin las gdugs dkar 'dzin pa'i rje/ /dad dam rab brtan theg mchog rigs gnas pa'i/ /mi yi lha de'i gser snyan dog pa'i drung ske/ /blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs kyi/ /mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho mang thos kyang / /lung rtogs yon tan nor bus dbul ba yi/ /dge sbyong gzugs brnyan de yis mchid 'di 'bul/ /legs byas skya rengs shing rtas drangs pa yi/ /mdzad bzang 'od zer 'bum phrag bdal ba'iganyen/ /gang sku nam mkha'i nor bu gnyis pa de / /bsod nams shar ri'i rtse mor gzhol lags sam/ /'di na yab rje sangs rgyas dngos gcig gis/ /bshad sgrub chos kyi re kha brgya bris mod / /snyigs ma'i gdol spyod rlung gis bsu nye tshe/ /srung skyob yol ba khyod la re bzhin mchis/ /mtshams zhu/ ched du gsol ba 'debs pa'i snying bo/ thub bstan lnga brgya phrag drug 'das nye dus/ /phyogs rnams kun tu thub bstan nyam dma' mod/ /srin yul gnyis par ming don mthun pa 'dir/ /bstan pa'i snang ba de bas ches cher bral/khyad par thub bstan nang bcud dge ldan lugs/ /mdo sngags 'od 367

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/brgya 'bar ba'i nyin byed de/ /phyogs zhen byang bstan phug par yib pa yi/ /skal ngan u lu ka rnams mjal dka' bas/ /dge ldan lugs bzang 'dzin pa'i nus bral yang / /dge ba'i phyogs der dad mos ma dor bar/ /dge ldan mkhas pa'i gsung ngag zlos pa yi/ /dge med bdag cag shin tu khas nyen gyur/ /de slad 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po yi/ /phrin las phyogs mthar spel ba'i dar chen zhabs / /rong chen ljags nag pa nas da lta'i bar/ /bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon zam ma chad pa dang / /mchod yon 'brel ba zab mos sbrel ba yi/ /dad dam mi 'gyur dge ba'i srid 'dzin 'di/ /mu tig bstar la brgyus 'dra'i mi dbang rabs/ /de dag rnams la glo ba ches dga' mod/ /da lta dam pa'i thugs bskyed dus babs su/ /shar ba rgyal bstan dbu 'phang 'degs pa'i rje/ /yang dgos 'jam mgon bstan la gces spras can/ /mi yi lha khyod gcam bu min par bsngags / /de phyir khyod kyi phrin las mu khyud stor/ /'dzugs la rangs pa'i yid can kho bo cag /phyogs 'dir rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag lugs / /'dzin pa'i shed mong bstsal te dbugs dbyung mdzod/ /'di na gdol spyod khram pa'i ar jag rgod/ /dbang chen rnams kyang de yi dan rgyab byed/ /gtso 'khor kun kyang sdig las 'ba' zhig gis/ /phyi 368

chab shog gi skor tsho bzhugs/ma phar zhog tshe 'dir phung gyur kyang / /da dung rang srid skyong ba'i che thabs su/ /rlom pa khyi rgan rus pa mur 'dra 'di/ /'jam po'i gsung gis 'jam por gdams pa dang / /drag shul thabs kyis tshar gcod gang 'os kyis/ /yul 'khor gsod gcod las kyi sdug bsngal 'di / /blun rmongs byis pa shed ma phyed 'dra'i las/ /rang sdug rang gis rin gyis nyos pa yi/ /ngan pa'i tshod 'dzin khyed la ma babs sam / /mdor na phyogs 'dis mtshon pa'i yul 'khor kun/ /bde skyid snang bar spyod pa'i thugs bskyed dang / /legs mdzad thabs la mkhas pa'i 'jug pa ni/ /rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs pa lags par 'khums/ /de yi bsod nams 'di dang phyi mar yang / /'byung 'gyur gzhal du med pas khyed dag ste/ /gzhan don khur du 'khyer ba'i theg chen yang / /rang 'phris bral ba'i mdzad pa de 'drar gsungs / /rang srid rgyas sam dpal dang byur gang 'gyur/ /shes par dka' na rang la des ci byed/ /de slad khyed 'dra dam pa'i rigs can gyis/ /gzhan don bsam pa'i go cha bzhes par rigs/ /dman bu cag kyang thugs kyi ze'u 'bru ru/ /bcangs nas dge pa'i gsung 'phros gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /thugs brtse lha chen ral ba las babs te//lugs gnyis rgud pa'i dri ma 'khrud par zhu/ /de skad zhu yig rma bya'i 369

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/zlos gar de/ /gsung bzang 'brug sgra snga phyir bsgrags pa las /dga' ba rnyed nas cir yang bsgyur ba'i gtam/ /lcags yos zla ba'i tshes la snyan ri nas/ /legs rten lha rdzas kyi skyes dang bcas/ chos smra ba'i gzugs brnyan dharma sā raḥzhes bya bas gus spros phul ba lags / / //༄7/ /o swa ste/ thog mar dge ba'i 'dren pa sangs rgyas zhabs / /bar du dge ba skyobs pa dam pa'i chos/ /tha mar dge ba tshogs mchog dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyis bkra shis stsol/ /zhes mchod par brjod pa'i bkra shis me tog gi phreng ba legs par spel te gang zhu bar bya ba ni/ lha dang bcas pa'i ston pa sangs rgyas 'jig rten gyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po de nyid kyis dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor te/ lha mi gtso bor gyur pa'i gdul bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig smin grol gyi lam la bkod cing / de'i dgongs pa 'grel ba la rgyal ba rang nyid kyis lung gis bsngags pa'i shing rta chen po klu sgrub dang thogs med zhabs te/ rgyal pa'i rgyal tshab chen po gnyis kyi rjes su bzung pa 370

chab shog gi skor tsho bzhugs/la brten nas byang chub sems dpa' blo gros mi zad pas zhus pa dang ske/ don dam yang dag 'phags kyis zhus pa'i theg chen gyi drang nges kyi gsung rab gnyis dpyad gzhir byas te ston (rton)rigs bcu drug gis mdo sde drang nges kyis shing rta'i lam srol chen po gnyis kyi sgo nas zab mo lta ba'i lam gyi dgongs pa gsal bar byas shing /sher phyin gyi mdo sde rgya mtsho chen po lta bu'i sbas don nor bu'i phreng ba shes bya mkhyen gsum dang nyams len sbyor bzhi'i 'bras bus chos skur dril te rgya che ba'i shing rta'i srol 'phags pa ma pham pas phyes pa zung 'brel gyi sgo nas rgyal pa'i bstan pa rin po che nyin mo ltar rgyas pa ni/ ji skad du/ bde gshegs gsung rab tshul gnyis shing rta'i srol / /legs par phye ba'i rgyal pa'i bstan pa mchog /sa gsum 'gro na nyi ltar gsal mdzad pa/ /klu sgrub thogs med zhabs la spyi bos 'dud / /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags shing / der ma zad shing rta chen po'i srol 'dzin pa'i mkhas grub nam mkha'i skar tshogs dang / sa yi rtsi shing lta bus 'phags pa'i yul du bstan pa rin po che mi nub ba'i rgyal mtshan bzung ste 'gro ba rnams gnas mthar gyi rgyad pa las bskyabs pa ni/ shing rta chen po'i srol gnyis legs bzung nas/ /'dzam gling blo gsal bye ba'i mig 'byed pa/ /'phags pa lha dang 371

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dpa' po sangs rgyas bskyangs/ /legs ldan 'byed dang zla ba grags pa'i zhabs / /dbyig gnyen zhabs dang blo brtan phyogs glang dang / /chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs sogs 'dzam gling rgyan/ /thub bstan mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i mchog /mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /ces gsungs pa ltar yin la/ 'dzam gling 'di'i yul dbus rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs ri kha ba can zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos yongs su bzung ba'i yul khyad par can gyi ljongs 'dir yang lha btsan po snga phyi'i sku ring la ra sa 'phrul snang dang / bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag sogs bzhengs te mkhan chen shan rak+ṣi ta dang / o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs gdan drangs te mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rgya cher spel te 'phags yul chos kyi rgya mtsho bsil ldan gyi khongs su drangs pas bstan pa snga dar zhes yongs su grags pa dang / rnam gnon tshul gyis parnyi ta chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes dang / 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sku mched gsum/ glang shar gnyis sogs 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po rnams bsam bzhin du bstan pa'i byi dor la phebs pa mang du byung ste mdo sngags yongs rdzogs kyi bstan pa gru bzhi lam me gang zag 372

chab shog gi skor tsho bzhugs/gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam du 'bab pa'i zab rgyas chu bo gnyis 'dres kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa bstan pa phyi dar zhes yongs su grags pa dang / khyad par du ston pa rang nyid kyis 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud du byis pa'i gzugs kyis sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byed par lung bstan pa ltar 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po zhes snyan pa'i ba dan dkar bo srid pa gsum gyi rna ba'i bcud len du gyur pa de nyid kyi zhal bzang mngon par bltams te thub pa'i dgongs pa shing rta chen po gnyis kyis bkral ba'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi lam srol dang / 'phags yul shing rta'i srol 'dzin thams cad kyi mdzad pa bdag gir mdzad de snyigs dus 'dir thub bstan li khri'i gos kyis sa chen po 'di mngon par g.yogs par byas pa ni/ ji skad du/ bstod pa 'jam mgon mnyes pa'i mchod sprin las/ li khri'i chab kyis kun nas bkram pa'am/ /gur gum gsar ba'i dga' tshal khyab pa bzhin/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i sa chen yongs gang ba'i/ /rnam thar 'di la sras bcas rgyal bas bsngags / /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar bstan ba'i nyi ma shar bar mdzad pa ni yongs su grags pa ste/ de lta na'ang bod chen po mdo khams sgang drug gi ya gyal zal mo sgang / (rma smar)gyi stod 'di rgyal 373

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/blon lo paṇa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mdzad pas ma khyab par dmu rgod du lus pa las/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i lung gi dus/ tshul khrims kyi le'u'i dus la bsleb par nye ba 'di tsam na/ 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i sku'i 'khrungs yul dang nye bar slar yang 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid dge sbyong gzhon nu'i sha tshugs kyis rnam par byon te/ gangs can gyi lu sri'i tshal gnyis pa sku 'bum chos sde chen po sogs su gzhung lugs brgal brtags kyis gtan la phabs/ yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtugs/ mdo sngags kyi chos bka' mtha' dag rdzogs par mnos / gdod nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'od zer bye ba'i spro bsdu'i byed po yin kyang / drang don gdul bya 'dul ba'i sgor gyur ba dam pa'i rnam thar gyi yon tan kun phyag len du gnang ste mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyi 'byung gnas su bzhugs pa nas dar klung g.yas su 'bab pa'i 'gram snyan mo ri rdo rje brag gi nye zhol du rnam rgyal dge ldan gyi gtsug lag jo bo rin po che bkra shis dge legs stong 'bar dang bcas sngar med gsar du bzhengs pa bstan 'gro'i bsod nams kyi gzhi rten brtan por byas te/ bshad sgrub bstan pa'i srol chen po'i dbu brnyes par mdzad pa'i skabs 'dir/ mdo sngags kyi chos 374

chab shog gi skor tsho bzhugs/bka' dpag tu med pas bskyangs pa'i gus slob gdan sa khag gnyis kyis/ dpon slob/ sprul ba'i sku/ rgan rim/ dbu mdzad/dge bskos sogs las byed / grwa mang / dpon rim bzhi khag chos mi blon rigs/ yul 'khor gyi skye bo pho mo dang bcas pas lus longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bur bkod de/ thog mar bkra shis pa'i lha gos srid du ring bas sna drangs/ rgyal ba tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku rten rin po che byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ gsung rten tshe dang bsod nams dpag tu med pa'i mdo sde glegs bam/ thugs rten mi mthun pa'i rgyad pa las rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod rten/ bskal ba rgya mtsho'i bar du zhabs zung bkod de dam chos 'dul ba las brtsams pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i gdan/ bzhugs gding bzang phrug las byas pa gcig gser mdog g.yung drung lag sbol gyi gos bzang las byas pa'i bzhugs gdan gcig khebs spu khra bo'i bzhugs gdan gcigayang g.yung gos gser mdog pa'i rgyab yol dar spras can gcig sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i bzang gos g.yung drung ris ser po'i khri khebs gcig phyag na rdo rje dril bu tshad ldan/ gdan sa phan tshun gyi 'dus sde khag gnyis kyis/ bdag cag gi ston pa dang / 'phags 375

pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug chos skyong ba'i rgyal bo chen po bzhi bcas kyis thams cad bskul ba'i bsags sbyangs spel ba'i cho ga khri phrag bla ma dam pa chos 'grub tshang dbur byas pa'i rma nyin srib kyi skye bo mang nas tshe thar khri phrag tshe lha rnam gsum gzungs dung phyur gsum/
nga du ringasgyu/ ba ‘

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ ༄ga /bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo / /de la 'dir rje btsun dam pa chos kyi rgyal po bka' drin 'khor mtha' med pa de nyid kyi zhal snga nas la bstod pa dad pa'i me tog 'thor ba'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba zhig rang gi dad pa'i khams gso ba'i slad du bsgrigs pa las/ thog mar mchod par brjod pa nam mkha' lding la byi'us 'gran pa bzhin sngon gyi lnga rig la mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyi phyag bzhes bzhin sum rkang du byas te zlos gar gyi lugs su bkod pa la/ bla ma sangs rgyas su mdo rgyud mtha' dag nas gsungs la/ gsung ba ltar rigs pas kyang 'grub cing / sangs rgyas ni skyon zad dang yon tan kun ldan du grags mod/ /'on kyang skyon zad tshul dang / yon tan rdzogs tshul dmigs ma phyed na sgra spyi tsam las don ji lta ba bzhin mi 'char bas/ dad pa yang de tsam du zad pa'i phyir sgrib gnyis kyi skyon ngos bzung nas de dag tshul dang / khyad par du sku gsum gyi yon tan rdzogs tshul legs par ngo 'phrod pa zhig byung na/ dad pa mi skye ba'i dbang med pa lta bu gcig 'dug pas/de ltar cung zad mtshon par bsam nas thog mar chos sku dang longs spyod rdzogs sku'i yon tan thun mong dang lhan cig tu brjod pa'i tshig rkang dang bo smras te/ dzñān ma ning gi rtags mtha' can la gsum pa 378

sgra tshad zung du 'brel bar dpyad pa'i sa bon rigs pa'i 'khor lo/phan chad skyes pa'i rtags a thung spyi 'gro ltar drug pa'i ngas byin te su ru bsgyur pas sdeb sbyor dbang bo rdo rje'i ta gcig byung / kā ya skyes pa'i rtags a thung mtha' can la rnam dbye dang bo'i gnyis tshig au byin pas lci ba gnyis dang / tshig phyi mar sbyor rgyu'i dgag tshig yang pa gcig dang bcas pas dbang rdor gyi ta gcig dang / ra dzam la dgag tshig a sbyar ba rnam bcad dang / rnam bcad mtshams sbyor gyis ra ru bsgyur te tshig phyi mar drangs shing gabhār ma ning gi rtags mtha' can la lnga ba 'byung khungs kyi gcig tshig ngasi byin/ ngesi a tra du bsgyur bas dza gcig dang ga gnyis bcas dbang rdor gyi rkang ba gcig rdzogs par grub pa ni/ glenasu'iyosaradza ṅgāshātā/ de thad drang du na/ ye shes kyi sku dag rdul med pa zab pa las/ zhes pa zhig thob cing ske/ sprul sku ni longs sku'i bdag rkyen dang / longs sku ni chos sku rnam par mi rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid yin pas sprul sku rags pa'i 'byung khungs sprul gzhi chos longs sprul gsum ngos 'dzin par 'dod de/ rgya skad du 'byung khungs kyi rnam dbye smras la bod skad du 'og min gyi longs sku nyid gdul bya'i ngor sprul sku'i rnam par snang ba lta bur ston slad rol ba'i tshig sbyar ro/ /sku gsum dngos rgyu tshogs pa gcig gis 'phangs pas rgyu rkyen mtshan nyid par bzhag tu med 379

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/kyang chos sku'i rang mdangs lta bur longs sku dang / longs sku'i zer lta bur sprul sku 'byung bas nyi ma'i 'od zer nyi ma las 'byung bar brjod pa bzhin tha snyad zor yang par byas te de ltar smras so/ /'di'i ye shes ni/ gang zhig shes par bya ba rnams kyi mchog chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa sgra rtog gis ji lta ba bzhin mtshon du mi btub pas smra bsam brjod bral gyi de kho na nyid la ji ltar shes par byed tshul kyang thos byung gi sgra dang / bsam byung gi rtog pas 'jal ba tsam min zhing / de gnyis sngon 'gror byas te sgom byung gi sbyor lam bzhis don spyi'i snang ba yang je srab tu btang nas mthar gnyis su snang ba cung zad tsam gyis kyang bar ma chod pa'i chos nyid rjen par 'jal te mnyam bzhag rang gi ngor spros pa'i zug rngu mtha' dag sangs pa byung yang da dung mnyam bzhag tu de ltar byung ba tsam las med pas bden gnyis res 'jog tu gzigs pa'i gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i bag chags kyi gnyen por tshogs gnyis kyi dpung bsags te gom pas mthar slob lam gyi rgyun mtha' rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bag chags phra mo gtan du bcom ba'i stobs las chos nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa de las slar ldang ba'am bskyod pa'i 'khrul ba'i bag chags med pas nam yang mi ldang / ma ldang na yang 380

sgra tshad zung du 'brel bar dpyad pa'i sa bon rigs pa'i 'khor lo/chos nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa'i ye shes de la yul dang yul can du snang ba'i spros pa tsam yang med bzhin chos can mtha' dag lag mthil gyi ri mo ltar ma 'dres par gsal bar 'jal zhing / gzhan don gyi mdzad pa'ang 'bad med lhun grub tu mnga' ba ni/ ji skad du/ji ltar rdza mkhan stobs chen ldan pa 'dir/ /sogs gsungs pa ltar yin pas ldang yang mi dgos par 'khor ba srid du mnyam par bzhag pa'i shes tshul khyad par ba'i dbang du byas pa'i ye shes shig yin phyir spangs pa la mi 'khrul bas ngo bo nyid sku shugs la bstan cing / ye shes chos kyi sku de ltar dngos su bstan te mtshon pa yin no/ /de lta ba'i ye shes de 'grub pa'i gtan tshigs ni gtso bor/ sangs rgyas rang nyid kyi dpe don gyi gsung rab 'grel bar lung bstan pa'i shing rta chen pos/ bdag las ma yin gzhan las min/ /gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min/ /dngos po gang dag gang na yang / /skye ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes mtha' bzhi'i skye med du gsung ba las / grub pa'i slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas bskyangs dang / zla ba'i zhabs kyis thal 'gyur gyi sgrub byed dang / yang slob dpon chen po legs ldan 'byed dang / shān+ta rak+ṣita sogs kyis rang rgyud kyi sgrub byed kyi rigs pa mang du gsungs pas grub pa'i de kho na nyid de bsgom pas/381

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/rten brtan gom zin 'bad rtsol bskyar ma la ma ltos pa sogs kyi rigs pas mtha' med du 'phel bar sgrub pa'i rnam 'grel gyi rigs pa'i 'gro ba'i thun mong ba dang bcas pas legs par grub tshul gzhung lugs chen mo'i legs bshad kyi dga' ston myong zhing / ji tsam du myong ba de tsam du dang ba dang mos gus kyi rkyen du gyur pa'i phyi nang ma 'jol ba'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis shes pas de 'dra la kha mig yar blta dgos so/ /ye shes kyi sku ni/ theg pa thun mong gi sde snod rnams su phal cher sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku de snga ma'i las nyon gyis 'phangs pa'i sdug bsngal bden pa'i lhag ma dang / de'i dbang gis shākya rnams kha btags pa'i tshe dbu snyung ba dang / zhabs la seng lding gi tshal bu zugs pa sogs rnam smin rang rgyud la yod par bshad kyang —/ de mya ngan las 'das te las nyon gyis mngon par 'du byas pa'i zag pa dang bcas pa'i dngos po spangs pa'i 'og tu zag med kyi dbyings spros pa zhi ba'i bde ba lhur len pa las gzhan don gyi sku gnyis kyis sems can gyi don byed pa'i rab tu phye ba'i rnam bzhag min la/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa ltar na mnyam gzhag tu bden snang gi spros pa gcod thub pa nas rim gyis je zab tu song pa'i sgo nas ma rig bag chags kyi sa la brten nas yid kyi rang bzhin gyi 382

sgra tshad zung du 'brel bar dpyad pa'i sa bon rigs pa'i 'khor lo/lus mtshan dpes brgyan pa rtsol bas mngon du byed pa dang / rim gyis rtsol ba rags pa med par mngon du byas pa'i rgyun rgyun mtha'i rdor ting gis bag chags kyi dri ma phra mo bcom pa'i skad cig gnyis pa nas ye shes dang ngo bo gcig tu grub pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sku longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'khor ba ji srid du g.yo ba med pa'i bdag nyid can du 'gyur ba dang / sku de'i rang bzhin sha khrag gi sku ma yin pa dang / zhal zas kyis 'tsho ba'i sku ma yin pa dang / sku de'i ba spu khung bu re res kyang shes bya thams cad gzigs pa sogs theg chen thun mong du yang shin tu rgyas par gsungs la/ de las kyang zhib par gsang sngags bla med nas zung 'jug gi sku'i rang bzhin dang /sku de ji ltar ye shes kyi sku yin pa'i gnad mthar thug sogs ni zhib cing rgyas par bka' stsal la/ de yang rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi don bshad rgyud chen po lngas legs par bkral ba'i shing rta chen po klu sgrub dang dpal ldan zla ba'i zhabs kyi legs bshad mtshungs pa med pa sgron ma gsal ba sogs na bzhugs pas ming don mthun pa'i mkhas pa mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs la nang byan chud pa re e rnyed bltas nas don gnyer bya ba'i rigs so/ /ye shes kyi sku de sgrub pa'i gtan tshig ni/ dngos 383

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/stobs rjes dpag gis byas rtags kyis sgra mi rtag pa bzhin bsgrub tu yod 'dra yang / gtso bo mdo rgyud spyi dang / bye brag gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa bshad kyi man ngag la brten nas gsung rab kyi dgongs pa mthar thug lon pa zhig gis rnyed pa lags so/ /sku la gnyis tshig sbyar ba ni ye shes dang sku gnyis mtshon pa'am/ sku de la skye 'phags so sor rjes su 'dzin pa'i longs sprul gnyis 'byung ba lta bu mtshon la/de gnyis la thun mong du rdul dang bral ba dang / zab pa'i yon tan yod la/ de yang mdo las/ rdul med rdul bral dpa' bo 'dod chags bral/ /sogs gsung ba ltar rdul dang bral ba'i yon tan ni/ye shes kyi dbang du byas na nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / de'i bag chags la rdul du byas nas de dang bral ba dang / gzugs sku'i dbang du byas te rdul du grub pa'i bem chos kyi mtshan nyid spangs pa ston zhing / zab pa ni/ ye shes ni so so rang gis rig pa'i ye shes yin pas de'i mtshan nyid ji bzhin pa sgra rtog gis yul du byas te mi myong bas de ltar rtogs par dka' ba'i don gyis zab pa dang / gzugs sku ni/ longs sku byang sems pa la gnas pa bden 'dzin gyi spros pa gcod nus pa kho nas chos dbyings rtogs pa'i rgyu mthun pa kho nas mngon sum gyi dngos yul du byed pa las de ltar so so'i skye bos 384

sgra tshad zung du 'brel bar dpyad pa'i sa bon rigs pa'i 'khor lo/'jal bar mi nus pa'i don gyis zab pa dang / sprul sku'i gtso bo mchog sprul yin pas de yang gdul rgyud dag pa'i khyad par kho na'i rjes su 'gro ldog gis mjal bar bya ba las gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i don gyis zab par bzhag ste/ mdor na tshig rkang dang po sprul sku rags pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rnam pa gang las byung ba'i 'byung khungs mtshon pa'i slad du sku gsum gyi rnam bzhag cung zad mtshon par byas pa yin no/ /de nas yang dbang bo rdo rje'i bzhi cha gnyis pa ni/ rang gzhan gyi don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i 'dod dgu zad mi shes pa'i gter chen po dpag bsam gyi ljon pa dang/ bum pa bzang bo lta bus kyang mtshon par dka' ba'i sku gsum gyi bdag nyid chen po de las rang gi bsod nams kyi skal ba dang mthun pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi skyabs bzang po 'di phyi'i bde skyid kyi dga' ston du thob ste rnyed pa legs par rnyed nas skal ba bzang bor gyur pa la mngon par bsngags pa'i zol gyis skyid glu blangs pa'i don la/ rū pa skyes pa'i rtags nges bzung gi don du mi zad pa'i e ba dang mtshams sbyar zhing —/ o dā ri ka ta shra dha'i rtags can nyer bsgyur su sngon ma can gyi mi tra mi zad pa'i bsdu ba'i dbang gis ma ning gi rtags mthar bsgyur 385

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/te ta gnyis dang dza gcig ga gnyis bsgrigs pa ni/rube+ebasla'orakatāsuman+d+ra / de thad sor bsgyur na/ gzugs nyid rags pa dge ba'am legs pa'i bshes/ zhes bya ba zhig thob cing / sprul sku rags pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen sdom brtson ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i rnam par mjal ba 'di ni mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi sku che ba'i yon tan gyis brjid pa lags shing / rū pa rang bzhin la yang 'jug cing o dā ri ka tā che long la yang 'jug pas/ bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus pa'i don du theg chen pos dbang med du tshogs gnyis kyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pas bsgrub pa'i sku gsum gyi bdag nyid de rdzogs par snang mi nus mod/ rang gi bsod nams che chung gi skal ba dang mthun par skyabs bzang bo de'i yon tan gyi bdag nyid che long tsam du mkhas btsun bzang bo'i dpal gyis spras pa'i sdom brtson ngur smrig 'dzin pa zhig rang gi bsam sbyor dge ba'i phyogs su bsgyur ba'i sgo nas phan 'dog pa'i bshes su thob pa ni lha'i mig gis rdul phra rab kyang mthong la/ lha mig sogs med pas de bsags pa'i rags pa'i gong bu kho na mthong ba ltar blo mig ma dag pa bdag lta bus mjal bar nus pa ni sprul sku rags pa 'di tsam yin te/ de ltar bsgrub pa'i lung rigs ni rgyas par lam rim rnams su bzhugs pa 386

sgra tshad zung du 'brel bar dpyad pa'i sa bon rigs pa'i 'khor lo/ltar ro/ /yang dbang bo rdo rje'i rkang ba gsum pa ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen de'i khyad par brjod par 'dod nas/ nyer bsgyur saṃ sngon ma can gyi puṇ+ḍis ta gcig dang / nir nges pa ston pa'i mi zad pa sngon ma can gyi de shes ta gcig dang / dha ra skyes pa'i rtags la bdun pa'i gcig tshig gi ji byin/ bsgrubs pas dhareḥdang / ni dhe:skyes pa'i rtags i thung mtha' can la drug pa'i gcig tshig ngas byin zhing tshig grogs dzaḥdang sbyar/ rnam bcad mtshams sbyar bas dza ga ga ste sum bsngags kyi rkang ba gcig rdzogs pa ni/ saṃ puṇ+ḍanirgashadharanidhe rdzaḥde bsgyur bas/ yongs rdzogs nges bstan 'dzin pa la blo yi gter/zhes bya ba zhig thob cing / de yang 'brom chos kyi rgyal bo'i zhal snga nas / bstan pa thams cad grub bzhi lam gyis 'khyer shes pa nga'i bla ma gsungs pa ltar thal phreng 'ga' res shags la byang ba tsam gyi rtog ge ba'i slob dpon mkhas par grags pa dang / gsang sngags kyi cho ga chos spyod than thun res mi tshe bskyal nas rdo rje 'phred bzung byed pa'i sngags kyi nyams myong can du grags pa tsam min par mdo rgyud mtha' dag gang zag gcig gi nyams len du gung bsgrigs nas thos bsam sgom gsum ngang gis byed cing gzhan yang de ltar 'khrid pa'i bstan 387

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/pa yongs rdzogs kyi bdag po yin tshul rjes su dran te dad pa'i me tog 'thor ba yin no/ /yang dbang rdor gyi yan lag rdzogs par byed pa'i yal 'dab rig byed kyi grangs su rtsen pa ni/ tsuḍa skyes pa'i rtags a thung mtha' can la/ drug pa'i gcig tshig ngasra byin te su ru bsgyur/ nor bu spyi ming rat+na la gnyis pa'i gcig tshig gi e byin/ yurmid drug pa'i rnam dbyes ta ba ru bsgyur ba la/ rkang ba'i skad dod pā da la ḍū rtakhya 'dzin pa'i dbyings la kun bshad kyi rnam dbye smon pa'i don du bdag don gyi skyes bu dang bo'i gcig tshig t+t+waṃ sbyin te byings gnyis brjod pa sogs kyis bhañtsa grub pas tata dza ga ga'i rkang pa rdzogs pa ni / tsutasurat+natab pā dadhalta/ de bsgyur bas/ gtsug gi nor bur khyod kyi zhabs 'dzin gyur cig ces pa thob/ de la kho bo'i kun rtog la mdo rgyud mtha' dag nas rang rang gi bstan tshod ltar gyi nyams su blang bya de ma skyes pa skyed pa dang / skyed pa mi nyams par ring du gnas shing / gnas pa gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i bogs 'byin pa'i bla ma la rag las par nan tan chen pos gsungs/ don gyi dbang de gzigs nas rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang gis mtshon skyes mchog dam pa rnams de kho na gtsigs su che bar mdzad de phyag bzhes kyi gtso 388

sgra tshad zung du 'brel bar dpyad pa'i sa bon rigs pa'i 'khor lo/bor mdzad/ rkyen des mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi mdzod du gyur pa la dpag na rang gis kyang kha mig yar blta zhig mi byed na der zad/ de min 'di nas rten 'brel gyi sna kha ma log pa zhig dgos 'dug pa ni/ po to ba chen pos/ man ngag thams cad bsdus pa'i mgo ni/ /bshes gnyen dam pa mi btang ba yin/ /gsung ba der gda' / rang nyid gcig pur da dung tshe rabs kyi grangs mtha' mi mngon par mtho dman ji ltar rigs par 'gro dgos pas tshe rabs thams cad du theg pa mchog la bkri ba'i grogs bzang bo zhig dgos pa ni/ bzang spyod las/ bdag la phan par 'dod pa'i grogs po dag /bzang bo spyod pa rab tu ston pa rnams/ /de dag dang yang rtag tu phrad par shog /de dag bdag gis nam yang yid mi dbyung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar nges par dgos so snyam nas de ltar snying thag pa nas smon lam du bgyis pa lags la/ kho bo la ni de lta bu'i smon lam re las lhag pa'i mkhas pa'i rtog dpyod/ rtogs ldan gyi nyams myong dang / phyag rdzogs dbu ma'i mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan gang yang med mod/ 'dis kyang nam zhig na 'tshangs snyam pa'i zhe brod cig ni yod lags so/ /de lta bu'i don yid la brnag nas/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i dwangs pa'i ye shes sku/ /rag pa'i gzugs su rol 389

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/ba'i dge ba'i bshes/ /yongs rdzogs thub bstan 'dzin pa'i blo gros gter / /khyod kyi zhabs pad gtsug gi nor bur mchod/ /ces bsgrigs so / /nor bu la las dang bya ba ngo bo tha mi dad pa'i las kyi rnam dbye sbyar te tu yig rar bsdus pa ni nor bu'i gtsug rgyan bzhin du rje btsun mchog de khur du mi lta bar rgyan du 'dzin pa'i dam bca' bzung ba yin la/ /bod skad la 'jam dpal smras pa ni/ man gang zag bye brag pa'i sprul gzhi ngos bzung ba lags so/ /zhes bstod pa dad pa'i me tog 'thor ba'i glu dbyangs kyi mchod brjod sum rkang du byas pa'i don la dpyad pa'i sgo tsam btod pa sgra tshad rigs pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba 'di ni rten 'brel bzang po'i bgyi sgo khyad par can la dmigs nas rje btsun bla ma mchog de'i thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir/rig byed kyi lung gis 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros tshangs sras snyem pa'i sde zhes ming gi cod pan byin pa'i dge sbyong gi gzugs brnyan dharma sa ras bris pa dzayas// //390

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/de yang mdo khams rol chen bco brgyad las/ rma rol dang /smar rol/ rdo rol/ zla rol sogs su gtso bor chags pa'i lcags mo mgo log pa 'di dag yongs grags ltar na phal cher spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bzhi ba'i mjug ste bod rab byung bdun pa tshugs ma thag tsam la khams 'gu kho lung nas gnas spo byas te/ da lta'i mgo log pad+ma rdzong gi sa cha gtso bor gyur ba'i rdo 'dzi smar gsum gyi yul gru bdag gir byas nas ring du ma song ba na/ mgo log phag thar gyi sras su maḥthog bla ma byang chub seng ge'i thugs zin gyi slob bu mkhas shing grub pa'i bdag nyid chen po mgo log bla ma chos 'bum bya ba 'khrungs pas dbu bzung / rim bzhin kur rnying bstan pa'i sgron me kurma yongs 'dzin chen po dang / zhwa nag sku phreng bcu ba mchog sprul chos dbyings rdo rje/ bcu gcig pa chen po ye shes rdo rje/ zhwa dmar bdun pa ye shes snying po/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i yang sprul de ma thag pa mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje/ zhe chen rab 'byams lnga ba kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma sogs gangs can bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag chen por gyur ba dag dang / gzhan yang mkhas pa'i khyu mchog 391

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho/ grub pa'i dbang po gtsang ba byams pa chos 'dzin/ smra ba'i dbang phyug rdo grub bstan pa'i nyi ma/ gtsug lag rtsis kyi nyin byed phyag mdzod byams pa gsung rab/ sman rgyal g.yu thog gnyis pa lha rje stag bla nor bu/ lo rgyus smra ba'i dbang po gyi lung sras po sku mched/ rtsod rigs smra ba'i seng chen 'gya ba a lags mdo sngags/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po khra dge slong tshul khrims dar rgyas/ yongs 'dzin chen po 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros / bstan pa'i nyin byed a rig dge bshes chen mo/ gsang chen bka' babs shar yod grags pa bzang po/ mdo rgyud smra ba gyang sprul don yod rdo rje/ nges pa don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta sku phyogs shing bza' sku phreng /rtsod bral dus babs kyi gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa / rab 'byams gzhung brgya smra ba'i mkhan chen a skong blo bzang rdo rje / theg mchog smra ba'i bka' babs kun bzang bde skyong dbang mo sogs mkhas dbang nor bu'i phreng ba zam ma chad par yul 'dir sku 'khrungs pa'am dus yun ring por bzhugs te mdzad phrin rgya cher bskyangs pa dang / dgon gnas dang dge 'dun gyi 'dus sde dag smra ma dgos/ khyim pa sbra nag pa dag gi khrod du'ang yig tshang lo rgyus gleng ba'i dge thon cing / dpe gtam sgrung rgyud 'chad la mnga' 392

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/brnyes pa/ dkar nag rtsis kyi 'phrul la thogs pa med cing / gso byed sma na gyi lugs la dbang 'byor ba/ ri mo dang yi ge'i bzo rtsal la mdzes byang gi cha khyad du thon pa sogs mang du byung 'dug par brten de dag gis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rig gnas kyi shul bzhag tu gyur ba par ma dang bris ma'i glegs bam du byas pa'ang da lta'i bar mi nyung ba zhig bzhugs yod pa la/ spyir grub mtha'i dbang du byas na yul 'dir snga 'gyur rnying ma ba dang / ri bo dge ldan pa/mnyam med bka' brgyud pa/ rgyal ba jo nang ba sogs bod brgyud nang bstan gyi grub mtha' che rigs phal cher zhig mnyam gnas su bzhugs shing / sa bab kyi dbang du byas tshe'ang mdo khams lho byang 'brel mtshams su chags yod pa sogs kyi dbang gis yul 'di'i rig gnas spyi dang dmangs khrod kyi rig gnas tshun chad la mdo khams rig gnas ma lag gnyis ka 'dres pa las byung ba'i khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod par brten/ myur skyob dang zhib 'jug dpyad gzhi'i rin thang 'gangs che ba zhig yod par gdon mi za/de'i phyir spyir bod kyi rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi bya bzhag la rang ngos kyi nus shugs 'bul ba dang / sgos thun min rang khyad thon pa'i sa gnas rig gnas shul bzhag myur skyob dang dar 393

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/spel byed pa'i kun slong gis bskul te/ nged las khungs nas 'tshol bsdu sgrig gsum gyi bya ba yun ring spel mthar dpe rnying mi nyung ba zhig lag son byung ba las bdams pa brgyud/ (mgo log sa khul mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs dpe tshogs〉zhes pa zhig bsgrigs nas rim par dpe deb skor zhig par du skrun par rgya che'i klog pa po dag gi gdeng 'jog legs po dang 'brel yod sde khag gi gzengs bstod thob/ rting skul de dag gi rmang gzhi'i steng(krung go'i grangs nyung mi rig gna' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lag star byed pa'i go skabs dang bstun te nga tshos rim pa sngar las spags te/ slar yang mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉kyi par skrun jus gzhi gsar ba zhig bzos nas khul srid gzhung dang 'brel yod mgo khrid la yar zhu byas pas rgyab skyor dang khas len legs par thob par brten da lta jus gzhi dngos su lag star byed pa'i skal ba legs po thob/de la 'dir dpe tshogs〉'di nyid 'tshol sdud dang dag sgrig rtsom sgrig par skrun bcas kyi skor gsal bshad du 'os pa 'ga' zhig zhu ba 'di lta ste/1 nga tshos bya ba 'di spel ba la mgo log khul u dang / khul 394

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/dmangs chen/ khul srid gzhung / khul srid gros bcas 'go khrid tshan skor che bzhi dang 'brel yod sde khag gi 'gan 'khur ba las grub pa'i ched don 'go khrid tshan chung btsugs thog 'brel yod don bya gang ci'i thad bka' skor snyan seng zhus pa'i dgongs don ltar bsgrubs pa yin la/ ched dmigs bya ba'i jus gzhi yig thog nas khul mi dmangs srid gzhung la zhus te chog mchan thob cing brgyud spel gnang ba dang bstun pa sha stag yin/ dus mtshungs su ma phyi'i yig rnying yod tshad so so'i 'brel yod gnyer bdag dang chos bdag dgon bdag sogs brgyud de tshul ldan lugs mthun sgos 'tshol sdud byas shing / khong tshor gros zhu byas te par skrun byed par thugs mthun yid 'thad byung ba yin la/ rgyun srol lam gsang ba sngags dang 'brel ba sogs kyi dbang gis bka' dog dgos min dag kyang khong tsho'i dgongs 'dod bka' 'khrol dang bstun pa ma gtogs nged cag gi lag tu gang son ltar gzu lum sger gcod byas pa gcig kyang med/2 mthun rkyen 'byor ba'i gnas bab 'og gsung 'bum gcig la'ang bris ma dang par ma'i ma phyi ci rnyed cig nye bar bsdus te phan tshun bsdur gshib sgos gang rgyas shos kyi rmang gzhi'i steng gzhan las kha bskangs shing / dmangs khrod du kha 'thor du bzhugs pa'i thor bu 395

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/dag kyang lag tu ci 'ong gis gsab snon byas yod pas/ so so'i gsung 'bum gang la mtshon na'ang mig snga ltar na da lta'i dpe tshogs〉 'dir 'khod pa kho na kha tshang shos dang rgyas shos su brtsi chog snyam/3 gsung chos go rim sgrig stangs skor la sngon gyi ma phyi gang legs shos su snang ba de'i sgrig stangs gzhir bzhag gi rmang gzhi'i steng gcig 'gyur dang dgos dbang sogs la gzhigs te rtsom sgrig pa nas las babs kyi 'gan dbang spyad de 'os 'tsham gyi skyar sgrig dang slar sdeb kyang byas yod/4 ma phyi phal cher la dpe chod yang yang bgyis la tshad ldan gyi par gzhi med pa sogs kyi dbang gis yi ge mi dag cing / chad lhag shor ba/ go rim 'chol ba/ ma yig mi gsal ba sogs cung mang ba la rang blos lcigs pa 'khrul med du snyam pa dag legs par bcos shing dag par bsgrigs la/ dogs gzhir mthong ba du ma zhig gzigs pa yangs shing de phyogs su nang rgyus che ba'i mkhas pa du mar drung bcar bka' 'dri yang yang byas te dogs pa chod pa dag de bzhin du bcos/ re zhig khungs lung mi gsal zhing dpog par dka' ba re zung 'dug pa phyis kyi dpyad gzhir zin bris su bgyis 396

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/thog 'ol tshod kyis ma bcos shing dpyad yams la ma 'jus par ma phyi sor 'jog byas shing / 'ga' zhig la yin shas che bar 'dod pa'i yi ge de zur gyi zla khyim du bkod yod/5 klog bde bar gzhigs te gsung chos bye brag pa phal mo cher mdzad byang sogs las dras te kha byang bkod cing / sa bcad blangs la / ldeb byang yang bye brag tu bkod yod/6 ba zur 'dogs min lta bu sogs yi ge skor zhig gi bkol stangs da lta'i dag yig 'ga' zhig dang gcig tu mthun min yod kyang mkhas pa tshad ldan gyi phyag rgyun la thar chags su yod phyin khungs lung re yod srid la phyis su dag yig zhib dpyod pa dag gi dpyad gzhir nye bar mkho yang srid snyam nas ji bzhin sor 'jog byas/gzhan yang ma yig tu skabs 'gar mkhas pa gzhan gyi gsung thung ngu tsam re yongs su drangs 'dug pa zhib par dpyad tshe gong 'og gi gsung gang rung re de'i zur rgyan nam gsal 'don ci rigs su song ba sogs 'brel shin tu che bas dgos dbang la gzhigs nas 'dir yang ma yig ltar bkod pa lags/bye brag snyan dgon sprul ba'i sku mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho tshang gi gsung chos phal mo che da reb lag tu son pa ltar 'dir bkod 397

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/yod la/ de yang phal mo che glo bla ka dag tshang gi phyag bris ma phyi dag par mthong ba de ltar bkod pa yin cing / der ma 'khod pa gzhan nas kha gsab bgyis te legs par bsgrigs pa yin mod/ bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi skor zhig dang phyis su mdzad pa'i shol ka re gnyis re zhig 'dir 'god pa'i rngo ma thogs/ gsung rtsom gyi ma phyi 'tshol sdud dang par zhu sogs kyi thad mchog sprul tshe ring bsam 'grub tshang dang che bos 'jigs rdor sogs nas thugs khur ram 'degs dang sku tshegs 'o brgyal mang du mdzad song bas 'dir snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhu/mtshams 'dir slebs tshe nga tshos cis kyang dran yul du bslang bar 'os pa ni dpe tshogs〉'di nyid la thog mtha' gang rung du thugs khur rgyab skyor khyad du gnang zhing 'di nyid kyi ched du sku tshegs 'o brgyal mdzad pa'i 'brel yod 'go khrid dang mkhas dbang blo mthun gyi tshogs dag yin te/ khong cag rnam pa'i rgyab skyor jogs ram dang bral phyin dpe tshogs〉'di nyid klog pa po dag gi spyan lam du gzigs mor spro ba'i de ring gi skal ba bzang po 'di nyid nyams par 'gyur bas/ nga tshos khong rnam par lhag bsam dag pas bka' drin zhu ba lags/ lhag par du dpe tshogs)'di nyid 'tshol 398

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/sdud dang / dag sgrig par skrun sogs gang ci'i thad thugs khur dang phyag ston bla lhag gnang zhing / gnad don du ma'i 'gag mdor gyur ba par skrun ma dngul gyi mthun rkyen sbyor ba'i cha nas bka' drin khyad du thon cing mdzad rjes kun las lhag pa ni khul u'i hru'u ci gzhon pa khul gna' rtsom dpe tshogs 'tshol sdud dag sgrig par skrun 'go khrid tshan chung gi tshan gtso sku zhabs pad ma rnam rgyal lags yin pas rang re 'brel yod mi rabs snga phyi kun nas khong gi bka' drin yid la 'chang zhing rjes su dran par 'os zhes 'di gar ched du gsal 'debs zhus pa lags/ de bzhin rdzong gtso smug lo lags nas kyang sa gnas mi rigs rig gnas phyogs dgongs klong yangs la spyod pa mdzangs pa'i bka' drin bstsal ba mdzad pa dge ba'i phyag rjes su che/gzhan yang zi khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang bod yig rtsom sgrig khang nas nga tshor phyogs gang ci'i thad bla na med pa'i mthun rkyen bskrun cing mi rigs rig gnas la gcig tu brtse ba'i lhag bsam dkar pos phyogs du ma nas dmigs bsal chen po'i mdzad pa bskyangs pas dngos gnas bka' drin che zhu/ lnga rig mkhas pa'i dbang po bshes gnyen chen po ngag dbang bde legs rab rgyas nas(dpe tshoṭa〉'di la thugs khur sku tshegs kyi mdzad pa bzhes shing /399

sprul sku gsung rab kyi gsung 'bum/gsung chos sam mdzad pa po so so la 'brel yod kyi dgon sde bla sprul rnam pas rang ngos kyi mthun rkyen sbyar ba'ang rang re klog pa po dang bcas pas yid la bsrel bar 'os pa nyid do/ /mjug mthar ched du zhu bya ni/ nga tshor gna' rtsom rtsom sgrig par skrun gyi nyams myong zhan cing / dag sgrig par zhu byed pa'i chu tshad dma' la/ dus tshod kyis gtug cing las brel che ba sogs kyi rkyen gyis dpe tshogs la nor 'gal gyi cha yod nges yin pas/ rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnam par thugs dkrugs dwangs zhu dang 'brel phyi phyir sman pa'i yo bcos dgongs 'char la'ang bsri ba med par 'tshal/ /zhes mgo log khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang nas/2003lo'i zla10tshes8la/400
